Reviews various presentations of testicular seminoma and importance of recognizing varied clinical manifestations.

title: Pediatric Spine Ultrasound: Comprehensive Review and Systematic Approach.
title_ja: 小児脊椎超音波:包括的レビューと体系的アプローチ
summary_ja: 小児脊椎超音波の総合的レビュー。先天性腫瘍として仙骨尾骨teratoma（germ cell tumor）を含む適応症をカバー。小児脊椎病態、特にGCTの評価と管理のための詳細な超音波画像診断と超音波ガイド法を提供。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric spine ultrasound techniques and interpretation. Covers indications including congenital tumors like sacrococcygeal teratomas (germ cell tumors). Provides detailed sonographic anatomy and ultrasound-guided approaches for evaluating and managing pediatric spinal pathology including GCTs.

title: Appraising the causal role of cathepsins in genitourinary carcinoma: a two-sample mendelian randomization and prospective study based on 36,225 individuals.
title_ja: 生殖泌尿器系癌におけるカテプシンの因果的役割の評価:36,225人の個人に基づいた2標本メンデリアンランダム化と前向き研究
summary_ja: 血清カテプシンレベルと泌尿生殖器がんの因果関連性をメンデルランダム化法で調査。カテプシンBが精巣非セミノーマと正の関連を示す。UK Biobankで検証。
summary_en: This Mendelian randomization study investigates causal associations between serum cathepsin levels and genitourinary carcinomas. Cathepsin B is positively associated with testicular non-seminoma, while cathepsin L2 shows protective effects. Findings were validated using UK Biobank data of 36,225 individuals.

title: Oncologic and fertility outcome in patients with advanced stage ovarian immature teratomas.
title_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫患者における腫瘍学的および妊孕性転帰
summary_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫患者17例の後方視的研究。76.5%が妊孕性温存手術を、82%が補助化学療法を施行。中央値237ヶ月のフォローアップで全例無病生存、FSS例の46%が妊娠達成。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 17 patients with advanced-stage ovarian immature teratomas. Most underwent fertility-sparing surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy. Despite advanced disease, all patients survived without evidence of disease. Fertility-sparing surgery proved safe and effective, with 46% achieving pregnancy.

title: Cornual Epithelioid Trophoblastic Tumor: A Report of a Rare Case and Literature Review.
title_ja: 角部類上皮栄養膜腫瘍：稀な症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 38歳サウジアラビア女性の角部子宮外妊娠が類上皮栄養膜腫瘍と診断。メトトレキサート治療後も高β-hCGが続いたため、外科的切除と多剤化学療法で正常化達成。
summary_en: Case report of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), a rare form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm, from cornual ectopic pregnancy. Despite initial methotrexate treatment, the patient required surgical intervention and multi-agent chemotherapy for β-hCG normalization, achieving successful treatment.

title: Malignant transformation of an ovarian mature teratoma diagnosed 17 years ago: a case report and literature review of treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
title_ja: 17年前に診断された卵巣成熟奇形腫の悪性転化：症例報告と免疫チェックポイント阻害薬による治療の文献レビュー
summary_ja: 17年前診断の卵巣成熟奇形腫が悪性転化し扁平上皮癌となった69歳女性。手術、パクリタキセル・カルボプラチン化学療法、ニラパリブ維持療法、ペムブロリズマブ免疫療法で治療され部分奏効達成。
summary_en: Case report of 69-year-old woman whose ovarian mature teratoma underwent malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma after 17 years. Treatment included surgery, chemotherapy (paclitaxel/carboplatin), niraparib, and pembrolizumab immunotherapy, demonstrating partial response.

title: Cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for Pseudomyxoma peritonei originating from ovarian teratomas: A single-center case series and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来の腹膜偽粘液腫に対する減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法の併用：単一施設症例集積と文献レビュー
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者4例を減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法で治療した後方視的研究。最適減量未達成だが、高グレード例を除き良好な術後転帰を示した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of four patients with pseudomyxoma peritonei originating from ovarian mature teratomas treated with cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy. All underwent CRS with HIPEC; high-grade PMP showed poorer prognosis. CRS with HIPEC is safe and effective for this complication.

title: SMARCB1-deficient poorly differentiated testicular carcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: SMARCB1欠損低分化精巣癌:症例報告
summary_ja: SMARCB1欠損の未分化精巣癌の初報告例。多剤治療にも関わらず予後不良。
summary_en: Case report of 36-year-old male with SMARCB1/INI1-deficient poorly differentiated testicular carcinoma showing mixed embryonal carcinoma or seminoma features. Despite multimodal therapy including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and immunotherapy, patient died 11 months post-surgery.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 10-year-old-female: a rare case report from Nepal.
title_ja: 10歳女児の仙尾部奇形腫:ネパールからの稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 10歳女児の仙尾骨部奇形腫症例。進行性仙骨部腫脹で発症。手術で治癒。
summary_en: Case report of 10-year-old girl with sacrococcygeal teratoma presenting with progressive sacral swelling, fever, pain, and discharge for 2 weeks. MRI confirmed complex infra-coccygeal mass. Surgical resection performed with good outcome, highlighting importance of early diagnosis.

title: Incidental Discovery of Persistent Müllerian Duct Syndrome in a Male With Bilateral Cryptorchidism and a Testicular Germ Cell Tumor: A Rare Case Report.
title_ja: 両側停留精巣および精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する男性における遺残ミュラー管症候群の偶然発見：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 24歳男性で両側停留精巣および左精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。偶然に遺残ミュラー管症候群が発見され、術後腫瘍マーカー正常化で6ヶ月後に再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old male with bilateral cryptorchidism and mixed germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor, seminoma, teratoma) of left testis. Incidental finding of persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. Post-operative tumor markers normalized within one month with no recurrence at six-month follow-up.

title: Pathological complete response with cocktail chemotherapy in mediastinal seminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマにおけるカクテル化学療法による病理学的完全奏効
summary_ja: 40代男性の大型前縦隔セミノーマで左迷走神経麻痺を伴う症例。導入療法エトポシド/シスプラチン後の交互化学療法で病理学的完全奏効と完全切除を達成した。
summary_en: Case report of man in his 40s with large anterior mediastinal seminoma causing phrenic nerve involvement. Treated with induction etoposide/cisplatin followed by alternating PEB regimen, achieving pathological complete response after chemotherapy and complete surgical resection.

title: Single-Port Robot-Assisted Post-Chemotherapy Unilateral Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection: Feasibility and Surgical Considerations.
title_ja: 単一ポートロボット支援化学療法後一側後腹膜リンパ節郭清：実行可能性と外科的考慮事項
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する単一ポートロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初例。病理検査で未熟奇形腫とリンパ節炎症が確認され、6ヶ月後に無病生存を達成した。
summary_en: First European case report of single-port robotic-assisted RPLND in 41-year-old with non-seminomatous testicular GCT. Pathology revealed immature teratoma and benign lymph nodes. Patient achieved disease-free status at six months with normal tumor markers and stable renal function.

title: Paraneoplastic Leucine Zipper 4 IgG Associated Motor-Predominant Polyradiculoneuropathy.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍症候群Leucine Zipper 4 IgG関連運動優位多根神経根炎
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに関連するLUZP4-IgG関連傍腫瘍性神経症候群。化学療法後も免疫療法が必要で改善。
summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old with testicular seminoma and LUZP4-IgG seropositivity presenting with motor-predominant polyradiculoneuropathy. Despite orchiectomy and chemotherapy, patient required aggressive immunotherapy with cyclophosphamide, eventually showing significant improvement in hand strength.

title: Standard-Dose Versus High-Dose Cisplatin for Intermediate/Poor-Risk Extracranial Malignant Germ Cell Tumors: Re-Analysis of Pediatric Oncology Group 9049 and Children's Cancer Group 8882 Trial Using Updated MaGIC Risk Stratification.
title_ja: 中間/低リスク頭蓋外悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準用量対高用量シスプラチン:更新MaGICリスク分類を用いたPOG9049およびCCG8882試験の再解析
summary_ja: GCT治療の臨床試験の再解析。高用量と標準用量シスプラチンの効果に差なし。
summary_en: Re-analysis of POG9049/CCG8882 trial examining high-dose versus standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy for intermediate/poor-risk extracranial GCTs using updated MaGIC stratification. No significant difference in 5-year event-free or overall survival between treatment groups.

title: Pembrolizumab and olaparib in a cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer patient with a high TMB: first case report.
title_ja: シスプラチン耐性精巣がん患者におけるペムブロリズマブとオラパリブ:最初の症例報告
summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者にペムブロリズマブとオラパリブで治療した初の症例報告。高PD-L1発現と高腫瘍遺伝子変異負荷に基づいて治療が選択された。ペムブロリズマブ開始4週以内にβ-hCGの顕著な低下が見られたが、その後再び増加し、免疫関連肺炎により患者は死亡した。
summary_en: First case report of cisplatin-refractory extragonadal non-seminomatous GCT (choriocarcinoma) treated with pembrolizumab and olaparib based on high PD-L1 expression and tumor mutational burden. Despite initial β-hCG decrease, patient developed immune-related pneumonitis with fatal outcome.

title: Extragonadal immature teratoma of the uterus.
title_ja: 子宮の性腺外未熟奇形腫
summary_ja: 膣出血で来院した27歳未産婦女性における子宮性腺外未熟奇形腫症例報告。卵巣保存を伴う全腹腔鏡下子宮摘出術および補助化学療法レジメン(BEP)で治療。胚細胞腫瘍に対する生殖保存的治療アプローチの成功例を示した。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old nulliparous woman with extragonadal immature teratoma of uterus presenting with vaginal bleeding. Treated with total laparoscopic hysterectomy with ovarian preservation and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. Demonstrates successful fertility-sparing approach for extragonadal GCT.

title: Oxidative stress markers 8-OHdG, Trx-1, and Prx6 are expressed in seminoma and are connected to TXNDC2, 3, and 6 expression levels.
title_ja: セミノーマにおける酸化ストレスマーカー8-OHdG、Trx-1、およびPrx6の発現とTXNDC2、3、6発現レベルとの関連
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ25例の酸化ストレスマーカー（8-OHdG、Trx-1、Prx6）とチオレドキシンレベルを検討した免疫組織化学研究。セミノーマは正常精巣と異なるマーカー発現パターンを示した。Trx-1とTXNDC6過剰発現がセミノーマ生物学に関連の可能性。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 25 testicular seminomas examining oxidative stress markers (8-OHdG, Trx-1, Prx6) and thioredoxin levels. Found distinct expression patterns in seminomas compared to normal testis. Trx-1 and TXNDC6 overexpression may be relevant to seminoma biology.

title: Papillary thyroid carcinoma and strumal carcinoid transformations of a mature cystic teratoma with NRAS codon 61 mutation: A case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と甲状腺ストルマカルチノイドの同時悪性転化の症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と甲状腺ストルマカルチノイドの同時悪性転化の稀な症例。次世代シーケンシング検査で両悪性成分にNRAS codon 61変異が認められた。単一奇形腫での両悪性腫瘍の共存は世界で6例目。
summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma with simultaneous papillary thyroid carcinoma and strumal carcinoid transformation. NGS revealed NRAS codon 61 mutations in both malignant components. This is only sixth reported case of coexisting these two malignancies in single teratoma.

title: A case of neonatal gastric teratoma complicated with occult gastrointestinal hemorrhage misdiagnosed as lymphangioma.
title_ja: リンパ管腫と誤診された潜在性消化管出血を伴う新生児胃奇形腫の症例
summary_ja: 潜在性消化管出血による重度の貧血を呈した新生児男児の胃未熟奇形腫症例。リンパ管腫と誤診されたが、石灰化と脂肪を含む大きな嚢胞固形腫瘤を確認。外科的切除を施行し、病理診断は1級未熟奇形腫。術後発達は良好で合併症なし。
summary_en: Case report of 28-day-old boy with neonatal gastric immature teratoma presenting with anemia from occult gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Large cystic-solid mass contained calcifications and fat. Surgical resection performed; pathology confirmed grade 1 immature teratoma. Post-operative development normal.

title: Research Progress in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors for Relapsed and Refractory Malignant Gonadal Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性の悪性性腺胚細胞腫瘍に対する免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の研究進展
journal: Zhongguo Yi Xue Ke Xue Yuan Xue Bao
summary_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性性腺胚細胞腫瘍における免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の免疫機構および臨床有効性をまとめたレビュー。症例報告と臨床試験を検討し、免疫療法の有効性を評価し、臨床実践の参考資料を提供する。
summary_en: Review article summarizing immune mechanisms and clinical efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in relapsed and refractory gonadal germ cell tumors. Examines case reports and clinical trials to assess effectiveness of immunotherapy, providing reference for future clinical practice.

title: Multidisciplinary Management of an Anterior Skull Base Teratoma in a Neonate.
title_ja: 新生児の頭蓋前底部奇形腫の学際的管理
summary_ja: 新生児女児が鼻咽頭へ延伸した稀な成熟頭蓋前底部奇形腫の症例。胎児手術による準備、経鼻腔内切除、および2段階の形成再建手術を施行。3年のフォローアップで再発なく神経学的欠損も認めず、鼻唇領域の最適な美容的転帰を達成。
summary_en: Case report of neonatal girl with rare mature skull base teratoma extending into nasopharynx. Managed with fetal surgery preparation, endoscopic resection, and 2-stage plastic reconstruction. Three-year follow-up shows no recurrence and optimal cosmetic outcome without neurological deficits.

title: A Breathtaking Case of Chemotherapy-Induced Pneumonitis.
title_ja: 化学療法誘発性肺炎の症例報告
summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者において胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法レジメンに用いられるエトポシド誘発性肺炎の稀な症例を報告。化学療法剤による肺毒性の診断は重要であり、化学療法中の急性呼吸不全を呈した患者では本疾患を鑑別診断に含めることの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of etoposide-induced pneumonitis in metastatic seminoma patient. Documents rare pulmonary toxicity from chemotherapy agent used in germ cell tumor treatment, highlighting diagnostic importance during acute respiratory failure.

title: Oncologic outcomes of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection following first-line chemotherapy for metastatic non-seminomatous germ-cell tumors.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清の腫瘍学的転帰
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清に関する大規模研究。病理学的予後、生存率を評価し、残存腫瘍サイズと原発腫瘍組織型が外科手術適応判定の予測因子であることを示した。
summary_en: Large-scale study of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in metastatic NSGCT. Evaluated pathologic outcomes, survival rates, and identified predictive factors including residual mass size and primary tumor histology for surgical decision-making.

title: Case Report: Prepubertal-type testicular teratoma with local metastasis in a postpubertal patient.
title_ja: 症例報告：思春期後患者における思春期前型精巣奇形腫の局所転移
summary_ja: 思春期後男性における転移性精巣成熟奇形腫の初報告。12p異常とGCNISを欠く成熟奇形腫が転移性を有する可能性があり、従来の分類パラダイムに反することを示唆している。
summary_en: First case report of metastatic mature testicular teratoma in postpubertal patient. Demonstrates that pure mature teratomas lacking chromosomal 12p abnormalities and GCNIS may possess metastatic potential, contrary to current classification paradigms.

title: Diagnostic value of magnetic resonance imaging for malignant ovarian tumors mis-subclassified by the ultrasound-based ADNEX model.
title_ja: 超音波ベースADNEXモデルで誤分類された悪性卵巣腫瘍に対する磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の診断価値
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む卵巣悪性腫瘍のMRI診断研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫など多様な組織型を対象に、超音波ベースのADNEXモデルで誤分類された症例におけるMRI画像特徴を分析し、診断精度の向上を検討した。
summary_en: MRI diagnostic study of ovarian malignancies including germ cell tumors (GCT, YST, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma). Analyzed imaging features in cases misclassified by ultrasound ADNEX model to improve diagnostic accuracy.

title: PGC7 maintains the pluripotency of F9 embryonic carcinoma cells by promoting Nanog translation.
title_ja: PGC7はNanog翻訳促進によってF9胎児性癌細胞の多能性を維持する
summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞（胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株）におけるPGC7機能の検討。PGC7がAKT1を介したYBX1のリン酸化を増強することでNanog mRNA翻訳を促進し、胚細胞の幹細胞多能性を維持する分子メカニズムを明らかにした。これは胚細胞腫瘍生物学ならびに幹細胞多能性維持機構の理解に重要である。
summary_en: Study of PGC7 function in F9 embryonic carcinoma cells, a GCT-derived cell line. Investigated molecular mechanisms of pluripotency maintenance through Nanog translation regulation, relevant to understanding GCT biology.

title: Somatic Malignancies Arising in Ovarian Mature Cystic Teratomas: A Multi-Institutional Study of 40 Cases Highlighting Outcomes and Novel Malignancies.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生する体細胞悪性腫瘍：40症例の転帰および新規悪性腫瘍を強調した多施設研究
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の二次性悪性腫瘍に関する大規模多施設研究。40例を分析し、進行期腫瘍で予後不良を示すことから、丁寧な組織採取と長期追跡の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: Large multi-institutional study of somatic malignancies arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas (MCT). Identified 40 cases with various histologies; poor outcomes primarily in advanced-stage tumors, emphasizing need for thorough sampling and long-term follow-up.

title: The post-orchiectomy systemic inflammatory index is associated with tumor characteristics in clinical stage I germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術後全身炎症指数は臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍特性と関連している
summary_ja: 臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍患者159例を対象とした後方視的研究。精巣摘除術後の全身炎症指数はリンパ管侵襲および腫瘍病期と関連し、リスク層別化を改善する可能性がある。予後バイオマーカーとしての新たな関連を初めて明らかに。
summary_en: Study of systemic inflammatory index (SII) and LDH as prognostic biomarkers in clinical stage I germ cell tumors. Identified associations with tumor characteristics and lymphovascular invasion, potentially improving risk stratification for adjuvant treatment decisions.

title: Novel therapeutics in refractory germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍における新規治療法
summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍の新規治療法に関するレビュー。チロシンキナーゼ阻害薬、CAR-T細胞療法、BiTE、抗体医薬複合体など、救援化学療法抵抗性患者への新規治療を概説している。
summary_en: Review of novel therapeutics in refractory germ cell tumors. Discusses emerging treatments including tyrosine kinase inhibitors, CAR-T cell therapies, BiTE, and antibody-drug conjugates for patients resistant to salvage chemotherapy.

title: Prenatal exposure to organochlorine pesticides and polychlorinated biphenyls and risk of testicular germ cell cancer later in life.
title_ja: 出生前のオルガノクロリン農薬およびポリ塩化ビフェニル曝露と後年の精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスク
summary_ja: 妊娠中の有機塩素系農薬とPCB曝露が精巣胚細胞癌リスクに及ぼす影響を調査した症例対照研究。妊娠血清中の化学物質濃度と後年のTGCC発症リスク間に有意な関連は認められなかった。
summary_en: Nested case-control study of 332 mother-son pairs investigating prenatal organochlorine pesticide and PCB exposure as risk factors for testicular GCC. Found no significant association between chemical exposure and TGCC development.

title: Exploring the therapeutic effect of melatonin targeting common biomarkers in testicular germ cell tumor, prostate adenocarcinoma, and male infertility: an integrated biology approach.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、前立腺腺癌、および男性不妊症の共通バイオマーカーを標的とするメラトニンの治療効果の探索：統合生物学的アプローチ
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略としてメラトニンの効果を検討した統合生物学研究。TGCT、前立腺癌、男性不妊の共通遺伝子を同定し、メラトニンとDDX3Yの結合親和性が有望であることを示した。
summary_en: Integrated biology study exploring melatonin as therapeutic agent targeting common biomarkers in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT). Identified shared genes among TGCT, prostate cancer, and male infertility; melatonin showed promising binding to DDX3Y.

title: Dermoid cyst associated with segmental multicystic renal dysplasia: A rare case.
title_ja: 区分性多嚢胞性腎形成異常に伴う類皮嚢腫：稀な症例
summary_ja: 4歳男児の多嚢胞性異形成腎内に発見された腎類皮嚢腫の症例報告。出生後の継続的な超音波検査で嚢腫の急速な増加を検出し、右上極腎摘除術を施行。腎内奇形腫などの稀な疾患検出における継続的な画像フォローアップの重要性。
summary_en: Case report of intrarenal dermoid cyst (teratoma) within segmental multicystic renal dysplasia in 4-year-old. Demonstrates importance of thorough imaging follow-up for detecting rare extragonadal teratomas requiring surgical intervention.

title: Ganglioglioma in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: Case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の神経膠腫：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた神経膠腫の稀な症例報告。腹腔鏡下卵巣切除により完全に切除され、12ヶ月フォローアップで良好な予後が得られた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の神経膠腫の発生は極めて稀であり、組織学的診断が重要。
summary_en: Rare case of ganglioglioma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma. First detailed description of neuroectodermal tumor within MCT showing favorable prognosis with surgical resection; highlights need for careful histologic evaluation of teratomas.

title: A Case Report of Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor (NMDAR) Encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。30歳の女性患者が精神病症状、感情不安定性、睡眠障害などの複雑な神経精神医学的症候群を呈し長期の集中治療が必要であった。脳脊髄液抗体検査により確定診断され、自己免疫性脳炎における腫瘍切除の診断および治療上の重要性を強調する。
summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma. Describes psychiatric and neurological presentation with diagnosis by CSF antibody testing and importance of teratoma removal in immune-mediated neurological disease.

title: Comprehensive analysis of calcification frequency and patterns in ovarian tumours using non-contrast CT.
title_ja: 造影なしコンピュータ断層撮影を用いた卵巣腫瘍における石灰化頻度およびパターンの総合的分析
summary_ja: 非造影CTを用いた卵巣腫瘍の石灰化パターン分析研究。胚細胞腫瘍は高い石灰化頻度を示す一方、転移性腫瘍は石灰化を示さない。未熟奇形腫は点状・線状・粗石灰化の混合パターンを特徴とする。組織型の鑑別診断に有用な画像所見。
summary_en: CT imaging study analyzing calcification patterns in ovarian tumors including germ cell tumors (GCT, YST, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma). Found GCTs showed higher calcification frequency than metastases; identifies diagnostic imaging features for tumor differentiation.

title: Metastatic Pure Seminomas With Early Relapse: Prognostic Roles of High Dose Chemotherapy and Surgery of Residual Disease.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマの早期再発：大量化学療法と残存病変切除術の予後的役割
summary_ja: 初期化学療法への奏効後の早期再発（12ヶ月以内）を有する91名の転移性セミノーマ患者を対象とした7施設共同後方視的研究。救援化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を施行した患者は化学療法単独と比較して無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の有意な改善を示した。大量化学療法の役割は限定的であった。
summary_en: Study of 91 metastatic seminoma patients with early relapse (<12 months) after first-line chemotherapy. RPLND after salvage chemotherapy associated with improved progression-free and overall survival compared to chemotherapy alone.

title: Secondary ovarian germ cell tumor following Wilms tumor after eight years post-treatment: A rare case report.
title_ja: Wilms腫瘍治療後8年で発生した続発性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: Wilms腫瘍治療後8年で続発性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した11歳女児の症例報告。がん生存者における晩期続発性悪性腫瘍の発症の可能性を強調し、長期フォローアップの重要性を示唆している。標準的な5年を超える継続的な監視が必要。
summary_en: Case of secondary ovarian germ cell tumor developing 8 years after Wilms tumor treatment in 11-year-old girl. Highlights importance of long-term surveillance in cancer survivors for detecting late-onset secondary malignancies including GCTs.

title: Acute abdominopelvic pain and distension in a 21-year-old woman revealing a mixed germ cell tumor: A case report.
title_ja: 21歳女性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍を明かした急性腹骨盤痛および膨満：症例報告
summary_ja: 急性腹部症状で発症した混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と無性細胞腫）の症例報告。生殖機能温存を考慮した経腟的単側付属器摘出術とプラチナ製剤ベース化学療法を施行した。
summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old female with mixed ovarian GCT (yolk sac tumor and dysgerminoma) presenting with acute abdominopelvic pain. Employed fertility-preserving transvaginal surgical approach with unilateral adnexectomy followed by platinum-based chemotherapy.

title: A case of seminal vesicle metastasis from bilateral seminoma.
title_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマからの精嚢転移の症例報告
summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマからの精嚢転移の初の報告症例。患者は初回精巣摘除術後8年で左精嚢転移をMRIおよび針生検で診断され、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンの4サイクルを施行後、PET-CTで完全奏効を確認した。
summary_en: First reported case of seminal vesicle metastasis from bilateral testicular seminoma. Patient developed isolated left seminal vesicle metastasis 8 years after initial orchiectomy; treated with BEP chemotherapy with favorable response.

title: Recurrence of seminoma 48 years after orchiectomy: Longest late recurrence and treatment.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術後48年のセミノーマ再発：最長の遅発再発と治療
summary_ja: 精巣精巣摘除術48年後の著しく遠隔な再発のケースレポート。後腹膜リンパ節転移に化学療法を施行。セミノーマの最長遠隔再発例として重要である。
summary_en: Exceptionally rare case of seminoma recurrence 48 years after orchiectomy in 83-year-old man. Para-aortic lymph node metastasis treated with chemotherapy; represents longest known late relapse in seminom literature.

title: A Complex Case of Triumphantly Treated ​​​​​​Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate (NMDA) Receptor Encephalitis.
title_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパルテート（NMDA）受容体脳炎の複雑で克服された症例
summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫関連の抗NMDA受体脳炎の複雑例。7回のIVIG投与で改善を認めた。早期診断、自己抗体検査、奇形腫摘出の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Complex case of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with bilateral ovarian teratomas. Required seven sessions of IVIG immunotherapy for symptom improvement; demonstrates importance of early diagnosis, autoantibody testing, and tumor resection in management.

title: Pembrolizumab in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: Systematic review and meta-analysis with sub-group analysis of potential prognostic factors.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するペムブロリズマブ：潜在的な予後因子のサブグループ解析を伴う システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するペムブロリズマブの有効性を検討した15研究のメタ解析。ペムブロリズマブは症例の71.59%で完全持続寛解を達成。年齢、GTN組織型、免疫療法開始までの時間、化学療法併用の有無を問わず同様の有効性を示した。
summary_en: Meta-analysis of 15 studies examining pembrolizumab efficacy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Pembrolizumab achieved complete sustained remission in 71.59% of cases, with similar performance across age groups, GTN histopathology subtypes, and chemotherapy combinations. Effective for high-risk, chemoresistant or relapsed disease including PSTT/ETT.

title: Mature Mediastinal Teratoma Complicated with Spontaneous Rupture into the Pleural Cavity: A Report of a Pediatric Case.
title_ja: 胸膜腔への自然破裂を伴う縦隔成熟奇形腫：小児症例報告
summary_ja: 胸膜腔への自然破裂を呈した小児縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例。成熟奇形腫の典型的な画像所見と胸膜腔への破裂などの合併症について解説。
summary_en: Case report of pediatric mature mediastinal teratoma with rare presentation of spontaneous rupture into pleural cavity. Article reviews typical radiological features of mature mediastinal teratomas and their complications on imaging.

title: Induction of SOX17 with stimulation of WNT, TGF-beta, and FGF signaling drives embryonal carcinomas into the yolk-sac tumor lineage resulting in increased cisplatin resistance.
title_ja: WNT、TGF-beta、およびFGFシグナル伝達の刺激によるSOX17の誘導は胎児性癌を卵黄嚢腫瘍系統に駆動し、シスプラチン耐性の増加をもたらす
summary_ja: SOX17誘導とWNT/TGF-beta/FGFシグナルによって胚胎癌から卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化が促進され、シスプラチン耐性が誘導される。YST形成は化学療法下での耐性獲得メカニズムを示唆。
summary_en: Study demonstrating that SOX17 induction with WNT/TGF-beta/FGF signaling drives embryonal carcinoma cells toward yolk sac tumor differentiation. YST-like cells show increased cisplatin resistance. Findings suggest YST formation serves as an escape mechanism during germ cell tumor therapy.

title: Sonographic features of ovarian malignancies in children and young adults - A case control study.
title_ja: 小児および若年成人における卵巣悪性腫瘍の超音波像の特徴-症例対照研究
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 卵巣癌患者（80%が胚細胞腫瘍）と良性腫瘍患者（45%が成熟奇形腫）を比較。悪性群は大きさ、固形成分、腹水、ドプラーフロー高値。成人と同じ画像所見が有用。
summary_en: Case-control study of 30 children and young adults with ovarian malignancy (80% germ cell tumors) vs. 60 with benign masses (45% mature teratomas). Malignant masses showed larger size, solid components, ascites, and high Doppler flow. Sonographic features for malignancy are valid in young patients but don't predict clinical course.

title: Nongestational Ovarian Choriocarcinoma with Precocious Puberty in a 7-Year-Old Girl: A Rare Case Report.
title_ja: 7歳女児における思春期早発症を伴う非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌:稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 7歳の非妊娠性卵巣絨毛膜癌患者が思春期早発で発症。β-hCG、AFP、CA125が高値。腫瘍切除後、ホルモン値が正常化し症状が消失。
summary_en: Case of 7-year-old with nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma presenting with precocious puberty. Laboratory tests showed elevated β-hCG, AFP, and CA125. Post-resection, hormone levels normalized and symptoms resolved, demonstrating successful treatment and importance of comprehensive endocrine evaluation in pediatric GCTs.

title: Imaging Manifestations of Primary Retroperitoneal Seminomas.
title_ja: 一次後腹膜セミノーマの画像所見
summary_ja: 一次後腹膜セミノーマの画像所見について説明するレビュー論文。全セミノーマの約1%を占め、身体の中心線周辺に通常発症する胚細胞腫瘍の稀な呈示を認識するための診断画像特性を検討。
summary_en: Review article describing imaging manifestations of primary retroperitoneal seminomas, representing approximately 1% of all seminomas and typically occurring along body midline. Discusses diagnostic imaging features to help clinicians recognize this rare presentation of germ cell tumors.

title: Biological and therapeutic implications of sex hormone-related gene clustering in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんの性ホルモン関連遺伝子クラスタリングの生物学的および治療学的意義
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における性ホルモン関連遺伝子クラスターを特定した研究。異なる遺伝子発現パターン、腫瘍型、臨床的行動を有する4つのクラスターを特定。クラスター割り当ては無増悪生存期間と様々な治療法への薬物感受性を予測。
summary_en: Study identifying sex hormone-related gene clusters in testicular germ cell tumors. Four distinct clusters identified with different gene expression patterns, tumor types, and clinical behaviors. Cluster assignment predicted progression-free survival and drug sensitivity to various therapies, offering insights for personalized treatment strategies.

title: Atypical Pelvic Tumors in Children.
title_ja: 小児の非定型骨盤腫瘍
summary_ja: 小児骨盤腫瘍の総合レビュー。仙尾骨奇形腫（最一般的な先天性腫瘍）と成熟卵巣奇形腫（青年期最一般的卵巣腫瘍）を含む。診断には画像と臨床の総合評価が重要。
summary_en: Review of atypical pelvic tumors in children, including sacrococcygeal teratoma (most common congenital tumor) and mature ovarian teratoma (most common ovarian neoplasm in adolescents). Discusses various other malignancies and emphasizes importance of comprehensive imaging and clinical correlation for accurate diagnosis.

title: Post-Chemotherapy Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Metastatic Testicular Cancer at a National Referral Centre.
title_ja: 全国紹介センターにおける転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するPC-RPLNDを受けた165例患者（中央値年齢30.5歳）の後方視的研究。切除標本の51.9%で奇形腫が認められた。複雑で補助的処置を必要とすることが多いが、高症例数紹介センターで安全に施行可能。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 165 patients with testicular germ cell tumors (median age 30.5 years) undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Teratoma was found in 51.9% of resected specimens. Though complex and often requiring adjunctive procedures, PC-RPLND can be safely performed at high-volume referral centers.

title: Knowledge Deficit About How Chemotherapy Affects Long-Term Survival in Testicular Tumor Patients.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者における化学療法が長期生存に与える影響についての知識欠落
summary_ja: 279例の精巣腫瘍患者（198例が化学療法受療）を対象とした調査で治療と長期的影響についての知識を検討。45%が化学療法の種類を述べられず；18.7%が長期的影響を認識していなかった。教育程度とカルボプラチン使用が知識欠落の予測因子。
summary_en: Survey of 279 testicular germ cell tumor survivors (198 received chemotherapy) about treatment and long-term effects knowledge. Only 45% could name chemotherapy type; 18.7% unaware of any long-term effects. Education level and carboplatin use were independent predictors of knowledge deficits regarding secondary tumors and andrological problems.

title: Natural History of subcentimeter pulmonary nodules in clinical stage I seminoma patients.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣セミノーマ患者における1cm未満肺結節の自然経過
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者79症例における40ヶ月フォローアップで1cm未満肺結節を検討した後方視的研究。肺結節は26.6%患者に認められるが疾患再発と関連していない。本研究は、臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者の肺結節発見が不必要な追加治療を駆動すべきではないことを示唆。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 79 clinical stage I seminoma patients with 40-month follow-up examining subcentimeter pulmonary nodules. SPNs found in 26.6% of patients but not associated with disease relapse. Study suggests SPN discovery should not drive unnecessary additional treatment in stage I seminoma patients.

title: Seronegative autoimmune encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma and uterine STUMP tumour.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫および子宮STUMP腫瘍に関連する血清陰性自己免疫性脳炎
summary_ja: 30代女性の血清陰性自己免疫性脳炎。急性行動障害と精神症状で発症。卵巣奇形腫と子宮STUMPを発見し腫瘍切除で神経学的症状消失。
summary_en: Case of woman in 30s with seronegative autoimmune encephalitis presenting with acute behavioral disturbance and psychiatric symptoms. Imaging revealed adnexal mass with elevated ovarian tumor markers. Ovarian teratoma and uterine STUMP resection resulted in significant clinical improvement and complete neurological symptom resolution.

title: Identification of genes associated with testicular germ cell tumor susceptibility through a transcriptome-wide association study.
title_ja: トランスクリプトーム全体関連研究を通じた精巣胚細胞腫瘍感受性に関連する遺伝子の同定
summary_ja: TWAS法によるTGCT関連遺伝子同定研究。165遺伝子を認識、46候補遺伝子を優先。23遺伝子が既知GWAS領域と重複、7は新規関連。遺伝的素因の理解向上。
summary_en: Transcriptome-wide association study identifying 165 TGCT-associated genes with false discovery rate <0.01. 46 candidate genes prioritized; 23 overlapped with GWAS loci with 7 novel associations. ARID3B and GINM1 showed protein accumulation in precursor and tumor cells, enhancing understanding of TGCT genetic predisposition.

title: Unveiling SMAD family member 6 as a novel biomarker for prognosis and immunotherapy response in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後と免疫療法応答のための新規バイオマーカーとしてのSMADファミリーメンバー6の解明
summary_ja: TGCT予後と免疫療法反応予測の生物マーカーとしてSMAD6を同定。高発現は予後不良、CD8+T細胞浸潤低下と関連。個別化医療に有用。
summary_en: Study identifying SMAD6 as novel prognostic biomarker for testicular germ cell tumors. High SMAD6 expression associated with poor prognosis and reduced CD8+ T cell infiltration, suggesting lower immunotherapy response. SMAD6 expression may guide personalized treatment selection in TGCT patients.

title: Mirvetuximab Soravtansine Induces Potent Cytotoxicity and Bystander Effect in Cisplatin-Resistant Germ Cell Tumor Cells.
title_ja: ミルベツキシマブ ソラブタンシンはシスプラチン耐性胚細胞腫瘍細胞において強力な細胞傷害性とバイスタンダー効果を誘導する
summary_ja: 反FRα抗体薬物複合体mirvetuximab soravtansineがシスプラチン耐性GCT細胞で強力な細胞毒性を誘導。FOLR1は化学療法後患者腫瘍で高発現。救済療法としての潜在的価値。
summary_en: Study demonstrating mirvetuximab soravtansine (anti-FRα antibody-drug conjugate) induces potent cytotoxicity in cisplatin-resistant germ cell tumor cells. FOLR1 highly expressed in TGCTs and cisplatin-resistant variants. Drug showed significant antitumor and bystander effects in vitro and elevated Folr1 in post-chemotherapy patient tumors.

title: Postpartum choriocarcinoma complicated by uterine perforation: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 子宮穿孔を伴う産後絨毛癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜癌の出産後症例。β-hCG上昇で初期診断。進行して子宮穿孔となったが多剤化学療法で寛解。化学療法と外科治療の組み合わせが重要。
summary_en: Case report of 25-year-old with postpartum choriocarcinoma presenting with heavy bleeding and elevated β-hCG. Disease progressed despite initial chemotherapy, leading to uterine perforation with hemoperitoneum requiring emergency surgery. Multi-agent chemotherapy achieved resolution, highlighting importance of prompt combined treatment.

title: Unexpected acute appendicitis found at laparoscopic surgery for a right ovarian teratoma: A case report.
title_ja: 右卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡手術時に発見された予期しない急性虫垂炎：症例報告
summary_ja: 左卵巣奇形腫摘除術の既往を有する20歳女性が左下腹痛で呈示。画像検査で右卵巣奇形腫5cm（直径）が認められた。卵巣捻転の疑いで腹腔鏡手術施行中に予期せず急性虫垂炎が発見され、卵巣奇形腫と虫垂が摘出され症状消失。
summary_en: Case of 20-year-old with history of left ovarian teratoma presenting with left lower abdominal pain. Imaging revealed right ovarian teratoma 5 cm. During laparoscopic surgery for suspected adnexal torsion, acute appendicitis was unexpectedly discovered. Both teratoma and appendix were surgically removed with symptom resolution.

title: Analysis of HNF1β expression suggests that its downregulation is involved in the sarcomatoid transformation of yolk sac tumor.
title_ja: HNF1β発現の分析は、その発現低下が卵黄嚢腫瘍の肉腫様変化に関与していることを示唆する
summary_ja: 化学療法後の稀な肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍のHNF1β発現低下を検討。HNF1β・FOXA2の共発現低下が肉腫様転移と関連。古典的マーカー（AFP、GPC3）より診断感度が高い。稀有GCT亜型の診断に有用。
summary_en: Analyzes HNF1β expression loss in sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor (YSTpt), rare post-chemotherapy GCT phenotype. HNF1β downregulation implicated in sarcomatoid transformation alongside FOXA2 changes. Immunohistochemical study shows HNF1β higher sensitivity than classical markers (AFP, GPC3) for YSTpt diagnosis.

title: Investigation of the Usefulness of Hanger and Retention Bag and Double Suture Hanger Technique in Preventing Tumor Spillage During Gynecologic Laparoscopic Surgery for Mature Cystic Teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の婦人科腹腔鏡手術中の腫瘍漏出防止におけるハンガーと保持バッグおよび二重縫合ハンガー技術の有用性の検討
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術での腫瘍流出防止の新手法（HRB・DSHT）を報告。簡便で経済的、学習曲線が短く、種々のポート配置に対応可能。最小侵襲手術の進歩に貢献する技術。
summary_en: Proposes hanger retention bag (HRB) and double suture hanger (DSHT) techniques to prevent ovarian tumor spillage during laparoscopic surgery for mature cystic teratoma. Simple, cost-effective methods requiring only retrieval bag and suture. Extremely short learning curve. Adaptable to various port configurations.

title: Renal immature teratoma in infant: A rare case report.
title_ja: 乳幼児における腎未熟奇形腫：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 5ヶ月齢女児における腎未熟奇形腫の稀な症例。最初はWilms腫瘍と疑われた無痛性腹部腫瘤を呈示。左腎摘除術施行でGrade III未熟奇形腫が確認され、外胚葉性、中胚葉性、内胚葉性成分と神経上皮構造を含む。
summary_en: Rare case of renal immature teratoma in 5-month-old female presenting as painless abdominal mass initially suspected Wilms tumor. CT imaging showed large left abdominal tumor. Left nephrectomy performed with Grade III immature teratoma confirmed, containing ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components with neuroepithelial structures.

title: Is primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection the way forward for patients with testicular seminoma and limited retroperitoneal metastases?
title_ja: 限定的な後腹膜転移を伴う精巣セミノーマ患者に対して一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清が今後の治療方法か？
summary_ja: 限定的な後腹膜転移を伴う精巣セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替アプローチを検討。従来の放射線療法/化学療法からの心血管疾患および二次悪性腫瘍のリスクに対処。施設シリーズと第II相試験からの有効性を評価。
summary_en: Reviews alternative primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) approach for testicular seminoma with limited retroperitoneal metastases. Addresses concerns about cardiovascular disease and secondary malignancy risks from conventional radiotherapy/chemotherapy. Evaluates efficacy from institutional series and phase II trials.

title: Retroperitoneal Nodal Distribution for Metastatic Seminoma: Is Modified Template Appropriate? A Retrospective Study.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマの後腹膜リンパ節分布：修正テンプレートは適切か？後方視的研究
summary_ja: セミノーマ患者104症例における二側（n=68）対一側（n=36）後腹膜リンパ節郭清テンプレートの比較後方視的研究。2年無再発生存率は二側法で優れている（86.8% vs 80.6%）。転移性セミノーマの好発リンパ節部位をマッピング；対側領域の微小転移を6～11.1%同定。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 104 seminoma patients comparing bilateral (n=68) versus unilateral (n=36) retroperitoneal lymph node dissection templates. Two-year recurrence-free survival superior with bilateral approach (86.8% vs 80.6%). Maps common metastatic landing zones; identifies 6-11.1% microscopic contralateral metastases.

title: Anterior Mediastinal Mass Mimicking Supravalvular Pulmonary Stenosis With Systolic Murmur.
title_ja: 肺動脈弁上狭窄を模倣する前縦隔腫瘤：収縮期雑音を伴う
summary_ja: 女性患者における先天性肺動脈弁上狭窄を模倣する性腺外前縦隔奇形腫の稀な症例。収縮期雑音で発症。外科的切除により症状は完全に消失。心臓評価における鑑別診断の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of anterior mediastinal extragonadal teratoma mimicking congenital supravalvular pulmonary stenosis in female patient presenting with systolic murmur. Complete symptom resolution achieved after surgical resection. Highlights importance of differential diagnosis in cardiac evaluation.

title: Germ Cell Neoplasia In situ in Undescended Testis: A Myth or Reality?
title_ja: 停留精巣における胚細胞上皮内腫瘍：神話か現実か？
summary_ja: 停留精巣における胚細胞上皮内腫瘍(GCN)の組織病理学的研究。43例の患者から精巣摘除術/精巣固定術で得られた組織を通常の組織病理学的検査および免疫組織化学検査(PLAP、CD-117)で検査。1症例(6.7%)がGCN陽性。早期外科的管理の重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Histopathological study of germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCN) in cryptorchid testes from 43 patients. Tissue samples from orchidectomy/orchiopexy examined with routine histology and immunohistochemistry (PLAP, CD-117). One case (6.7%) showed GCN positivity. Demonstrates importance of early surgical management.

title: Preoperative semen quality is superior to the quality shortly after orchiectomy in patients with testicular germ cell tumour - a retrospective study from two centres in Germany.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における術前精液質は根治的精巣摘除術直後の質より優れている - ドイツの2つの施設からの遡及的研究
summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者の術前163例vs術後242例の精液検査比較。すべての主要パラメータが術前で有意に優越。射精量・精子数・運動性で顕著差。術後無精子症が3倍増加。術前凍結保存が推奨。
summary_en: Retrospective comparison of semen quality in testicular GCT patients preoperatively (n=163) versus post-orchiectomy (n=242). All major parameters significantly better preoperatively: volume (3 vs. 2 ml), total sperm count (56.9 vs. 13 million), motility (40% vs. 25%); azoospermia threefold higher postoperatively.

title: Papillary thyroid carcinoma within struma ovarii: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: ストルマオバリ（卵巣甲状腺腫）内乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例。50歳女性で正常甲状腺を有する。文献10例の平均診断年齢46.5歳。更年期女性の定期検査の重要性を指摘。
summary_en: Case report of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) within struma ovarii (ovarian mature teratoma with predominant thyroid tissue) in 50-year-old woman with histologically normal thyroid gland. Literature review of 10 similar cases shows median diagnosis age 46.5 years. Emphasizes importance of routine screening in perimenopausal women.

title: Carcinoid tumor arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: A case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生したカルチノイド腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来のカルチノイド腫瘍の稀な症例で、59歳女性が画像検査で良性奇形腫と誤診されていた。骨盤切除術を施行し、病理学的にカルチノイド由来と確認。36か月のフォローアップで再発転移なし。良性と悪性奇形腫成分の鑑別における診断上の課題を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of carcinoid tumor arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma (MCTO) in 59-year-old woman, initially misdiagnosed as benign teratoma on imaging. Pelvic resection performed; pathology confirmed carcinoid origin. 36-month follow-up without recurrence. Highlights diagnostic challenges in distinguishing benign from malignant teratoma components.

title: Salvage En Bloc Resection for Refractory Recurrent Pure Testicular Seminoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 難治性再発精巣セミノーマに対する救済的一塊切除：症例報告
summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性難治性胚細胞腫瘍の治療は臨床的に問題のある状況である。初期治療に反応しなかった転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者は限られた治療選択肢と高い死亡率に直面するが、本症例は難治性精巣セミノーマに対する根治的手術の成功を示した。
summary_en: Case report of successful salvage en bloc resection for refractory recurrent testicular seminoma after cisplatin resistance. Addresses clinical challenge of metastatic GCT patients unresponsive to initial chemotherapy. Demonstrates radical surgical intervention as viable alternative for high-mortality patient group with limited therapeutic options.

title: Ovarian Dysgerminoma Associated With Pregnancy Presenting as Hemoperitoneum: An Obstetric Case Report.
title_ja: 妊娠に伴う卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が腹腔内出血として呈示：産科症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠中（33歳、妊娠23週）に発見された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が出血性ショックと腹腔内出血で呈示した稀な症例。左卵巣に24×29cm大の腫瘍と4.5L血性腹水を認める。緊急付属器摘除術を施行し、母体および胎児転帰は良好。早期段階未分化胚細胞腫の管理の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of ovarian dysgerminoma discovered during pregnancy (33 years, 23 weeks gestation) presenting with hemorrhagic shock and hemoperitoneum. Large 24×29 cm left ovarian tumor with 4.5 L hemorrhagic ascites. Emergency adnexectomy performed; maternal and fetal outcomes favorable. Emphasizes early-stage dysgerminoma management.

title: Successful multi-disciplinary management of anti-NMDAR encephalitis during pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の集学的管理の成功例
summary_ja: 妊娠中にてんかん重積状態で発症した女性が、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。骨盤画像検査で一側性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が同定され、外科的に切除された。免疫療法と集中治療の後、患者は良好に回復し、予定日に健康な新生児を分娩した。このまれな合併症に対する集学的管理の成功を示す。
summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with status epilepticus in early pregnancy, diagnosed with anti-NMDAR encephalitis. A unilateral mature cystic teratoma was identified on pelvic imaging and surgically removed. Following immunotherapy and intensive care, she recovered well and delivered a healthy infant at term, demonstrating successful multi-disciplinary management of this rare condition.

title: Ruptured ovarian dermoid causing chemical peritonitis: a case report.
title_ja: 破裂卵巣類皮嚢腫による化学性腹膜炎：症例報告
summary_ja: 32歳女性が卵巣皮様嚢胞の自然破裂による化学腹膜炎で救急車搬送された。患者は外科的に管理された。卵巣皮様嚢胞の自然破裂は稀であり、この症例は良性奇形腫から生じる急性外科的合併症を示している。
summary_en: A 32-year-old female presented with abdominal pain and distension caused by spontaneous rupture of an ovarian dermoid cyst, leading to chemical peritonitis. The patient was managed surgically. Spontaneous rupture of ovarian dermoid cysts is uncommon, and this case highlights the acute surgical complications that can arise from these benign teratomas.

title: MRI Features with Pathologic Correlation of Primary Ovarian Carcinoid: A Case Report.
title_ja: 原発性卵巣カルチノイド腫瘍のMRI所見と病理的相関：症例報告
summary_ja: 一次性卵巣カルチノイドは成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じることが多い稀な分化型神経内分泌腫瘍である。51歳女性患者のMRI画像所見と病理学的相関について報告している。奇形腫からの悪性転化の典型的な病態を示している。
summary_en: Primary ovarian carcinoid tumors are rare well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors classified as monodermal teratomas, often arising from mature cystic teratomas. This case report describes a 51-year-old female with primary ovarian carcinoid, detailing MRI features and pathological correlation demonstrating malignant transformation of teratoma.

title: How can we best manage ovarian sebaceous carcinomas arising from mature cystic teratomas?
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した脂腺癌の最適な管理方法は？
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する脂腺癌は極めてまれで、文献に報告されているのは19例のみである。60代の女性が包括的な手術治療(子宮全摘出術および両側卵管卵巣摘出術を含む)を受けた。レビューでは70%が早期FIGO病期で発症し、外科的管理後の予後が良好であることを示した。
summary_en: Sebaceous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratomas is exceptionally rare, with only 19 cases reported in literature. This case describes a woman in her 60s who underwent comprehensive surgical treatment including hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Review shows 70% present at early FIGO stages with excellent prognosis after surgical management.

title: Arterial thromboembolic events in testicular cancer patients: short- and long-term incidence, risk factors, and impact on mortality.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における動脈血栓塞栓症：短期および長期の発生率、リスク因子、および死亡率への影響
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)患者1,277例における動脈血栓塞栓症(ATE)の発生率およびリスク因子を検討した後方視的コホート研究。10年および25年での累積ATE発生率はそれぞれ2.6%および12.0%であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は短期ATEリスクを増加させ、喫煙、年齢≥35歳、乳酸脱水素酵素上昇が長期リスク因子であった。
summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 1,277 testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients examined incidence and risk factors for arterial thromboembolic events (ATE). Cumulative ATE incidence at 10 and 25 years was 2.6% and 12.0% respectively. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy increased short-term ATE risk, while smoking, age ≥35, and elevated LDH were independent long-term risk factors.

title: Stage I Non-Seminomatous Testicular Cancer: Long-Term Follow-Up with Surveillance Approach Post-Orchiectomy.
title_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がん：精巣摘除術後の積極的監視アプローチによる長期フォローアップ
summary_ja: 精巣病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)457例における精巣摘除術後の積極的監視を評価した後方視的研究。中央値フォローアップ65.3か月で、20%に再発を認め、後腹膜リンパ節が最も一般的な再発部位であった。20年における全生存期間(全生存率)は98.25%で、救済治療後に91.1%が無病であった。
summary_en: A retrospective study of 457 patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) treated with active surveillance post-orchiectomy. With median follow-up of 65.3 months, 20% experienced relapse, with retroperitoneal lymph nodes as most common site. Overall survival at 20 years was 98.25%, with 91.1% of relapsed patients achieving disease-free status after salvage treatment.

title: Robot-assisted transmesocolic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumors: A promising approach.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するロボット支援経腸間膜的後腹膜リンパ節郭清：有望なアプローチ
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法後の持続性後腹膜腫瘤に対するロボット支援経腸間膜的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を報告した本症例集積。4例が手術を受け、良好な周術期転帰が得られた。病理所見は思春期後奇形腫および壊死を含み、フォローアップ時にすべて無病。
summary_en: This case series presents robot-assisted transmesocolic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for persistent retroperitoneal masses in testicular NSGCT patients after chemotherapy. Four patients underwent the procedure with favorable perioperative outcomes. Pathological findings included post-pubertal teratoma and necrosis. All patients remained disease-free at follow-up.

title: Factors influencing serum hCG negativization timing in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン陰性化時期に影響する因子
summary_ja: 206例妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者のhCG陰性化時期に影響する因子の後方視的分析。BMI増加はhCG陰性化時間短縮と関連。化学療法前hCGレベル高値、子宮全摘術は陰性化時間延長と関連。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 206 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients identified factors influencing time to hCG negativization. Increased BMI was associated with shorter hCG negativization time, while higher pre-treatment hCG levels, longer time since last pregnancy, and hysterectomy were associated with prolonged conversion times. These findings support tailored treatment strategies for GTN management.

title: Single-Nucleus RNA Sequencing and Spatial Transcriptomics for Squamous Cell Carcinoma Arising From Ovarian Mature Teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌に対する単一核RNAシーケンシングと空間トランスクリプトミクス解析
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌の分子病理学的特徴をシングルニュークレウスRNA配列決定と空間トランスクリプトミクスで分析。KLF5が細胞増殖を促進するアップレギュレートされた遺伝子として同定。miR-145-5pが負の制御因子として機能し、KLF5関連因子が新規治療標的の可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: This study applied single-nucleus RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to analyze squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma (SCC-MT), a rare malignancy with poorly understood molecular pathology. Analysis identified KLF5 as an upregulated gene promoting cell proliferation, with miR-145-5p as a negative regulator, suggesting novel therapeutic targets.

title: The clinical characteristics and prognostic analysis of 35 postterm choriocarcinomas.
title_ja: 35例後期絨毛癌の臨床的特性および予後分析
summary_ja: 2011年から2022年の35例後期絨毛癌患者の後方視的分析。異常子宮出血が最も一般的な症状（71.4%）。完全寛解率は88.6%。正常化学療法コース数の増加と補助化学療法コース数が再発リスクの有意な予後因子。
summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 35 postterm choriocarcinoma patients treated from 2011 to 2022. Abnormal uterine bleeding was the most common symptom (71.4%). Complete remission rate was 88.6%. Number of chemotherapy courses before achieving normal β-hCG and consolidation chemotherapy courses were significant prognostic factors affecting recurrence risk.

title: Unusual Adolescent Abdominal Tumors Presenting With Neuropsychiatric and Massive Abdominopelvic Manifestations: A Report of Two Cases.
title_ja: 神経精神医学的および大規模な腹腔骨盤症状を呈する異常な思春期腹部腫瘍：2症例報告
summary_ja: 思春期の腹部腫瘍の2症例報告。第1例は抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う3 cm卵巣類皮嚢腫で、外科的切除と免疫療法で数日で完全回復。第2例は30 cm子宮平滑筋腫。両症例ともフォローアップで良好。
summary_en: Two case reports of unusual abdominal tumors in adolescents: (1) a 12-year-old girl with anti-NMDAR encephalitis and a 3-cm ovarian dermoid cyst successfully managed with surgery and immunotherapy; (2) a 14-year-old girl with massive uterine leiomyoma. The first case demonstrates significant neuropsychiatric manifestations associated with ovarian teratoma.

title: Elevations of α-fetoprotein in patients undergoing chemotherapy for pure testicular seminoma: a retrospective cohort study.
title_ja: 純粋精巣セミノーマに対する化学療法施行患者におけるαフェトプロテイン上昇値：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 175例の精巣古典的セミノーマ患者における化学療法中のαフェトプロテイン上昇の後方視的検討。8例（4.6%）がベースラインで上昇AFP有し、6例が治療中に安定した中程度上昇を維持。軽度AFP上昇は診断変更なし。
summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 175 testicular classical seminoma (TCS) patients examined α-fetoprotein (AFP) elevations during chemotherapy. Eight patients (4.6%) had elevated baseline AFP; six maintained stable moderate elevations without affecting diagnosis or management. Findings highlight that mild AFP elevations in TCS may occur without clinical significance.

title: Yolk sac ovarian cancer with mesenteric metastases.
title_ja: 腸間膜転移を伴う卵黄嚢卵巣腫瘍の症例
summary_ja: 早期思春期の少女における卵黄嚢卵巣腫瘍からの腸間膜転移の稀な症例を報告する。腹部膨満で呈示し、画像検査で腫瘍マーカーの上昇を伴う悪性卵巣腫瘍が認められた。病理組織学的検査により卵黄嚢腫瘍が確認。卵巣腫瘍からの腸間膜転移は極めて稀である。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare presentation of mesenteric metastases from yolk sac ovarian cancer in an early adolescent girl. Patient presented with abdominal distension; imaging revealed a malignant ovarian tumor with elevated tumor markers. Surgical resection with histopathological confirmation of yolk sac tumor was performed. Mesenteric involvement is exceptionally rare.

title: Brachyury expression is highly specific for chordoma: A tissue microarray study involving 14,976 cancers from 135 different tumor types and subtypes.
title_ja: ブラキューリ発現は脊索腫に対して極めて特異的である: 135の異なる腫瘍タイプおよび亜型からの14,976のサンプルを含む組織マイクロアレイ研究
summary_ja: 14,976検体(135腫瘍型)を用いたブラキウリ発現の組織マイクロアレイ研究。精巣胚細胞腫瘍でのブラキウリ陽性率:卵黄嚢腫瘍21.4%、胎児癌15.2%、セミノーマ4.4%、奇形腫2.4%。胚細胞腫瘍はコルドーマ以外で有意なブラキウリ発現を示す唯一の腫瘍群である。
summary_en: This tissue microarray study of 14,976 samples from 135 tumor types analyzed brachyury expression. Among testicular germ cell tumors, brachyury positivity was found in: 21.4% of yolk sac tumors, 15.2% of embryonal carcinomas, 4.4% of seminomas, and 2.4% of teratomas. Germ cell tumors represent the only additional group showing significant brachyury expression beyond chordomas.

title: Comparison of carboplatin-based chemotherapy versus cisplatin-based chemotherapy in the treatment of malignant gonadal germ cell tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
title_ja: 悪性生殖腺胚細胞腫瘍の治療におけるカルボプラチン系化学療法対シスプラチン系化学療法の比較: システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 性腺胚細胞腫瘍患者1,409名を対象とした8研究のメタアナリシス。カルボプラチン系療法はシスプラチン系より治療失敗率が高いが、全生存率は同等。高用量カルボプラチン(AUC 7.9)はシスプラチンと同等の有効性で毒性がより許容可能。カルボプラチンは実行可能な代替選択肢を示唆している。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies (1,409 patients) comparing carboplatin-based versus cisplatin-based chemotherapy in malignant gonadal germ cell tumors (GCTs). Carboplatin showed increased treatment failure rate but similar overall survival. High-dose carboplatin (AUC 7.9) achieved comparable efficacy to cisplatin with more tolerable toxicity, suggesting carboplatin as viable alternative.

title: Combination chemotherapy with sintilimab for treatment of a male patient with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の治療におけるシンチリマブとの併用化学療法: 症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 67歳男性の原発性肺絨毛膜癌。シスプラチン、エトポシド、パクリタキセルとシンチリマブの併用化学療法で治療。HCG上昇、PD-L1陽性。免疫チェックポイント阻害剤で腫瘍縮小を達成。
summary_en: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a 67-year-old male treated with combination chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, paclitaxel) and sintilimab. HCG was elevated and PD-L1 expression positive (70%). Treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors achieved significant tumor reduction, suggesting promising therapeutic options for PPC.

title: Redefining Good-prognosis Seminoma: Implications for Clinical Practice of the Updated International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group Classification and Results from the SEMITrends Survey.
title_ja: 良好予後セミノーマの再定義：更新された国際胚細胞腫瘍協力グループ分類の臨床実践への含意とSEMITrendsサーベイ結果
summary_ja: セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に関する国際胚細胞腫瘍協力グループ分類の更新を報告。ラクテート脱水素酵素(LDH)の正常上限値の2.5倍以上の上昇を重要な予後因子として強調。高LDH良好リスクセミノーマの臨床管理の世界的な傾向変化を調査したSEMITrendsサーベイ結果。
summary_en: Updates to the International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group classification for seminomatous GCTs, highlighting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) elevation >2.5× upper limit of normal as a key prognostic factor. Results from the SEMITrends survey on global management trends for high-LDH good-risk seminoma.

title: Prediction Model for Brain Metastasis in Patients With Metastatic Germ-Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者における脳転移予測モデル
summary_ja: 2291例の転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者を用いた脳転移予測モデルの開発。診断時年齢≥40、絨毛癌優位組織型、化学療法前hCG≥5000、肺転移、骨転移を含む因子を組み込み、脳転移確率を0.6%から90%に層別化。
summary_en: Development of a prediction model for brain metastasis in metastatic germ cell tumors using 2291 patients. Model incorporates age ≥40, choriocarcinoma histology, pre-chemotherapy hCG ≥5000, pulmonary and bone metastases. Risk stratification ranges from 0.6% to 90% probability of brain metastasis.

title: Mixed Trabecular and Mucinous Carcinoid Arising in the Background of a Mature Ovarian Cystic Teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を背景とした混合型索状および粘液性カルチノイドの発生
summary_ja: 67歳閉経後女性患者の成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した混合型索状および粘液性カルチノイド腫瘍の症例。病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的分析で確認された。6ヶ月フォローアップで再発は認められず。成熟卵巣奇形腫における同時性悪性腫瘍スクリーニングの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case of mixed trabecular and mucinous carcinoid tumors arising from a mature ovarian cystic teratoma in a 67-year-old woman. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed carcinoid features. Six-month follow-up showed no recurrence. Highlights importance of careful examination for synchronous malignancies.

title: Incidence and Pitfalls of Intratesticular Adipose Tissue Encountered in Orchiectomy Specimens.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術標本に見られる精巣内脂肪組織の発生頻度および落とし穴
summary_ja: 精巣生殖細胞腫瘍における脂肪組織の検討。605例の精巣摘出標本を分析。脂肪組織は1.8%で認識。位置や範囲を検討。病理診断における落とし穴を強調。
summary_en: Multi-institutional study of intratesticular adipose tissue in 605 orchiectomy specimens from 3 academic centers, identifying presence in 1.8%. Includes GCTs with and without teratoma components. Location ranged from rete testis to testicular parenchyma. Important for accurate staging and avoiding pathologic staging pitfalls.

title: Analysis of a mouse germ cell tumor model establishes pluripotency-associated miRNAs as conserved serum biomarkers for germ cell cancer detection.
title_ja: マウス胚細胞腫瘍モデル分析により多能性関連マイクロRNAが胚細胞腫瘍検出の保存された血清バイオマーカーとして確立される
summary_ja: マウス悪性TGCTモデルを用いてマイクロRNA(miR-291-293、ヒトmiR-371-373のホモログ)を血清バイオマーカーとして同定した研究。マイクロRNAは多能性胎児性癌細胞により発現されるが良性奇形腫では非発現。早期TGCT検出と出生前診断の可能性を示唆。
summary_en: Study using mouse malignant TGCT model to identify miRNAs (miR-291-293, homologs of human miR-371-373) as serum biomarkers. MicroRNAs are expressed by pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells but not benign teratomas. Findings suggest potential for early TGCT detection and possible prenatal diagnosis.

title: Mature Teratoma Combined with Bladder Stones: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 膀胱結石を伴う成熟奇形腫: 症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 排尿障害と結石様所見を呈した53歳女性の膀胱原発成熟奇形腫症例報告。奇形腫は3つの胚葉由来組織を含む胚細胞由来。外科的切除により症状解決し、長期フォローアップが実施。
summary_en: Case report of primary mature teratoma in bladder of 53-year-old woman presenting with urinary obstruction and stone-like findings. Teratoma originates from germ cells containing tissues from all three germ layers. Surgical resection performed with symptom resolution and long-term follow-up.

title: [A Case of Metastatic Testicular Cancer after Kidney Transplantation in which Complete Remission was Achieved].
title_ja: [腎移植後に完全寛解が得られた転移性精巣がん症例]
summary_ja: 腎移植22年後の29歳患者における後腹膜転移を伴う精巣セミノーマ症例。BEP化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)で治療され、リンパ節の縮小を示した。治療中および治療後のAFP上昇は綿密な監視が必要。
summary_en: Case of testicular seminoma with retroperitoneal metastasis in 29-year-old post-kidney transplant patient, 22 years after transplantation. Treated with BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) with lymph node regression. AFP elevation required careful monitoring during and after treatment.

title: Testicular Germ Cell Tumors: A Review.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍: レビュー
summary_ja: 米国における15~40歳男性の最も一般的な固形悪性腫瘍の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のJAMAレビュー(毎年約10,000例)。分類(セミノーマ対非セミノーマ)、リスク要因、腫瘍マーカー(AFP、hCG、LDH)による診断、病期分類、治療をカバー。病期I~III の5年生存率:99%、92%、85%。
summary_en: Comprehensive JAMA review of testicular germ cell tumors, most common solid malignancy in males aged 15-40 in the US (~10,000 cases/year). Covers classification (seminomas vs nonseminomatous), risk factors, diagnosis using tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH), staging, treatment, and survivorship. Stage I-III 5-year survival: 99%, 92%, 85%.

title: Bilateral Adnexal Entanglement: A Diagnostic Challenge in Postmenopausal Women.
title_ja: 両側卵巣付属器纏絡: 閉経後女性における診断的課題
summary_ja: 56歳の閉経後女性の両側付属器纏絡症例。病理組織学的検査により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)として確認。画像上は初期には先の手術に由来する続発性病変と誤解釈。閉経後女性の付属器腫瘤の診断的複雑性を強調。
summary_en: Case of 56-year-old postmenopausal woman with bilateral adnexal entanglement confirmed as mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) on histopathology. Initially misinterpreted on imaging as secondary lesions from prior surgeries. Emphasizes diagnostic complexity of adnexal masses in postmenopausal women.

title: (Epi)genetic and Genomic Features of Pediatric and Adult Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 小児および成人胚細胞腫瘍の(エピ)遺伝学的およびゲノム的特徴
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムおよびエピジェネティック変化の概要。異染色体12p形成と多能性遺伝子のコピー数異常を含む。青年および成人患者のTGCT素因、発症、診断、治療における分子的特徴をカバー。
summary_en: Overview of genomic and epigenetic alterations in testicular germ cell tumors, including isochromosome 12p formation and copy number alterations in pluripotency genes. Covers molecular features in predisposition, development, diagnosis, and treatment of TGCTs across adolescent and adult populations.

title: Somatic-type Malignancies of Germ Cell Origin: Molecular, Pathologic, and Clinical Features.
title_ja: 胚細胞由来の体細胞型悪性腫瘍: 分子的、病理学的、および臨床的特徴
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に由来する体細胞型悪性腫瘍の包括的なレビュー (患者の3~8%に影響)。分子的知見、病理学的特徴、臨床経過、および組織学的亜型をカバー。STMは侵襲的な性質と全身療法への頻繁な耐性を示す。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of somatic-type malignancies arising in germ cell tumors, affecting 3-8% of patients. Covers molecular findings, pathologic features, clinical behavior, and histologic subtypes. STMs show aggressive behavior and frequent resistance to systemic therapy.

title: Relapse detection in the Danish surveillance program of patients with clinical stage I seminoma: a nationwide study.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者のデンマーク監視プログラムにおける再発検出: 全国規模の研究
summary_ja: デンマークの積極的監視を受けた臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者924例の全国的コホート。5年累積再発リスク16% (再発146例)、71%は画像検査単独で検出。リスク適応型監視で低リスク患者9% vs 非低リスク28%の再発率を示し、低リスク群での監視削減が可能。
summary_en: Nationwide Danish cohort of 924 clinical stage I seminoma patients on active surveillance. 5-year cumulative relapse risk 16% (146 relapses), with 71% detected by imaging alone. Risk-adapted surveillance identified low-risk patients (9% relapse) vs non-low-risk (28%), suggesting safe reduction of monitoring for low-risk groups.

title: Rare malignant ovarian tumors: a review.
title_ja: 稀な悪性卵巣腫瘍：レビュー
summary_ja: 稀な卵巣悪性腫瘍3型のレビュー：中腎様腺癌、成人顆粒膜細胞腫、成熟奇形腫の悪性転化。扁平上皮癌が最も一般的。病理学、免疫組織化学、治療法を概説。
summary_en: Review of three rare malignant ovarian tumors: mesonephric-like adenocarcinoma, adult granulosa cell tumors, and malignant transformation of mature teratoma (most commonly squamous cell carcinoma). Covers epidemiology, pathology, immunohistochemistry, and treatment. Malignant teratoma transformation suspected in older patients with large tumors.

title: SALL4 as a Useful Marker for the Distinction of Various Gestational Trophoblastic Disease Subtypes: Choriocarcinoma From Other Trophoblastic Lesions and Early Complete Hydatidiform Mole From Partial Mole and NonMolar Villi.
title_ja: SALL4は様々な絨毛性疾患亜型の鑑別における有用なマーカー：絨毛癌と他の栄養膜病変の鑑別および早期完全胞状奇胎と部分胞状奇胎および非胞状性絨毛の鑑別
summary_ja: 妊娠胎盤性疾患の鑑別におけるSALL4免疫染色の研究。絨毛膜癌、水胞状奇胎、胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍を検討。細胞栄養膜での拡散的SALL4陽性は絨毛膜癌に特異的。
summary_en: Study of SALL4 immunostaining to distinguish gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) subtypes: choriocarcinoma from other trophoblastic lesions, and complete hydatidiform mole from partial mole. Diffuse SALL4 positivity in cytotrophoblast/intermediate trophoblast is 74% sensitive and specific for choriocarcinoma diagnosis.

title: Superior vena cava obstruction following pericardial effusion absorption in the presence of a pericardial teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 心膜奇形腫患者の心膜液吸収後に生じた上大静脈閉塞: 症例報告
summary_ja: 乳幼児の稀な心膜内成熟奇形腫症例。心膜液吸収後に上大静脈閉塞を呈した。心膜液貯留と心臓圧迫が典型的であり、心エコー図と胸部コンピュータ断層撮影血管造影で上大静脈圧迫が確認され、外科的切除により成功裏に治療された。
summary_en: Rare case of intrapericardial mature teratoma presenting with superior vena cava obstruction following pericardial effusion absorption in an infant. Typically presents with pericardial effusion and cardiac compression. Echocardiography and thoracic CTA revealed mass compressing superior vena cava; surgical resection performed successfully.

title: Gestational trophoblastic disease: understanding the molecular mechanisms of placental tumours.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患：胎盤腫瘍の分子メカニズムの理解
summary_ja: 妊娠胎盤性疾患の分子メカニズムのレビュー。遺伝学、エピジェネティクス、マイクロRNAの役割を検討。胎盤栄養膜由来の稀な良性・悪性病変。病因メカニズムの理解を深める。
summary_en: Review of molecular mechanisms underlying gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including genetic, epigenetic, and microRNA roles in pathogenesis and progression. GTD comprises rare benign and malignant lesions originating from placental trophoblast cells. Provides framework for understanding drivers of this rare condition.

title: Seminoma Diagnosed by Multicancer Detection Testing: A Case Report.
title_ja: 多がん検査で診断されたセミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 67歳男性における多がん検査スクリーニングで診断された早期精巣セミノーマの症例報告。初期の陰性診断検査にもかかわらず、高度な画像検査と内視鏡検査がセミノーマ診断と精巣摘除術へ導いた。陽性多がん検査結果の解釈における課題を強調する症例である。
summary_en: Case report of early-stage testicular seminoma in a 67-year-old male diagnosed via multicancer detection screening test. Despite initial negative diagnostic workup, advanced imaging and endoscopy eventually led to seminoma diagnosis, with subsequent orchiectomy. Highlights challenges in interpreting positive multicancer detection results.

title: Trichoptysis: a pathognomonic presentation of anterior mediastinal teratoma.
title_ja: 毛髪咳：前縦隔奇形腫の病理的特異的所見
summary_ja: 毛髪喀出症で発症した前縦隔成熟奇形腫の女性患者の症例報告。気管支肺への浸潤を伴い、右前側方開胸術と右上肺区域切除により治療された。術後は無症状で経過している。
summary_en: Case report of a woman presenting with trichoptysis (coughing up hair) diagnosed with benign mature teratoma of the anterior mediastinum with bronchopulmonary involvement. Treated with right anterolateral thoracotomy and right upper bilobectomy with good outcomes.

title: Abdominopelvic imaging in the follow-up of testicular germ-cell tumors in adults: recommendations of the Scrotal and Penile Imaging Working Group of the European Society of Urogenital Radiology.
title_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍フォローアップにおける腹部骨盤画像診断：欧州尿生殖器放射線学会の推奨
summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のフォローアップにおける腹部骨盤画像診断に関する欧州尿生殖器放射線学会の推奨。後腹膜リンパ節検出のためのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を比較し、放射線被ばく回避のため臨床病期I疾患でMRIを支持。
summary_en: European Society of Urogenital Radiology recommendations for abdominopelvic imaging follow-up in adult testicular germ-cell tumor (TGCT) patients. Compares CT and MRI for retroperitoneal lymph node detection, favoring MRI for stage I disease to avoid radiation exposure.

title: Down syndrome with cryptorchidism and retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumour in an adult patient: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: ダウン症候群と停留精巣および後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する成人患者：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: ダウン症候群と停留精巣を有する42歳男性の後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍およびセミノーマ）の症例報告。腫瘍マーカーの上昇（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG）、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査所見、および手術所見が詳述。化学療法にもかかわらず予後不良。
summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor and seminoma) in a 42-year-old man with Down syndrome and cryptorchidism. Elevated tumor markers (AFP, β-hCG), PET/CT findings, and surgical findings are detailed. Poor prognosis despite chemotherapy.

title: Retroperitoneal cystic mature teratoma in an adult male: A clinical report of one case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 成人男性における後腹膜嚢胞性成熟奇形腫：1症例の臨床報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 86歳男性における後腹膜嚢胞性成熟奇形腫の症例報告。成人、特に男性における稀な性腺外腹部奇形腫の提示。画像特性について討論。病理組織検査ではリンパ球増殖と限局性扁平上皮異型を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を示した。外科的切除が主要治療として推奨された。
summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal cystic mature teratoma in an 86-year-old male. Rare extragonadal presentation in adults, particularly in males. Imaging features discussed; pathology showed mature cystic teratoma with lymphoid hyperplasia and focal squamous atypia.

title: A case of autoimmune haemolytic anaemia associated with mediastinal teratoma.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫に伴う自己免疫性溶血性貧血の1症例
summary_ja: 前縦隔奇形腫に伴う自己免疫溶血性貧血の26歳男性の症例報告。前縦隔奇形腫が基礎疾患であり、腫瘍摘出術により自己免疫溶血性貧血は完全に軽快した。
summary_en: Case report of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) secondary to mediastinal teratoma in a 26-year-old male. Mediastinal teratoma identified as underlying cause; AIHA resolved completely following surgical excision of the tumor.

title: Intracardiac Teratoma in a Patient With Nonseminomatous Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の心内奇形腫
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性患者の心内奇形腫の症例報告。深部静脈血栓症、肺塞栓症、腹腔骨盤転移併存。多診療科的調整による心内腫瘤の外科的切除実施。
summary_en: Case report of intracardiac teratoma in a 30-year-old male with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Patient also had abdominopelvic metastases, deep vein thrombosis, and pulmonary embolism. Surgical excision of intracardiac mass with multidisciplinary coordination.

title: [(18)F]FDG PET/CT in Metastatic Extragonadal Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 転移性性腺外絨毛癌における[18F]FDG PET/CT
summary_ja: 転移性腹腔外絨毛癌の男性患者の症例報告。血清β-hCG上昇と女性化乳房を呈し、生検が不決定的であったが、FDG PET/CTと腫瘍マーカーにより診断確定。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic extragonadal choriocarcinoma in a male presenting with elevated serum β-hCG and gynecomastia. Diagnosis confirmed by FDG PET/CT imaging findings and elevated tumor marker despite inconclusive biopsies.

title: Smoking and testicular cancer: A Danish nationwide cohort study.
title_ja: 喫煙と精巣がん：デンマーク全国コホート研究
summary_ja: 母親の喫煙（プロキシ：母親肺がん）と息子の精巣がんリスク間の関連性を調査したデンマーク全国コホート研究。セミノーマでハザード増加(HR=1.52)だが、非セミノーマでは増加なし。51年間フォローアップに基づく。
summary_en: Danish nationwide cohort study investigating association between maternal smoking (proxy: maternal lung cancer) and testicular cancer risk in sons. Found increased hazard for seminomas (HR=1.52) but not non-seminomas. Based on 51-year follow-up.

title: Atypical mediastinal mass in the fetus: a review of the literature.
title_ja: 胎児における非定型縦隔腫瘤：文献レビュー
summary_ja: 胎児の先天性胸部腫瘤(縦隔奇形腫を含む)に関する文献レビュー。出生前診断の画像特性、出生後の経過、転帰を論じている。一部の胎児奇形腫は自然退縮を示した。
summary_en: Literature review of atypical congenital thoracic masses in fetuses, including mediastinal teratomas and rhabdomyomas. Discusses prenatal imaging features, postnatal manifestations, and outcomes. Some fetal teratomas showed spontaneous regression.

title: Networks of pre-diagnostic circulating RNA in testicular germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における診断前循環RNAネットワーク
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の診断前血清中の循環RNAネットワークを分析した研究。セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの両方のネットワークでハブ遺伝子TEX14、NARS2、G3BP2などが同定された。腫瘍感受性遺伝子と共通の役割が示唆された。
summary_en: This study analyzes weighted gene co-expression networks in circulating RNAs from pre-diagnostic serum of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients. Hub genes including TEX14, NARS2, G3BP2, and others associated with testicular dysgenesis were identified in both seminoma and non-seminoma networks. Estrogen-related transcription factors were implicated in TGCT development.

title: Familial History in Ovarian Teratomas Is a Frequent Event: 22 Years' Experience at a Single Center.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫における家族歴は頻繁な現象である：単一施設での22年間の経験
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫136例のうち18%に家族性形態が認められた。家族歴のある患者は多焦点腫瘍と転移性病変の発生率が高かった。遺伝的メカニズムは不均一である可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: This 22-year retrospective study found familial forms in 18% of 136 pediatric ovarian mature teratoma cases. Patients with family history showed higher rates of multifocal tumors and metachronous lesions. First-degree relatives were affected in half of familial cases, highlighting the importance of genetic predisposition in ovarian teratoma development.

title: Fistula formation after excision of extraperitoneal paravaginal teratoma.
title_ja: 腹膜外傍膣奇形腫切除後の瘻孔形成
summary_ja: 髄外性傍腟奇形腫の稀な症例。術後5年で膿瘍と腟会陰瘻が形成された。適切な治療管理により4年間の再発なし。長期フォローアップの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of paravaginal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) with fistula formation 5 years post-surgery. The 23-year-old patient developed abscess with vaginoperineal fistula requiring debridement and fistulectomy. Long-term follow-up demonstrated successful management without recurrence, emphasizing importance of postoperative counseling.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia associated with a normal pregnancy with no evidence of uterine primary lesion.
title_ja: 子宮原発巣の証拠のない正常妊娠に伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍
summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍から発症した絨毛性腫瘍の症例。子宮原発病変がないまま、リンパ節転移と高値β-hCGで診断された。妊娠性絨毛性疾患。
summary_en: Case of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (placental site trophoblastic tumor) in a 27-year-old woman with an ovarian lesion during pregnancy. Multiple lymphadenopathy was present at presentation, with elevated bHCG. Immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis despite no uterine primary lesion.

title: Ovarian squamous cell carcinoma: clinicopathological features, prognosis and immunotherapy outcomes.
title_ja: 卵巣扁平上皮癌：臨床病理学的特徴、予後および免疫療法の治療成績
summary_ja: 卵巣扁平上皮癌42例の検討。54.8%が奇形腫からの悪性転化。中央値OS 42ヶ月、5年生存率48.7%。高TMBと免疫療法の効果が示唆された。
summary_en: Study of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma in 42 patients, with 54.8% arising from teratomas. Median overall survival was 42 months, with 5-year OS of 48.7%. High tumor mutation burden was common. Combined immunotherapy with chemotherapy showed benefit in select patients, suggesting potential for future treatment approaches.

title: The effects of regular exercise on cognitive and cardiometabolic health in testicular cancer survivors subjected to platinum-based chemotherapy.
title_ja: プラチナ系化学療法に曝露された精巣がん生存者における定期的運動が認知機能および心代謝の健康に与える効果
summary_ja: プラチナ系化学療法を受けた28人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における6ヶ月間の監督運動介入研究。運動は心肺フィットネス、認知機能を改善し、残留プラズマプラチナ低下。グルコースとリピド代謝改善、内臓脂肪減少、リン酸クレアチン回復動力学の向上。
summary_en: Six-month supervised exercise intervention study in 28 testicular germ cell tumor survivors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy. Exercise improved cardiopulmonary fitness, cognitive function, and reduced residual plasma platinum. Enhanced glucose and lipid metabolism, with decreased visceral adiposity and improved phosphocreatine recovery dynamics.

title: Medium-term Ovarian Volume and Anti-Müllerian Hormone After Ovarian-sparing Surgery for Benign Neoplasms in Pediatric Patients.
title_ja: 小児患者における良性腫瘍に対する卵巣温存手術後の中期卵巣容積およびアンチミューラー管ホルモン
summary_ja: 小児卵巣良性腫瘍（奇形腫含む）に対する卵巣温存手術後の機能保護。正常卵巣体積81.5%、正常AMH 89.5%。再発なし。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 31 girls (mean age 11.7 years) undergoing ovarian-sparing surgery for benign ovarian neoplasms including teratomas. Normal ovarian volume was preserved in 81.5% of cases, with 89.5% showing normal AMH levels. No ipsilateral recurrences occurred during median 46.6-month follow-up.

title: Germ cell tumors in children.
title_ja: 小児の胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 2022年版WHO小児腫瘍分類における更新を反映した小児胚細胞腫瘍の包括的レビュー。分子生物学と病理組織学の進歩を反映した臓器非依存的分類について論議。多診療科的ケアへの統合と診断的課題に焦点。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric germ cell tumors reflecting updates in the 2022 WHO Classification of Pediatric Tumors. Discusses organ-independent classification reflecting advances in molecular biology and histopathology. Emphasizes integration of updated classification in multidisciplinary care with focus on diagnostic challenges in pre- and post-pubertal-type tumors.

title: Clinical Outcomes of Stage IIA/IIB Seminoma Treated With Radiation Therapy and Chemotherapy: Should Regional Therapy be Considered the Preferred Treatment Approach?
title_ja: 放射線療法および化学療法で治療されたステージIIA/IIBセミノーマの臨床成績：地域療法が好適な治療アプローチと考えられるべきか?
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: ステージIIA/IIBセミノーマ153例の治療成績比較。放射線療法の5年再発率10%、化学療法3%。放射線療法が急性毒性が少ない。
summary_en: Single-institution retrospective analysis of 153 patients with stage IIA/IIB seminoma (67 de novo, 86 relapsed). Radiation therapy (78%) and chemotherapy (22%) yielded excellent outcomes with 5-year relapse rates of 10% and 3% respectively. Radiation therapy preferred due to favorable acute toxicity profile.

title: Stage IV malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma palliatively treated with concurrent chemoradiotherapy: A case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の第IV期悪性転化に対する併用化学放射線療法による緩和治療：症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）の進行例。同時化学放射線療法により腫瘍縮小と機能改善が得られた。
summary_en: Case report of malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma (squamous cell carcinoma) in a 73-year-old woman. Concurrent chemoradiotherapy resulted in tumor reduction and improved performance status preoperatively. Surgery was performed, but dissemination and metastases developed 5 months postoperatively.

title: Incidence and Clinical Features of Inguinal Metastases of Testicular Germ-Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鼠径部転移の発生率と臨床的特徴
summary_ja: 740例の胚細胞腫瘍患者分析で、8例（1.1%）の鼠径部転移を同定。全例が一次セミノーマで75%が既往の鼠径部手術歴。転移性セミノーマでの相対頻度は8.3%。すべての患者で手術および/または化学療法で治癒達成。
summary_en: Analysis of 740 germ cell tumor patients identified 8 cases (1.1%) with inguinal metastases, all primary seminomas with 75% having prior groin surgery. Relative frequency in metastatic seminoma was 8.3%. All patients achieved cure with surgery and chemotherapy or chemotherapy alone.

title: Racial/ethnic differences in trends of testicular germ cell tumor incidence in the United States, 1992-2021.
title_ja: 米国における精巣胚細胞腫瘍発生率の人種・民族別傾向の差異（1992～2021年）
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率は1992年の4.71から2021年の6.22に増加。ヒスパニック系男性で最高の発生率と最大の増加を示した。
summary_en: SEER database analysis of TGCT incidence trends (1992-2021) showing overall increase from 4.71 to 6.22 per 100,000. Rates increased for both seminoma and nonseminoma across all racial/ethnic groups. Hispanic men now have the highest incidence rates with greatest increases and more advanced stage at diagnosis.

title: Malignant transformation of a mature teratoma in the duodenum: A case report.
title_ja: 十二指腸成熟奇形腫における悪性転化の症例報告
summary_ja: ベトナム初の十二指腸成熟奇形腫における悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）の症例報告。腹痛、食欲不振、メレナを訴える35歳男性。外科的切除後に補助化学療法。5ヶ月のフォローアップで再発・転移なし。
summary_en: First documented case in Vietnam of malignant transformation (squamous cell carcinoma) in a duodenal mature teratoma. 35-year-old male with flank pain, anorexia, and melena. Surgical resection followed by adjuvant chemotherapy resulted in no recurrence or metastasis at 5-month follow-up.

title: Malignant transformation of the mature ovarian teratoma into early-stage ovarian adenocarcinoma: A case report with literature review.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の早期卵巣腺癌への悪性転化：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から卵巣腺癌への悪性転化の症例。BRCA2遺伝子変異が検出された。文献レビュー掲載。
summary_en: Case report of malignant transformation of mature ovarian teratoma into early-stage ovarian adenocarcinoma in a 47-year-old woman. Previously unclassified BRCA2 variant (c.8167 G>A) was identified in the adenocarcinoma. Literature review discusses clinicopathological features of teratoma-associated malignant transformation.

title: Proposal of a novel index in assessing perinatal mortality in prenatal diagnosis of Sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断における周生期死亡率評価のための新規指標の提案
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断における後方視的研究で、11例の胎児における周生期転帰を評価。腫瘍体積対頭部周囲比と多羊水の組み合わせから新規指標を提案。36%の高い出生後死亡率。100%の感度で死亡率予測。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 11 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) proposing a novel perinatal mortality index combining tumor-to-head-circumference ratio and polyhydramnios. High postnatal mortality rate of 36% observed. THC ratio >3.0 with polyhydramnios predicted mortality with 100% sensitivity.

title: Total en bloc spondylectomy in testicular immature teratoma: Long-term survival amidst vertebral metastasis escalated by growing teratoma syndrome.
title_ja: 精巣未熟奇形腫の椎体転移に対する脊椎全摘除術：growing teratoma syndromeを伴う長期生存例
summary_ja: 18歳男性で精巣未熟奇形腫および腰椎転移例。化学療法後、growing teratoma syndromeの診断。転移部位で成熟奇形腫を認め、脊椎全摘除術を施行。追加化学療法後、17年間無再発生存。
summary_en: Case report of 18-year-old man with testicular immature teratoma and lumbar metastasis. Growing teratoma syndrome was diagnosed after chemotherapy. Total spondylectomy revealed mature teratoma at the metastatic site. Recurrence-free survival achieved for 17 years following additional chemotherapy.

title: Ovarian Fetiform Teratoma in 38 Years Nulliparous Woman: A Case Report.
title_ja: 38歳未婚女性における卵巣成熟奇形腫（胎児様奇形腫）の症例報告
summary_ja: 38歳未婚女性における卵巣胎児様奇形腫（homunculus）の稀な症例報告。超音波検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を示唆。病理学的検査で胎児様奇形腫を確認。fetus in fetuとの区別の臨床的重要性。
summary_en: Rare case report of ovarian fetiform teratoma (homunculus) in a 38-year-old nulliparous woman presenting with abdominal distention. Imaging suggested mature cystic teratoma, but histopathology confirmed fetiform teratoma—a highly differentiated form with fetal-like structures. Clinical importance of distinguishing from fetus in fetu emphasized.

title: Molecular Diversity of Embryonic-Type Neuroectodermal Tumors Arising From Testicular Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍から発生した胎児型神経外胚葉腫瘍の分子的多様性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍から発生した胎児型神経外胚葉腫瘍の分子的特徴を分析。全腫瘍にKRAS/CCND2/KMD5A同時増幅を伴う12p染色体獲得を認知。MYCN/MYC増幅とp53抑制、およびPI3K経路活性化とCDK4増幅の2つの遺伝的パターンで層別化。
summary_en: This study describes the molecular features of embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumors arising from testicular germ cell tumors. All tumors showed chromosome 12p gain with KRAS/CCND2/KMD5A coamplification. Analysis revealed two distinct genetic stratification patterns: MYCN/MYC amplification with p53 pathway inactivation, and PI3K pathway activation with CDK4 amplification.

title: A Rare Case of Testosterone-Producing Non-Seminoma Germ-Cell Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: テストステロン産生性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例
summary_ja: テストステロン分泌精巣非seminomaGCTの稀な症例報告。過アンドロゲン血症関連症状を呈した。GCT患者におけるホルモンスクリーニングの重要性を強調し、精巣摘除前後の標準化されたホルモン検査実施を提唱。
summary_en: A rare case of testosterone-secreting non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The patient presented with hyperandrogenism-related symptoms. The paper highlights the importance of hormonal screening in GCT patients and advocates for standardized hormonal laboratory analyses in pre- and post-orchidectomy assessments.

title: A case of transient hyperthyroidism induced by placental site trophoblastic tumor.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に誘発された一過性甲状腺機能亢進症の症例
summary_ja: 胎盤部絨毛膜癌（PSTT）が一過性甲状腺機能亢進症で発症した症例。29歳女性が産後6ヶ月に異常性器出血で発症。血中hCG上昇と甲状腺機能亢進を認めた。子宮全摘および両側卵管切除術後、甲状腺機能は正常化し2年で再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) presenting with transient hyperthyroidism. A 29-year-old woman developed abnormal genital bleeding 6 months postpartum with elevated hCG and hyperthyroidism. Following hysterectomy and bilateral salpingectomy, thyroid function normalized with no recurrence at 2-year follow-up.

title: Worldwide patterns and trends in ovarian cancer incidence by histological subtype: a population-based analysis from 1988 to 2017.
title_ja: 1988年から2017年における組織学的亜型別卵巣癌発症率の世界的パターンと傾向：人口ベースの分析
summary_ja: 65および40か国の卵巣癌発症率の疫学的分析。組織学的亜型別の地域的変動を記載。多くの国で漿液性癌および胚細胞腫瘍のASRが時間とともに増加していることを示す。
summary_en: Population-based epidemiological analysis of ovarian cancer incidence and trends across 65 and 40 countries respectively. The study documents variations by histological subtype, showing increased ASRs for germ cell tumors over time in most countries despite stable overall ovarian cancer trends globally.

title: Successful Treatment Outcome of a Pediatric Malignant Germ Cell Tumor With an Extensive Cavo-atrial Tumor Thrombus Presenting as an Oncological Emergency.
title_ja: 広範な下大静脈右心房内腫瘍栓を呈する小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍の成功した治療成績：腫瘍学的緊急事態として呈示
summary_ja: 下大静脈および右心房血栓を伴う仙骨尾骨胚細胞腫瘍で腫瘍学的緊急事態として呈示した13か月女児。9日目に緊急腫瘍栓除去術施行。化学療法と尾骨を含む腫瘍外科的切除後、12か月フォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of a 13-month-old girl with sacrococcygeal germ cell tumor complicated by inferior vena cava and right atrial thrombus presenting as an oncologic emergency. Emergency surgical debulking of cardiac thrombus was performed on day 9. Following chemotherapy and tumor resection with coccygectomy, the patient remained recurrence-free at 12-month follow-up.

title: Long-term outcome of the vaginoscopic approach for infantile vaginal yolk sac tumors: A case report.
title_ja: 乳幼児膣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する膣鏡検査アプローチの長期転帰:症例報告
summary_ja: 膣鏡検査アプローチに続く乳幼児膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の長期転帰の症例報告。7ヶ月女児は化学療法に続いて膣鏡検査下での残存病変の同定および切除を受けた(MRIで見落とされた)。60ヶ月フォローアップ間に血清AFPは正常化し、再発なく卵巣/子宮機能が保存された。
summary_en: Case report of infantile vaginal yolk sac tumor with long-term outcome following vaginoscopic approach. A 7-month-old girl underwent chemotherapy followed by vaginoscopic identification and resection of a residual lesion missed by MRI.
