Over 60-month follow-up, serum AFP normalized with no recurrence and ovarian/uterine function preserved.

title: Surgical management of testicular cancer with limited retroperitoneal disease.
title_ja: 限定的後腹膜病変を有する精巣がんの外科的管理
summary_ja: 臨床病期II胚細胞腫瘍の治療オプションとしての一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)のレビュー。論文はRPLNDと化学療法を比較し、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの再発率をレビューし、外科的知見に基づいた補助化学療法決定について述べている。
summary_en: Review of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) as treatment option for clinical stage II germ cell tumors. The paper compares RPLND with chemotherapy, reviews recurrence rates in seminoma and nonseminoma, and discusses adjuvant chemotherapy decisions based on surgical findings.

title: Multimodality Imaging in the Diagnosis and Staging of Gestational Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の診断および病期分類における多モダリティ画像
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜癌の診断、病期分類、予後危険度スコアリング、および管理における多態的画像検査の役割をレビュー。臨床病理学的所見と画像所見を関連付けて最適な患者管理を提案。
summary_en: Review article on the role of multimodality imaging in diagnosis, staging, prognostic risk scoring, and management of gestational choriocarcinoma. The paper correlates imaging findings with clinicopathologic features to optimize patient care for this rare invasive placental malignancy.

title: Nodular expression of seminoma in the neck: An unusual case presentation.
title_ja: 頸部におけるセミノーマの結節性表現：異常な症例提示
summary_ja: grade IIIC intermediate risk精巣seminomaが頸部リンパ節腫瘤で発症した31歳男性の症例。放射線学的検査による診断法を示し、臨床像に基づく画像解釈の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of a 31-year-old male with grade IIIC intermediate risk testicular seminoma presenting initially with cervical lymph node mass. The paper demonstrates radiological modalities for diagnosis and emphasizes coordinating imaging with clinical presentation in seminoma metastasis.

title: The Outcomes of Onco-Testis Sperm Extraction at the Time of Radical Orchiectomy.
title_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術時における腫瘍精巣精子抽出の転帰
summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術を受けた38人の無精子症精巣がん患者における腫瘍精巣精子抽出の転帰。全体的に24%が成功した精子回収を有した。76%が胚細胞腫瘍を有していた(83%は純粋なセミノーマ、17%は混合型)。胚細胞腫瘍患者の生殖能温存データを提供。
summary_en: Outcomes of onco-testicular sperm extraction (TESE) in 38 azoospermic men with testicular cancer undergoing radical orchiectomy. Overall 24% had successful sperm retrieval. 76% had germ cell tumors (83% pure seminoma, 17% mixed). Provides fertility preservation data for GCT patients.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasm: Patient outcomes and clinical pearls from a multidisciplinary referral center.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍：多科連携紹介センターからの患者転帰および臨床的示唆
summary_ja: 1988-2022年に治療された189例のGTN患者の成績。低危険度疾患は治療センターで100％対地元87％の治癒率。高危険度：89％対47％。治療センターへの集約化で成績が向上。
summary_en: Outcomes of 189 GTN patients (molar pregnancy, choriocarcinoma, PSTT, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor) treated 2006-2022. Low-risk disease achieved 100% cure rate at tertiary center versus 87% locally. High-risk disease: 89% versus 47%. Treatment consolidation at referral centers significantly improves outcomes.

title: Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in clinical stage 2a/b non-seminomatous germ cell tumour.
title_ja: 臨床病期2a/bの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: marker-negativeなCS 2 NSGCTに対する原発性RPLNDの305例の多施設分析。5年無病生存率はCS 2aで79％、CS 2bで76％。viable cancer患者において補助化学療法は成績を改善。RPLNDは選択GCT患者の治療選択肢。
summary_en: Multicenter retrospective analysis of primary RPLND in 305 men with marker-negative CS 2 NSGCT. 5-year DFS was 79% for CS 2a and 76% for CS 2b. With viable cancer, adjuvant chemotherapy improved outcomes. RPLND represents viable alternative to initial chemotherapy in selected GCT patients.

title: Fœtal sacrococcygeal teratoma type I: A case report.
title_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫I型：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠30週に超音波で診断され胎児MRIで確認された巨大 type I 仙骨尾骨teratomaの症例。妊娠34週に急性胎児仁窮により緊急帝王切開施行。生後3日に合併症なく切除、新生児は良好に回復。
summary_en: Prenatal case of giant type I sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) diagnosed at 30 weeks gestation and confirmed by fetal MRI. Emergency cesarean section at 34 weeks was performed due to acute fetal distress. Successful postnatal resection on day 3 without complications with good neonatal recovery.

title: Otoprotective Effects of Sodium Thiosulfate by Demographic and Clinical Characteristics: A Report From Children's Oncology Group Study ACCL0431.
title_ja: 人口統計学的および臨床的特性による硫化ナトリウムの耳保護効果：小児腫瘍学グループ研究ACCL0431からの報告
summary_ja: 小児癌患者でのsodiumthiosulfate シスプラチン誘発難聴予防効果をACCL0431試験で複数のサブグループで分析。CIHL罹患率はSTS投与で22.4%対非投与54%。5歳未満児およびneuroblastoma等はGCT等より大きなSTS保護効果。
summary_en: Secondary analysis of ACCL0431 trial evaluating sodium thiosulfate otoprotection in pediatric cancer patients across subgroups. CIHL incidence was 22.4% with STS versus 54% with observation. Children <5 years and those with neuroblastoma/hepatoblastoma/medulloblastoma showed greatest STS otoprotective effects compared to GCT patients.

title: Evaluation of CacyBP/SIP expression and its relationship with ERK1/2 and p38 kinase in testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるCacyBP/SIP発現とERK1/2およびp38キナーゼとの関係の評価
summary_ja: 本研究は免疫組織化学とqRT-PCRを使用して、精巣セミノーマにおけるCacyBP/SIPタンパク質とERK1/2およびp38キナーゼの発現を分析した。癌性組織で正常組織と比較してCacyBP/SIP発現の著明な減弱が観察され、セミノーマ癌生成経路への関与を示唆している。
summary_en: This study analyzed CacyBP/SIP protein and ERK1/2 and p38 kinase expression in testicular seminoma using immunohistochemistry and qRT-PCR. Marked weakening of CacyBP/SIP expression was observed in cancerous tissue compared to normal tissue, suggesting involvement in seminoma carcinogenesis pathways.

title: Vaginal metastasis in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: Experience from Sheffield trophoblastic disease Centre and recommendations for management.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における膣転移：Sheffield絨毛性疾患センターの経験と管理に関する推奨
journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol
summary_ja: 25人の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)患者の膣転移に関する後方視的研究では、76%が化学療法単独で解決した。膣転移は予後上の重要性がわずかで、WHO予後スコアに基づいた標準化学療法レジメンによる保存的管理が推奨された。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 25 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients with vaginal metastases found that 76% resolved with chemotherapy alone. Vaginal metastases had minimal prognostic significance, and conservative management with standard chemotherapy regimens based on WHO prognostic scoring was recommended.

title: Molecular characterization of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma originating from mature teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟奇形腫に由来する卵巣扁平上皮癌の分子学的特性化
summary_ja: 本研究は、275の癌感受性遺伝子のMIPアレイと標的配列決定を使用して、成熟奇形腫に由来する卵巣扁平上皮癌(SCC)の分子学的特性化を実施した。TP53変異は82%の症例で、CDKN2A変異は54.5%で見られ、奇形腫細胞から由来する胚細胞の起源を支持する証拠があった。
summary_en: This study performed molecular characterization of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) arising from mature teratomas using MIP array and targeted sequencing of 275 cancer-susceptibility genes. TP53 mutations were found in 82% of cases, CDKN2A mutations in 54.5%, with evidence supporting germ cell origin from teratoma cells.

title: Laparoscopic Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection After Chemotherapy for Nonseminomatous Testicular Germ-Cell Tumor at a Single Center.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 化学療法後の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者13例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清では、最小限の周術期罹病率で、1例で残存がん、7例で成熟奇形腫が認められた。中央18.6ヶ月のフォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: This study evaluated laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for 13 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients after chemotherapy. Minimal morbidity occurred, with residual cancer in one patient and mature teratoma in seven. No recurrence occurred during median 18.6-month follow-up.

title: Anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma: A case series and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫と関連した抗NMDA受容体自己免疫性脳炎：症例集積と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の臨床レビュー。18歳以上女性の58%に卵巣奇形腫が認められ、早期診断と治療が予後と生殖機能改善につながる。
summary_en: This review describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma, predominantly affecting young women (81%). Up to 58% of women over 18 have underlying ovarian teratoma. Early recognition and treatment significantly improve recovery chances and reproductive outcomes.

title: Prognostic significance of surgically treated malignant struma ovarii with or without adjuvant thyroid-related therapy: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
title_ja: 手術治療された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫における補助甲状腺関連治療の有無による予後予測的有意性：システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性ストルマ患者376例の系統的レビュー。10年生存率91%、20年生存率87%。補助甲状腺治療による生存率改善なく、過度治療の可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: A systematic review of surgically treated malignant struma ovarii (MSO) with or without adjuvant thyroid therapy in 376 patients. Overall survival was 91% at 10 years and 87% at 20 years. Adjuvant thyroid-related therapy showed no survival benefit, suggesting potential overtreatment.

title: Gonadal Tumors in Individuals with Turner Syndrome and Y-Chromosome Mosaicism: A Retrospective Multisite Study.
title_ja: ターナー症候群とY染色体モザイクを有する個人における性腺腫瘍：後方視的多施設研究
summary_ja: Y染色体モザイクを有するターナー症候群患者57例の後方視的研究で、性腺腫瘍の24.6%の有病率(ゴナドブラストーマ14例、ディスジャーミノーマ2例)が判明。47例が中央値8歳で性腺摘除術を受けた。成長ホルモン暴露は腫瘍発症の予測因子ではなかった。
summary_en: This retrospective study of 57 Turner syndrome patients with Y-chromosome mosaicism found 24.6% prevalence of gonadal tumors (14 gonadoblastomas, 2 dysgerminomas). Forty-seven underwent gonadectomy at median age 8 years. Growth hormone exposure was not predictive of tumor development.

title: Potential next generation markers of testicular germ cell tumors: miRNA-371a-3p.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の次世代マーカーの可能性：マイクロRNA-371a-3p
summary_ja: 67の研究のレビューは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍用の次世代バイオマーカーとしてのマイクロRNA-371a-3pを検討しています。この胚性幹細胞関連マイクロRNAは従来のマーカー(AFP、β-hCG、LDH)と比較して優れた感度を示し、診断、監視、フォローアップのための臨床ガイドラインで認識され始めています。
summary_en: This review of 67 studies examines miRNA-371a-3p as a next-generation biomarker for testicular germ cell tumors. This embryonic stem cell-associated microRNA demonstrates superior sensitivity compared to conventional markers (AFP, β-hCG, LDH) and is becoming recognized in clinical guidelines for diagnosis, monitoring, and follow-up.

title: A Unique Case of Bilateral Testicular Tumours: Nonseminomatous Germ Cell Tumour and Contralateral Spermatocytic Tumour 27 Years Apart.
title_ja: 両側精巣腫瘍の独特な症例：非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と対側精原細胞腫瘍が27年離れて発症
summary_ja: 56歳男性が右側非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍治療の27年後に左側精原細胞腫瘍を発症。血清腫瘍マーカーとマイクロRNA-371a-3pは正常。精巣新生物の異なる発生学的起源を強調する例外的症例。
summary_en: A unique case of a 56-year-old man who developed a left testicular spermatocytic tumor 27 years after right-sided nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treatment. Serum tumor markers including miRNA-371a-3p were normal. This exceptional case highlights different pathogenetic origins of testicular neoplasms.

title: Hyperthyroidism induced by paraneoplastic human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) production from testicular tumours: a retrospective clinical and histopathological study.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍からの傍腫瘍性ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生によって誘発される甲状腺機能亢進症：後方視的臨床および病理組織学的研究
summary_ja: 20人の男性におけるhCG陽性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の研究では、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の77%が胎児性癌成分を含有し、54%が絨毛癌成分を有していました。2人の患者がhCG誘発性甲状腺機能亢進症から甲状腺クリーゼを発症し、甲状腺摘除術または抗甲状腺療法が必要でした。
summary_en: This study of 20 males with hCG-positive testicular germ cell tumors found that 77% of nonseminomatous tumors contained embryonal carcinoma and 54% had choriocarcinoma components. Two patients developed thyroid storm from hCG-induced hyperthyroidism, requiring thyroidectomy or anti-thyroid therapy.

title: Radiation therapy for stage IIA/IIB seminomas: Back to the future?
title_ja: 病期IIA/IIBセミノーマに対する放射線療法：新たな展望
summary_ja: 本論文は病期IIA/IIBセミノーマに対する放射線療法戦略を、最近の放射線療法技術の進歩の文脈で検討している。この極めて治癒可能な疾患の95%を超える治癒率を鑑みると、長期治療の有害事象が治療の最適化における重要な考慮事項である。
summary_en: This review examines radiation therapy strategies for stage IIA/IIB seminomas in the context of recent radiotherapy advances. Given high cure rates exceeding 95%, long-term treatment morbidity is a crucial consideration in optimizing therapy for this highly curable disease.

title: Epidemiology and Risk Factors for Testicular Cancer: A Systematic Review.
title_ja: 精巣がんの疫学とリスク因子：システマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 53の研究に関するシステマティックレビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の疫学とリスク因子。遺伝的素因は遺伝率の約44%を占める。出生前内分泌撹乱物質曝露、停留精巣などの早期生活因子がリスク増加に関連。
summary_en: A systematic review of 53 studies on testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) epidemiology and risk factors. Genetic predisposition accounts for ~44% of heritability. In utero exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals, cryptorchidism, and early-life factors are associated with increased TGCT risk.

title: Anti N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis during pregnancy: A case report.
title_ja: 妊娠中の抗NMDA受容体脳炎：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠30週の31歳女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎症例。卵巣奇形腫に関連。精神症状が優位。第一選択免疫療法で症状改善。妊娠継続し経腟分娩実現。
summary_en: A case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis during pregnancy (30 weeks) in a 31-year-old woman with ovarian teratoma, presenting with predominantly psychiatric symptoms. First-line immunotherapy improved symptoms, allowing term pregnancy and vaginal delivery.

title: Apocrine adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma in the anterior mediastinum: A case report.
title_ja: 前縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来アポクリン腺癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性アポクリン腺癌の稀な症例。GCDFP-15陽性、Ki-67陽性10%。手術後6年無再発で予後良好。
summary_en: A case report of primary mediastinal apocrine adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma in a 51-year-old dialysis patient. The tumor showed cribriform/solid patterns with decapitation secretion and GCDFP-15 positivity. Patient remained recurrence-free 6 years after surgery without adjuvant therapy.

title: Coexistence of complete intestinal tract, prostatic tissue, prostatic urethra and bladder structure in ovarian mature cystic teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における完全腸管、前立腺組織、前立腺尿道および膀胱構造の共存：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における前例のない完全腸管、前立腺組織、尿道および膀胱構造の共存症例。26歳女性。腹腔鏡下囊胞摘出術成功。悪性腫瘍なく術後合併症なし。
summary_en: A case report of ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing unprecedented coexistence of complete intestinal tract, prostatic tissue, urethra, and bladder structures. A 26-year-old underwent successful laparoscopic cystectomy with no malignancy or postoperative complications.

title: Remote rupture of ovarian dermoid cyst: A curious case report.
title_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の遠隔破裂：興味深い症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢胞の医原性破裂と遠隔播種の稀有な症例。長期間無症状で経過した。画像所見と病理組織学で診断確定。
summary_en: A case report of remote rupture of ovarian dermoid cyst with peritoneal and liver surface implants in a postmenopausal woman. Despite iatrogenic rupture history, patient remained asymptomatic for extended period. Classical imaging and histopathology established diagnosis of this rare complication.

title: Factors impacting tumor displacement artifact and pseudo-lymphovascular invasion in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍変位アーチファクトと偽リンパ管脈管侵襲に影響する因子
summary_ja: 121の精巣摘除術における腫瘍変位アーチファクト(TDA)と偽リンパ管脈管侵襲(LVI)の検討。セミノーマはTDA(68%)および偽LVI(53%)が多い。延長したホルマリン固定で組織学的品質改善。
summary_en: This study of 121 testicular orchiectomies examined tumor displacement artifact (TDA) and pseudo-lymphovascular invasion (LVI). Seminomas had more TDA (68%) and pseudo-LVI (53%) than mixed GCT. Prolonged formalin fixation (>1 night) reduced TDA and improved histological quality.

title: Optimal Treatment Strategies for Early-Stage Primary Mediastinal Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 早期原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に対する最適な治療戦略
summary_ja: 早期原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍について、化学療法単独と手術ベースの多剤併用療法を比較した全国登録データ解析。セミノーマは同等の成績。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では手術が5年全生存期間向上に関連。
summary_en: A national database analysis of early-stage primary mediastinal germ cell tumors comparing chemotherapy alone versus surgery-based multimodal treatment. For seminomas, outcomes were similar. For nonseminomatous tumors, surgery was associated with improved 5-year survival compared to chemotherapy alone.

title: Surgical Management of Genitourinary Cancer Liver Metastases.
title_ja: 泌尿生殖器がんの肝転移に対する外科的管理
summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器がんからの肝転移に対する外科的切除のレビュー。胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法が第一選択。肝切除術の適応は腫瘍系統と化学療法反応性に依存。がん種により予後が異なる。
summary_en: Surgical review of liver metastases from genitourinary cancers including germ cell tumors. Chemotherapy serves as first-line treatment for metastatic GCTs. Liver resection feasibility depends on tumor lineage and initial chemotherapy response. Discusses different prognostic outcomes across cancer types including GCT.

title: Association of ovarian teratoma with anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis: a case report and narrative review.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫と関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 35歳女性の卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告と文献レビュー。神経精神症状と発熱を呈する傍腫瘍性自己免疫症候群の臨床的特性を記載。診断上の課題と誤診のリスク、プレドニゾロン、静脈内免疫グロブリン、リツキシマブおよび手術的奇形腫切除を含む多科的管理の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in a 35-year-old woman. Describes paraneoplastic autoimmune syndrome presenting with neuropsychiatric symptoms. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and multidisciplinary management including immunotherapy and surgical teratoma removal.

title: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Choriocarcinoma Brain Metastases: Illustrative Case Presentation and Systematic Review.
title_ja: 絨毛癌脳転移に対する定位放射線治療：症例呈示とシステマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 絨毛癌脳転移に対する定位放射線治療の症例集積とシステマティックレビュー。3例の患者(精巣原発2例、妊娠性1例)が画像フォローアップで良好な局所腫瘍制御を示した。文献検索ではCC脳転移に対するSRSの単一症例報告は3編のみで、本報告がこの稀で積極的な胚細胞腫瘍の合併症に対する最大の転帰シリーズである。
summary_en: Case series and systematic review of stereotactic radiosurgery for choriocarcinoma brain metastases. Reports 3 patients (2 testicular, 1 gestational) with good local tumor control on imaging follow-up. Literature review identified only 3 prior SRS case reports, establishing this as largest outcome series for rare complication.

title: Bilateral Somatically Derived Germ Cell Tumors With 12p Gains Arising in High-grade Serous Carcinomas of the Ovary: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 卵巣高異型度漿液性癌における12p利得を伴う両側体細胞由来胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 高悪性度漿液性癌背景の卵巣双側性体細胞由来GCT（卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛がん）症例。予後不良で正確な診断が治療指針に重要。従来報告45例のみ。
summary_en: Case report of rare somatically derived germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma) arising in bilateral ovaries with high-grade serous carcinoma background. Only 45 similar cases reported. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and poor prognosis of somatically derived GCTs, highlighting importance of accurate pathologic diagnosis for treatment planning.

title: Approaches to the Diagnosis and Management of Paediatric Ovarian Tumours and Oncological Outcomes in a Single-centre Study. Evidence in Support Of IPSO Reccomendations.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍の診断と管理のアプローチ及び単一施設研究における腫瘍学的転帰：IPSO推奨を支持する根拠
summary_ja: 60人の小児患者における卵巣腫瘍の単一施設研究。画像検査及び腫瘍マーカーの診断信頼性、術前評価及び術式に焦点。腫瘍漏出回避と腫瘍学的原則遵守の重要性、特に未熟奇形腫で重要。
summary_en: Single-center study of 60 girls with ovarian tumors including germ cell tumors. Examines diagnostic reliability of imaging and tumor markers, with focus on preoperative evaluation and surgical approaches. Discusses importance of avoiding tumor spillage and following oncologic principles, particularly for immature teratomas.

title: Multifocal Hemorrhagic Choriocarcinoma With Diffuse Pancreatic FDG Uptake on 18 F-FDG PET/CT.
title_ja: 18F-FDG PET/CTで膵臓びまん性FDG摂取を示す多巣性出血性絨毛癌
summary_ja: 30歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺、膵臓、肝臓および腎臓の多巣性出血性病変を示した稀な症例。18F-FDG PET/CTで膵臓びまん性FDG摂取を含む全身性疾患を有効に検出。化学療法後HCGレベルが低下し、この高度に悪性な胚細胞腫瘍の肯定的な治療反応を示唆した。
summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma in 30-year-old woman presenting with multifocal hemorrhagic lesions involving lungs, pancreas, liver, and kidneys. 18F-FDG PET/CT effectively detected systemic disease. HCG levels declined after chemotherapy, demonstrating treatment response in this rare and highly malignant germ cell tumor.

title: Surgical approach and recurrence risk in struma ovarii: A retrospective and systematic analysis.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫における外科的アプローチと再発リスク：後方視的およびシステマティック分析
summary_ja: 23卵巣甲状腺腫症例と164悪性卵巣甲状腺腫症例のシステマティック分析。卵巣嚢胞摘出術は再発リスク因子であり、卵管卵巣摘除術で再発リスク有意に低下。病期I悪性卵巣甲状腺腫管理における外科的アプローチ選択の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 23 struma ovarii cases and systematic review of 164 malignant struma ovarii (MSO) cases. Identifies ovarian cystectomy as risk factor for recurrence, while salpingo-oophorectomy significantly reduces recurrence risk. Emphasizes importance of surgical approach selection in stage I MSO management and prognosis.

title: Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in stage II testicular seminoma: a systematic review.
title_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマにおける一次性後腹膜リンパ節郭清：システマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマにおける一次性後腹膜リンパ節郭清のシステマティックレビュー。385人の患者を含む6つの研究。低合併症率と許容可能な周術期転帰。標準治療より高い再発率だが、長期生存データは92%の5年全生存期間(全生存率)を示唆する。
summary_en: Systematic review of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for stage II testicular seminoma. Analyzes 6 studies involving 385 patients. Reports acceptable perioperative outcomes with low morbidity rates. Recurrence rate higher than standard treatment, though long-term survival data suggests 92% 5-year OS.

title: Diagnostic incidence and pitfalls of rete testis hyperplasia and hyaline globules in a multi-institutional study of 348 testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 348例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多施設研究における精巣網過形成とヒアリン小体の診断的発生率と落とし穴
summary_ja: 348例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多施設研究で精巣網過形成とヒアリン小体の発生率と診断的落とし穴を検討。本コホートでの発生率は30%で、これらの所見は卵黄嚢腫瘍と顕著に重複する可能性があった。腫瘍塊による精巣閉塞が病因と推定され、形態学的模倣の正確な認識と区別が適切な臨床管理のために重要である。
summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 348 testicular germ cell tumor specimens examining diagnostic pitfalls of rete testis hyperplasia and hyaline globules mimicking yolk sac tumor. Finds 30% incidence of these findings. Hypothesizes etiology related to testicular obstruction. Emphasizes importance of distinguishing morphologic mimicry for appropriate clinical management.

title: Management of an Incidentally Discovered Ovarian Teratoma in an Adolescent Patient.
title_ja: 思春期患者における偶発的に発見された卵巣奇形腫の管理
summary_ja: 思春期女性に偶然発見された卵巣成熟奇形腫の管理。小児患者での確立した治療指針の不足を指摘。文献ギャップの存在。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of incidentally discovered mature ovarian teratoma in adolescent patient. Discusses management challenges in pediatric population where definitive treatment guidelines are lacking. Highlights significance gap in literature for evidence-based recommendations in children with mature teratomas.

title: Yolk-sac carcinoma mimicking sacrococcygeal teratoma in an infant.
title_ja: 乳幼児における仙尾部奇形腫を模倣する卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。診断困難で、手術・化学療法に反応。再発例で再手術が必要。管理の複雑性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of malignant sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor in 8-month-old presenting as pelvic mass compressing bladder. Describes diagnostic challenges, surgical management, and adjuvant chemotherapy. Documents tumor relapse and need for second resection, highlighting complexity of managing rare extragonadal germ cell tumors in infants.

title: Association of gestational trophoblastic disease with subsequent development of non-trophoblastic cancer.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患と後続する非絨毛性癌の発症との関連性
summary_ja: 3084人の妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者と414万人の対照を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。妊娠性絨毛癌と侵入奇胎では非絨毛性癌のリスク上昇が認められたが、胞状奇胎では認められなかった。癌リスクは妊娠後の短期間に限定され、長期フォローアップ中に正常化する傾向が見られた。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 3084 women with gestational trophoblastic disease examining association with subsequent non-trophoblastic cancer development. Finds increased cancer risk with gestational choriocarcinoma and invasive moles, particularly for gynecologic cancers. Risk elevated in short-term follow-up but normalizes over time.

title: Short and long-term outcomes of arterial and caval replacement during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in metastatic testicular cancer.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんにおける化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中の動脈および下大静脈置換の短期および長期転帰
summary_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に大血管切除(大動脈、下大静脈、腸骨動脈)を必要とした転移性精巣がん患者41例の後方視的研究。2年全生存率45%、合併症率56%を報告。再手術手技は有意に悪い転帰と関連。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 41 metastatic testicular cancer patients requiring major vascular resection (aorta, IVC, iliac artery) during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Reports 45% 2-year overall survival with 56% complication rate. Re-operative procedures associated with significantly worse outcomes.

title: Recurrence and resistance risk factors in low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における再発および耐性リスク因子
summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠滋養膜疾患の化学療法耐性と再発危険因子の包括的レビュー。FIGO score、hCG値、転移などが予測因子。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of risk factors for treatment resistance and recurrence in low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Examines multiple clinical and laboratory factors including FIGO score, hCG levels, metastasis pattern, and imaging findings. Identifies independent predictors for chemotherapy resistance and disease recurrence.

title: Trophoblastic disease and choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患と絨毛癌
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜疾患と絨毛膜癌の遺伝学および後生遺伝学的側面に関するレビュー。水疱状奇胎から絨毛膜癌への進行機序と分子的基盤を解析し、疾患の臨床的管理および治療戦略への示唆を提供する。
summary_en: This review outlines current understanding of the genetics and epigenetics of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including hydatidiform moles and gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors examine molecular basis of trophoblastic cell abnormality and malignant transformation, and explore the connection between these conditions.

title: Sustained Response to Anti-PD-1 Therapy in Combination with Nab-Paclitaxel in Metastatic Testicular Germ Cell Tumor Harboring the KRAS-G12V Mutation: A Case Report.
title_ja: KRAS-G12V遺伝子変異を有する転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるAnti-PD-1療法とナブ-パクリタキセルの併用による持続的奏効：症例報告
summary_ja: KRAS-G12V変異を有する転移性精巣腫瘍で抗PD-1療法とナブパクリタキセルの併用により持続的奏効を得た初の症例。個別化医療に基づくGCT治療戦略の有効性を示す報告。
summary_en: First case report of KRAS-G12V mutated metastatic testicular germ cell tumor achieving sustained disease remission with combined anti-PD-1 immunotherapy and nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy. Case demonstrates personalized treatment approach for chemotherapy-resistant TGCTs, highlighting role of molecular profiling and immune checkpoint inhibition in managing recurrent disease.

title: Central nervous tissue in ovarian mature teratoma: A neuropathological study of 101 resected tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫における中枢神経組織：101例の摘出腫瘍の神経病理学的研究
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫251例中101例（40.2%）の中枢神経系組織の神経病理学的検討。皮質構造形成、プルキンエ細胞の異形成変化、血液脳関門形成など、多様な病理学的所見を詳細に記述。
summary_en: Systematic neuropathological examination of CNS tissue in 101 ovarian mature teratomas (40.2% of 251 cases), documenting structural variations including plate-like formations, neuron morphology, blood-brain barrier formation, and cortical structures with variable dysmorphic changes. Observations provide insights into teratoma pathogenesis and development of neural tissue abnormalities.

title: Nasal immature teratoma in an elderly patient: Clinicopathological and epigenetic analogies with central nervous system counterparts, alongside genomic divergences.
title_ja: 高齢患者の鼻腔未熟奇形腫：中枢神経系腫瘍との臨床病理学的・表観遺伝学的類似性とゲノム学的相違
summary_ja: 70歳男性の鼻腔における稀な性腺外未熟奇形腫で、SMARCA4機能喪失変異およびCNS GCT様メチル化プロファイルを有する症例。カルボプラチン/エトポシド化学療法および局所放射線照射で治療され、3年以上の無再発生存という好ましい転帰を達成した。非定型GCT部位における正確な診断と個別化管理の必要性を示唆している。
summary_en: Rare case of extragonadal immature teratoma in nasal cavity of 70-year-old man with SMARCA4 loss-of-function mutation and CNS GCT-like methylation profile. Treated with carboplatin/etoposide chemotherapy and localized irradiation, achieving favorable outcomes with over three years recurrence-free survival, demonstrating need for precision diagnostics and tailored management in atypical GCT locations.

title: Expression of Heat Shock Protein 90 in Testicular Cancer: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるヒートショックプロテイン90の発現: 後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 84人の精巣がん標本(胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、成熟/未熟奇形腫、絨毛癌を含む)における免疫組織化学的HSP90発現の後方視的研究。HSP90bは胎児性癌、セミノーマ、絨毛癌で普遍的に陽性。HSP90aは可変的発現で胎児性癌で最も高い。
summary_en: Retrospective immunohistochemical study of HSP90 expression in 84 testicular cancer specimens including embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, mature/immature teratoma, and choriocarcinoma. HSP90b was universally positive in embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, and choriocarcinoma, while HSP90a showed variable expression, with highest levels in embryonal carcinoma.

title: Enhancing the accuracy of preoperative and intraoperative evaluation of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors with a focus on fertility preservation in young women.
title_ja: 若年女性における生殖能温存を重視した悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の術前および術中評価の精度向上
summary_ja: 40歳未満の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者48例(ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍)の後方視的分析。術前MRIと術中凍結切片分析の感度を比較。MRIは95.5%の感度を示し、凍結切片分析の72.9%を上回った。MRIは特に未熟奇形腫の検出に優れていた。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 48 women <40 years with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor), comparing preoperative MRI and intraoperative frozen-section sensitivity for diagnosis. MRI demonstrated 95.5% sensitivity versus 72.9% for frozen-section analysis, with MRI particularly superior for immature teratoma detection (88.9% vs 50%).

title: Eleven-Year Experience With Midline Extraperitoneal Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する正中線腹膜外後腹膜リンパ節郭清の11年間の経験
summary_ja: 11年間の単一施設経験：237例GCT患者(72%化学療法後)による正中線腹膜外後腹膜リンパ節郭清。中央在院日数2日で89%が術後第2日までに退院。罹病率低く(グレードIII-IV 4%)。腫瘍学的転帰は許容可能で、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性GCT両者の2年再発回避生存期間は85%以上。
summary_en: Eleven-year single-institution experience with midline extraperitoneal retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 237 GCT patients (72% post-chemotherapy). Median hospital stay 2 days with 89% discharged by POD2; low morbidity (4% grade III-IV complications); acceptable oncologic outcomes with 2-year RFS >85% in both seminomas and non-seminomatous GCTs and only 7 in-field recurrences.

title: Combined removal of ovarian teratoma and oocyte retrieval by laparoscopic surgery under regional anesthesia.
title_ja: 区域麻酔下の腹腔鏡手術による卵巣奇形腫と卵子採取の同時除去
summary_ja: 31歳女性の卵巣奇形腫除去と同時卵子採取の腹腔鏡手術症例。区域麻酔下で10cm成熟奇形腫を完全切除し、7個の卵子を採取、6個の成熟卵子を凍結保存。
summary_en: Case report of simultaneous laparoscopic removal of 10cm ovarian mature dermoid cyst and oocyte retrieval under regional anesthesia in 31-year-old woman with prior contralateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Seven follicles were aspirated during procedure with six mature oocytes successfully retrieved and cryopreserved; cyst was completely removed without intracavitary spillage.

title: Unwrapping the immunological alterations in testicular germ cell tumors: From immune homeostasis to malignancy and emerging immunotherapies.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における免疫学的異常の解明：免疫ホメオスタシスから悪性転化および出現する免疫療法まで
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における免疫学的異常の検討：正常な精巣免疫特権から悪性転化まで。精巣免疫特権の破壊、腫瘍発生に寄与する慢性炎症、化学療法耐性TGCT患者における免疫療法について述べた。予後不良患者での有効性は有望だが確実でない。
summary_en: Review of immunological alterations in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) from normal testicular immune privilege to malignant transformation. Discusses disruption of testicular immune privilege, chronic inflammation contributing to tumor development, and emerging immunotherapy approaches for chemotherapy-resistant TGCT patients with poor prognosis, highlighting promising but uncertain effectiveness.

title: Placental site nodules and reproductive outcomes: a clinicopathologic case series.
title_ja: 胎盤部位結節と生殖転帰：臨床病理症例集積
summary_ja: 中間栄養膜細胞から発生する良性栄養膜性病変である胎盤部位結節(PSN)32症例の後方視的症例集積。最も一般的な症状は異常子宮出血(40.6%)。反復流産(15.6%)および不妊症(15.6%)も一般的。62.5%は子宮器械操作の既往。慢性子宮内膜炎が9.4%に共存。子宮鏡下切除の生殖転帰への利益は限定的。
summary_en: Retrospective case series of 32 patients with placental site nodules (PSNs), benign trophoblastic lesions developing from intermediate trophoblastic cells. Most common presentation was abnormal uterine bleeding (40.6%); recurrent pregnancy loss (15.6%) and infertility (15.6%) also common. 62.5% had prior uterine instrumentation; coexisting chronic endometritis noted in 9.4%; hysteroscopic resection showed limited benefit for fertility outcomes.

title: 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D mediated hypercalcemia in seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマにおける1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD媒介性高カルシウム血症
summary_ja: セミノーマによる高カルシウム血症の症例報告と文献レビュー。腫瘍による1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD産生亢進が機序。セミノーマの高カルシウム血症11例の報告から、ビタミンD介在性が主要機序と考察。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of hypercalcemia in seminoma mediated by elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D production. Elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (>200 pg/mL) with suppressed PTH and normal PTHrP indicates vitamin D-mediated hypercalcemia of malignancy. Review of 11 reported seminoma cases with hypercalcemia; all four cases with available vitamin D data showed elevated metabolite levels.

title: A Case of Dysgerminoma in a Pediatric Patient With a PIK3CD Mutation.
title_ja: PIK3CD多型を有する小児患者のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例
summary_ja: 非定型的発症とPIK3CD遺伝子多型を有する小児ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）。SRY遺伝子と発育不全性腺が異常発症のリスク因子。進行ステージ病では一次的外科管理に続いて補助化学療法を実施。
summary_en: Pediatric case of ovarian dysgerminoma with atypical presentation and PIK3CD genetic mutation. Discusses risk factors including SRY gene presence and dysgenic gonad for abnormal dysgerminoma presentation. Reviews associations between dysgerminoma and other genetic mutations while noting lack of definitive established correlations; outlines primary surgical management followed by adjuvant chemotherapy for advanced-stage disease.

title: Pseudo-myometrial thinning in placental site trophoblastic tumors: a case series with multiparametric MRI.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍における擬似子宮筋層菲薄化：多パラメータMRI症例集積
summary_ja: 胎盤部位絨毛膜癌4例のマルチパラメトリックMRI画像所見報告。腫瘍による圧迫で見かけ上の子宮筋層菲薄化が生じ、病理的厚さとMRI計測値に大きな乖離を認めた。
summary_en: Multiparametric MRI case series of 4 placental site trophoblastic tumors with emphasis on characteristic "pseudo-myometrial thinning." All tumors showed heterogeneous T1/T2/DWI signal with hypointense rim on T2WI and DCE-MRI. Myometrial thickness measured on MRI significantly thinner than pathologic thickness, creating appearance of transmural invasion despite superficial myometrial location, attributed to focal myometrial compression.

title: Prostate Type Malignancies Arising in Ovarian Teratomas - A Report of Two Patients.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に発生した前立腺型悪性腫瘍：2症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内に発生した前立腺型腺癌とBasal cell carcinoma の2例の稀少症例。免疫組織化学により前立腺由来を確認。手術後14ヶ月および11ヶ月で再発なし。
summary_en: Rare case series of two ovarian mature teratomas containing prostatic-type malignancy. First case showed infiltrative atypical glandular proliferation within teratoma; second case exhibited prostate-type low-grade basal cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma (Gleason 3+4), plus goblet cell adenocarcinoma of appendiceal type. Immunostains (NKX3.1, PSA) confirmed prostatic origin; both patients recurrence-free at follow-up.

title: Diagnosis and management of a case of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with lumbosacral metastases.
title_ja: 仙尾部転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断と管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜疾患新生物の腰仙骨転移症例。β-hCG>100万mIU/mL、圧迫症状を伴う13cm の腫瘍。EMACO化学療法と放射線療法により完全奏効を達成。
summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with lumbosacral metastasis causing conus medullaris syndrome and lumbar radiculopathy in 34-year-old woman. Markedly elevated β-hCG (>1,000,000 mIU/mL); lumbosacral mass 13.3×11.5×6.3 cm with bone and nerve involvement. Successfully managed with 10 cycles EMACO chemotherapy and 30 Gy palliative radiotherapy; achieved remission with resolution of neurologic symptoms and β-hCG normalization.

title: Personalized approach to malignant struma ovarii: Insights from a web-based machine learning tool.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫への個別化アプローチ:ウェブベースの機械学習ツールからの知見
summary_ja: 監視疫学および最終成績データベース(329人の患者)を用いた悪性卵巣甲状腺腫予後の機械学習分析。多変量Cox回帰は高年齢、未婚状態、化学療法、複数腫瘍を不良予後因子と同定。多層パーセプトロンモデルが5年生存率予測で最高精度を示し、MSO管理の臨床的意思決定支援ツール提供。
summary_en: Machine learning analysis of malignant struma ovarii prognosis using Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database (329 patients). Multivariate Cox regression identified older age, unmarried status, chemotherapy, and multiple tumors as poor prognostic factors. Multilayer perceptron model showed highest predictive accuracy for 5-year survival; study provides personalized tool for clinical decision-making in MSO management.

title: Testicular ultrasonographic features predict future risk for bilateral testicular germ cell tumour: A long-term single centre follow-up study.
title_ja: 精巣超音波検査所見による両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の将来リスク予測:長期単一施設フォローアップ研究
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者319例の中央値62ヶ月フォローアップ研究で、両側腫瘍発症に関連する超音波検査所見を特定。微石灰化、不均一なエコーテクスチャ、および残存精巣体積低下が再発リスクを有意に増加。従来の5年を超えた個別化監視プロトコル支持。
summary_en: Study of 319 testicular GCT patients identifying ultrasound features predicting bilateral tumor risk over median 62-month follow-up. Microlithiasis, inhomogeneous echotexture, and reduced residual testis volume significantly increase recurrence risk, supporting personalized surveillance protocols beyond conventional 5-year follow-up.

title: Trials of interventions for ovarian and testicular germ cell tumors registered in ClinicalTrials.gov: A cross-sectional study.
title_ja: ClinicalTrials.govに登録された卵巣および精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する介入試験：横断的研究
summary_ja: ClinicalTrials.govに登録されたGCT治療試験142件の分析。完了試験の75%が結果未公表で、登録情報が不十分。多施設前向き研究と結果公表の強化、試験管理の最適化が必須。
summary_en: Analysis of 142 registered clinical trials for ovarian and testicular GCTs reveals significant gaps: 75% of completed trials lack published results, most use single-group designs, and 23% lack reported primary outcomes. Highlights urgent need for improved trial conduct and result dissemination.

title: Neuroendocrine Lesions Arising From Mediastinal Teratoma-A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 縦隔奇形腫から発生する神経内分泌病変-症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生する神経内分泌病変の症例報告および文献レビュー。57歳患者が分化良好な低悪性度神経内分泌腫瘍を呈示。13症例の文献レビューは外科的切除のみで優れた予後を示し、高悪性度成分を有する場合でも疾患関連死亡がなかった。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of neuroendocrine lesions from mediastinal mature cystic teratoma. 57-year-old presenting with well-differentiated low-grade neuroendocrine tumor. Literature review of 13 similar cases shows excellent prognosis with surgical resection alone, with no disease-related mortality even with high-grade components.

title: Mixed Gestational Trophoblastic Tumors-Challenging Clinicopathological Presentations.
title_ja: 混合型絨毛性腫瘍：臨床病理学的に課題を呈する症例
summary_ja: 絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮栄養芽細胞腫瘍の混合型妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍3例。DNA遺伝子型解析で妊娠性起源を確認。診断の複雑性と多成分認識が治療・予後判定に重要。
summary_en: Three cases of rare mixed gestational trophoblastic tumors combining choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. DNA genotyping confirmed gestational origin. Demonstrates diagnostic complexity with variable hCG levels and importance of recognizing all tumor components for prognosis and treatment.

title: Dysgerminoma of the ovary.
title_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のサブタイプであるディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）のシステマティックレビュー。生殖年齢女性に多く、早期段階で診断、良好な予後、受精能温存治療の安全性と補助化学療法の有益性を強調。多施設前向き研究が必要。
summary_en: Systematic review of dysgerminoma, a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor subtype, primarily affecting reproductive-age women. Emphasizes early-stage presentation with favorable prognosis, safety of fertility-sparing treatment, and benefits of adjuvant chemotherapy. Highlights need for multicenter prospective studies.

title: Diagnosis and Management of an Enlarging Placental Immature Teratoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 拡大する胎盤未熟奇形腫の診断と管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎盤未熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告。臨床画像と病理学的知見を呈示。分類に関する議論と治療・フォローアップの管理指針を示す極めて稀な胎盤腫瘍の報告。
summary_en: Rare case report of immature teratoma of the placenta presenting with clinical imaging and pathology findings. Discusses classification controversies and therapeutic/follow-up management suggestions for this exceptionally rare placental neoplasm.

title: CK7+/CK20+/CDX2+ mucinous carcinoma, arising in a mature cystic teratoma of ovary, presenting with disseminated metastasis and pseudomyxoma peritonei.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来のCK7+/CK20+/CDX2+粘液性癌：播種性転移および腹膜偽粘液腫を伴う症例
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内から生じた粘液性腺癌で、広範転移と偽粘液性腹膜炎を呈した稀有例。通常と異なるCK7+免疫表現型。奇形腫における悪性転化の可能性を示唆。
summary_en: Rare case of well-differentiated mucinous carcinoma arising within ovarian mature cystic teratoma presenting with disseminated metastasis and pseudomyxoma peritonei. Unusual CK7+/CK20+/CDX2+ immunophenotype suggesting potential for malignant transformation within mature teratomas.

title: Neuroendocrine differentiation in a metachronous metastatic deposit in a case of mature growing ovarian teratoma: A rare occurrence.
title_ja: 成熟growing teratoma syndromeの卵巣症例における異時性転移巣での神経内分泌分化：稀な報告
summary_ja: 化学療法完了後の卵巣成熟奇形腫のgrowing teratoma syndromeで、長期存在する転移巣に神経内分泌分化を認めた稀症例。転移性疾患における異常な組織分化パターンを示す。
summary_en: Rare case of growing teratoma syndrome in ovarian mature teratoma with neuroendocrine differentiation in long-standing metastatic deposit following chemotherapy completion. Demonstrates unusual histopathological differentiation patterns in metastatic disease.

title: EHMT2/G9a and EZH2: Epimarkers in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: EHMT2/G9aおよびEZH2：精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるエピマーカー
summary_ja: 精巣GCT166例（原発155例、転移11例）におけるEZH2とEHMT2/G9aエピマーカー発現の評価。非セミノーマで高発現、特に胚細胞癌。シスプラチン曝露転移で発現上昇。転移と悪性度の関連マーカーを示唆。
summary_en: Evaluation of EZH2 and EHMT2/G9a immunoexpression in 155 primary and 11 metastatic testicular GCTs. Non-seminomas show higher expression, particularly embryonal carcinoma. Cisplatin-exposed metastases demonstrate elevated expression, suggesting biomarkers for aggressiveness and metastatic potential.

title: Incidence of pulmonary toxicity in bleomycin-containing regimens for testicular cancer with and without the use of growth factor.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対するブレオマイシン含有化学療法レジメンにおける増殖因子の有無による肺毒性の発生率
summary_ja: ブレオマイシン含有化学療法を受けた33例の精巣がん患者（G-CSF併用/非併用）の後方視的研究。G-CSF併用患者の36.6%が肺毒性を発症しブレオマイシン中止を要した。毒性リスク要因のさらなる検討の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 33 testicular cancer patients receiving bleomycin-containing chemotherapy with/without G-CSF. 36.6% receiving concurrent G-CSF developed pulmonary toxicity requiring bleomycin discontinuation. Highlights need for further investigation of toxicity risk factors.

title: Functional paraganglioma, an uncommon cause of seminoma metastasis, diagnostic and therapeutic management.
title_ja: 機能性傍神経節腫：セミノーマ転移の稀な原因、診断および治療管理
summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘍で機能性パラガングリオーマが疑われたが、組織学的にセミノーマと判明した62歳男性。PLAP、OCT3/4陽性。後腹膜腫瘍の診断における複雑性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of 62-year-old with functional paraganglioma suspected on imaging; histology unexpectedly revealed seminoma positive for PLAP, OCT 3/4, c-kit, and MDM2. Demonstrates diagnostic complexity of retroperitoneal masses and importance of pathological confirmation.

title: Understanding Sociodemographic Factors among Hispanics Through a Population-Based Study on Testicular Cancer in Mexico.
title_ja: メキシコにおける精巣がんの人口ベース研究によるヒスパニック系住民の社会人口学的要因の理解
summary_ja: メキシコの244例の精巣がん症例（2007～2020年）の人口ベース後方視的研究。致死性の社会人口学的リスク要因を特定：非セミノーマ組織型、進行期、低教育水準。腫瘍組織型と社会経済的状況による健康格差を強調している。
summary_en: Population-based retrospective study of 244 Mexican testicular cancer cases (2007-2020) identifies sociodemographic risk factors for mortality: non-seminoma histology, advanced stage, lower education levels. Highlights health disparities by tumor histology and socioeconomic status.

title: Endoscopic manifestations of jejunal choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 空腸絨毛癌の内視鏡的所見
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の空腸転移による消化管症状。超高リスク群として化学療法と手術治療を施行。妊娠性絨毛癌の稀有な腸転移例を呈示。
summary_en: Case of jejunal metastasis from gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with gastrointestinal symptoms. Patient classified as super high-risk and received combination chemotherapy and surgical intervention. Demonstrates rare presentation of gestational choriocarcinoma with intestinal metastasis.

title: Nonseminomatous Testicular Tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的なレビューであり、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、奇形腫を含む。分類、病理組織学、病期分類、および多重治療法について論じている。優れた予後を有し、5年生存率は約96%に達している。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors encompassing yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma. Discusses classification, pathology, staging, and multimodal treatment with excellent prognosis (96% 5-year survival).

title: Testicular Teratoma.
title_ja: 精巣奇形腫
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫のWHO分類に基づいた詳細なレビュー。思春期前型（低悪性度）と思春期後型（悪性）の特性、転移能、治療アプローチを記載。進行例は外科切除が重要な役割。
summary_en: Detailed review of testicular teratoma including prepubertal (indolent) and postpubertal (malignant) types per WHO classification. Discusses metastatic potential, somatic-type transformation, and multimodal treatment combining chemotherapy and surgery for advanced disease.

title: Cystic Teratoma.
title_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫は3つの胚葉由来の高分化組織を含む良性胚細胞腫瘍である。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の約20%が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）である。最も一般的には卵巣および精巣に見られるが、縸隔、仙骨尾骨部、頸部にも発生する可能性がある。
summary_en: Cystic teratoma is a benign germ cell tumor containing well-differentiated tissues from three embryonic layers. Approximately 20% of ovarian germ cell tumors are mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts). Most commonly found in ovaries and testes, they can also occur in mediastinum, sacrococcygeal region, or neck. Although always benign with slow growth rate (1.8 mm/year), malignant transformation rarely occurs.

title: Mediastinal Seminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔セミノーマ
summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマは縦隔腫瘍の1-4%を占める稀な腺外GCTである。成長が緩徐で転移能が限定的である。化学療法と放射線療法に高度に感受性がある。5年生存率は87-100%で、精巣セミノーマと同等である。通常、前縦隔上部、特に無名静脈と上大静脈の交差点付近に発生する。
summary_en: Mediastinal seminomas are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors comprising 1-4% of mediastinal neoplasms. These tumors exhibit slow growth patterns and limited metastatic potential. They are highly sensitive to both chemotherapy and radiation therapy. Five-year survival rates have increased to 87-100%, equivalent to testicular seminomas. These tumors typically develop in the anterior-superior mediastinum, particularly near the junction of innominate vein and superior vena cava.

title: Mediastinal Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 前縦隔は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の最も一般的な部位で、症例の50～70%を占める。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は性腺腫瘍に組織学的および生化学的に類似し、両方が12p等腕染色体を示す。3つの主要亜型がある：奇形腫、非セミノーマ性腫瘍、セミノーマで、それぞれ異なる予後と治療意義を有する。
summary_en: The anterior mediastinum is the most common site for extragonadal germ cell tumors, accounting for 50-70% of cases. Mediastinal germ cell tumors resemble gonadal tumors histologically and biochemically, both showing isochromosome 12p. Three main subtypes exist: teratomas, non-seminomatous tumors, and seminomas, each with distinct prognosis and treatment implications. Treatment involves surgical resection or cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by surgery, depending on histological subtype.

title: Yolk Sac Tumors.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍は原始卵黄嚢間葉に組織学的に類似した悪性原始胚細胞腫瘍である。3歳未満の小児における最も一般的な精巣腫瘍で、この年齢群で予後は良好である。成人では、卵黄嚢腫瘍は奇形腫および胎児性癌などの他の胚細胞腫瘍型との組み合わせでしばしば見られる。
summary_en: Yolk sac tumors are malignant primitive germ cell tumors histologically similar to primitive yolk sac mesenchyme. The most common testicular tumor in children under three years, with generally good prognosis in this age group. In adults, yolk sac tumors typically occur in combination with other germ cell tumor types such as teratoma and embryonal carcinoma, representing mixed histological patterns.

title: Orchiectomy.
title_ja: 精巣摘除術
summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術は精巣悪性腫瘍の標準的な診断および治療処置である。胚細胞腫瘍は精巣腫瘍の95%を占め、セミノーマが50%以上を占める。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はほぼ排他的に腫瘍マーカー上昇と関連しており、約10～25%のセミノーマはβ-hCG上昇または乳酸脱水素酵素上昇を示す。
summary_en: Radical orchidectomy via inguinal approach is the standard diagnostic and therapeutic procedure for testicular malignancies. Germ cell tumors comprise 95% of testicular tumors, with seminomas accounting for over 50%. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors are almost exclusively associated with elevated tumor markers, while approximately 10-25% of seminomas show elevated beta-human chorionic gonadotropin or lactate dehydrogenase.

title: Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia(Archived).
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の悪性型である：絨毛癌、侵入奇胎、上皮様栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍。これらの悪性腫瘍はすべて転移し、適時で効果的な治療がない場合、致命的となる可能性がある。
summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia includes malignant forms of gestational trophoblastic disease: choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. All these malignancies can metastasize and prove fatal without timely and effective treatment. Abnormal trophoblastic tissue becomes highly invasive and vascular through dysfunctional regulatory mechanisms, resulting in the development of invasive malignancies.

title: Seminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマは最も治癒可能なGCTで、早期発見時の5年生存率は95%以上である。主に15-34歳の男性に発生し（人口10万対5例）。精巣、縦隔、後腹膜、または腺外部位に発生しうる。組織学的に純粋セミノーマと非セミノーマの区別が治療アルゴリズムを決定する。
summary_en: Testicular seminoma is a malignant germ cell tumor with excellent prognosis, achieving over 95% survival rate if diagnosed in early stages. Occurring in approximately 5 per 100,000 men, with peak incidence between 15-34 years. Seminomas can occur in testis, mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or other extragonadal sites. Histological distinction between pure seminoma and non-seminoma determines treatment algorithms.

title: Germ Cell Seminoma.
title_ja: 胚細胞セミノーマ
summary_ja: 原始胚細胞から由来し、主に性腺（精巣および卵巣）に生じるが、稀に性腺外部位に生じる胚細胞腫瘍。臨床的にセミノーマと非セミノーマに分類。稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は全GCTの1～3%。ジャーミノーマは頭蓋内GCTのほぼ3分の2を占める。若い思春期に診断され、高い放射線感受性で90%以上の5年全生存期間。
summary_en: Germ cell tumors arise from primordial germ cells in gonads or, rarely, at extragonadal sites (1-3% of all GCTs). Clinically classified as seminomas or non-seminomas with significant prognostic implications. Germinoma, the intracranial counterpart of seminoma, comprises approximately two-thirds of intracranial germ cell tumors and generally has over 90% five-year survival rate due to radiosensitivity.

title: Anterior Mediastinal Mass.
title_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤
summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤は胸部腫瘍の3%を占め、50%が前方に発生します。最も一般的な前方腫瘤は「4T's」の頭文字：胸腺腫、奇形腫、甲状腺組織、「恐ろしい」リンパ腫。胚細胞腫瘍、特に奇形腫は前縦隔での重要な考慮です。管理は臨床提示、放射線学的所見、組織学、分子技術を統合して最適な治療意思決定を行います。
summary_en: Anterior mediastinal masses comprise 3% of thoracic tumors, with 50% occurring anteriorly. The most common anterior masses follow the mnemonic "4T's": thymoma, teratoma, thyroid tissue, and "terrible" lymphoma. Germ cell tumors, specifically teratomas, are important considerations in the anterior mediastinum. Management integrates clinical presentation, radiological findings, histology, and molecular techniques for optimal therapeutic decision-making.

title: Choriocarcinoma(Archived).
title_ja: 絨毛癌
summary_ja: 絨毛癌はGTDの稀で攻撃的な亜型で、絨毛性と非絨毛性の2つの型があり、生物学的活動と予後が大きく異なる。主に女性に発生するが、男性では混合型GCTの成分として現れることがある。古くはヒポクラテスが400BC頃に記載したが、より正確に特徴付けられたのはその後である。
summary_en: Choriocarcinoma is a rare and aggressive subtype of gestational trophoblastic disease with two significant forms: gestational and non-gestational types showing very different biological behaviors and prognoses. While predominantly occurring in women, choriocarcinoma can also occur in men, typically as a component of mixed germ cell tumors. The disease has been recognized since ancient times but characterized more accurately in recent medical history.

title: Gestational Trophoblastic Disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患は異常栄養膜増殖に由来する腫瘍群を包含し、胞状奇胎と栄養膜新生物の両方を含みます。悪性形態（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）は転移し、迅速な治療がなければ致命的になる可能性があります。これらの悪性腫瘍は任意の妊娠に続く数週間から数年後に発生する可能性があり、奇胎妊娠後に最も高い危険性があります。
summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic disease encompasses a group of tumors arising from abnormal trophoblastic proliferation, including both hydatidiform moles and trophoblastic neoplasms. Malignant forms (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, placental site trophoblastic tumor) can metastasize and become fatal without prompt treatment. These malignancies can develop weeks to years following any pregnancy, with highest risk after molar pregnancy.

title: Hydatidiform Mole.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎は奇胎妊娠として一般に知られており、妊娠性絨毛性疾患に由来する希な妊娠異常です。異常受精に特徴付けられ、絨毛水腫および栄養膜増生をもたらし、完全または部分である可能性があります。通常良性ですが、胞状奇胎は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣または胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）に進行する可能性がある前悪性病変です。
summary_en: Hydatidiform mole, commonly known as molar pregnancy, is a rare pregnancy abnormality arising from gestational trophoblastic disease. Characterized by abnormal fertilization resulting in villous hydrops and trophoblastic hyperplasia, it can be complete or partial. Although typically benign, hydatidiform moles are premalignant lesions that can progress to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid or placental site trophoblastic tumors).

title: Testicular Seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣がんは細胞由来に基づいて様々な組織型に分類され、セミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が最も一般的です。セミノーマは全精巣胚細胞腫瘍悪性腫瘍の約3分の1を占め、最も治療可能なヒトがんの一つで、早期疾患では98～99%の生存率があります。全体的な発症率は比較的低いにもかかわらず、15～35歳の男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍です。
summary_en: Testicular cancers are classified by cell of origin into various histological types, with seminomatous and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors being the most common. Seminoma accounts for approximately one-third of all testicular germ cell malignancies and represents one of the most treatable human cancers, with 98-99% survival in early-stage disease. Despite relatively low overall incidence, it is the most common malignancy in males aged 15-35 years.

title: Mediastinal Nonseminoma.
title_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ
summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマは精巣または卵巣から由来する胚細胞腫瘍であり、主に若い男性に生じる稀な悪性腫瘍である。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のほぼ70%が非セミノーマで、残り約30%がセミノーマ。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌が非セミノーマに含まれる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の唯一の周知されたリスク因子はクラインフェルター症候群。
summary_en: Mediastinal non-seminomas are germ cell tumors arising from testes, ovaries, or the mediastinum primarily in young males. Nearly 70% of mediastinal germ cell tumors are non-seminomas, including embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas, and choriocarcinomas, while approximately 30% are seminomas. Klinefelter syndrome remains the only well-known risk factor for extragonadal germ cell tumors. Symptoms typically appear only when tumors enlarge.

title: Case Report | Pembrolizumab in the Management of Chemorefractory Gestational Choriocarcinoma: Report of Two Cases.
title_ja: 化学療法耐性妊娠性絨毛癌に対するペムブロリズマブ治療：2症例の症例報告
summary_ja: 化学療法、手術、放射線療法に耐性を示す妊娠性絨毛癌患者2名がペムブロリズマブ免疫療法により長期寛解を達成した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患腫瘍のPD-L1強発現は免疫チェックポイント阻害薬治療の適応となり、化学療法耐性症例における有用な治療選択肢である。
summary_en: This case report describes two gestational choriocarcinoma patients with multidrug resistance to multiple lines of chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation therapy who achieved long-term remission after pembrolizumab immunotherapy. Strong PD-L1 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease tumors makes them suitable targets for immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, offering an alternative treatment strategy for chemorefractory cases.

title: [THREE CASES OF DENYS-DRASH SYNDROME WITH GONADOBLASTOMA].
title_ja: ゴナドブラストーマを伴うDenys-Drash症候群の3症例
summary_ja: Denys-Drash症候群に伴う胎児生殖母細胞腫の3症例が報告される。胎児生殖母細胞腫は高度に悪性の腺性腫瘍の前駆病変であり、性芽細胞腫を含む悪性腫瘍へ進行する重要な前駆病変である。両側性病変や6歳患者の性芽細胞腫（文献で最年少例の一つ）を含む。DDS患者での除睾タイミング決定は複雑である。
summary_en: Three cases of Denys-Drash syndrome with gonadoblastoma are presented, emphasizing the malignant potential of this germ cell tumor precursor. Gonadoblastoma serves as a crucial precursor to highly malignant gonadal tumors including dysgerminoma. Notable findings include bilateral involvement in some cases and a dysgerminoma diagnosis in a 6-year-old patient, among the youngest dysgerminoma cases reported. The timing for gonadectomy in DDS patients remains complex.

title: Case Report: A crushing sensation-a rare case of mediastinal germ cell tumor causing cardiac tamponade.
title_ja: 症例報告: 心タンポナーデを引き起こす稀な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 32歳患者の稀な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍症例。心膜液ではなく腫瘍塊による直接的な心臓構造圧迫により、タンポナーデ様生理が生じた。血行動態不安定性を呈し、血行動態最適化と外科的介入による腫瘍塊除去を必要とした学際的アプローチが実施。
summary_en: Case report of mediastinal germ cell tumor causing tamponade-like physiology through direct tumor compression of cardiac structures rather than pericardial fluid. Unusual presentation in 32-year-old patient with hemodynamic instability requiring multidisciplinary approach for hemodynamic optimization and definitive mass removal through surgical intervention.

title: Squamous Cell Carcinoma Originating From Mature Cystic Teratoma of the Ovary Diagnosed 10 Years After Initial Tumor Detection: A Case Report.
title_ja: 初期腫瘍検出から10年後に診断された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 69歳女性で初期検出10年後に診断された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌の症例。17cm大嚢胞で画像上悪性所見は最小限。組織診で扁平上皮癌原位置と部分的な間質浸潤を認めた。放射線学的安定性にもかかわらず卵巣奇形腫の遅延悪性転化の可能性を強調。
summary_en: Case of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma 10 years after initial detection in 69-year-old woman. Large 17cm cyst with minimal imaging evidence of malignancy. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma in situ with partial stromal invasion. Highlights delayed malignant transformation potential of mature ovarian teratomas despite radiographic stability.

title: Exploring the microbiome-gut-testis axis in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腸内微生物-腸-精巣軸の探索
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における腸内微生物-腸-精巣軸を探索するレビュー論文。若い男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍について議論。菌叢異常が免疫応答、炎症、ホルモンバランスに及ぼす影響を論じる。難治性患者における治療有効性改善と化学療法誘発毒性低減のための微生物バイオマーカーと微生物叢修飾戦略を提案する。
summary_en: Review article exploring the microbiome-gut-testis axis in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), the most common malignancy in young men. Discusses dysbiosis effects on immune response, inflammation, and hormonal imbalances. Proposes microbial biomarkers and microbiota modulation strategies for improving treatment efficacy in refractory patients while reducing chemotherapy-induced toxicity.

title: Opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome in the course of teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 奇形腫の経過中の眼球移動異常-ミオクローヌス症候群：症例報告
summary_ja: 奇形腫に伴う眼球振盪筋クローヌス症候群の症例報告である。傍腫瘍症候群として眼球振盪、筋クローヌス、失調、行動異常と睡眠障害を呈した。当該症候群の診断経路と治療方針を論じ、腫瘍摘出が治療の基本であることを示唆。
summary_en: Case report of opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome (OMS) as paraneoplastic manifestation in 20-year-old female with teratoma. OMS is rare inflammatory neurological disease presenting with opsoclonus, myoclonus, ataxia, behavioral and sleep disturbances. Literature review demonstrates that tumor removal is the primary effective treatment for OMS syndrome associated with teratoma.

title: A Rare Case of Anti-Caspr2 Autoimmune Encephalitis Associated with a Testicular Mixed Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に随伴した抗CASPR2自己免疫性脳炎の稀な症例
journal: J Community Hosp Intern Med Perspect
summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に随伴した抗CASPR2抗体仲介の自己免疫性脳炎の最初の報告症例。腫瘍随伴性辺縁系脳炎として人格・行動変化、精神病、記憶喪失、けいれんなどの神経精神医学的後遺症を呈した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な自己免疫学的発現と、交叉反応腫瘍抗体の重要性を示唆する症例である。
summary_en: First reported case of anti-CASPR2 antibody-mediated autoimmune encephalitis associated with testicular mixed germ cell tumor. Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis presented with neuropsychiatric sequelae including personality and behavioral changes, psychosis, memory loss, and seizures. Case highlights rare autoimmune manifestation of testicular germ cell tumors and importance of cross-reacting tumor antibodies.

title: [A CASE OF TESTICULAR TUMOR UNDER CONSIDERATION FOR PARTIAL ORCHIECTOMY THROUGH RAPID INTRAOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS].
title_ja: 迅速術中診断による部分精巣摘除を検討した精巣腫瘍の一例
summary_ja: 35歳男性のセミノーマの症例で、不妊症評価中に直径10mm精巣腫瘍と陰性の腫瘍マーカーで発見された。右精巣萎縮により迅速術中病理診断が実施されセミノーマが確認。根治的精巣摘除術と生殖能力温存のための術中精子採取を施行し、術後テストステロン補充療法を実施した。
summary_en: Case of 35-year-old male with seminoma discovered during infertility evaluation with 10mm testicular mass and negative tumor markers. Right testicular atrophy prompted rapid intraoperative pathology diagnosis confirming seminoma. Patient underwent radical orchiectomy with intraoperative sperm extraction for fertility preservation followed by testosterone replacement therapy post-operatively.

title: Non-neoplastic and neoplastic scrotal pathologies on magnetic resonance imaging: a pictorial essay.
title_ja: 磁気共鳴画像法における精巣および陰嚢の非腫瘍性および腫瘍性病変：図解エッセイ
summary_ja: 陰嚢および精巣病変の磁気共鳴画像法による図解レビュー。特に超音波検査で不確実な所見を呈する場合において、精巣内・精巣外病変および腫瘍性・非腫瘍性病変の鑑別に優れた能力を有する。術前の腫瘍病期分類と臨床判断決定において重要な役割を果たし、外科的評価が必要な陰嚢病変患者のケアにおける放射線科医の重要な役割を強調する。
summary_en: Pictorial review of testicular and scrotal pathologies on magnetic resonance imaging with emphasis on differentiating intratesticular versus extratesticular lesions and neoplastic versus non-neoplastic pathologies. Highlights MRI's critical role in preoperative tumor staging and clinical decision-making for patients presenting with scrotal lesions requiring surgical evaluation.

title: Pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma mimicking pulmonary thromboembolism: a case report.
title_ja: 肺血栓塞栓症を模倣する肺動脈絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 32歳女性の肺血栓塞栓症として疑われた肺動脈絨毛癌の症例。喀血と胸痛を伴う患者。生検により悪性トロフォブラスト細胞を認めた。化学療法の実施でβ-hCGの正常化とイメージング改善が確認され、1年間のフォローアップで寛解達成。
summary_en: Case of primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma presenting as suspected pulmonary thromboembolism in 32-year-old female with hemoptysis and chest pain. Diagnosed by biopsy revealing malignant trophoblastic cells. Patient achieved complete remission with chemotherapy, confirmed by normalized β-hCG and imaging improvement at 1-year follow-up.

title: Mitochondrial genome variability and metabolic alterations reveal new biomarkers of resistance in testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: ミトコンドリアゲノム変異性と代謝変化は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療抵抗性の新規バイオマーカーを明らかにする
summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性対感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるミトコンドリアゲノム突然変異を同定した研究。耐性細胞は複数のmtgene突然変異と解糖代謝の選好を示し、感受性細胞は酸化的リン酸化を好んだ。知見は耐性TGCT表現型を区別し、代謝標的治療戦略を示唆。
summary_en: Study identifying mitochondrial genome mutations in cisplatin-resistant versus cisplatin-sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Resistant cells showed mutations in multiple mt genes and preferential glycolysis metabolism, while sensitive cells preferred oxidative phosphorylation. Findings provide novel molecular biomarkers distinguishing resistant TGCT phenotype and suggesting metabolic-targeted therapeutic strategies.

title: Characteristics and prognosis of testicular mixed teratoma and seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣混合型奇形腫とセミノーマの特性と予後
summary_ja: SEER登録データを用いた精巣混合奇形腫・セミノーマ3296例の予後研究である。進行T分類、遠隔転移、大きな腫瘍サイズ、リンパ管侵襲が不良予後因子。遠隔転移とリンパ節郭清が独立予後因子として抽出された。
summary_en: Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database study of 3,296 patients with testicular mixed teratoma and seminoma (TMTS). Advanced T stage, lymph node and distant metastasis, large tumor size, and lymphovascular invasion predicted inferior overall and cancer-specific survival. Distant metastasis and regional lymph node resection emerged as independent prognostic factors.

title: Retroperitoneal Teratoma in a Newborn: A Case Report and Diagnostic Insights.
title_ja: 新生児の後腹膜奇形腫：症例報告と診断的知見
summary_ja: 出生前に検出された後腹膜未熟奇形腫の新生児症例報告。左上腎部の大きな病変を画像で示す。血清AFP、β-hCG、MIBG シンチグラフィー結果は正常。出生後6日目の開腹術で悪性成分のない未熟奇形腫を確認。良性病理と一致したAFP軌跡で出生後35日目に退院。
summary_en: Case report of newborn with prenatal-detected retroperitoneal immature teratoma showing large left suprarenal mass on imaging. Serum AFP, β-hCG, and MIBG scintigraphy results were normal. Exploratory laparotomy on postnatal day 6 confirmed immature teratoma without malignant components. Patient discharged on day 35 with normal AFP trajectory consistent with benign pathology.

title: Successful Treatment of an Atypical Presentation of Disseminated Retroperitoneal Seminoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 非典型的に発症した播種性後腹膜セミノーマの治療成功例：症例報告
summary_ja: 大動脈下大静脈塊として発症した転移性セミノーマの症例である。複数の経皮的生検後に開放生検で診断。根治的精巣摘出とBEP化学療法（3コース）で治療。6ヶ月後のPET/CTで腫瘍ほぼ消失、β-hCGとLDH正常化。
summary_en: Unusual case of 56-year-old male with disseminated seminoma presenting as aortocaval mass. Diagnosis required open surgical biopsy after unsuccessful percutaneous attempts. Treated with radical orchiectomy and three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy. Six-month follow-up PET/CT showed near-complete mass resolution with normalization of β-hCG and lactate dehydrogenase.

title: Mediastinal Yolk Sac Tumor With Solitary Adenocarcinoma in Subcarinal Nodal Metastases.
title_ja: 準気管支部リンパ節転移における単発性腺癌を伴う縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と転移リンパ節腺癌の症例報告である。化学療法後の腫瘍摘出で原発巣に生存細胞なく、転移リンパ節に腺癌を認めた。体細胞型固形悪性腫瘍への転化を示唆する稀な所見。
summary_en: Case of 41-year-old male with mediastinal yolk sac tumor presenting with adenocarcinoma in subcarinal lymph node metastases. Computed tomography revealed enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes and anterior mediastinal mass. After chemotherapy, tumor resection showed no viable cells in primary tumor but adenocarcinoma in metastatic nodes, demonstrating somatic-type solid malignancy transformation.

title: Correction: Auskalnis et al. Synchronous Seminoma of Testis and Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Rare Case Report. Medicina 2024, 60, 1553.
title_ja: 訂正：Auskalnis他による同時性精巣セミノーマと腎細胞癌の症例報告 Medicina 2024, 60, 1553
summary_ja: 同時性精巣セミノーマと腎細胞癌の症例報告に関する訂正通知。セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍は若年成人男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍であり、胚細胞腫瘍文献と高い関連性がある。稀な同時悪性腫瘍の管理について詳述。
summary_en: Correction notice to previously published case report of synchronous seminoma of testis and renal cell carcinoma. Seminomatous testicular tumors represent the most common malignancy in young adult males and are highly relevant to germ cell tumor literature. Original case report details the management of rare concurrent malignancies.

title: Can Multiparametric Ultrasound Analysis Predict Malignancy in Testes? An 11-Year Single Center Experience with Testicular Masses.
title_ja: マルチパラメトリック超音波検査は精巣悪性腫瘍を予測できるか？精巣腫瘤に関する11年間の単一施設経験
summary_ja: 精巣病変の多パラメトリック超音波評価の単施設11年研究である。CEUS感度93.8%、特異度85.2%。エラストグラフィで悪性腫瘍の高い組織硬度（77.8%）を検出。診断支援ツールとしての有用性を示唆。
summary_en: Eleven-year retrospective study of 342 patients with testicular lesions using multiparametric ultrasound including contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) and elastography. Of 84 surgically explored cases, malignancy confirmed in 48 (57.1%). CEUS demonstrated sensitivity 93.8% and specificity 85.2%. Elastography showed tissue stiffness in 77.8% of malignant versus 41.0% of benign tumors.

title: The Role of Radioiodine Therapy in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer Arising from Struma Ovarii: A Systematic Review.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた分化型甲状腺癌の放射性ヨウ素療法の役割：システマティックレビュー
summary_ja: ストルマオバリ（卵巣奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織）由来の分化型甲状腺癌に関する系統的レビュー。甲状腺全摘出と放射性ヨード治療が多用されたが、大多数の患者では放射性核種療法が必須ではなかった。選別的治療の重要性を指摘。
summary_en: Systematic review of radioiodine therapy in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) arising from struma ovarii, an ovarian teratoma containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Analysis of 11 studies showed most cases treated with total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, particularly with distant metastases. However, majority of patients did not require radiometabolic therapy, suggesting selective rather than universal treatment approach.

title: Ex Vivo Fluorescence Confocal Microscopy Meets Innovation and Revolutionary Technology, for "Real-Time" Histological Evaluation, in Pediatric Surgical Oncology.
title_ja: 小児外科腫瘍学における生体外蛍光共焦点顕微鏡による「リアルタイム」病理組織学的評価
summary_ja: 小児外科腫瘍学における5症例の生体外蛍光共焦点顕微鏡(FCM)の予備的研究。悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌90%、卵黄嚢腫瘍10%）を含む症例でFCMが確定病理組織学的検査と高度な一致を示し、迅速な腫瘍特性化のための補助診断ツールとしての有望性を示唆。
summary_en: Preliminary study of ex vivo fluorescence confocal microscopy (FCM) for real-time pathological diagnosis in five pediatric surgical oncology cases including malignant mixed germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma 90%, yolk sac tumor 10%). FCM demonstrated high agreement with definitive histopathology. Shows promise as adjunctive diagnostic tool for rapid tumor characterization and intraoperative surgical guidance.

title: Non-Invasive miRNA Profiling for Differential Diagnosis and Prognostic Stratification of Testicular Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 非侵襲的マイクロRNA(miRNA)プロファイリングによる精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別診断と予後層別化
summary_ja: TCGA-TGCTデータベースの134患者における転写産物解析で、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、奇形腫の間での差別的なマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現パターンを同定。7つの上昇シグネチャーと7つの低下シグネチャーは鑑別診断と予後層別化で高い感度/特異度（0.94/1.0、0.97/0.94）を示し、AJCC病期および遠隔転移に関連。
summary_en: Transcriptomic analysis of 134 testicular germ cell tumor patients from TCGA database identifying differential miRNA expression patterns among seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, mixed GCT, and teratoma. Seven upregulated and seven downregulated miRNA signatures showed high sensitivity/specificity (0.94/1.0 and 0.97/0.94) for differential diagnosis and were associated with AJCC stage and distant metastasis.

title: [A Case of Metastatic Extragonadal Germ Cell Tumor Treated by Surgical Resection after Chemotherapy and Follow-Up Time : A Case Report].
title_ja: 化学療法後の外科的切除およびフォローアップで治療した転移性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 21歳男性の原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍で肺および脳への多発転移を有した症例。導入化学療法(4サイクルBEP)および救援化学療法(4サイクルTIP)で治療。後腹膜リンパ節郭清および肺転移切除後、残存癌細胞なし。
summary_en: Case of 21-year-old male with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumor with multiple lung and brain metastases. Treated with induction (four cycles BEP) and salvage chemotherapy (four cycles TIP). After gradual tumor marker decline, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and lung metastasis resection performed without residual cancer cells. Case demonstrates value of close monitoring post-chemotherapy to guide additional interventions.

title: [A Case of Primary Mediastinal Germ Cell Tumor Requiring Multidisciplinary Treatment Due to Circulatory Disturbance Associated with Cardiopulmonary Compression].
title_ja: 心肺圧迫に関連する循環障害を有する原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の多学際的治療を要した症例
summary_ja: 28歳男性の17×16×8cm前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で卵黄嚢成分を有し、右心圧迫と心原性ショックを引き起こした症例。BEP化学療法後、AFPが24,769 ng/mlで上昇。静脈-動脈体外膜酸素化支持が必要。腫瘍縮小手術後、心血管状態は急速に改善。
summary_en: Case of 28-year-old male with 17×16×8cm anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor with yolk sac component causing right heart compression and cardiogenic shock. Elevated AFP at 24,769ng/ml. After BEP chemotherapy, cardiac decompensation required veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support. Tumor debulking surgery performed; post-operative cardiovascular status improved rapidly. Demonstrates necessity of multidisciplinary collaboration.

title: Congenital Epignathus and Extra-Uterine Intrapartum Treatment Procedure.
title_ja: 先天性エピグナトゥスと子宮外産時治療処置
summary_ja: 先天性エピグナトゥスの症例報告。稀な奇形腫で硬口蓋に由来し、発生率は生児出生35,000～200,000人に1人。超音波検査で31週間に出生前診断、MRIで35週間に確認。EXIT処置により塊摘除と気道開存を確保。
summary_en: Case report of congenital epignathus, a rare teratoma originating from hard palate (incidence 1 in 35,000-200,000 live births). Prenatal diagnosis established at 31 weeks by ultrasound and confirmed by MRI at 35 weeks. Extra-uterine intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure successfully performed to excise mass and ensure airway patency. Demonstrates importance of prenatal diagnosis and multidisciplinary delivery management.

title: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Ovary: A Rare Case.
title_ja: 卵巣扁平上皮癌：稀な症例
summary_ja: 本論文は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化した卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例と、その組織発生、診断、治療戦略についての文献レビューを提示しています。
summary_en: This case report presents squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) in a 62-year-old woman. The paper discusses histogenesis, diagnostic approaches, and treatment strategies for this rare malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

title: Stalking the stalk: Isolated pituitary stalk thickening and predictive factors for proliferative disease.
title_ja: 茎を追い詰める：孤立性下垂体茎肥厚と増殖性疾患の予測因子
summary_ja: この研究は孤立性下垂体茎肥厚を有する小児における増殖性疾患の予測因子を評価した。結果は35％が増殖性疾患を発症し、8例のジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）が同定され、進行性の茎肥厚が診断と関連していた。
summary_en: This study evaluates predictive factors for proliferative disease in children with isolated pituitary stalk thickening. Results show 35% developed proliferative disease, with eight germinomas identified, and progressive stalk thickening associated with germinoma diagnosis.

title: Coexisting growing teratoma syndrome and gliomatosis peritonei following ovarian immature teratoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫治療後に併発したgrowing teratoma syndromeと腹膜神経膠腫症：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫化学療法後のgrowing teratoma syndromeと腹膜神経膠腫症の稀な併発例。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン化学療法後に妊孕性温存手術施行。悪性成分と良性成分の区別の診断的課題を強調。
summary_en: This case report describes the rare coexistence of growing teratoma syndrome and gliomatosis peritonei following chemotherapy for ovarian immature teratoma. The paper emphasizes the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing benign from malignant components in post-treatment residual masses.

title: Spinal Metastases in Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Testicular Tumors: Prognosis and Integrated Therapeutic Approaches-A Systematic Review with an Institutional Case Illustration.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における脊椎転移：予後と統合的治療アプローチ - 施設症例を含むシステマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脊椎転移164症例のシステマティックレビュー。シスプラチン系化学療法および外科的介入を検討。全身および局所疾患管理における多学科ケアの重要性を強調している。
summary_en: This systematic review evaluates spinal metastases in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, analyzing 164 cases. It discusses chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy approaches, highlighting the importance of multidisciplinary care for managing both systemic and localized disease.

title: Ruptured Ovarian Mature Cystic Teratoma with Adenocarcinoma Transformation: A Case Report.
title_ja: 腺癌転化を伴った破裂卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 75歳閉経後女性の破裂卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に腺癌が転化した症例。手術および組織検査で確認。カルボプラチンとパクリタキセル化学療法後、10か月のフォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: This case report presents adenocarcinoma transformation of a ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a 75-year-old postmenopausal woman. After partial rupture and surgery, histopathology confirmed adenocarcinoma, followed by chemotherapy with good long-term outcomes.

title: Comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic approaches to uterine teratoma in postmenopausal women: a case study and review.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における子宮奇形腫の包括的診断および治療アプローチ：症例研究および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 54歳閉経後女性の成熟良性子宮奇形腫の症例報告および文献レビュー。子宮鏡手術により神経組織、骨、軟骨を含む成熟組織の腫瘤を切除。稀な子宮腫瘍の診断基準と治療戦略を提示している。
summary_en: This case report and review describe a mature benign uterine teratoma in a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman. Hysteroscopic surgery successfully removed the mass containing various mature tissues. The paper provides diagnostic criteria and treatment strategies for this rare uterine tumor.

title: Mucinous Cystadenoma Arising in Post-Treatment Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor: A Rare Occurrence.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍治療後に発生した粘液性嚢胞腺腫：稀な症例
summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に発生した粘液性嚢胞腺腫の症例報告。化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘍における診断的課題を強調している。
summary_en: This case report describes mucinous cystadenoma arising from residual mass in a patient treated for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The unexpected histological finding highlights diagnostic challenges in post-chemotherapy residual masses.

title: Primary Retroperitoneal Seminoma-An Uncommon Presentation With Significant Implications.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜セミノーマ—臨床的意義のある稀な臨床発症
summary_ja: 本論文は胚細胞腫瘍の5%未満である後腹膜セミノーマの稀な症例を報告しており、診断と多学科的治療アプローチについて論述しています。
summary_en: This case report presents primary retroperitoneal seminoma in a 40-year-old male, a rare germ cell tumor accounting for <5% of such tumors. Discusses diagnostic challenges, surgical management, and BEP chemotherapy, achieving complete response with multidisciplinary care.

title: Primary classical seminoma of the testis with rhabdoid differentiation.
title_ja: ラブドイド分化を有する精巣の古典的セミノーマ
summary_ja: 本論文は横紋筋肉腫様分化を示す精巣セミノーマの初報告です。この分化パターンは予後不良を示唆し、病理診断の重要性を強調しています。
summary_en: This case report describes the first documented case of a testicular seminoma with rhabdoid differentiation, a feature typically associated with poor prognosis in other malignancies. The report emphasizes the need for careful pathological review of this rare finding in seminoma.

title: Unusual Presentation of Non-Gestational Extragonadal Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 非妊娠性性腺外絨毛癌の異常な臨床発症
summary_ja: 本論文は非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の稀な症例を報告しており、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の0.6%未満です。脳・肺転移を有し、β-HCG上昇を示していました。
summary_en: This case report presents non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with elevated β-HCG, an extremely rare germ cell tumor (<0.6% of ovarian GCTs). The patient presented with neurological symptoms from brain and lung metastases, with histopathology confirming non-gestational origin.

title: Differential expression of metabolic enzymes in testicular germ cell tumors: The impact of glycolytic metabolism in embryonal carcinoma histotype.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における代謝酵素の分化発現：胎児性癌組織型における解糖代謝の影響
summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍における代謝酵素の発現を調査し、胎児性癌が高いグリコリーシス活性を示すことを明らかにしており、MCT1阻害薬の治療可能性を示唆しています。
summary_en: This study investigates differential expression of metabolic enzymes (GLUT-1, MCT1, MCT4, LDHA, HIF-1α) across testicular germ cell tumor subtypes. Embryonal carcinomas show significantly higher glycolytic activity, suggesting potential therapeutic targets with MCT1 inhibitors.

title: [A Case of Intestinal Metastasis of Testicular Choriocarcinoma Revealed Through Gastrointestinal Bleeding].
title_ja: 消化管出血により明らかになった精巣絨毛癌の腸転移の症例
summary_ja: 本症例報告は喀血および肺転移で呈現した精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(60%絨毛癌を伴う混合型NSGCT)の26歳男性を記述する。消化管出血を引き起こす小腸転移は部分的切除が必要であった。BEPおよびTIP化学療法後完全寛解が達成された。
summary_en: This case report documents a 26-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor (mixed NSGCT with 60% choriocarcinoma) presenting with hemoptysis and lung metastases. Small bowel metastasis causing gastrointestinal bleeding required partial resection; complete remission achieved after BEP and TIP chemotherapy.

title: Pediatric Sublingual Dermoid Cyst: Diagnostic Challenges and Surgical Management in a 13-Year-Old Boy.
title_ja: 小児舌下類皮嚢腫:13歳男児における診断的困難および外科的管理
summary_ja: 本症例報告は進行性増殖、音声障害および嚥下困難で呈現した13歳男児の舌下類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)を記述する。病理組織学的確認を伴う口内切除を通じた外科的切除は小児頭頸部奇形腫における診断的および管理的困難を実証する。
summary_en: This case report describes a sublingual dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) in a 13-year-old boy presenting with progressive growth, speech disorders, and swallowing difficulties. Surgical excision via intra-oral approach with histopathological confirmation demonstrates diagnostic and management challenges in pediatric head and neck teratomas.

title: Surgical management of a huge mediastinal mature teratoma in a 2-year-old girl: a case report.
title_ja: 2歳女児における巨大縦隔成熟奇形腫の外科的管理:症例報告
summary_ja: 本症例報告は左半胸郭の広範な浸潤を有する2歳女児における巨大縦隔成熟奇形腫の外科的管理を呈示する。ECMO支援による正中胸骨切開を通じた完全切除は成功し、良性病理が確認され優れた回復が得られた。
summary_en: This case report presents surgical management of a huge mediastinal mature teratoma in a 2-year-old girl with extensive left hemithorax involvement. Complete resection via median sternotomy with ECMO support was successful, with benign pathology confirmed and excellent recovery.

title: Size threshold as a risk for malignant transformation in typical ovarian dermoid lesions: a scoping review.
title_ja: 典型的卵巣類皮嚢腫病変における悪性転化のリスクとしての大きさの閾値:スコーピングレビュー
summary_ja: 本スコーピングレビューは15,295の卵巣類皮嚢腫を25の研究全体で体系的に評価し、大きさに基づいて悪性転化リスクを決定する。悪性転化の>25%は<10cmであり、悪性リスク層別化のための10cmO-RADS閾値に異議を唱えている。
summary_en: This scoping review systematically evaluates 15,295 ovarian dermoid cysts across 25 studies to determine malignant transformation risk based on size. Finds that >25% of malignant transformations were <10 cm, questioning the 10 cm O-RADS threshold for malignancy risk stratification.

title: The New Tumour Biomarker miRNA-371-3p Influences Cisplatin Sensitivity of Testicular Germ Cell Tumour Cell Lines.
title_ja: 新規腫瘍バイオマーカーmiRNA-371-3pは精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株のシスプラチン感受性に影響を与える
summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン耐性におけるmiR-371-3pの役割を調査し、miR-371阻害によりシスプラチン感受性が有意に向上することを示しています。
summary_en: This study investigates miRNA-371a-3p (miR-371) role in cisplatin resistance of testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Using antagomirs to inhibit miR-371 significantly increased cisplatin sensitivity, suggesting potential therapeutic strategy for cisplatin-resistant TGCTs.

title: Uterine teratoma and the role of short-tandem repeat genotyping in understanding origins.
title_ja: 子宮奇形腫および起源理解におけるショートタンデムリピート遺伝子型解析の役割
summary_ja: 子宮奇形腫は稀な腫瘍で、発生起源は不明である。本症例は成熟嚢胞性子宮奇形腫を呈した44歳女性。STR遺伝子型検査は腫瘍と宿主組織の遺伝的類似性を示し、複数座位のヘテロ接合性喪失を認め、未受精卵や胎児組織ではなく、宿主の多能性幹細胞に由来することが示唆された。
summary_en: Uterine teratomas are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors with unclear developmental origins. This case presents a 44-year-old woman with mature cystic uterine teratoma. STR genotyping analysis showed genetic similarity between tumor and host tissues with loss of heterozygosity, suggesting origin from host pluripotent stem cells rather than nonfertilized ova or fetal tissue.

title: A Rare Case of an Aggressive Mixed Germ Cell Tumor Following Testicular Torsion.
title_ja: 精巣捻転後の攻撃的混合型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例
summary_ja: 精巣がんは若年男性に一般的であり、胚細胞腫瘍が優勢なタイプである。本症例は精巣捻転に続く攻撃的混合型NSGCT(胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫)の40歳男性を記述する。著しく上昇した腫瘍マーカー(AFP19,420ng/mL、β-hCG4,749mIU/mL)および急速な増殖はNSGCT初期介入の重要性を強調する。
summary_en: Testicular cancer is common in young men, with germ cell tumors being the predominant type. This case describes a 40-year-old male with aggressive mixed NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma) following testicular torsion. Markedly elevated tumor markers (AFP 19,420 ng/mL, HCG 4,749 mIU/mL) and rapid growth emphasize the importance of early intervention in NSGCTs.

title: Contemporary surgical management of testicular seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣セミノーマの現代的外科的管理
summary_ja: セミノーマは精巣胚細胞腫瘍の50%以上を占める。根治的精巣摘除術後の現代的管理は腫瘍病期とリスク階層化に依存する。臨床病期I疾患では80~85%の再発なし率で監視が好まれる。進行例は放射線療法または化学療法、選択例ではRPLND、残存腫瘤の外科的切除が必要である。
summary_en: Seminoma comprises over half of all testicular germ cell neoplasms. Contemporary management after radical orchiectomy depends on tumor stage and risk stratification. Surveillance is preferred for early-stage disease with 80-85% relapse-free rates.
