Presented with encephalitis, headaches, and auditory hallucinations. Extensive workup including imaging and physician consultations led to diagnosis. Demonstrates rare paraneoplastic effect from dermoid cyst.

title: Patterns of Neuropsychiatric Manifestations of Ovarian Teratomas: A Systematic Review of Case Reports.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の神経精神症状の発症パターン：症例報告のシステマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連脳炎58例のシステマティックレビュー。記憶障害50%、幻覚43%、攻撃性40%が主要症状。神経精神症状が腫瘍診断に先行する例が98%。腫瘍治療で63.8%が完全寛解。生殖細胞腫瘍の傍腫瘍性神経学的合併症の重要な集約。
summary_en: Systematic review of 58 patients from 33 case reports of ovarian teratoma-associated encephalitis (2014-2024). Most common neuropsychiatric symptoms: memory impairment (50%), hallucinations (43.1%), aggressive behavior (39.7%). Symptoms preceded tumor diagnosis in 98.3%. Treatment of teratoma led to full recovery in 63.8%. Long-term outcome data limited.

title: Epithelioid Trophoblastic Tumor Predominant Mixed Germ Cell Tumor of the Testis: A Case Report and Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 精巣の上皮様栄養膜腫瘍優位混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣における上皮様栄養膜腫瘍が優位な混合型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。通常は子宮/子宮頸部に発症し、男性では極めて稀。転移(性)部位で通常認められる。一次精巣発症は3例目で、優位成分としては初報告。他の胚細胞腫瘍型との診断鑑別が重要。
summary_en: Rare case of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) as predominant histology in testicular mixed germ cell tumor. ETT typically occurs in uterus/endocervix; extremely rare in males, usually found in metastatic sites. This is third documented primary testicular ETT and first with ETT as dominant component. Important diagnostic distinction from other germ cell tumor types.

title: Robotic left intrapericardial upper lobectomy, pericardial reconstruction and diaphragmatic plication.
title_ja: ロボット支援左心膜内上葉切除術、心膜再建および横隔膜折り畳み術
summary_ja: 左主肺動脈由来の大型縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のロボット支援胸腔鏡下切除。Growing teratoma syndrome——化学療法後の正常な腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず持続的に腫瘍が増大する状態。手術は左上葉切除術、心膜切除/再建、および横隔膜折り畳み術を含んだ。稀な縦隔GCT合併症に対する先進的外科手術を示す。
summary_en: Robotic-assisted thoracoscopic resection of large mediastinal germ cell tumor from left main pulmonary artery. Growing teratoma syndrome—persistent enlargement despite normal tumor markers after chemotherapy. Procedure included left upper lobectomy, pericardial resection/reconstruction, and diaphragmatic plication. Demonstrates advanced surgical technique for rare mediastinal GCT complication.

title: Malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma with rupture, elevated serum CA199, CA12, CEA: A case report.
title_ja: 破裂を伴う卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化、血清CA199、CA12、CEA上昇：症例報告
summary_ja: 破裂と悪性転化を伴う卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で発症した81歳女性の症例報告。血清腫瘍マーカー(CA19-9、CA12、CEA)の上昇を認めた。イメージングで複雑な充実性嚢胞性塊を認めた。外科的管理により12ヶ月フォローアップで再発なく良好な成績。
summary_en: Case report of an 81-year-old woman with ovarian mature cystic teratoma presenting with rupture and malignant transformation. Elevated serum tumor markers (CA19-9, CA12, CEA) observed. Imaging showed complex solid-cystic mass. Surgical management (total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy) resulted in good outcomes without recurrence at 12-month follow-up.

title: Diagnosis of a large cystic teratoma of accessory ovary complicated with torsion by ultrasound: A case report.
title_ja: 超音波による捻転を合併した副卵巣の大型嚢胞性奇形腫の診断：症例報告
summary_ja: 副卵巣の大きな嚢胞性奇形腫に捻転を伴った稀な症例。18歳女性が右下腹部痛で来院。超音波で14.1×10.1cm大の嚢胞性腫瘤と渦巻き兆候を確認。腹腔鏡下切除術とoophoroplasty施行。術後良好に経過。
summary_en: Rare case of an 18-year-old girl with large cystic teratoma of accessory ovary complicated by torsion. Ultrasound showed 14.1×10.1×9.0 cm hypo-echoic cystic lesion with whirlpool sign. Laparoscopic resection and oophoroplasty performed. Post-operative imaging showed normal follicles in both eutopic and accessory ovaries with good recovery.

title: A large benign struma ovarii with atypical imaging findings.
title_ja: 非定型的な画像所見を伴う大型良性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: ストルマ・オバーリ（甲状腺成分を主とする卵巣成熟奇形腫）の稀な大型症例。44歳女性。充実成分を伴い、甲状腺組織とコロイド様物質を含む嚢胞構造を有する。通常と異なるMR画像の所見を呈示。
summary_en: Rare case of large struma ovarii (thyroid-rich mature ovarian teratoma) in a 44-year-old woman with atypical imaging features. Presented as solid mass with thyroid tissues and cystic structures containing colloid-like material, unusual for struma ovarii typically presenting as small multilocular cystic tumors. MRI characteristics highlighted.

title: Testicular seminoma presenting as an acute strangulated hernia: An intraoperative diagnosis.
title_ja: 急性嵌頓ヘルニアとして発症した精巣セミノーマ：術中診断
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが絞扼ヘルニアを模倣した症例。40歳男性が急性陰嚢腫脹で来院。ドップラー超音波で脱出内容物が疑われたが、手術で精巣腫瘍と判明。根治的精巣摘出術でpT2精巣セミノーマと確認。
summary_en: Case of testicular seminoma in a 40-year-old man presenting with acute scrotal swelling and pain, initially suspected as strangulated inguinal hernia. Doppler ultrasound showed herniated content. Surgical exploration revealed large testicular tumor with hematoma. Radical orchiectomy confirmed stage pT2 testicular seminoma.

title: A fetus with a mass in the oral cavity: A rare case of large oral immature teratoma.
title_ja: 口腔内に腫瘤を有する胎児：大型口腔未熟奇形腫の稀な症例
summary_ja: 20週の胎児の口腔内に発生した大型未熟奇形腫の稀な症例。口腔から突出する10.8×6.7 cm大の腫瘤。組織学的検査で未熟奇形腫と確認。口腔奇形腫は全奇形腫の2-9%を占める。
summary_en: Rare case of large oral immature teratoma in a 20-week fetus. Mass protruding from oral orifice measured 10.8×6.7 cm. Histopathological examination revealed immature teratoma of oropharynx with three germ layers. Oral teratomas comprise 2-9% of all teratomas.

title: Incidental testicular germ cell tumor in a transgender woman: A case report.
title_ja: トランスジェンダー女性において偶発的に発見された精巣胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 27歳トランスジェンダー女性の精巣摘出術標本から偶発的に発見された精巣GCTの症例。臨床症状なく、転移なし。トランスジェンダーの医学的管理と悪性腫瘍スクリーニングの重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case of testicular germ cell tumor discovered incidentally during routine histopathologic examination of orchiectomy specimen in 27-year-old transgender woman. Patient presented with no clinical malignancy signs and no metastases on workup. Underscores importance of screening in transgender individuals.

title: Presacral Keratinous and Dermoid Cyst Masquerading as Meningocele - A Rare Case Report.
title_ja: 髄膜瘤に類似した仙骨部ケラチン性嚢腫と類皮嚢腫の稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 15ヶ月女児における仙骨部ケラチン性嚢腫および類皮嚢腫(奇形腫)の症例。腹痛で発症。尾骨切除術を伴う完全外科的切除を施行。その後、左顔面類皮嚢腫の発症を認め、切除を施行した。
summary_en: Case of presacral keratinous cyst and dermoid cyst (teratoma) in 15-month-old girl presenting with abdominal pain. Midline developmental tumors associated with closure defects. Complete surgical excision with coccygectomy performed. Patient subsequently developed left facial dermoid cyst requiring excision.

title: Teratoma combined with struma ovarii and sarcomatoid carcinoma: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫と肉腫様癌を合併した奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: ストルマ・オバーリと肉腫様癌の併存の稀な症例報告。ストルマ・オバーリは甲状腺成分を主とする卵巣成熟奇形腫。肉腫様癌との併存は極めて稀で初報告の可能性。臨床像、診断、治療、病因を分析。
summary_en: Rare case of struma ovarii combined with sarcomatoid carcinoma in ovary. Struma ovarii is specialized mature ovarian teratoma with predominant thyroid tissue. Combined occurrence with sarcomatoid carcinoma extremely rare, possibly first reported case. Clinical manifestations, diagnosis, treatment, and pathogenesis analyzed.

title: Association between glutathione S-transferases M1 expression and treatment outcome in germ cell tumor patients.
title_ja: グルタチオン S-トランスフェラーゼ M1 発現と胚細胞腫瘍患者の治療成績の関連性
summary_ja: 207例の胚細胞腫瘍標本(セミノーマ、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌を含む)におけるGSTM1発現を検討した翻訳研究。低GSTM1発現は再発回避生存期間の延長と関連。GSTM1はGCTの独立した予後バイオマーカーである。
summary_en: Translational study examining glutathione S-transferase mu 1 (GSTM1) expression in 207 germ cell tumor specimens including seminoma, teratoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma. Low GSTM1 expression associated with better relapse-free survival. GSTM1 represents independent prognostic biomarker for GCT.

title: Intraabdominal mature cystic teratoma in a 20-year-old male: A rare case.
title_ja: 20歳男性における腹腔内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫:稀な症例
summary_ja: 20歳男性の腹腔内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の稀な症例。成熟奇形腫は通常女性の性腺に発生し、成人男性の腹部発生は極めて稀。扁平上皮と皮膚付属器由来の成熟組織で構成。異なる発生部位を示唆。
summary_en: Rare case of intra-abdominal mature cystic teratoma in 20-year-old male. Mature teratomas typically found in female gonads, making abdominal location in adult male exceptional. Composed of mature tissue types from squamous epithelium and skin adnexal structures. Case highlights unusual presentation.

title: Tislelizumab for treatment of a pediatric patient with primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔絨毛癌の小児患者の治療のためのティスレリズマブ:症例報告
summary_ja: 15歳男児の原発性縦隔絨毛癌の症例。発熱と咳嗽で発症。胸部CTで5.4×3.8 cmの纵隔腫瘤と肺転移。β-HCG大幅上昇、AFP上昇。脳転移を認めた。tislelizumab治療で部分奏効達成。
summary_en: Case of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in 15-year-old boy treated with tislelizumab and chemotherapy. Presented with fever and cough; chest CT showed 5.4×3.8 cm mediastinal mass with lung metastasis. Elevated β-HCG (125,554 mIU/mL) and AFP. Brain metastases detected. Achieved partial remission.

title: From pure testicular Teratoma to primitive neuroectodermal tumor: Successful management of Teratoma malignant transformation with widespread metastases in a young adult.
title_ja: 純粋精巣奇形腫から原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への進行:広範な転移を伴う奇形腫悪性転化の若い成人における成功した管理
summary_ja: 精巣純粋奇形腫から原始神経外胚葉腫瘍（PNET）への悪性変化の症例。腫瘍体積の85%を占めた。後腹膜に転移した石灰化腫瘤として発見。手術と化学療法で治療。GCTでの体細胞型悪性腫瘍の稀な発生。
summary_en: Case of testicular pure teratoma with malignant transformation to Primitive Neuroectodermal Tumor (PNET), comprising ~85% of final tumor volume. Presented as calcified retroperitoneal mass from testicular origin with widespread metastases. Successfully managed with surgical resection and chemotherapy.

title: The expression of programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) involves in the clinicopathologic characteristics and prognostic implications of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT): a systematic review and meta-analysis.
title_ja: プログラム細胞死リガンド1(PD-L1)発現は精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の臨床病理学的特徴および予後的意義に関与する:システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 精巣GCT（セミノーマ、胚細胞癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌）でのPD-L1発現と予後の関連のメタ分析。1,589人の患者データ。腫瘍浸潤免疫細胞でのPD-L1陽性は良好な予後と関連。難治性GCTへの免疫療法への理論的根拠。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of PD-L1 expression in testicular GCT including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma, and choriocarcinoma. Analysis of 8 studies with 1,589 patients. PD-L1 positivity in tumor-infiltrating immune cells associated with better prognosis. Implications for immunotherapy.

title: Cut-offs for relapse detection in men with stage I testicular germ cell tumors during active surveillance within a prospective multicentre cohort study using either raw or housekeeper normalized miR-371a-3p serum levels.
title_ja: 積極的監視中の病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍における再発検出のためのmiR-371a-3p血清レベルのカットオフ値：前向き多施設コホート研究
summary_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者34例(純セミノーマ18例、混合型/非セミノーマ16例)における積極的監視中の再発検出のためのmiR-371a-3p血清レベルの評価。新規液体バイオマーカーは奇形腫を除く全組織型を検出。未処理Cqカットオフ値<28は偽陽性わずか1例(3%)。
summary_en: Prospective multicenter study evaluating miR-371a-3p serum levels for relapse detection during active surveillance in 34 men with stage I testicular GCT (18 pure seminoma, 16 mixed/nonseminomatous). Novel liquid biomarker detects all histologies except teratoma. Raw Cq with cut-off <28 showed only 1 false positive.

title: Characterization of testicular embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor and embryonic-type neuroectodermal tissue admixed with mature neuro-glial tissue using a broad immunohistochemical panel.
title_ja: 広範な免疫組織化学パネルを用いた精巣胎児型神経外胚葉性腫瘍と成熟神経膠組織と混在する胎児型神経外胚葉性組織の特性化
summary_ja: GCTの体細胞型悪性腫瘍（embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor）の免疫組織化学的特性化。SOX2はEtNTに最も感受性が高い（100%）。GFAP、S100は成熟神経膠組織に特異的。EtNTの定量化に有用な免疫組織化学パネルを提案。
summary_en: Study characterizing embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor (ENT), somatic-type malignancy in germ cell tumors, using broad immunohistochemical panel. SOX2 most sensitive for embryonic-type neuroectodermal tissue (100%), GFAP and S100 specific for mature neuro-glial tissue. Proposed immunohistochemical panel for identification and quantification.

title: Phosphokinases related to drug resistance in two cohorts from the cancer genome atlas (TCGA): uterine carcinoma and testicular cancer.
title_ja: がんゲノムアトラス(TCGA)の2つのコホートにおける薬剤耐性に関連するホスホキナーゼ:子宮体がんと精巣がん
summary_ja: TCGAデータベースの精巣GCT患者コホートにおけるがん幹細胞関連遺伝子と薬物耐性の研究。POU5F1、NANOG、SOX2、SALL4、ABCトランスポーターの発現異常。再発患者ではPIM1とPRKACAが関連する可能性。新規治療標的として有用。
summary_en: Gene expression analysis of TCGA Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TGCT) cohort examining cancer stem cell transcription factors and phosphokinases related to drug resistance in recurrent patients. Identified altered expression of POU5F1, NANOG, SOX2, SALL4, and ABC transporters. PIM1 and PRKACA identified as potential therapeutic targets.

title: Malignant transformation and tumour recurrence in sacrococcygeal teratoma: a global, retrospective cohort study.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫における悪性転化と腫瘍再発の全世界後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫3,612例の全世界後方視的コホート研究で悪性転化と再発リスクを検討。悪性リスクは生後3ヶ月の3.3%から2年で32.9%に増加し6年後は安定。再発は10.2%に認め36.1%が悪性。Altman型IIまたはIIIと未分化/悪性組織が再発の予測因子。
summary_en: Large global retrospective cohort study of 3,612 sacrococcygeal teratoma patients examining malignant transformation and recurrence risk. Malignancy risk increased with age from 3.3% at 3 months to 32.9% at 2 years, plateauing after 6 years. Recurrence occurred in 10.2% with 36.1% being malignant. Altman type and immature/malignant histology predicted recurrence.

title: Non-gestational Choriocarcinoma of the Ovary: A Report of a Rare Case From Saudi Arabia.
title_ja: 卵巣の非妊娠性絨毛癌:サウジアラビアからの稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 47歳女性の非妊娠関連卵巣絨毛癌症例報告。血管性腫瘤として提示。全子宮腹式切除術、両側卵管卵巣摘出術、BEP化学療法で治療。稀な胚細胞腫瘍で診断上の課題と早期発見の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the ovary in 47-year-old woman presenting as vascular mass with pelvic pain. Managed with total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, platinum). Highlights diagnostic challenges and importance of early detection in this rare germ cell tumor.

title: Surgical Management of Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の外科的管理
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の外科的管理。主に化学療法で治療されるが、手術は複数の段階で重要。外科的切除は局所化疾患では化学療法回避が可能だが、再発監視が必要。化学療法耐性疾患や出血合併症の管理にも有用。
summary_en: Reviews surgical management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), which is primarily treated with chemotherapy but where surgery plays key roles at multiple disease stages. Discusses initial diagnosis via vacuum aspiration or curettage, excisional procedures for localized disease potentially avoiding chemotherapy, and resection for chemoresistant disease or bleeding complications.

title: Equol exerts anti-tumor effects on choriocarcinoma cells by promoting TRIM21-mediated ubiquitination of ANXA2.
title_ja: Equolは TRIM21仲介ユビキチン化を通じて絨毛癌細胞における抗腫瘍効果を発揮する
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞とマウスモデルにおけるEqolの抗腫瘍効果に関する研究。細胞増殖抑制、アポトーシス誘導、腫瘍形成低下。TRIM21アップレギュレーション、ANXA2のプロテアソーム分解促進、β-カテニン活性化阻害。絨毛癌の新規治療候補。
summary_en: Research on Equol's anti-tumor effects in choriocarcinoma cells (gestational trophoblastic disease) and xenograft models. Equol suppressed proliferation, induced apoptosis, and reduced tumorigenesis through TRIM21-mediated proteasomal degradation of ANXA2 and β-catenin pathway inhibition. Proposes Equol as potential novel therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma.

title: Epidemiology of Gestational Trophoblastic Disease.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患の疫学
summary_ja: 妊娠性滋養膜疾患（GTD）の全世界的疫学を概説。アジアは一般的にヨーロッパ・北米より高い発生率を報告するが、最近はアジアで減少、西洋諸国で増加傾向。母体年齢と既往胞状奇胎が主要なリスク因子。
summary_en: Reviews global epidemiology of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), noting methodological differences making international comparison difficult. Asia generally reports higher incidence than Europe/North America, though recent trends show decreasing rates in Asia and increasing rates in some Western countries. Maternal age and previous molar pregnancy are main risk factors.

title: High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplants in adult primary non-seminoma mediastinal germ-cell tumors. A report from the Cellular Therapy and Immunobiology working party of the EBMT.
title_ja: 成人原発性縦隔非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍に対する自己造血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法：EBMT細胞治療および免疫生物学作業班からの報告
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍患者69例に対する大量化学療法と自己造血幹細胞移植の欧州後方視的研究。5年全生存率は34.7%。一次治療としてのHDCは救済治療より優れていた(5年全生存率51.3% vs 25.9%)。移植前の寛解状態が治療効果を予測する因子。
summary_en: European retrospective study of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation for primary mediastinal non-seminoma germ cell tumors (n=69). Five-year overall survival was 34.7%. Upfront HDC showed better outcomes than salvage therapy (5-year OS 51.3% vs 25.9%). Better remission status before transplantation predicted benefit from treatment.

title: Diagnostic imaging analysis to differentiate struma ovarii from mucinous carcinomas, encompassing T2*-based imaging, diffusion-weighted imaging, and dynamic contrast-enhanced imaging.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫と粘液性癌腫の鑑別診断：T2*ベース画像、拡散強調画像、及び動的造影画像を用いた診断画像解析
summary_ja: CT及びMRIを用いた卵巣甲状腺腫と粘液性癌腫の画像診断比較。卵巣甲状腺腫は低T2/T2*信号、高吸収、及び拡散制限なき高リスクTICパターンをより頻繁に示し、これらを組み合わせることで特異的診断が可能である。
summary_en: Imaging study comparing CT and MRI findings between struma ovarii (specialized mature teratoma) and mucinous carcinomas. Struma ovarii showed significantly higher frequency of low T2/T2*-weighted signal, hyperattenuation on non-contrast CT, and high-risk TIC patterns without diffusion restriction, enabling specific diagnosis when combined with lack of restricted diffusion.

title: Dysgerminoma with Syncytiotrophoblastic Giant Cells Associated with a Concurrent Ectopic Pregnancy.
title_ja: 同時性子宮外妊娠を伴う合胞体栄養膜性巨細胞を含むディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）
summary_ja: 27歳妊娠中の女性で左卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に合胞体栄養膜性巨細胞分化と同時性右子宮外妊娠を併発した症例。稀な組織学的所見がhCG上昇を招き診断上の混乱を生じたが、左卵管卵巣摘除と補助化学療法で対応した。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old pregnant woman with left ovarian dysgerminoma showing rare syncytiotrophoblastic giant cell differentiation and concurrent right ectopic pregnancy. Unusual histological finding caused elevated hCG, creating diagnostic dilemma. Managed with left salpingo-oophorectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy with close serial hCG monitoring.

title: A Rare Case of Retroperitoneal Immature Teratoma in a Young Adult Male: A Case Report From Eastern Morocco.
title_ja: 若年成人男性における後腹膜未熟奇形腫の稀な症例：東モロッコからの症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳患者の後腹膜成熟未分化奇形腫症例報告。稀な精巣外胚細胞腫瘍。初期切除は陽性断端を伴い、残存腫瘍にプラチナベース化学療法を施行。診断基準と多学科管理を強調。
summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old with rare retroperitoneal immature teratoma (extragonadal germ cell tumor). Initial resection achieved positive margins with residual mass requiring platinum-based chemotherapy. Highlights diagnostic criteria, multidisciplinary management approach, and treatment strategy for this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor variant.

title: Alteration in folate carrier expression via histone deacetylase inhibition in BeWo human placental choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: BeWoヒト胎盤絨毛癌細胞におけるヒストン脱アセチラーゼ阻害によるフォレート担体発現の変化
summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞（GTDモデル）におけるヒストン脱アセチラーゼ阻害後の葉酸キャリア発現を研究。複数のHDAC阻害剤が葉酸受容体FOLR1、SLC19A1、SLC46A1を異なる様式で調節。クラスI HDAC阻害で葉酸キャリア発現が変化。
summary_en: Studies folate carrier expression in BeWo human placental choriocarcinoma cells (gestational trophoblastic disease model) following histone deacetylase inhibition. Various HDAC inhibitors differentially regulated folate receptor FOLR1, SLC19A1, and SLC46A1 expression. Class I HDAC inhibition, particularly HDAC1/2, upregulated FOLR1 and SLC46A1 potentially relevant to trophoblastic folate metabolism.

title: Atypical placental site nodules: Clinicopathologic features, management and patient outcomes in an institutional series.
title_ja: 非定型胎盤床結節:臨床病理学的特徴、管理および患者転帰の施設系列
summary_ja: ニューイングランド妊娠性絨毛性疾患センター(NETDC)の非定型胎盤床結節(APSN)患者35例の施設系列。異常子宮出血が最も一般的な症状。上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(15.4%)または再発APSN(34.6%)への進展リスク。悪性可能性が不確定で子宮全摘が確定治療。
summary_en: Institutional series of 35 atypical placental site nodules (APSN), gestational trophoblastic lesions, from specialized trophoblastic disease center. Most common presentation was abnormal uterine bleeding. 42.3% underwent hysterectomy; 57.7% underwent re-sampling. Risk of progression to epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (15.4%) or recurrent APSN (34.6%) observed. Hysterectomy remains definitive management due to uncertain malignant potential.

title: Clinical outcome and prognostic factors for immunotherapy-based treatments in patients with platinum-refractory germ cell tumor.
title_ja: プラチナ奏効性低下胚細胞腫瘍患者における免疫療法ベース治療の臨床転帰と予後因子
summary_ja: プラチナ奏効性低下胚細胞腫瘍患者37名を免疫療法で治療した後方視的解析。全体奏効率24.32%、中央無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)4.67ヶ月、全生存期間(全生存率)22.67ヶ月。AFP & hCG <100患者で有意に良好な転帰。先行治療での開始が予後改善と関連。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 37 male patients with platinum-refractory germ cell tumors treated with immunotherapy (2017–2023). Overall response rate 24.32%; median PFS and OS 4.67 and 22.67 months respectively. Patients with both AFP and hCG <100 showed significantly better outcomes. Lower tumor markers and earlier treatment lines independently predicted improved PFS.

title: Maediastinal germ cell tumors: analysis using hospital-based cancer registry data in Japan.
title_ja: 日本における縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の分析：院内がん登録データを用いた検討
summary_ja: 日本の院内がん登録による縦隔胚細胞腫瘍患者123例の分析(2012-2013年)。非セミノーマ(55.3%)がセミノーマ(44.7%)よりやや多い。最も一般的な非セミノーマ組織型：卵黄嚢腫瘍、次に混合型胚細胞腫瘍。5年生存率：セミノーマ96.4%、非セミノーマ57.3%。絨毛癌は最悪の予後を示した。
summary_en: Hospital-based registry analysis of 123 mediastinal germ cell tumor patients in Japan (2012–2013). Non-seminoma (55.3%) slightly more common than seminoma (44.7%). Most common non-seminoma histology: yolk sac tumor, followed by mixed germ cell tumor. Five-year survival: seminoma 96.4%, non-seminoma 57.3%. Choriocarcinoma showed worst prognosis.

title: Mature Cystic Teratoma of Anterior Mediastinum in a Child: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 小児における前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
journal: J Investig Med High Impact Case Rep
summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(良性胚細胞腫瘍)の症例報告および文献レビュー。胸痛および呼吸困難で来院した10歳女児。画像検査で石灰化を伴う6×5×5 cm腫瘤を認めた。右開胸術による外科的切除で良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認。術後経過良好で1年間のフォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of anterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma (benign germ cell tumor) in 10-year-old girl presenting with chest pain and dyspnea. Imaging showed 6×5×5 cm mass with calcifications. Surgical excision via right thoracotomy yielded benign mature teratoma with excellent postoperative recovery and no recurrence at 1-year follow-up.

title: A case image of epicardial implants in a young male with mixed germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する若年男性における心膜植播の症例画像
summary_ja: 若年男性の混合胚細胞腫瘍からの心外膜転移症例報告。診断と管理上の課題を提起。既知悪性腫瘍患者で心症状を呈する場合の包括的全身評価の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of epicardial metastasis from mixed germ cell tumor in young male, presenting diagnostic and management challenges. Highlights importance of comprehensive systemic evaluation in patients with known malignancies presenting with cardiac symptoms, including potential for cardiac involvement in germ cell tumor dissemination.

title: A Case of Metastatic Vulvar Choriocarcinoma Misdiagnosed as Vulvar Abscess: A Case Report.
title_ja: 陰部膿瘍と誤診された転移性外陰部絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 25歳患者の転移性外陰部絨毛癌（妊娠性滋養膜疾患）症例報告。初期は外陰部膿瘍と誤診。自然流産後に発症。β-hCG上昇で診断。放射線療法後EMA-CO化学療法。低資源地域での診断困難性強調。
summary_en: Case report of 25-year-old with metastatic vulvar choriocarcinoma (gestational trophoblastic neoplasia), initially misdiagnosed as vulvar abscess over 5 months following spontaneous abortion. Diagnosis confirmed by elevated β-hCG. Managed with radiotherapy and EMA-CO chemotherapy. Emphasizes diagnostic difficulty in resource-limited settings and importance of β-hCG testing.

title: Primary yolk sac tumor of the endometrium combined with situs inversus totalis: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 完全内臓逆位を伴う子宮内膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 完全内臓逆位を伴う42歳女性の子宮内膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例で、著しく高い血清AFP値(1210ng/ml以上)を示した。子宮全摘除術、両側付属器摘除術、およびBEP化学療法で治療。13ヶ月のフォローアップで再発または遠隔転移なし。子宮内膜上皮新生物からの鑑別診断を考察。
summary_en: Rare case of primary yolk sac tumor of endometrium in 42-year-old woman with situs inversus totalis and significantly elevated serum AFP (>1210 ng/mL). Treated with hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy, and BEP chemotherapy. Patient alive without recurrence or distant metastasis at 13-month follow-up. Discusses differential diagnosis from endometrial epithelial neoplasia.

title: Successful mediastinal teratoma resection in a child by assisted VATS: a case report.
title_ja: 補助的VATS（ビデオ補助胸腔鏡手術）による小児縦隔奇形腫切除の成功例
summary_ja: 9歳女性の前縦隔成熟奇形腫（5.4×5.1×5.8cm）症例。上大静脈に接着。筋温存腋窩皮膚切開による小開胸を伴う胸腔鏡補助手術で安全に切除。術後5日目退院、1年で再発なし、整容結果良好。
summary_en: Case of 9-year-old girl with anterior mediastinal mature teratoma (5.4×5.1×5.8 cm) successfully resected via video-assisted thoracic surgery with muscle-sparing mini-thoracotomy. Tumor adhered to superior vena cava but safely managed. Patient discharged postoperative day 5 with no recurrence at 1-year follow-up and excellent cosmetic results.

title: Testicular seminoma in transverse testicular ectopia.
title_ja: Transverse testicular ectopiにおける精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 35歳男性がTransverse testicular ectopiを有する精巣セミノーマで発症した稀な解剖学的異常。精巣摘除術後、傍大動脈リンパ節転移が10ヶ月後に発生し、化学療法で治療された。Transverse testicular ectopiにおけるセミノーマの認識の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: A 35-year-old male presented with testicular seminoma in an ectopic testis (transverse testicular ectopia), a rare anatomical anomaly. After orchiectomy, para-aortic lymph node metastasis developed 10 months later, successfully treated with chemotherapy. This case demonstrates the importance of recognizing seminoma in testicular ectopia.

title: Fertility outcomes in stage I ovarian immature teratomas.
title_ja: 病期I卵巣未熟奇形腫における妊孕性転帰
summary_ja: 妊孕性温存手術で治療された病期I卵巣未熟奇形腫の47例の女性における妊孕性転帰の後方視的研究。妊娠率は78.7%、生児出産率は80.9%。補助化学療法群と経過観察群および異なる手術アプローチ間での転帰は類似しており、妊孕性温存治療を支持している。
summary_en: Retrospective study of fertility outcomes in 47 women with stage I ovarian immature teratoma treated with fertility-sparing surgery. Pregnancy rate was 78.7% with 80.9% live birth rate. Outcomes were similar between adjuvant chemotherapy and surveillance groups and between different surgical approaches, supporting fertility-preserving treatment.

title: Lactating Adenoma Arising From Ovarian Mature Teratoma: An Unusual Presentation of a Young Pregnant Woman.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来の授乳性腺腫：若年妊娠女性の異常な臨床像
summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣成熟cystic teratomaから発生した乳腺lactating adenomaの稀な症例。IHC確認による乳腺組織分化を示す世界5例目の報告であり、choroid plexusとの合併も初報告である。
summary_en: Rare case of lactating adenoma arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a pregnant woman. This is the fifth reported case and first demonstrating dual rare findings (choroid plexus and lactating adenoma) with immunohistochemical confirmation of mammary tissue differentiation.

title: Can serum tumor marker densities according to tumor volume and testicle size be used to predict progression in patients with testicular cancer?
title_ja: 腫瘍体積および精巣サイズに応じた血清腫瘍マーカー密度は精巣がん患者の進行予測に使用できるか？
summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー密度比(AFP、β-hCG、LDHと腫瘍体積または精巣サイズの比)を、95人の精巣がん患者における無増悪生存期間の予測因子として評価した後方視的研究。密度値が高いほど、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの両グループでPFSが不良であり、予後マーカーとしての臨床的有用性を示唆している。
summary_en: Retrospective study evaluated tumor marker density ratios (AFP, β-hCG, LDH relative to tumor volume or testis size) as predictors of progression-free survival in 95 testicular cancer patients. Higher density values independently predicted poor PFS in both seminoma and nonseminoma groups, suggesting clinical utility as prognostic marker.

title: Elucidation of the role of XBP1 in the progression of complete hydatidiform mole to invasive mole through RNA-seq.
title_ja: RNA-seqを用いた完全胞状奇胎から侵入奇胎への進行におけるXBP1の役割の解明
summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎から後発性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍への進行を駆動する分子因子をRNA-seq解析により同定した研究。XBP1がGTNで活性化される重要な転写因子として同定され、機能研究により遊走、invasion、および腫瘍形成能の促進における役割が確認された。
summary_en: Using RNA-seq analysis, this study identified molecular factors driving progression from complete hydatidiform mole to post-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. XBP1 was identified as key transcription factor activated in GTN, with functional studies confirming its role in promoting migration, invasion, and tumorigenicity.

title: Understanding the role of endocrine disrupting chemicals in testicular germ cell cancer: Insights into molecular mechanisms.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の開発における内分泌撹乱化学物質の役割の理解：分子機構への洞察
summary_ja: 内分泌攪乱化学物質 (EDCs)、特に農薬とPFAs/PFCsのtesticular germ cell tumor (TGCT)発生機序における役割を検討した包括的レビュー。内分泌経路阻害、epigenetic変化、nuclear receptor異常を中心に論じている。
summary_en: Comprehensive review examining role of endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs), particularly pesticides and perfluorinated/polyfluoroalkyl substances, in testicular germ cell tumor development. Discusses mechanisms involving endocrine pathway disruption, epigenetic changes, and nuclear receptor dysregulation.

title: Anesthesia for an infant with congenital mediastinal mass: a case report.
title_ja: 先天性縦隔腫瘤を有する乳児の麻酔：症例報告
summary_ja: 体重の2倍以上の巨大縦隔teratoma (2.5 kg)を有する生後3ヶ月乳児の麻酔管理の症例報告。気道管理とmultidisciplinary teamアプローチの重要性、周術期マネジメント原則を示している。
summary_en: Case report of anesthesia management for 3-month-old infant with giant congenital anterior mediastinal teratoma weighing 2.5 kg (twice patient's body weight). Case illustrates challenges and principles for managing pediatric mediastinal teratoma resection including airway control and multidisciplinary coordination.

title: Differential diagnosis of non-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with ectopic pregnancy by clinical-pathological features.
title_ja: 臨床病理学的特徴による非胞状奇胎性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と異所性妊娠の鑑別診断
summary_ja: 非molar妊娠後のgestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma、PSTT等)とectopic pregnancyの鑑別診断に用いられる血清progesterone、endometrial thickness、組織病理学的特徴を検討。診断補助因子としての有用性を示している。
summary_en: Study differentiated non-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor) from ectopic pregnancy based on serum progesterone, endometrial thickness, and histopathologic features. These parameters aid clinical diagnosis and treatment planning for GTN.

title: Breath on the Brink: Navigating Anaesthesia Management in a Case With a Mediastinal Mass.
title_ja: 崖っぷち：縦隔腫瘤症例における麻酔管理のナビゲーション
summary_ja: 肺動脈、大動脈弓、左主気管支を圧迫した19歳男性の縦隔成熟benign teratomaの症例。麻醉管理ではspontaneous ventilation維持と気道確保が優先され、multidisciplinary supportの重要性を示している。
summary_en: Case report of 19-year-old male with symptomatic anterior mediastinal mature benign teratoma causing compression of major structures (pulmonary arteries, aortic arch, left main bronchus). Anesthesia management prioritized spontaneous ventilation and airway preservation, demonstrating surgical and intensive care considerations.

title: Heterotopic Tubal Choriocarcinoma Coexistent with a Viable Intrauterine Pregnancy: A Case Report.
title_ja: 生存性子宮内妊娠と共存する異所性卵管絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 生存中の妊娠と並存する卵管choriocarcinomaの稀な症例。血清β-hCG 139,482 IU/Lに上昇し、EP/EMA regimen化学療法でFIGO score 8にもかかわらず完全寛解を得た。
summary_en: Rare case of heterotopic tubal choriocarcinoma (gestational trophoblastic neoplasia) coexisting with viable intrauterine pregnancy at 39 weeks gestation. After emergency cesarean delivery and tubal excision, serum β-hCG elevated at 139,482 IU/L; EP/EMA chemotherapy achieved complete remission despite FIGO score 8.

title: Molecular Basis of Hydatidiform Moles-A Systematic Review.
title_ja: 胞状奇胎の分子基盤：システマティックレビュー
summary_ja: Gestational trophoblastic disease (hydatidiform mole等)のmolecular基盤に関する系統的レビュー。p53、BCL-2、growth factor receptor、microRNAの異常が妊娠性trophoblastic neoplasiaの進行と臨床転帰に関与することを示している。
summary_en: Systematic review of molecular basis of gestational trophoblastic disease (molar pregnancies), examining genetic and epigenetic factors contributing to disease progression. Key findings include dysregulations in p53, BCL-2 pathways, growth factor receptors, and microRNAs differentiating molar disease from normal placentation.

title: AGR2 facilitates teratoma progression by regulating glycolysis via the AnXA2/EGFR axis.
title_ja: AGR2はAnXA2/EGFRシグナル経路を介した糖解析調節により奇形腫の進行を促進する
summary_ja: 精巣teratomaにおけるAGR2発現が上昇し、AnXA2/EGFR軸を介してglycolysisとcell proliferation、invasionを促進することを示した。AGR2ノックダウンはxenograft tumorの成長を阻害し、therapeutic targetとしての可能性を示唆している。
summary_en: Study demonstrates AGR2 (anterior gradient-2) is upregulated in testicular teratoma tissues and promotes cell proliferation, invasion, and glycolysis through AnXA2/EGFR signaling. AGR2 knockdown inhibited teratoma growth in xenograft models, suggesting therapeutic potential in testicular teratomas.

title: Lymph node density as a prognostic marker of relapse in patients who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.
title_ja: 原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者における再発の予後予測因子としてのリンパ節密度
summary_ja: TGCT患者178例のprimary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection後のrelapse-free survivalとlymph node density (正/全リンパ節数比)の関連性を検討。独立した予後因子ではなかったが、他の既知の危険因子との組み合わせの重要性を示唆している。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 178 testicular GCT patients undergoing primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Lymph node density (ratio of positive to total nodes removed) was not significantly associated with relapse-free survival, suggesting limited utility as standalone prognostic marker despite established role of node count.

title: An infant with testicular Fetus-in-fetu in the abdominal cavity: rare case report.
title_ja: 腹腔内の精巣内Fetus-in-fetuを有する乳児：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 生後4か月男性乳児の腹膜内Fetus-in-fetuの稀な症例。被包化された奇形腫様病変で皮膚、軟骨、消化管成分を含むが脳組織は欠如。外科的切除と超音波検査、腫瘍マーカーによるフォローアップ実施。
summary_en: Rare case of testicular fetus-in-fetu (FIF) presenting as intraperitoneal mass in 4-month-old male infant. FIF is encapsulated teratoma-like lesion containing organized tissue elements including skin, cartilage, and GI components but lacking cerebral tissue. Surgical resection with ultrasound and tumor marker follow-up performed.

title: Atypical Cutaneous Presentation and Diagnostic Challenges in Advanced Metastatic Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 進行転移性精巣がんの非定型的皮膚症状と診断上の課題
summary_ja: 脳転移による神経欠損で発症した進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の29歳症例。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)と乳酸脱水素酵素の上昇が診断を支持。デキサメタゾン、レベチラセタム、化学療法による集学的治療で神経機能が著明に改善。
summary_en: Case report of a 29-year-old with advanced non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor presenting with neurological deficits from brain metastases and multiple organ involvement. Elevated AFP and LDH supported diagnosis. Patient received multidisciplinary treatment with dexamethasone, levetiracetam, and chemotherapy with good clinical response.

title: Personalized Chemotherapy on the Basis of Tumor Marker Decline in Poor-Prognosis Germ-Cell Tumors: Updated Analysis of the GETUG-13 Phase III Trial.
title_ja: 不良予後胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍マーカー低下に基づく個別化学療法：GETUG-13第III相試験の更新解析
summary_ja: 不良予後非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍263例のGETUG-13試験更新解析。マーカー低下が不利な患者の強化化学療法により5年無増悪生存期間が改善（58.9% vs 46.7%）。長期毒性は最小限で救済的大量化学療法使用は減少。
summary_en: Updated GETUG-13 trial analysis of 263 poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients. Those with unfavorable tumor marker decline received intensified chemotherapy with improved 5-year progression-free survival (58.9% vs 46.7%) and minimal long-term toxicity.

title: Unusual presentation of giant mature mediastinal teratoma in a young child: A case report.
title_ja: 若い小児における巨大成熟縦隔奇形腫の非典型的な臨床像：症例報告
summary_ja: 小児の稀な成熟型縦隔奇形腫の症例。脊椎変形を伴う非典型的臨床像。悪性腫瘍との鑑別に組織学的確認が必要。
summary_en: Rare case report of giant mature mediastinal teratoma in a child with unusual presentation including spinal deformity. Diagnosis challenged by slow growth and nonspecific symptoms, requiring histological confirmation to differentiate from malignant mediastinal tumors.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: A case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発症した扁平上皮癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 54歳女性における卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の症例。手術と補助化学療法を受け良好に回復。この稀な悪性転化例での個別化管理の必要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in a 54-year-old woman. Patient underwent surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy with good recovery, highlighting need for individualized management of this rare malignant transformation.

title: Intrapericardial Teratoma and Associated 3q29 Deletion in a Fetus: Case Report.
title_ja: 胎児における心膜内奇形腫と3q29欠失の関連：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児心膜内奇形腫の症例。非免疫性水腫を伴い胎児死亡。病理解剖で大動脈根部起源と3q29欠失を確認。
summary_en: Case report of intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally at 20 weeks with associated non-immune hydrops and intrauterine fetal death. Post-mortem autopsy revealed teratoma originating from aortic root with 3q29 microdeletion, first such reported association.

title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals that the APP-CD74 axis promotes immunosuppression and progression of testicular tumors.
title_ja: 単細胞トランスクリプトーム解析はAPP-CD74軸が精巣腫瘍の免疫抑制と進行を促進することを明らかにする
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと混合型胚細胞腫瘍の40,760個の細胞の単細胞トランスクリプトーム解析。APP-CD74相互作用が免疫抑制を促進し、無病生存期間の悪化と関連。精子形成の変化とセルトリ細胞機能不全を同定。
summary_en: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of 40,760 cells from seminomas and mixed germ cell tumors revealing tumor microenvironment heterogeneity. APP-CD74 interactions promote immunosuppression and worse disease-free survival. Identified altered spermatogenesis and Sertoli cell dysfunction.

title: Effect of emergent nephrostomy on long-term total and split renal function in patients with upper urinary tract obstruction due to pelvic malignant tumors.
title_ja: 骨盤悪性腫瘍による上部尿路閉塞を伴う患者における緊急腎瘻造設術の長期的全腎機能および分腎機能への影響
summary_ja: 骨盤悪性腫瘍による上部尿路閉塞と水腎症を伴う7人の小児患者の研究。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍1例を含む。腎瘻造設術は推定糸球体濾過量を有意に改善し、分腎機能の改善傾向を示した。
summary_en: Study of nephrostomy effects in 7 pediatric patients with pelvic malignant tumors causing hydronephrosis, including one ovarian germ cell tumor case. Nephrostomy significantly improved estimated glomerular filtration rate and showed improvement trend in split renal function.

title: Testicular tumor in a case of, undescended testes, persistent mullerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia: Report of a case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 停留精巣、永続的ミュラー管症候群、およびtransverse testicular ectopiaを伴う精巣腫瘍の症例と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 停留精巣と永続的ミュラー管症候群、およびtransverse testicular ectopiaという稀な先天異常を伴う古典的精巣セミノーマの症例。鼠径部精巣摘除術中に痕跡子宮が同定され、診断が確認された。
summary_en: Case of 20-year-old with classical testicular seminoma presenting with rare congenital anomalies: persistent Mullerian duct syndrome, undescended testes, and transverse testicular ectopia. Diagnosis confirmed during inguinal orchiectomy with identification of rudimentary uterus.

title: Metastatic choriocarcinoma to the heart and lung with successful multimodal management.
title_ja: 心臓および肺への転移性絨毛癌の多様式治療による成功例
summary_ja: 24歳女性の心臓と肺への転移性絨毛癌。呼吸困難で発症。心臓手術と化学療法による多学科的治療で成功。
summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old female with metastatic choriocarcinoma to heart and lung presenting with dyspnea. Successfully managed with multidisciplinary approach combining cardiac surgery and chemotherapy.

title: Male hermaphroditism with rare malignant transformation of gonadal organs: a case report.
title_ja: 男性仮性半陰陽における稀な性腺の悪性転化：症例報告
summary_ja: 仮性半陰陽（子宮遺残、線条性腺）を有する27歳男性患者が不妊症で入院。性腺生検により両側性腺にゴナドブラストーマと悪性ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）が診断された。子宮全摘出術と両側性腺摘除術、その後の局所放射線療法を受けた。
summary_en: 27-year-old male with pseudohermaphroditism (persistent uterus, streak gonads) diagnosed with bilateral gonadoblastoma and malignant germinoma (seminoma) on gonad biopsy. Underwent total hysterectomy and bilateral gonadectomy with subsequent local radiotherapy.

title: Testicular Germ Cell Tumors with Venous Tumor Thrombus: Prevalence, Presentation, and Management.
title_ja: 静脈腫瘍栓を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍：罹患率、臨床的特徴および管理
summary_ja: TGCTにおける静脈腫瘍栓の症例研究。データベース分析で0.3-3.1%の罹患率を推定。34症例の多施設調査で非セミノーマ性が主で複雑な外科管理が必要。化学療法後RPLND時の静脈血栓摘出術が必須。
summary_en: Study of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients presenting with venous tumor thrombus (VTT). Database analysis estimated 0.3-3.1% prevalence. Multicenter survey of 34 patients identified mostly nonseminomatous tumors requiring complex surgical management with venous thrombectomy.

title: Regional Differences in Stage III Nonseminoma Germ Cell Tumor Patients Across SEER Registries.
title_ja: SEER登録所における病期III非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の地域差異
summary_ja: 2004-2018年のSEER登録所における3,174例の病期III非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の分析。患者人口統計、IGCCCG予後群、全身療法率（84-97%）およびRPLND率（11-32%）に有意な地域差異を認めた。
summary_en: Analysis of 3,174 stage III nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients across SEER registries (2004-2018). Identified significant regional differences in patient demographics, IGCCCG prognostic groups, systemic therapy rates (84-97%), and RPLND rates (11-32%), affecting cancer-specific mortality.

title: Frozen in Time: Intraoperative Diagnosis and Management of Malignant Transformation in Mature Cystic Teratoma.
title_ja: 時間に凍結:成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化の術中診断と管理
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌発症の2症例。閉経後女性で大型腫瘍(>20cm)。術中凍結切片で悪性転化を確認し、病期分類開腹手術を実施。腫瘍マーカー(CA-125、LDH)の上昇を認めた。
summary_en: Two cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in postmenopausal women with large tumors. Intraoperative frozen section confirmed malignancy, guiding staging laparotomy. Elevated tumor markers (CA-125, LDH) observed.

title: Metastatic Pure Choriocarcinoma Masquerading in the Gastrointestinal Tract.
title_ja: 消化管に偽装して現れた転移性純粋絨毛癌
summary_ja: 寛解中の混合型胚細胞腫瘍既往を有する52歳男性における消化管転移性純粋絨毛癌の稀な症例。十二指腸腫瘤をコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)誘導生検で確認。陰性の監視画像と腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず転移を認めた。
summary_en: Rare case of pure choriocarcinoma metastasis to gastrointestinal tract (duodenal mass) in 52-year-old male with prior mixed germ cell tumor in remission. CT-guided biopsy confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma despite negative surveillance imaging and tumor markers.

title: Fetomaternal Hemorrhage and Choriocarcinoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 胎児母体出血と絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児胎盤出血による新生児重度貧血が母親の絨毛癌診断のきっかけ。母体Kleihauer-Betke試験陽性（7%）。交換輸血後に回復したが絨毛癌追跡が必要。
summary_en: Infant born at 35 6/7 weeks with severe anemia from fetomaternal hemorrhage (hemoglobin <5). Mother's elevated Kleihauer-Betke test (7%) led to diagnosis of maternal choriocarcinoma. Infant received partial exchange transfusion, recovered, and requires choriocarcinoma surveillance.

title: Long-term Outcomes of Regressed or "Burnt Out" Primary Testicular Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 退縮（"Burnt out"）原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期予後
summary_ja: 退縮した原発精巣胚細胞腫瘍の56症例を精巣摘除術時に検討。17例は精巣外疾患なし、39例は進行病変を認めた。両群で優れた5年無再発生存率（CSx/CS0：88%；CSII+：90%）を示し、生存腫瘍に匹敵する予後を得た。
summary_en: Study of 56 patients with regressed primary testicular germ cell tumors at orchiectomy. 17 had no extragonadal disease; 39 had advanced disease. Excellent 5-year recurrence-free survival in both groups (CSx/CS0: 88%; CSII+: 90%), comparable to viable primary tumors.

title: Discriminating Malignant from Benign Testicular Masses Using Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging-A Prospective Single-Center Study.
title_ja: 多重パラメトリック磁気共鳴画像法による精巣の悪性・良性腫瘤の鑑別：前方視的単一施設研究
summary_ja: 多重パラメトリックMRIを用いて精巣の悪性・良性腫瘤を鑑別する前方視的研究。48症例で拡散強調画像とダイナミックコントラスト増強を分析。感度94.3%、特異度76.9%の優れた診断性能を示し、MRIが精巣病変診断の重要な画像モダリティと示された。
summary_en: Prospective study of 48 patients using multiparametric MRI including diffusion-weighted imaging and dynamic contrast enhancement to differentiate malignant from benign testicular masses. Seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors showed significantly lower ADC values and distinct enhancement patterns. MRI demonstrated 94.3% sensitivity, 76.9% specificity, with excellent diagnostic performance.

title: Metastasis of ovarian dysgerminoma in a postmenopausal patient: a rare case report.
title_ja: 閉経後患者における卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の転移：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 58歳の閉経後女性における卵巣ジスジャーミノーマ転移症例で、通常若年女性に発症するジスジャーミノーマの非典型的提示。BEP化学療法で治療されたが、骨髄抑制とリンパ節転移が発生。LDHが疾患進行と相関。高齢者患者の治療課題を強調。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic ovarian dysgerminoma in 58-year-old postmenopausal woman, unusual presentation as dysgerminomas typically occur in young women under 30. Treated with BEP chemotherapy. Patient developed bone marrow suppression and lymph node metastasis. Lactate dehydrogenase changes correlated with disease progression. Highlights management challenges in elderly dysgerminoma patients.

title: Immature ovarian teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei, paraneoplastic hyponatremia and growing teratoma syndrome: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症および腫瘍随伴低ナトリウム血症を伴う未熟卵巣奇形腫とgrowing teratoma syndrome：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: SIADH由来の重度低ナトリウム血症と腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う26歳女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫症例。妊孕能温存手術後、BEP化学療法を施行。腫瘍マーカー反応良好にもかかわらず画像進行を認め、growing teratoma syndromeと診断。完全切除後2年間無病生存。
summary_en: Case of 26-year-old with immature ovarian teratoma presenting with severe refractory hyponatremia from SIADH, gliomatosis peritonei, and growing teratoma syndrome. Underwent fertility-preserving surgery followed by BEP chemotherapy. Growing teratoma syndrome developed with radiological progression despite biomarker response. Complete surgical resection achieved and patient disease-free after 2 years.

title: Hypermethylated RASAL1's promotive role in chemoresistance and tumorigenesis of choriocarcinoma was regulated by TET2 but not DNMTs.
title_ja: メチル化されたRASAL1の絨毛癌の化学療法耐性と腫瘍形成における促進的役割はTET2によって制御されたがDNMTsによってではない
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞におけるRAsal1プロモーター過メチル化のTET2による制御に関する研究。β-カテニン経路を介した化学療法耐性と腫瘍形成への役割を実証。RASAL1減少は細胞増殖とEMT表現型を促進。マウス異種移植モデルでTET2介在性エピジェネティック制御が腫瘍進行に影響することを確認。
summary_en: Study of RASAL1 promoter hypermethylation regulation by TET2 in choriocarcinoma cells, demonstrating role in chemoresistance and tumorigenicity via β-catenin pathway. Reduced RASAL1 expression promoted cell viability, proliferation, stemness and EMT. RASAL1 restoration prohibited cell growth. Xenograft models confirmed TET2-mediated epigenetic regulation influences choriocarcinoma progression.

title: Germ cell tumors, cell surface markers, and the early search for human pluripotent stem cells.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍、細胞表面マーカー、およびヒト多能性幹細胞の初期探索
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の多能性幹細胞発見への歴史的貢献についての総説。マウステラトカルシノーマから人間腫瘍への研究進展を追跡。Wistar InstituteにおけるヒトEmbryonal carcinoma細胞の初期特性化とその表面抗原マーカーの同定を強調。多能性幹細胞研究への応用を述べた。
summary_en: Historical review of germ cell tumor research contributions to pluripotent stem cell discovery, spanning laboratory mouse teratocarcinomas and human tumors. Highlights characterization of human embryonal carcinoma cells at Wistar Institute, identifying key surface antigen markers now used in pluripotent stem cell studies and exploitation. Emphasizes collaborative interdisciplinary research.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome: diagnostic challenges and outcomes.
title_ja: Growing teratoma syndrome：診断上の課題と予後
summary_ja: 低い罹患率で頻繁に誤診されるgrowing teratoma syndrome。初回治療が不十分であった46歳患者の未熟奇形腫症例。当院で診断され、腹壁切除を含む完全な減量手術を施行。化学療法中・治療後の急速な腫瘤増大の早期認識が重要。
summary_en: Case report emphasizing significance of growing teratoma syndrome in immature ovarian teratoma, highlighting frequent misdiagnosis due to low prevalence and limited healthcare professional awareness. 46-year-old patient with immature teratoma treated unsuccessfully with initial surgery and chemotherapy. Diagnosis and complete surgical debulking including abdominal wall resection achieved at tertiary center.

title: Monodermal teratoma: Three case reports and review of literature.
title_ja: 単皮層奇形腫:3症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 文献レビュー付きの生殖器系単皮層奇形腫の3症例報告。症例1:右精巣単皮層奇形腫の14歳男児。症例2:左卵巣単皮層奇形腫の40歳女性。症例3:左卵巣単皮層奇形腫の49歳女性。すべての症例は良性臨床症状を示し、単純な外科的切除で成功裏に管理。
summary_en: Three case reports of monodermal teratomas of reproductive system with literature review. Case 1: 14-year-old male with right testicular monodermal teratoma. Case 2: 40-year-old female with left ovarian monodermal teratoma. Case 3: 49-year-old female with left ovarian monodermal teratoma. All cases showed benign clinical manifestations managed successfully by simple surgical resection.

title: Spermatocytic tumor with extensive lymphovascular invasion in a young male.
title_ja: 広範なリンパ管血管侵襲を有する若年男性の精母細胞腫
summary_ja: 35歳男性における広範なリンパ管血管侵襲を伴う精母細胞腫の症例。無痛性で緩徐増大する精巣腫瘤。血清腫瘍マーカーは正常。精巣摘除術による病理検査で多型細胞とリンパ管血管侵襲確認。免疫組織化学検査でSALL4、CD117陽性;OCT4、AFP、CD30陰性。化学療法後1年無再発。
summary_en: Case of spermatocytic tumor with extensive lymphovascular invasion in 35-year-old male with painless slow-growing testicular mass. Serum tumor markers normal. Orchiectomy histopathology confirmed spermatocytic tumor with polymorphic cells and lymphovascular invasion. Immunohistochemistry positive for SALL4, CD117; negative for OCT4, AFP, CD30. Patient underwent chemotherapy and remained recurrence-free.

title: Ruptured large ectopic hydatidiform mole: an infrequent presentation of gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 破裂した大きな子宮外胞状奇胎:妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な発症
summary_ja: 妊娠8週の36歳経産婦の破裂した子宮外胞状奇胎(妊娠性絨毛性疾患)の稀な症例。重度の腹痛と不正出血で発症。超音波検査で大きな右付属器胞状奇胎と血性腹水を認識。緊急開腹術で右付属器全摘除実施。病理検査で完全な子宮外胞状奇胎診断確定。
summary_en: Rare case of ruptured ectopic hydatidiform mole (gestational trophoblastic disease) in 36-year-old multiparous woman at 8 weeks gestation. Presented with severe abdominal pain and spotting. Ultrasound revealed large right adnexal molar mass with hemoperitoneum. Emergency laparotomy with right adnexal clearance performed. Histopathology confirmed complete ectopic hydatidiform mole diagnosis.

title: Management and Outcomes of Children with Malignant Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍の管理と治療成績
summary_ja: 29年間に治療された小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍177症例（男児37%）の前向き分析。中央年齢30ヶ月。49%が頭外、51%が性腺原発。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最多（73%）。5年全生存率84.7%、無イベント生存率69.9%。ステージIII/IV疾患と頭外原発が不良予後を予測した。
summary_en: Prospective analysis of 177 children (37% male) with extracranial malignant germ cell tumors treated over 29 years. Median age 30 months. Cohort included 49% extragonadal and 51% gonadal cases. Endodermal sinus tumor most common (73%). 5-year overall survival 84.7%, event-free survival 69.9%. Stage III/IV disease and extragonadal site predicted poorer outcomes.

title: A novel T1a/b classification for testicular cancer: not only seminoma.
title_ja: 精巣がんのための新規T1a/b分類:セミノーマのみならず
summary_ja: セミノーマ以外のすべてのT1精巣がんタイプへのT1a/b分類拡張を提案する観察研究。2000年から2018年のSEERデータベース分析で、34 mmが最適腫瘍サイズ遮断値として同定。T1b期(>34 mm)は全生存期間および癌特異的生存期間の独立危険因子。PSM分析で検証され、個別化治療とフォローアップ計画支援。
summary_en: Observational study proposing T1a/b classification extension to all T1 testicular cancer types beyond seminoma. Using SEER database data from 2000-2018, study identified 34 mm tumor size as optimal cutoff. T1b stage (>34 mm) independent risk factor for poor overall survival and cancer-specific survival. PSM analysis validated findings for personalized treatment and follow-up planning.

title: Mature Cystic Teratoma in a Newborn With Down Syndrome.
title_ja: ダウン症候群を有する新生児の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫
summary_ja: ダウン症候群を有する新生児の成熟嚢胞性後腹膜奇形腫の症例。栄養不良評価中の超音波検査で偶発的に発見。造影CT検査で左腎門に沿った複雑な嚢胞性病変を認識。鑑別診断に嚢胞性神経芽細胞腫とリンパ管腫含む。外科的摘除実施。病理検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫確認。1年フォローアップで良好な転帰。
summary_en: Case of mature cystic retroperitoneal teratoma in newborn with Down syndrome. Incidentally discovered during ultrasound evaluation for poor feeding. CECT revealed complex cystic lesion along left renal hilum. Differential diagnosis included cystic neuroblastoma and cystic lymphangioma. Surgical excision performed. Histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Favorable outcome at one-year follow-up.

title: Case report: A case with atypical presentation oftesticular choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 症例報告:精巣絨毛癌の非定型的な発症例
summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の非定型的発症として後腹膜腫瘤で初診した29歳男性。肝肺転移あり。後腹膜腫瘍を含む外科的治療を受けたが、術後に精巣絨毛癌と診断。救援化学療法開始も重篤な化学療法反応で死亡。後腹膜腫瘍では胚細胞腫瘍の除外が重要。
summary_en: Case of testicular choriocarcinoma presenting atypically as massive retroperitoneal mass with hepatic and pulmonary metastases in 29-year-old male. Initial diagnosis considered retroperitoneal tumor. CT-guided biopsy and surgical resection confirmed choriocarcinoma. Imaging revealed history of cryptorchidism. Case emphasizes importance of excluding germ cell tumor in retroperitoneal masses and avoiding surgical intervention as initial treatment.

title: Mini-review: Evaluation and Management of Retroperitoneal Masses in Patients with Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: ミニレビュー:精巣がん患者における後腹膜腫瘤の評価と管理
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘤管理のミニレビュー。セミノーマと非セミノーマの異なる管理戦略を論じる。セミノーマの残存腫瘤にはFDG PET推奨。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は治療的利益ありだが困難。奇形腫が非切除ではgrowing teratoma syndrome、悪性転化、後期再発を引き起こす。
summary_en: Mini-review of residual mass management after chemotherapy in testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses seminomas and nonseminomas with different management strategies. FDG PET recommended for seminoma residual masses. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection offers therapeutic benefits but challenging. Teratoma if unresected can cause growing teratoma syndrome, malignant transformation, late relapse.

title: A testis-specific lncRNA functions as a post-transcriptional regulator of MDM2 and stimulates apoptosis of testicular germ cell tumor cells.
title_ja: 精巣特異的lncRNA LINC03074はMDM2の転写後調節因子として機能し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞のアポトーシスを刺激する
summary_ja: 精巣特異的lncRNA LINC03074は精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるMDM2の転写後調節因子として機能する研究。健康な精子および腫瘍細胞で高発現。Alu要素を介したMDM2 mRNAへの結合により、STAU1仲介の核外輸送とPKR仲介の翻訳抑制を促進。精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞のアポトーシスとシスプラチン応答性を増強。
summary_en: Study of testis-specific lncRNA LINC03074 as post-transcriptional regulator of MDM2 in testicular germ cell tumors. LINC03074 highly expressed in healthy sperm and TGCT cells. Binds MDM2 mRNA via Alu element reducing protein levels. Stimulates STAU1-mediated nuclear export and PKR-mediated translational repression. Enhances apoptosis and cisplatin responsiveness in TGCT cells.

title: Opioid prescription following radical orchiectomy associated with new persistent opioid use.
title_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後のオピオイド処方は新規持続的オピオイド使用と関連
summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術を受けた2,911例の精巣がん患者における術後オピオイド処方と持続的オピオイド使用リスクの研究。術後オピオイド投与患者の10.5%が3～15ヶ月後に持続的使用を発症し、非投与群の0%と比較。非オピオイド疼痛管理アプローチを支持。
summary_en: Study of 2,911 men with testicular cancer undergoing radical orchiectomy examining postoperative opioid prescription patterns and persistent opioid use risk. Found 10.5% of patients receiving postoperative opioids developed persistent use within 3-15 months versus 0% without postoperative opioids, supporting non-opioid pain management approaches.

title: Contralateral Testicular Biopsy in Men with Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における対側精巣生検
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者において、対側精巣に胚細胞上皮内腫瘍(GCNIS)を有する患者は2~5%存在し、50%以上が癌に進行する可能性がある。定期的な対側精巣生検の実施、GCNISのスクリーニングと治療、精巣機能を保持する治療法について論じた。
summary_en: Mini-review of contralateral testicular biopsy in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients. Approximately 2-5% harbor germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) in contralateral testicle with ≥50% progressing to cancer. Discusses current guidelines, screening indications, and treatment considerations while preserving testicular function.

title: Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection in Patients with Stage II Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumour.
title_ja: 病期IIセミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: セミノーマの後腹膜転移患者における治療減量戦略。専門外科医により実施された一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、臨床的病期IIA/Bセミノーマ患者の≥70%においてシスプラチンベース化学療法と長期副作用を回避できる可能性がある。
summary_en: Brief review of treatment de-escalation strategies for seminoma with retroperitoneal metastases. Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection conducted by expert surgeons may avoid chemotherapy and associated long-term side effects in ≥70% of patients with clinical stage IIA/B seminoma.

title: Testicular choriocarcinoma with pelvic and pulmonary metastases: a case report.
title_ja: 骨盤および肺転移を伴う精巣絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌(精巣GCTの0.3%未満)の症例報告で、27歳男性が骨盤・肺転移で発症。初診時嘔気・嘔吐・腹痛を呈した。過去20年間の中国および国際的な30歳以下の精巣絨毛癌症例のレビューを含む。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old male with testicular choriocarcinoma (accounting for <0.3% of TGCTs) presenting with pelvic and pulmonary metastases. Describes initial symptoms of nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain. Includes review of testicular choriocarcinoma cases in individuals aged ≤30 years over past 20 years in China and internationally.

title: Seminoma-associated orbitopathy mimicking thyroid-associated orbitopathy: report of a case and literature review.
title_ja: 甲状腺眼症を模倣するセミノーマ関連眼窩症：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマI期患者における両側性傍腫瘍性眼窩筋炎が甲状腺眼症に類似した症例。セミノーマ関連眼窩病症は極めて稀で本例が隠蔽期における2番目の報告。根治的精巣摘除術と7週間の血漿交換療法で治療。
summary_en: Case report of bilateral diffuse paraneoplastic orbital myositis induced by stage IA testicular seminoma presenting as thyroid-associated orbitopathy. Fifth reported case of seminoma-associated orbitopathy, second occurring during occult cancer phase. Treatment included urgent orchiectomy and 7 weeks of therapeutic plasma exchange.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma of the ovary arising from a mature cystic teratoma associated with hypercalcaemia.
title_ja: 高カルシウム血症を伴った成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した卵巣扁平上皮癌
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫からの扁平上皮がん症例で強い高カルシウム血症を呈した40歳女性。手術と化学療法を施行したが急速進行を認め、診断後5か月で死亡。放射線療法に抵抗性。
summary_en: Case report of 40-year-old female with squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma complicated by severe parathyroid hormone-related protein-induced hypercalcemia. Underwent debulking surgery (TAH-BSO, partial omentectomy) and carboplatin/paclitaxel chemotherapy. Experienced rapid disease progression; died 5 months after diagnosis.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome of the ovary: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣growing teratoma syndrome:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: Growing teratoma syndrome(GTS)は悪性胚細胞腫瘍に続発する稀な状態。化学療法中または後の腹部腫瘤増大、正常な腫瘍マーカー、成熟奇形腫成分の病理組織学的特徴で特徴付けられる。化学療法と放射線療法に反応しないため、完全な外科的切除が唯一の有効な治療法。
summary_en: Case report of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in 20-year-old female following chemotherapy for immature ovarian teratoma. GTS characterized by enlarging abdominal mass during/after chemotherapy with normal tumor markers and histologically mature teratoma. Chemotherapy and radiotherapy resistant; complete surgical resection is sole effective treatment.

title: A Case Report on Primary Pulmonary Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告
summary_ja: 流産後6か月の34歳女性における原発性肺絨毛癌症例。初診時肺腺癌と誤診されたが組織診と上昇したβ-hCG(179,000 IU/ml)で絨毛癌と確定診断。化学療法とアンギオグラフィー下動脈塞栓術でβ-hCG低下。
summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in 34-year-old female with abortion history six months prior. Initially misdiagnosed as lung adenocarcinoma; elevated β-hCG (179,000 IU/ml) and pathology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Received chemotherapy (etoposide, cisplatin) and selective arterial embolization with gradual β-hCG decline.

title: Laparoscopic-Assisted Fertility-Sparing Surgery for Growing Teratoma Syndrome of the Ovary: Experience From a Tertiary Center.
title_ja: 卵巣growing teratoma syndromeに対する腹腔鏡補助下妊孕性温存手術:一次医療センターからの経験
summary_ja: 卵巣growing teratoma syndrome患者26名(腹腔鏡群12名)の妊孕性温存手術。腹腔鏡群は開腹手術と比較して、手術時間(76.5対180分)、出血量(20対400mL)、入院期間(2対7日)が有意に短かった。周術期合併症なし。術後妊娠1例達成。
summary_en: Retrospective study of laparoscopic-assisted fertility-sparing surgery in 26 patients with ovarian growing teratoma syndrome. Laparoscopic group (n=12) demonstrated shorter operative time (76.5 vs 180 min), lower blood loss (20 vs 400 mL), and decreased hospital stay (2 vs 7 days) compared to open surgery. No conversions or perioperative complications; one post-operative pregnancy achieved.

title: Phenotype and gene signature of testicular tumors in 129.MOLF-Chr19 mice resemble human teratomas.
title_ja: 129.MOLF-Chr19マウスの精巣腫瘍の表現型と遺伝子シグネチャーはヒト奇形腫に類似している
summary_ja: 129.MOLF-Chr19マウス系統における精巣腫瘍を前臨床モデルとしてのヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の特性化。組織学的分析で3つのすべての胚層に由来する組織を有する奇形腫を確認。遺伝子発現は増殖、血管浸潤および多能性マーカーの上方制御を示し、腫瘍サイズとの強い相関がGCT研究への適切性を確認。
summary_en: Characterization of testicular tumors in 129.MOLF-Chr19 mouse strain as preclinical model for human testicular germ cell tumors. Histological analysis confirmed teratomas with tissues from all three germ layers. Gene expression showed upregulation of proliferation, vascular invasiveness, and pluripotency markers with strong correlation to tumor size, confirming suitability for GCT research.

title: A rare sweat gland tumor in an ovarian teratoma: Spiradenocylindroma case report.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に発生した稀な汗腺腫瘍:シピラデノシリンドローマの症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫内に発生した稀な良性汗腺腫瘍(シピラデノシリンドローマ)の症例報告。65歳女性が左卵巣付属器腫瘤で提示。超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法で壁肥厚と石灰化を伴う腫瘤が認められ、外科的切除と病理組織学的検査により確定診断。
summary_en: Case report of spiradenocylindroma (rare benign sweat gland tumor) arising within mature ovarian teratoma in 65-year-old female. Imaging showed left adnexal mass with mural calcifications. Excisional surgery with histopathological examination confirmed diagnosis. Spiradenocylindroma is rare, often misdiagnosed, and unusual presentation within mature ovarian teratoma.

title: Intratesticular prepubertal‑type mature teratoma in an infant: A case report and mini‑review of the literature.
title_ja: 乳幼児における精巣内思春期前型成熟奇形腫：症例報告およびミニレビュー
summary_ja: 右側陰嚢腫脹で発症した6ヶ月齢男児の精巣内思春期前型成熟奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍マーカー（AFP、β-hCG）正常。外科的核出術施行。病理で3胚葉すべての成熟要素からなる良性思春期前型奇形腫を確認。再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of intratesticular prepubertal-type mature teratoma in 6-month-old male infant presenting with right scrotal swelling. Tumor markers (AFP, β-hCG) normal. Surgical enucleation performed; histopathology confirmed benign prepubertal-type teratoma with mature elements from all three germ layers. Excellent prognosis with no recurrence risk.

title: A rare case of benign retrorectal teratoma in an adult female: Diagnostic challenges and successful surgical management.
title_ja: 成人女性における稀な良性直腸後奇形腫：診断上の課題と外科的管理の成功
summary_ja: 31歳女性の後腹膜/仙骨前奇形腫症例で月経不規則と便秘で発症。乳幼児時に左卵巣奇形腫手術既往あり。CT検査で子宮後方に8.2 × 9.3 × 5.7 cm嚢胞を認め、開腹手術で良性デルモイド嚢胞と確定診断。完全切除で再発率低い。
summary_en: Case report of benign retrorectal/presacral teratoma in 31-year-old female presenting with irregular menstruation and constipation. Prior ovarian teratoma surgery in infancy. CT imaging revealed 8.2 × 9.3 × 5.7 cm cyst posterior to uterus; surgical resection confirmed benign dermoid cyst. Low recurrence rates with complete excision of benign retrorectal teratomas.

title: Cellular Senescence in Germ Cell Neoplasia In Situ (GCNIS) and Other Histological Types of Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍原位形成（GCNIS）および他の組織型の精巣がんにおける細胞老化
summary_ja: 30人の精巣がん患者を対象とした免疫組織化学研究で、複数の組織型間で細胞老化を検討。老化細胞は前悪性GCNIS（セミノーマ20.81%、胎児性癌6.64%）でより一般的。奇形腫（4.43%）および卵黄嚢腫瘍（3.76%）で検出。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study examining cellular senescence in 30 testicular cancer patients across histological types. Senescence more prevalent in premalignant GCNIS (20.81% in seminoma, 6.64% in embryonal carcinoma) than invasive tumors. Senescent cells detected in teratoma (4.43%) and yolk sac tumor (3.76%), suggesting protective role in premalignant lesions.

title: Development of Fournier's gangrene after chemotherapy for the recurrence of testicular cancer despite the absence of anorectal lesions: A case report.
title_ja: 肛門直腸病変がないにもかかわらず精巣がん再発に対する化学療法後に発症したフルニエ壊疽:症例報告
summary_ja: 54歳男性の精巣がん再発患者が初期肛門直腸病変がないにもかかわらず化学療法後にフルニエ壊疽を発症。化学療法による重度好中球減少が細菌感染を可能にした。緊急手術的デブリードマン・集中治療管理32日間、複数回の手術介入を実施。腫瘍再発なく391日後に退院。
summary_en: Case report of 54-year-old male with testicular cancer recurrence developing Fournier's gangrene following chemotherapy without initial anorectal lesions. Severe neutropenia from chemotherapy enabled bacterial superinfection. Underwent emergency surgical debridement and intensive care management for 32 days with multiple surgical interventions. No tumor recurrence; discharged after 391 days.

title: Gestational Trophoblastic Disease: Complete versus Partial Hydatidiform Moles.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患：完全奇胎対部分奇胎
summary_ja: 妊娠滋養膜疾患に含まれる胞状奇胎(完全奇胎・部分奇胎)に関する総説。異常受精による絨毛水腫と栄養膜過形成、核型異常(完全奇胎46,XX対部分奇胎69,XXY)、p57などの分子マーカーと遺伝子異常(NLRP7,KHDC3L)、掻爬術とHCG監視について述べている。
summary_en: Review of hydatidiform moles (complete and partial) as subset of gestational trophoblastic disease caused by abnormal fertilization. Discusses chromosomal abnormalities (CHM: 46,XX; PHM: 69,XXY), molecular markers (p57/CDKN1C), pathogenic imprinting genes (NLRP7, KHDC3L), and management including dilation/curettage with HCG surveillance for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: miR-371a-3p Predicting Viable Tumor in Patients Undergoing Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Metastatic Testicular Cancer: The SWENOTECA-MIR Study.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受ける患者における生存可能腫瘍を予測するmiR-371a-3p:SWENOTECA-MIR研究
summary_ja: 114例の転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした後腹膜リンパ節郭清におけるmiR-371a-3pの多施設前向き研究。セミノーマ患者(n=24)では生存可能腫瘍に対して感度74%、特異度100%で従来のマーカーを上回った。非セミノーマおよび化学療法後患者での有用性は限定的。手術後にmiR-371a-3p値が有意に低下。
summary_en: Prospective multicenter SWENOTECA-MIR study evaluating miR-371a-3p predicting viable residual tumor in 114 metastatic GCT patients undergoing RPLND. In seminoma patients (n=24), miR-371a-3p showed 74% sensitivity and 100% specificity for viable tumor, outperforming conventional markers. Limited utility in nonseminoma and postchemotherapy patients. Levels significantly decreased after surgery.

title: Expression of Podocalyxin Potentially Decorated With Low-sulfated Keratan Sulfate in Human Testicular Embryonal Carcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト精巣胎児性癌における低硫酸化ケラタン硫酸で修飾される可能性のあるポドカリキシンの発現
summary_ja: 精巣GCT 83例における低硫酸化ケラタン硫酸で装飾されたポドカリキシン発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。低硫酸化KSは胚細胞がんで優先的に発現し、単クローン抗体R-10G及び294-1B1で認識。ポドカリキシンはムチン型コア2 O-グリカン介して低硫酸化KSの主タンパク質で診断マーカーとしての有用性が示唆。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 83 testicular germ cell tumors examining podocalyxin (PODXL) expression decorated with low-sulfated keratan sulfate (KS). Low-sulfated KS preferentially expressed in embryonal carcinoma. Double immunofluorescence and western blot confirmed PODXL as core protein. PODXL-KS glycoform potentially serves as diagnostic marker for testicular embryonal carcinoma.

title: Large ovarian mature teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei in a young female: A case report.
title_ja: 若年女性の大きな卵巣成熟奇形腫と腹膜グリオーマ症：症例報告
summary_ja: グリオマトーシス腹膜炎と著明な腹水を伴った卵巣成熟奇形腫の症例。長期的な腹部膨満の既往があり、放射線学的・病理学的所見により診断確定。成熟奇形腫の稀な合併症。
summary_en: Case of large ovarian mature teratoma complicated by gliomatosis peritonei and gross ascites. Imaging and histopathology findings detailed; highlights rare complications of mature ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Insights Into Giant Intrapulmonary Teratomas in Infants: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 乳幼児の巨大肺内奇形腫への洞察：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 乳幼児の肺内巨大奇形腫の症例報告。呼吸困難と発熱で発症、右肺全体を占める異質性腫瘤として診断。外科切除により良好な転帰。髄外奇形腫として極めて稀。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of giant intrapulmonary teratoma in one-year-old female. Discusses rare extragonadal origin of mature teratomas in infants with comparison to two previously reported cases.

title: A case report of recurrent testicular germ cell tumor in a patient with a history of primary pulmonary germ cell tumor and a review of the literature.
title_ja: 一次性肺胚細胞腫瘍の既往を有する患者における再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 一次肺胚細胞腫瘍既往患者における再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。2つの部位で異なる組織学的所見(胎児性癌およびセミノーマ)が記録された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(EGCT)の診断と治療において早期病理生検の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Case report of recurrent testicular germ cell tumor in patient with prior primary pulmonary GCT. Documents different histology between two sites (embryonal carcinoma and seminoma); emphasizes importance of early biopsy in EGCTs.

title: Struma ovarii with Hashimoto's thyroiditis: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫とHashimoto甲状腺炎：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内のstruma ovariiとHashimoto甲状腺炎の症例。25歳女性、両側卵巣奇形腫切除後の再発性腫瘤。F-18 FDG PET/CTと手術所見により確診。奇形腫の稀な合併症。
summary_en: Case of struma ovarii (thyroid tissue within mature ovarian teratoma) with Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Discusses diagnostic challenges distinguishing struma ovarii from ovarian cancer through imaging and pathology correlation.

title: Symptomatic occlusion of the inferior vena cava and bilateral iliac veins due to malignant seminoma: Percutaneous recanalization, thrombectomy, and stenting to restore patency.
title_ja: 悪性セミノーマによる下大静脈および両側腸骨静脈の症候性閉塞:経皮的再開通、血栓摘除術およびステント留置による開存性の恢復
journal: J Vasc Surg Cases Innov Tech
summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ寛解後の下大静脈および両側腸骨静脈の症候性慢性閉塞症例。経皮的ガイドワイヤー再開通、機械的血栓摘除術およびステント留置により腸大静脈開存性が恢復された。血栓症と関連する珍しい合併症である。
summary_en: Case of symptomatic chronic occlusion of inferior vena cava and bilateral iliac veins due to malignant seminoma. Describes percutaneous recanalization, mechanical thrombectomy, and stenting to restore patency post-remission.

title: Half-life of serum alpha-fetoprotein in prepubertal testicular yolk sac tumors: an index significantly associated with prognosis.
title_ja: 思春期前精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍における血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期:予後と有意に関連する指標
summary_ja: 思春期前児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍患者42例を対象としたαフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期の予後予測指標としての検討。根治的精巣摘除術後のAFP半減期≥5.78日が再発、転移、死亡などの予後不良転帰の独立危険因子として同定された。
summary_en: Study of AFP half-life as prognostic index in prepubertal children with testicular yolk sac tumors. Analyzes 42 patients; AFP half-life ≥5.78 days identified as independent risk factor for poor outcomes.

title: RAISN: Robot-assisted Indocyanine Green-guided Sentinel Node Biopsy in Clinical Stage I Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: RAISN:臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍におけるロボット支援インドシアニングリーン誘導センチネルリンパ節生検
summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するロボット支援インドシアニングリーン誘導センチネルリンパ節生検を調査するRAISN試験。この新規画像誘導的アプローチは、潜在性転移性疾患の予測精度を改善し、過剰治療および治療関連毒性を軽減することを目的としている。
summary_en: RAISN trial investigating robot-assisted indocyanine green-guided sentinel lymph node biopsy for clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumors. Novel imaging approach aims to improve staging accuracy and reduce treatment-related toxicity.

title: Coexisting Sacrococcygeal Teratoma With Mild Encephalitis/Encephalopathy With a Reversible Splenial Lesion: A Case Report.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫と軽度脳炎/脳症(可逆性脾梁病変)の併存例
summary_ja: 56歳男性における仙尾部成熟奇形腫と軽度脳炎/脳症(可逆性脾梁病変)の併存例を報告。病理組織学的検査により悪性腫瘍を伴わない成熟奇形腫が確認された。奇形腫とMERSの関連性が認められたが、発症機序は明確ではない。
summary_en: Case of coexisting sacrococcygeal mature teratoma with mild encephalitis/encephalopathy with reversible splenial lesion (MERS). 56-year-old male; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma without malignancy; association with MERS noted but etiology unclear.

title: Analysis of Fertility Prognosis and Risk Factors in Patients Post-Gestational Trophoblastic Disease.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者における生殖能予後及び危険因子の分析
summary_ja: 82例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者における生殖能転帰を後方視的に分析。再妊娠は37.74%で発生し、生児出産率は65.00%、流産率25.00%、子宮外妊娠率5.00%であった。妊娠前相談の欠如が再妊娠の有意な独立危険因子と判明した。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of fertility outcomes in 82 GTD patients. Re-pregnancy occurred in 37.74% with 65% live birth rate. Gestational trophoblastic disease is established relevant content per site editorial policy.

title: Integrating muti-omics data to identify tissue-specific DNA methylation biomarkers for cancer risk.
title_ja: マルチオミクスデータを統合して癌リスク用の組織特異的DNA メチル化バイオマーカーを同定
summary_ja: 7つのがん種(乳房、大腸、腎、肺、卵巣、前立腺、精巣GCT)のDNA メチル化バイオマーカー統合解析。4,248個のCpGが有意に関連、92個の新規遺伝座位を同定。
summary_en: Multi-omics study identifying tissue-specific DNA methylation biomarkers for cancer risk. Testicular germ cell cancer included among seven cancers analyzed; 4,248 significant CpGs identified with cancer-type specificity.

title: Perforated degenerated immature teratoma of the ovary: Rare cause of acute peritonitis, case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣の穿孔した変性未熟奇形腫: 急性腹膜炎の稀な原因、症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣未分化奇形腫穿孔による急性腹膜炎と敗血性ショックの症例。75歳女性、重度の腹痛で救急受診。腫瘍破裂は稀な合併症で予後が悪化。手術治療で管理。
summary_en: Case of perforated immature ovarian teratoma causing acute peritonitis and septic shock in 75-year-old woman. Discusses rare malignant transformation and spontaneous rupture as life-threatening complications of ovarian germ cell tumors.

title: Currarino syndrome with immature teratoma: A case report with review of literature.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫を伴うカリアリーノ症候群：症例報告と文献の検討
summary_ja: カリアリーノ症候群を伴う13カ月大患児が仙骨前未熟奇形腫で発症。肛門閉鎖と仙骨変形を呈現。病理組織学での未熟成分の同定はリスク層別化と治療方針決定に重要。
summary_en: Case of Currarino syndrome with presacral immature teratoma in 13-month-old boy. Presents with anal atresia, hemisacrum, and presacral mass; histopathology confirmed immature teratoma—rare manifestation requiring risk stratification.

title: Teratoma to Angiosarcoma: A Metamorphosis in the Mediastinum.
title_ja: 縦隔における奇形腫から血管肉腫への変化
summary_ja: 縦隔未分化奇形腫が高悪性度血管肉腫に転化した稀な症例。21歳男性、シスプラチン化学療法後、肝転移が血管肉腫として確認。縦隔MNGCTの攻撃的な経過を示唆する初例。
summary_en: Rare case of mediastinal immature teratoma transforming to high-grade angiosarcoma in 21-year-old male. Describes sarcomatous differentiation after cisplatin chemotherapy; highlights aggressive behavior of mediastinal non-seminoma GCTs.

title: Choroid Plexus Papilloma Tumor of the Ovary: A Case Report.
title_ja: 卵巣の脈絡叢乳頭腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 19歳患者の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に脈絡叢乳頭腫を認めた症例。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は良性胚細胞腫瘍；脈絡叢乳頭腫は稀な脳腫瘍で卵巣奇形腫内での出現は稀。MRI/CT画像検査と外科摘除で治療。
summary_en: Case of choroid plexus papilloma within mature cystic teratoma of ovary in 19-year-old. Mature cystic teratoma is benign GCT; choroid plexus papilloma is rare brain tumor infrequently found within ovarian teratoma.

title: Mucinous intestinal adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary treated with FOLFOX-6 - a case report.
title_ja: FOLFOX-6で治療された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腸型腺癌 - 症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠中に診断された卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した粘液性腸型腺癌の症例。FOLFOX-6化学療法で治療。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化は稀だが、妊娠中は診断が遅延する可能性。
summary_en: Case of mucinous intestinal adenocarcinoma arising from mature ovarian cystic teratoma during pregnancy. Rare malignant transformation of ovarian germ cell tumor managed with FOLFOX-6 chemotherapy.

title: A 10-year retrospective study of the risks and peculiarities in pediatric patients with (para)gonadal tumors and cysts.
title_ja: 小児(傍)性腺腫瘍および嚢腫患者におけるリスク因子および特異性に関する10年後方視的研究
summary_ja: 小児(傍)性腺腫瘍210例の10年後方視的研究でリスク因子と臨床特性を同定。未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)、混合型胚細胞腫瘍などの悪性腫瘍リスク増加。リスク回避と早期発見で予防・早期診断が可能。
summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of 210 pediatric patients with gonadal/paragonadal tumors. Identifies risk factors and peculiarities for immature teratomas, dysgerminomas, and mixed GCTs; emphasizes prevention and early detection.

title: Discordance of retroperitoneal and thoracic histologic findings in patients with metastatic germ cell tumors at postchemotherapy residual tumor resection.
title_ja: 化学療法後残存腫瘍摘除における転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者の後腹膜および胸部組織学的所見の不一致
summary_ja: 病期III NSGCT患者の化学療法後残存腫瘍摘除における後腹膜および胸部検体の組織学的不一致を分析。不一致率は23%；後腹膜奇形腫では胸部一致率78～100%。壊死は胸部所見を予測しない。
summary_en: Study of histologic discordance between retroperitoneal and thoracic specimens in 50 patients with stage III non-seminomatous germ cell tumors undergoing postchemotherapy residual tumor resection. Teratomatous elements show high concordance between sites.

title: Impact of microscopic deposits of yolk sac tumor on recurrence of mature sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 成熟仙尾部奇形腫の再発に対する卵黄嚢腫瘍の顕微鏡的沈着の影響
summary_ja: 仙尾部成熟奇形腫56例中、顕微鏡的卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた症例では再発リスクが有意に高かった。AFP値上昇と再発の相関を示し、厳密な監視が重要。
summary_en: Study of 56 patients with sacrococcygeal teratomas found microscopic yolk sac tumor foci significantly increased recurrence risk (56% vs 4%). Rising AFP levels predicted malignant recurrence. Close surveillance with serial AFP measurements and MRI is recommended for mature SCT with YST.

title: Characteristics of Epithelioid Trophoblastic Tumor: Endoscopic and Magnetic Resonance Imaging Findings.
title_ja: 上皮様栄養膜腫瘍の特徴：内視鏡および磁気共鳴画像所見
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜疾患の一型である絨毛膜疾患の症例。子宮下部から骨盤内進展を示す。MRI所見と遅延診断の課題を示す。
summary_en: Case of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (GTN) with mixed choriocarcinoma presenting as cervical pregnancy. MRI showed characteristic cystic pelvic mass. Hysterectomy confirmed diagnosis of mixed ETT and choriocarcinoma. Case illustrates imaging findings and diagnostic challenges in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Burned-Out Testicular Carcinoma Presenting as Inferior Vena Cava Tumor Thrombus With Pulmonary Tumor Embolism on FDG PET/CT: A Case Report.
title_ja: 下大静脈腫瘍栓および肺腫瘍塞栓として発症した焼けつき精巣がん：FDG PET/CT症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣原発巣退行消失の焼けつき胎児性癌が下大静脈腫瘍栓および悪性肺塞栓として発症した稀な症例。FDG PET/CTが疾患範囲と重要性の検出に重要な役割。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異常な転移性発現を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of burned-out testicular embryonal carcinoma presenting as extensive inferior vena cava thrombus with malignant pulmonary embolism. FDG PET/CT revealed disease extent and significance. Case highlights unusual metastatic presentation of testicular germ cell carcinoma.

title: Ovarian Dermoid Cyst Trajectory in Premenarchal Girls.
title_ja: 思春期前女児における卵巣類皮嚢腫の軌跡
summary_ja: 思春期前女児の卵巣皮様嚢胞44例。成長速度は0.8cm/年で年長女性より遅い。嚢胞サイズと年齢で治療選択。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 44 premenarchal patients with ovarian dermoid cysts showed average growth rate of 0.8 cm/year, slower than older cohorts. Larger cysts underwent surgery; smaller cysts managed expectantly. Study provides evidence-based management parameters for pediatric ovarian teratomas.

title: Chemo-resistant Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia and the Use of Immunotherapy: A Case Report and Review of Literature.
title_ja: 化学療法抵抗性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と免疫療法の使用：症例報告と文献の検討
summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するペムブロリズマブ免疫療法の初報告症例。複数の化学療法レジメン抵抗後のβ-hCG低下達成。薬剤耐性GTNの新たな治療選択肢として免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の有用性示唆。
summary_en: First reported case of immunotherapy (pembrolizumab) for chemo-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma). Patient achieved β-hCG response despite resistance to multiple chemotherapy regimens. Case demonstrates emerging therapeutic option for drug-resistant GTN with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

title: Challenges in the diagnosis and treatment of pure non-gestational uterine choriocarcinoma in a child: a case report.
title_ja: 小児における純粋非妊娠性子宮絨毛癌の診断と治療の課題：症例報告
summary_ja: 4歳女児の非妊娠性子宮絨毛膜癌。化学療法耐性を示し、小児患者での治療が困難。診断と管理の課題を示す。
summary_en: Case of non-gestational uterine choriocarcinoma in 4-year-old girl presenting with vaginal bleeding. Exploratory laparotomy revealed uterine origin. Hysterectomy performed; histology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Poor chemotherapy response highlights management challenges in pediatric non-gestational germ cell tumors.

title: Gonadal Teratomas: A State-of-the-Art Review in Pathology.
title_ja: 性腺奇形腫：病理学における最新の総説
summary_ja: 胚細胞由来の3胚葉を含む性腺奇形腫について総説。卵巣腫瘍の20～25%、精巣腫瘍の3～5%を占める。卵巣奇形腫は小児期・思春期に、精巣奇形腫は新生児期～19歳に好発。大多数は良性だが、悪性型は積極的治療が必要。
summary_en: Review of gonadal teratomas encompassing tissues from three embryonic germ layers. Discusses pediatric and adult presentations, noting teratomas comprise 20-25% of ovarian tumors and 3-5% of testicular tumors. Majority are benign, though malignant variants require aggressive therapy.

title: Diagnostic Value of SALL4 and OCT3/4 in Pediatric Testicular Tumors.
title_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍におけるSALL4およびOCT3/4の診断的価値
summary_ja: 小児精巣腫瘍18例のSALL4およびOCT3/4免疫染色に関する後方視的研究。SALL4陽性83.3%、OCT3/4陽性38.9%。混合型胚細胞腫瘍でOCT3/4高発現。これらのマーカーは診断と予後評価を補助し、個別化治療戦略を指針する。
summary_en: Retrospective study evaluating SALL4 and OCT3/4 immunostaining in 18 pediatric testicular tumors. SALL4 positive in 83.3%, OCT3/4 in 38.9%. Mixed germ cell tumors showed higher OCT3/4 prevalence. These markers aid diagnosis and prognostic assessment, potentially guiding personalized therapeutic strategies.

title: Acute abdomen secondary to ovarian tumour incarcerated in an umbilical hernia: A case report.
title_ja: 臍ヘルニアに嵌頓した卵巣腫瘍による急性腹症：症例報告
summary_ja: 両側卵巣成熟奇形腫が臍ヘルニアに嵌頓して急性腹症となった稀な症例。卵巣嚢腫切除と憩室修復施行。
summary_en: Case of acute abdomen from bilateral ovarian teratomas incarcerated in umbilical hernia. Surgical exploration revealed large right ovarian teratoma herniated through umbilicus. Bilateral cystectomy and herniorrhaphy performed. Rare but serious presentation of ovarian teratoma with hernia complication.

title: Incidental seminoma in nonobstructive azoospermia: a case report.
title_ja: 非閉塞性無精子症における偶発的セミノーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 非閉塞性無精子症患者の顕微鏡下精巣精子抽出術中の侵襲性セミノーマ偶発発見例。その後の診断精査と根治的精巣摘除術を実施。男性不妊症患者における病理組織学的分析と身体診察の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Incidental discovery of invasive testicular seminoma during microdissection testicular sperm extraction in azoospermic patient. Subsequent diagnostic workup and radical orchiectomy performed. Highlights importance of histopathological analysis and physical examination in men with male factor infertility.

title: Unexpected placental tumor: A case report.
title_ja: 予期しない胎盤腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎盤成熟奇形腫の稀な症例。胎膜内発生で文献上40例未満。良性で胎児・母体合併症なし。
summary_en: Rare case of mature placental teratoma arising within fetal membranes at 40 weeks gestation. Pathology showed mature keratinized squamous layer with skin appendages, adipose and cartilaginous tissues. Only 40 cases reported in literature; usually benign without fetal or maternal complications.

title: A case for the use of chemotherapy in hereditary mitochondrial optic neuropathies: Successful administration of cisplatin/etoposide in a male patient with testicular seminoma and Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy.
title_ja: 遺伝性ミトコンドリア性視神経障害における化学療法の使用：レーベル遺伝性視神経障害ミトコンドリア変異を有する男性患者における精巣セミノーマへのシスプラチン/エトポシド投与成功例
summary_ja: レーベル遺伝性視神経障害ミトコンドリア変異キャリアにおいてシスプラチン/エトポシド化学療法による病期2B精巣セミノーマ治療に成功。神経毒性化学療法は疾患進行や神経障害悪化なく安全に投与可能なことを示唆。
summary_en: Successful chemotherapy (cisplatin/etoposide) for stage 2B testicular seminoma in carrier of Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy mitochondrial mutation. Case demonstrates neurotoxic chemotherapy can be safely administered in mitochondrial disease without disease conversion or worsening neuropathy.

title: Metastatic testicular seminoma presenting as acute lower limb ischaemia.
