title_ja: 急性下肢虚血として呈現した転移性精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 腹部大動脈を圧迫する大規模後腹膜腫瘤によって急性下肢虚血として呈現した転移性精巣セミノーマのユニークな呈現。患者は血管バイパス手術、化学療法、精巣摘除術を受けた。セミノーマからの急性血管合併症の初報告例。
summary_en: Unique presentation of metastatic testicular seminoma as acute lower limb ischemia due to large retroperitoneal mass compressing abdominal aorta. Patient underwent vascular bypass surgery, chemotherapy, and orchiectomy. First published case of acute vascular complication from seminoma.

title: Follow-Up of Patients Diagnosed With Germinal Testicular Tumors (Seminomas and Non-seminomatous) Treated With a Bone Marrow Transplant and a High Dose of Chemotherapy.
title_ja: 骨髄移植および大量化学療法で治療された胚細胞性精巣腫瘍(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性)患者のフォローアップ
summary_ja: 難治性精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性)患者57例の後方視的研究で、大量化学療法と骨髄移植を受けた患者。全生存期間中央値7.4ヶ月；他のコホートと比較して予後不良。多回再発疾患に対するこの救済療法の有用性に疑問を提示。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 57 patients with germinal testicular tumors (seminoma and non-seminomatous) treated with high-dose chemotherapy and bone marrow transplant for refractory disease. Overall survival 7.4 months; poor prognosis compared to other cohorts. Questions utility of this salvage approach for multiply-relapsed disease.

title: Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma Arising from the Struma Ovarii Coexisting with Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma, Hashimoto's Thyroiditis and Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome-a Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌、橋本甲状腺炎、多嚢胞性卵巣症候群と共存する卵巣甲状腺腫から発生した濾胞性甲状腺癌－症例報告及び文献レビュー
summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌、橋本甲状腺炎、多嚢胞性卵巣症候群と共存する悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(濾胞性甲状腺癌)の稀な症例。この組み合わせの初例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫は主に甲状腺組織で構成される特殊化した成熟奇形腫。
summary_en: Rare case of malignant struma ovarii (follicular thyroid carcinoma) coexisting with papillary thyroid carcinoma, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, and polycystic ovarian syndrome. First case of this combination reported. Struma ovarii is a specialized mature teratoma composed primarily of thyroid tissue.

title: SRY-positive 45,X/46,XY karyotype in a phenotypically Turner-like Chinese adolescent female with ovarian dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma.
title_ja: ターナー症候群様表現型を呈するSRY陽性45,X/46,XY核型中国人思春期女性における卵巣未分化胚細胞腫とゴナドブラストーマの症例報告
summary_ja: ターナー症候群様表現型を呈する45,X/46,XY嵌合性思春期女性で、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫とゴナドブラストーマを呈示した症例。Y染色体微小欠失が生殖腺組織で認められた。双側卵巣摘除術施行、3年フォローアップで再発なし。分子遺伝学的検査の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case of phenotypically Turner-like adolescent with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism presenting with ovarian dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma. Y chromosome microdeletions found in gonadal tissue. Bilateral gonadectomy performed; no recurrence after 3-year follow-up. Highlights importance of molecular genetic testing.

title: Prenatal diagnosis in estimating the prognosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の予後推定における出生前診断
summary_ja: 希な先天性奇形である仙尾部奇形腫の文献レビュー。出生前超音波検査による診断、予後マーカー、外科的管理を論述。良好な出生前所見と適切な出生後外科的治療により予後は優れており、詳細な形態学的評価の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Literature review of sacrococcygeal teratoma, a rare congenital malformation. Discusses prenatal ultrasound diagnosis, prognostic markers, and surgical management. With favorable prenatal findings and adequate postnatal surgical treatment, prognosis is excellent, emphasizing importance of detailed morphologic assessment.

title: Survival of stage III non-seminoma testis cancer patients versus simulated controls, according to race/ethnicity.
title_ja: 人種/民族別の病期IIIの非セミノーマ精巣がん患者の生存率と模擬対照群の比較
summary_ja: SEERデータベース分析で、病期IIIの非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者(2004-2014年)の5年全生存率を人種/民族別で比較。癌特異的死亡率はアジア/太平洋諸島民(32%)とアフリカ系アメリカ人(26%)で最も高い。進行精巣がんの転帰における有意な人種/民族別格差を強調。
summary_en: SEER database analysis of stage III non-seminomatous testicular GCT patients (2004-2014) comparing 5-year overall survival by race/ethnicity. Cancer-specific mortality highest in Asian/Pacific Islanders (32%) and African Americans (26%). Highlights significant racial/ethnic disparities in advanced testicular cancer outcomes.

title: Performance of O-RADS MRI Score in Differentiating Benign From Malignant Ovarian Teratomas: MR Feature Analysis for Differentiating O-RADS 4 From O-RADS 2.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の良悪性鑑別におけるO-RADS MRIスコアの性能：O-RADS 4とO-RADS 2を鑑別するためのMR特徴分析
summary_ja: MRI研究で卵巣奇形腫の良悪性鑑別におけるO-RADS MRIスコア評価(137例：良性123例、悪性14例)。年齢18歳未満、大きなロキタンスキー結節、病変外伸展などが悪性と関連。周辺造影は良性を強く示唆。
summary_en: MRI-based study evaluating O-RADS scoring for differentiating benign from malignant ovarian teratomas (137 patients: 123 benign, 14 malignant). Identified imaging features associated with malignancy including age <18, large Rokitansky nodule, and extralesional extension. Peripheral nodule enhancement strongly suggests benignity.

title: Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours: outcomes and adjuvant chemotherapy.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清：転帰および補助化学療法
summary_ja: 病理学的病期IIのNSGCT患者における一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清単独対補助化学療法の後方視的研究。109例(96例はRPLND単独、13例は補助化学療法併用)。5年無再発生存期間は72%対92%、疾患特異的生存期間は同等。大多数患者は追加化学療法を必要とせず、RPLND単独は治療負荷を減らす可能性がある。
summary_en: Retrospective study comparing primary RPLND alone versus with adjuvant chemotherapy in pathologic stage II NSGCT. 109 patients (96 RPLND-only, 13 with adjuvant chemotherapy). 5-year RFS 72% vs 92%; DSS similar. Most patients don't require additional chemotherapy; RPLND-only approach may reduce treatment burden.

title: Primary Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection as Treatment for Low-volume Metastatic Seminoma in a Population-based Cohort: The Swedish Norwegian Testicular Cancer Group Experience.
title_ja: 低容量転移性セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清治療：スウェーデン・ノルウェー精巣がん研究グループの集団ベース研究の経験
summary_ja: 低容量転移性セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清の集団ベース研究(62例)。外科的合併症率は低く(5%)、24ヶ月無増悪生存率90%、全生存率100%。化学療法/放射線療法に対する代替治療選択肢となり、長期的な治療関連罹病率を減らす可能性がある。
summary_en: Population-based Swedish-Norwegian study of primary RPLND for low-volume metastatic seminoma (62 patients). Low surgical complication rate (5% Clavien-Dindo III). 24-month PFS 90%, OS 100%. RPLND offers alternative to chemotherapy/radiation for selected seminomas, potentially reducing long-term treatment morbidity.

title: Successful treatment and remission of advanced testicular cancer after COVID-19 infection during induction chemotherapy.
title_ja: 導入化学療法中のCOVID-19感染後の進行精巣がんの成功した治療と寛解
summary_ja: 病期IIIBの進行精巣非セミノーマの症例報告。導入化学療法中のCOVID-19感染にもかかわらず化学療法で成功裏に治療され、最小限の治療延期で寛解を達成した。がん進行リスク管理と急性COVID-19重症度のバランスの重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of stage IIIB advanced testicular non-seminoma successfully treated with chemotherapy despite COVID-19 infection during induction. Patient achieved remission with minimal treatment delay. Demonstrates importance of balancing cancer progression risk with acute COVID-19 severity in treatment decisions.

title: Seminoma in a 46, XY patient with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency.
title_ja: 17α-水酸化酵素欠損症を伴う46,XY患者におけるセミノーマ
summary_ja: 17α-水酸化酵素欠損症を有する46,XY患者のセミノーマの稀な症例。この遺伝的背景における初めての生殖細胞腫瘍報告。予防的性腺摘出と多職種専門家の関与が重要である。
summary_en: Rare case of seminoma in 46,XY patient with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency presenting as 9-cm pelvic mass. Patient had undiagnosed XY karyotype and endocrine disorder until age 52. Third documented testicular tumor case in this genetic context. Highlights need for prophylactic gonadectomy in this disorder.

title: A case of testicular tumor and respiratory failure caused by choriocarcinoma syndrome managed through modified chemotherapy and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
title_ja: 修正化学療法および体外膜酸素化により管理された絨毛癌症候群に起因する精巣腫瘍および呼吸不全の症例
summary_ja: コリオカルシノーマ症候群を伴う精巣腫瘍の症例。肺転移による呼吸不全に対してECMO管理と化学療法を組み合わせた治療を実施。ECMOはコリオカルシノーマ症候群による呼吸不全管理に有用である。
summary_en: Case report of testicular tumor with choriocarcinoma syndrome and multiple lung metastases causing respiratory failure. Reduced chemotherapy combined with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) successfully maintained oxygenation until chemotherapy reduced lung masses. Demonstrates ECMO utility in managing choriocarcinoma-related respiratory complications.

title: Ultrasonographic and clinicopathological features of pelvic yolk sac tumors in women: a single-center retrospective analysis.
title_ja: 女性の骨盤卵黄嚢腫瘍の超音波検査および臨床病理学的特徴：単一施設の後方視的分析
summary_ja: 16人の卵黄嚢腫瘍患者の後方視的分析（13卵巣、2仙骨尾骨、1腸間膜）。全症例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇。58.3％でCA125上昇。3つの超音波タイプを特定。超音波特性と腫瘍マーカーの組み合わせは診断を改善し受精能保存手術を導く。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 16 yolk sac tumor (YST) patients (13 ovarian, 2 sacrococcygeal, 1 mesenteric). Elevated AFP observed in all cases; 58.3% had elevated CA125. Three ultrasound types identified. Combined ultrasound features with tumor markers improve diagnosis and guide fertility-preserving surgical decisions.

title: Management strategy for children with ovarian immature teratoma: results from a tertiary pediatric oncology center.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の小児管理戦略：三次小児腫瘍センターからの結果
summary_ja: 32人の小児卵巣未熟奇形腫患者の後方視的レビュー。87.5％が病期I、手術単独で治療。5人の患者が腹膜神経膠腫症を有し広範な手術不要。5年全生存期間100％、無事象生存期間93.4％。限局性未熟奇形腫に対する手術単独戦略は適切。
summary_en: Retrospective review of 32 pediatric ovarian immature teratoma (IT) patients. 87.5% stage I, treated with surgery alone; 5 patients had gliomatosis peritonei without requiring extensive surgery. 5-year overall survival 100%, event-free survival 93.4%. Surgery-alone strategy appropriate for localized IT.

title: Embryoid Bodies and Related Proliferations in Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍における胚様体および関連増殖
summary_ja: 100個の未熟奇形腫、125個の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍、6個の多胚腫の病理学的研究。よく形成された胚様体は稀であるが、14％の未熟奇形腫に胚様体残存がある。25％の悪性混合型腫瘍に残存を認め、卵黄嚢腫瘍および胎児性癌と関連。
summary_en: Pathologic study of embryoid bodies and related proliferations in 100 immature teratomas, 125 malignant mixed GCTs, and 6 polyembryomas. Well-formed embryoid bodies rare but remnants present in 14% of immature teratomas. Remnants found in 25% of malignant mixed tumors, often associated with yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma.

title: [Three Cases of Bilateral Metachronous Testicular Tumors].
title_ja: 両側転移性精巣腫瘍3症例
summary_ja: 双側転移性精巣腫瘍の3症例。発症間隔は平均19年と長く、対側精巣腫瘍検出には長期的経過観察が必要。精巣萎縮や未降下精巣の既往がある場合は対側精巣生検を考慮すべき。
summary_en: Three cases of bilateral metachronous testicular tumors: Case 1 - nonseminomatous GCT with metastases 24 years after germ cell neoplasia in situ; Case 2 - bilateral seminomas 19 years apart; Case 3 - bilateral seminomas 14 years apart. Long interval (mean 19 years) emphasizes need for lifelong surveillance.

title: SEOM-GG clinical guidelines for the management of germ-cell testicular cancer (2023).
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理のためのSEOM-GG臨床ガイドライン（2023年）
summary_ja: 2023年SEOM精巣胚細胞腫瘍管理ガイドライン。鼠径精巣摘除術、IGCCCG予後分類、BEP化学療法レジメン、マーカー低下評価、残存腫瘍管理、救援治療をカバー。セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、性腺外後腹膜・縦隔腫瘍に適用。
summary_en: 2023 SEOM guidelines for testicular GCT management. Covers inguinal orchiectomy, IGCCCG prognostic classification, BEP chemotherapy regimens, marker decline assessment, residual mass management by tumor type, and salvage therapy. Applies to seminoma, non-seminoma, and extragonadal retroperitoneal/mediastinal tumors.

title: Bilateral Synchronous Testicular Cancer with Discordant Histopathology: A Case Report.
title_ja: 不一致の病理組織像を伴う両側同時性精巣がん：症例報告
summary_ja: 両側同時性精巣がんで不一致の病理組織像を伴う症例報告（1853年以来57番目）。同時に発症する両側精巣腫瘍が異なる病理学的亜型を呈する非常に稀有な臨床像であり、異時性両側腫瘍の発現形式と比較して極めて稀である。
summary_en: Case report of bilateral synchronous testicular cancer with discordant histopathology (57th documented case since 1853). Demonstrates unusual presentation of simultaneous bilateral testicular tumors with different pathologic subtypes, emphasizing rarity compared to metachronous bilateral tumors.

title: Comparison of overall and patterns of care in patients with a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor by age in the United States: a National Cancer Database (2004-2016) analysis.
title_ja: 米国における悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の年齢別全生存期間と治療パターンの比較：全国がんデータベース（2004-2016）分析
summary_ja: 2,998人の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍）のNCDB分析。40歳以上の女性は予後不良で、併存疾患が多く両側腫瘍と高い段階を呈した。死亡リスク5.37倍増加。
summary_en: NCDB analysis of 2,998 women with malignant ovarian GCTs (immature teratoma, dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, mixed GCT). Women aged ≥40 had worse outcomes with higher comorbidities, bilateral tumors, and higher stage. Age ≥40 associated with 5.37-fold increased mortality risk.

title: A drastic post operative course after the resection of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a male.
title_ja: 男性の原発性肺絨毛癌切除後の劇的な術後経過
summary_ja: 46歳男性の原発性肺絨毛膜癌の症例報告。咳嗽、呼吸困難、喀血で呈示。腫瘍塞栓症により術後28日で死亡。非常に稀で予後不良な悪性腫瘍であることを示唆している。
summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a 46-year-old male presenting with hemoptysis and dyspnea. Despite successful surgical resection, the patient died 28 days post-operatively from tumor emboli in the coronary artery, illustrating the aggressive nature and poor prognosis of this rare malignancy.

title: Paraneoplastic neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder associated with ovarian dysgerminoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に関連した傍腫瘍性視神経脊髄炎スペクトラム障害：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に関連した傍腫瘍性視神経脊髄炎スペクトラム障害の48歳女性症例。段階的な視力低下で発症し、AQP4-IgG抗体陽性。免疫抑制療法と外科的切除、化学療法による治療により視力が回復し完全寛解を達成した。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of paraneoplastic neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) associated with ovarian dysgerminoma in a 48-year-old woman. Patient presented with visual loss, positive AQP4-IgG antibodies, and imaging-confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma. Complete remission achieved after chemotherapy and immunosuppressive therapy with vision recovery.

title: Pulmonary metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma following an uncomplicated term pregnancy: a case report.
title_ja: 正常妊娠終了後の肺転移妊娠性絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 正常妊娠後の肺転移性妊娠絨毛膜癌の症例報告。20歳イラン女性。β-hCG > 1,000,000で両側肺転移。多剤化学療法(EMACO)に良好に反応。予後は早期治療で良好。
summary_en: Case report of pulmonary metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma in a 20-year-old woman presenting with dyspnea and chest pain one day after uncomplicated term pregnancy. Markedly elevated β-hCG (>1,000,000) and bilateral pulmonary nodules confirmed diagnosis. Patient responded well to etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine chemotherapy.

title: PD-L1 expression in testicular germ cell tumors undergoing spontaneous regression.
title_ja: 自然退縮を経験する精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるPD-L1発現
summary_ja: 自然に退縮した精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるPD-L1発現の調査研究。完全に退縮した5腫瘍および部分的に退縮した6腫瘍を分析。完全退縮症例ではPD-L1がなく、セミノーマ含有部分退縮腫瘍のリンパ球では有意なPD-L1を示し、免疫介在性自然退縮を支持。
summary_en: Study investigating programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in spontaneously regressed testicular germ cell tumors. Analyzed 5 completely regressed and 6 partially regressed tumors showing no PD-L1 in completely regressed cases but significant PD-L1 in lymphocytes of partially regressed seminoma-containing tumors, supporting immune-mediated spontaneous regression.

title: Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia Associated with Mature Ovarian Cystic Teratoma Containing Monoclonal Immunoglobulin G: A Case Report and Review of Literature.
title_ja: モノクローナル免疫グロブリンGを含む成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に関連する自己免疫溶血性貧血: 症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に関連する続発性自己免疫溶血性貧血(AIHA)の症例報告および文献レビュー。22歳女性が進行性貧血および溶血マーカーで発症。腫瘍は赤血球に対するモノクローナルIgG-κ抗体を含有。プレドニゾロン療法で貧血の改善に反応。
summary_en: Case report and literature review of secondary autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) associated with mature ovarian cystic teratoma. 22-year-old woman presented with progressive anemia and hemolysis markers. Tumor contained monoclonal IgG-κ antibodies against red blood cells. Responded to prednisolone therapy with improved anemia.

title: Primary Dysgerminoma of the Uterine Cervix: A Rare Case Report.
title_ja: 子宮頸部原発未分化胚細胞腫：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 18歳女性の子宮頸部一次性ジスジェルミノーマの稀な症例報告。12ヶ月の膣出血。8×6×5 cm腫瘤。化学療法と放射線治療後に再発。水腎症と敗血症で死亡。極めて攻撃的経過。
summary_en: Rare case report of primary cervical dysgerminoma in an 18-year-old woman presenting with 12-month history of vaginal bleeding. MRI showed 8×6×5 cm cervicovaginal mass. Despite chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) and radiation, patient developed recurrence and died from hydronephrosis, anemia, and sepsis, illustrating aggressive clinical course.

title: Primary intracardiac germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 原発性心臓内胚細胞腫瘍
summary_ja: 軽微な外傷後に頭皮腫脹で初発症状を呈した6歳女児における原発性心臓内胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。その後の臨床検査および画像検査により、原発性心臓腫瘍からの頭皮転移と診断された。心エコー検査により心臓内の腫瘍性病変が明確に記録されている。
summary_en: Case presentation of a 6-year-old girl with primary intracardiac germ cell tumor who presented with scalp swelling after minor trauma, later diagnosed as metastases from the primary cardiac tumor. Echocardiography images documented the cardiac lesion.

title: Germ Cell Tumor of the Testis: Lethal Subtypes of a Curable Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍: 治癒可能ながんの致死的サブタイプ
summary_ja: 肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍(S-YST)および上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)を含む化学療法耐性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍サブタイプの7名の患者の症例集積。治癒達成のための追加化学療法より初期の外科的切除が優れており、化学療法耐性胚細胞腫瘍の管理戦略を強調。
summary_en: Case series of seven patients with chemo-resistant non-seminomatous germ cell tumor subtypes including sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor (S-YST) and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT). Demonstrates early surgical resection as superior to additional chemotherapy for achieving cure, highlighting management strategies for chemotherapy-resistant germ cell tumors.

title: Assessment of Molecular Markers in Pediatric Ovarian Tumors: Romanian Single-Center Experience.
title_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍における分子マーカーの評価: ルーマニア単一施設経験
summary_ja: 18歳未満の64名の小児卵巣腫瘍におけるSALL4およびOCT3/4バイオマーカー発現の後方視的分析。SALL4は腺癌、ディスジャーミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、未熟奇形腫において有意に発現。両マーカーは高いグレード、病期、高いAFP/LDH値、短い無増悪生存期間に相関。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of SALL4 and OCT3/4 biomarker expression in 64 pediatric ovarian tumors under age 18. Found SALL4 significantly expressed in adenocarcinoma, dysgerminoma, mixed germ cell tumors, and immature teratoma. Both markers correlated with higher grade, stage, elevated AFP/LDH, and shorter progression-free survival.

title: Genetic Profiling of Sebaceous Carcinoma Arising from an Ovarian Mature Teratoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した脂腺癌の遺伝子解析：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した皮脂癌の初の詳細な遺伝子解析。TP53ナンセンス変異とPIK3R1欠失を同定。片親性二体性の証拠。術後8ヶ月で再発なし。
summary_en: First detailed genomic analysis of sebaceous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma (OMT) in a 36-year-old woman. Identified TP53 nonsense mutation (p.R306*) and PIK3R1 deletion with evidence of uniparental disomy. Stage IA disease with no recurrence 8 months post-surgery, illustrating malignant transformation mechanisms.

title: Unilateral Post-Chemotherapy Robot-Assisted Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Stage II Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumors: Sexual and Reproductive Outcomes.
title_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の一側性ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清: 性機能および生殖機能転帰
summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後のロボット支援一側性後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-rRPLND)後の性機能および生殖機能転帰の研究。適格患者22名のうち31.8%が逆行性射精(13.6%)、精子数減少症(4.5%)、勃起障害(13.6%)を含む男性学的障害を発症し、9.1%が自然妊娠に成功。
summary_en: Study of sexual and reproductive outcomes following post-chemotherapy robot-assisted unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-rRPLND) for stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of 22 eligible patients, 31.8% developed andrological disorders including retrograde ejaculation (13.6%), hypospermia (4.5%), and erectile dysfunction (13.6%), with 9.1% achieving natural conception.

title: Regionalization of Testis Cancer Care-Is It Necessary?
title_ja: 精巣がん診療の集約化は必要か？
summary_ja: 高容量基準センターにおける精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の集約化に関する検討。初期の管理ステップは他の施設で実行できるが、外科的および全身細胞障害性治療は中核センターで実行される必要がある。精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の地域中核化は優れた腫瘍学的転帰をもたらす。
summary_en: Review examining regionalization of testicular germ cell tumor care at high-volume reference centers. While initial management can be performed elsewhere, surgical and systemic therapy require specialized centers. Evidence shows regionalized care results in superior oncological outcomes for testicular germ cell tumors.

title: Contemporary Role of Radiation Therapy in Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける放射線療法の現代的役割
summary_ja: 精巣がん、特にセミノーマに対する現代的放射線療法のレビュー。セミノーマは放射線感受性で、病期I、IIA、IIB疾患の精巣摘除術後の補助放射線療法に良好に反応。線量漸減は二次悪性腫瘍リスクを含む急性および長期有害性を減らしながら再発を効果的に予防。
summary_en: Review of contemporary radiation therapy for testicular cancer, particularly seminoma. Seminomas are radiation-sensitive and respond well to adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy for stage I, IIA, and IIB disease. Dose de-escalation effectively prevents recurrence while reducing acute and long-term toxicities including secondary malignancy risk.

title: MicroRNA for Prediction of Teratoma and Viable Germ Cell Tumor after Chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法後の奇形腫および生存可能な胚細胞腫瘍の予測のためのマイクロRNA
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性のレビュー。高感度性と特異性を示し、特に化学療法後の奇形腫と生存可能な胚細胞腫瘍検出のための治療反応予測への使用を支持する新たなエビデンスがあるが、臨床応用にはさらなる研究が必要。
summary_en: Review of microRNA (miRNA) utility as tumor markers for testicular germ cell tumors across disease spectrum. miRNAs show high sensitivity and specificity for GCTs and emerging evidence supports their use for predicting treatment response, particularly for teratoma and viable GCT detection after chemotherapy, though clinical application requires further study.

title: Update on the Management of Low-stage Seminoma.
title_ja: 低病期セミノーマの管理に関する最新情報
summary_ja: 低病期セミノーマの現代的治療管理パラダイムの最新情報。高い耐久性のある治癒率を達成しながら治療負担を最小化。病期Iセミノーマの進化する経過観察戦略、および病期IIA/IIBセミノーマ患者に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の実行可能性を支持する新たなデータを検討。
summary_en: Update on contemporary management paradigm for low-stage seminoma achieving high cure rates while minimizing treatment burden. Reviews evolving surveillance strategies for stage I seminoma and emerging data supporting retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) as viable treatment option for selected stage IIA and IIB seminoma patients.

title: Pathogenesis and pathobiology of testicular germ cell tumours: a view from a developmental biological perspective with guidelines for pathological diagnostics.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症経路と病態生物学：発生生物学的見地からの概観および病理診断ガイドライン
summary_ja: 発生学的起源と分子的特性によるI～III型分類を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍病態生物学の包括的レビュー。セミノーマ、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌の形態学的および免疫組織化学的診断アルゴリズムを論述。GCT発展における多能性因子(OCT3/4、SOX2、SOX17)の役割を強調。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular germ cell tumor pathobiology covering type I-III classification by developmental origin and molecular features. Discusses seminoma, teratoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma with morphological and immunohistochemical diagnostic algorithms. Emphasizes role of pluripotency factors (OCT3/4, SOX2, SOX17) in GCT development and diagnosis.

title: Testicular Mixed Germ Cell Tumor (TMGCT) Management: Addressing Infection and Tumor Marker Dynamics.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍管理：感染と腫瘍マーカー動態への対応
summary_ja: 23歳男性、精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍とαフェトプロテイン上昇で診断。併存感染が診断され抗生物質で治療。感染治療後に腫瘍マーカーが低下。精巣摘除術で診断確認。併存感染が臨床的表現と腫瘍マーカーに影響を与える重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of 23-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with testicular swelling, elevated AFP and LDH levels. Concurrent infection was diagnosed and treated with antibiotics, resulting in fever resolution and significant decrease in tumor marker levels. Mixed germ cell tumor diagnosis confirmed on orchidectomy.

title: Mucinous cystadenoma and carcinoid tumor arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a 60 year-old patient: a case report.
title_ja: 60歳患者の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた粘液性嚢胞腺腫とカルチノイド腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 60歳閉経後女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化したカルチノイド腫瘍。病理組織学的に低グレードとして分類。包括的手術後14ヶ月で再発なし。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からのカルチノイド転化は稀で、病理組織学的評価の重要性を強調。
summary_en: 60-year-old woman with malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma into carcinoid tumor with benign mucinous cystadenoma. After comprehensive staging surgery and hysterectomy, patient remained disease-free for 14 months without chemotherapy. Case highlights importance of careful histopathological evaluation in detecting rare carcinoid transformation in postmenopausal women with adnexal masses.

title: Role of 18F-Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography in Children With Germ Cell Tumor After Chemotherapy.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後における18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割
summary_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者17名の後方視的研究。術前化学療法後のPET/CTで5例中1例の偽陰性。残存悪性成分と成熟奇形腫の識別困難。化学療法後の治療計画決定におけるPET/CTの限界を指摘。
summary_en: Retrospective study evaluating 18F-FDG PET/CT role in restaging malignant germ cell tumors in 17 pediatric patients after neoadjuvant chemotherapy. PET/CT showed one false negative case and limited discrimination between residual malignant component and mature teratoma. Findings suggest PET/CT limitations in post-chemotherapy assessment for treatment planning in pediatric GCT patients.

title: Amplifications of EVX2 and HOXD9-HOXD13 on 2q31 in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary identified by array comparative genomic hybridization may explain teratoma characteristics in chondrogenesis and osteogenesis.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の2q31上のEVX2およびHOXD9-HOXD13増幅と軟骨形成・骨形成における奇形腫特性
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫9例のゲノム異常をarray CGHで分析。EVX2、HOXD9-HOXD13などの遺伝子増幅が全例で認められ、軟骨造成・骨化の特性を説明する可能性がある。奇形腫形成の分子基盤と組織分化メカニズムの理解に貢献する。
summary_en: Array comparative genomic hybridization analysis of 9 ovarian mature cystic teratomas identified recurrent gene amplifications including EVX2, HOXD9-HOXD13, and Xq28-encoded genes. Amplifications may explain teratoma characteristics in chondrogenesis and osteogenesis, providing insights into teratoma molecular biology and tissue differentiation mechanisms.

title: A Multicenter Evaluation of Treatment-associated Changes in Body Composition in Men With Germ Cell Tumors of the Testis: Implications for Adverse Events and Complications.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍男性における治療関連体組成変化の多施設評価：有害事象および合併症への影響
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者216人を対象とした多施設後方視的研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法後、患者は6%の骨格筋喪失と脂肪量増加を示した。低骨格筋量は高い3度以上の化学療法関連有害事象と関連し、胚細胞腫瘍化学療法毒性管理への知見を提供。
summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 216 men with testicular germ cell tumors. Following cisplatin-based chemotherapy, patients showed 6% skeletal muscle loss and increased adiposity. Decreased skeletal muscle mass was associated with higher grade 3+ chemotherapy-related adverse events, providing insights into GCT chemotherapy toxicity management.

title: Pure 46, XY gonadal dysgenesis and 46, XY complete androgen insensitivity syndrome: A case report.
title_ja: 純粋な46,XY性腺異形成および46,XY完全アンドロゲン不応症：症例報告
summary_ja: 性腺悪性腫瘍リスク増加を伴う2つのまれな46,XY性分化異常症（XY純粋性腺異形成と完全アンドロゲン不応症）の症例。両側予防的性腺摘除術で性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。長期ホルモン補充療法が推奨される。
summary_en: Two rare cases of 46,XY disorders of sex development (XY pure gonadal dysgenesis and complete androgen insensitivity syndrome) with elevated gonadal malignancy risk. Bilateral prophylactic gonadectomy revealed gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Long-term hormone replacement therapy recommended for secondary sexual characteristics and osteoporosis prevention.

title: Indocyanine green fluorescence imaging-assisted laparoscopy resection of retroperitoneal tumors in children: case report and literature review.
title_ja: 小児の後腹膜腫瘍のインドシアニングリーン蛍光イメージング補助腹腔鏡下切除:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 小児後腹膜腫瘍の腹腔鏡手術にインドシアニングリーン蛍光イメージングを応用した3症例。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を1例含む。蛍光イメージングにより血管構造の可視化が向上し、手術安全性が増強された。小児後腹膜GCT管理に有用な手技である。
summary_en: Three pediatric cases of laparoscopic retroperitoneal tumor resection using indocyanine green fluorescence imaging. One case was mature cystic teratoma. ICG fluorescence imaging improved vascular visualization and enhanced surgical safety. Technique demonstrated safe and effective outcomes for pediatric retroperitoneal tumor management.

title: Robot-Assisted Laparoscopic Radical Prostatectomy for Prostatic Metastatic Recurrence from Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんからの前立腺転移に対するロボット支援腹腔鏡下根治的前立腺摘除術
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術2年後に前立腺セミノーマ転移を発症した34歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者。導入化学療法後、腫瘍マーカー正常化と画像反応を認め、ロボット支援根治的前立腺摘除術施行。9ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: 34-year-old male with mixed germ cell tumor of testis presenting with prostatic seminoma metastasis two years after orchiectomy. After neoadjuvant chemotherapy with tumor marker normalization and imaging response, robot-assisted radical prostatectomy was performed. No recurrence observed at 9-month follow-up.

title: Struma Ovarii during Pregnancy.
title_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 卵巣ストルマオバリイは全卵巣奇形腫の2～5％に認められる稀な亜型。50％以上が甲状腺組織。妊娠中の診断・管理、悪性転化リスク（0.5～10％）、妊娠ホルモン（エストロゲン、プロゲステロン、hCG）による増殖促進の課題を検討している。
summary_en: Review of struma ovarii, a rare ovarian teratoma type composed of >50% thyroid tissue occurring in 2-5% of ovarian teratomas. Focuses on diagnostic challenges and management during pregnancy, considering malignant transformation risk (0.5-10%) and growth acceleration from pregnancy hormones including estrogen, progesterone, and hCG.

title: Non-Syndromic and Syndromic Defects in Children with Extracranial Germ Cell Tumors: Data of 2610 Children Registered with the German MAKEI 96/MAHO 98 Registry Compared to the General Population.
title_ja: 頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児における非症候群的および症候群的欠損：ドイツMAKEI 96/MAHO 98登録に登録された2610人の小児と一般人口との比較
summary_ja: 2610人の小児の頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした登録ベースの研究。スウィーア症候群（OR 338.6）およびクラリーノ症候群（OR 34.2）との強い関連を確認。症候群性症例のほとんどが女児。胚細胞腫瘍発症のリスク層別化を提供。
summary_en: Registry-based study of 2610 children with extracranial germ cell tumors examining associations with genetic syndromes and congenital anomalies. Strong associations confirmed for Swyer (OR 338.6) and Currarino (OR 34.2) syndromes. Most syndromic cases involved girls. Study provides risk stratification for GCT development.

title: Bone Metastases in Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumors: A 20-Year Retrospective Analysis.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における骨転移：20年の後方視的分析
summary_ja: NSGCT患者における骨転移の20年後方視的分析(29同時性、11異時性)。ほとんどがIGCCCG不良リスク患者。骨転移はしばしば無症状で脊椎を関与し、病理で壊死/奇形腫/セミノーマを示した。異時性BMはより悪い転帰と関連(5年OS 36.4% vs 53.9%同時性)。
summary_en: Retrospective 20-year analysis of 40 NSGCT patients with bone metastases (29 synchronous, 11 metachronous). Most were IGCCCG poor-risk patients. Bone metastases frequently asymptomatic, involved spine (92.5%), revealed necrosis/mature teratoma/seminoma on pathology. Metachronous BM associated with worse outcomes (5-year OS 36.4% vs 53.9% synchronous).

title: Retroperitoneal dermoid cyst complicated with uterine adenomyoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 子宮腺筋症を伴う後腹膜類皮嚢腫:症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫と子宮腺筋症を合併した症例報告。骨盤腫瘤の誤診リスク軽減のための文献考察。異なる骨盤病変の鑑別診断における画像診断と臨床評価の重要性を強調している。
summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) complicated with uterine adenomyoma. Literature review addresses diagnostic considerations for pelvic masses to reduce misdiagnosis risk. Highlights importance of imaging and clinical assessment in managing pelvic teratomas.

title: Abnormal methylation of HOXA11 promoter promotes tumor progression in testicular germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるHOXA11プロモーターの異常メチル化が腫瘍進行を促進する
summary_ja: 63例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてHOXA11プロモーターメチル化を調査した研究。メチル化はGCT組織で隣接組織より有意に頻繁であり、リンパ節転移およびTNM病期と相関した。メチルトランスフェラーゼ阻害薬によりHOXA11発現が増加し、異常メチル化がHOXA11を抑制して腫瘍進行を促進することを示唆する。
summary_en: Study investigating HOXA11 promoter methylation in 63 testicular germ cell tumors. Methylation significantly more frequent in GCT tissue than adjacent tissue and correlated with lymph node metastasis and TNM stage. Methyltransferase inhibitor increased HOXA11 expression, suggesting abnormal methylation suppresses HOXA11 and promotes tumor progression.

title: Perioperative strategies and management of giant anterior mediastinal tumors: a narrative review.
title_ja: 巨大前縦隔腫瘍の周術期戦略と管理：ナラティブレビュー
summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤症候群を有する巨大前縦隔腫瘍(>10 cm)についてのナラティブレビュー。成熟奇形腫およびliposarcomaが最も一般的な診断であり、悪性リンパ腫および悪性胚細胞腫瘍が頻繁にMMSを発症する。MMSの発症に基づくリスク分類と治療アルゴリズムを提案し、悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法および放射線療法の優先性を示す。
summary_en: Narrative review of giant anterior mediastinal tumors (>10 cm) and mediastinal mass syndrome. Discusses mature teratomas and liposarcomas as most common diagnoses; malignant lymphomas and malignant germ cell tumors frequently develop MMS. Proposes classification strategy based on imaging, treatment algorithms prioritizing chemotherapy/radiotherapy over surgery for malignant GCTs.

title: Isolated pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma masquerading as pulmonary embolism diagnosed by endovascular biopsy.
title_ja: 肺動脈の孤立性絨毛癌：肺塞栓症に偽装し血管内生検で診断された症例
summary_ja: 52歳女性の肺動脈絨毛癌症例。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往があり、肺塞栓症に偽装して発症。β-hCG>100,000の上昇と血管内生検で診断。稀な頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の診断における血管内放射線学の重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of isolated pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma in 52-year-old female with gestational trophoblastic disease history. Presented with dyspnea mimicking pulmonary embolism; diagnosis confirmed by elevated beta-hCG (>100,000) and endovascular biopsy. Illustrates diagnostic challenges and interventional radiology role in obtaining histological diagnosis of rare GCTs.

title: Image-guided aspiration of a cystic mediastinal teratoma: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 画像誘導下縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫穿刺吸引：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 気管および腕頭動脈圧迫による脳梗塞を起こした大きな嚢胞性縦隔奇形腫を有する51歳男性の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)/磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)画像所見およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)誘導下穿刺吸引による減圧を記述し、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を病理で確認した。
summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old male with large cystic mediastinal teratoma causing tracheal and brachiocephalic artery compression leading to stroke. Describes CT/MRI imaging findings and percutaneous CT-guided aspiration for decompression. Pathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma.

title: Imaging appearance of ovarian dysgerminoma: A report of two cases.
title_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の画像所見：2症例の報告
summary_ja: 若い女性に見られた最も一般的な卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍である卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の2症例を報告した。骨盤痛で発症し、特性的な線維血管中隔を有する大きな固形腫瘤を示すMRI画像所見を記述し、両症例で外科的切除および組織学的確認を実施した。
summary_en: Reports two cases of ovarian dysgerminoma, the most common ovarian malignant germ cell tumor, presenting with pelvic pain in young women. Describes MRI imaging features showing large solid masses with characteristic fibrovascular septa. Surgical resection and histological confirmation performed in both cases.

title: Use of Risk Factors To Select Adjuvant Therapy Versus Surveillance for Testicular Nonseminoma and Seminoma Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 精巣非セミノーマおよびセミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍における補助療法対観察選択のためのリスク因子の活用
summary_ja: 病期I精巣がんにおけるセミノーマと非セミノーマの再発リスクに関する新しいリスク因子を検討し、更新されたリスク層別化が従来のパラメータと比較して再発をより良く予測し、補助化学療法と観察戦略間の選択を改善することを議論する。
summary_en: Reviews new risk factors for stage I testicular cancer relapse in seminoma and nonseminoma to guide adjuvant therapy decisions. Discusses how updated risk stratification better predicts recurrence compared to previous parameters and improves selection between adjuvant chemotherapy and surveillance strategies.

title: Remote Field Application of Digital Technology for Hearing Assessments in a Cohort of Pediatric Germ Cell Tumor Survivors.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍生存者における遠隔デジタル技術を用いた聴力評価
summary_ja: 白金化学療法で治療された小児胚細胞腫瘍生存者(n=100)におけるGOLDコホートで遠隔タブレットベース聴力評価の実現可能性を評価した。標準周波数で難聴が21%で観察され、自己報告と測定された難聴の間に強い一致が見られた。参加者の97%で遠隔評価を完全に成功した。
summary_en: Evaluates feasibility of remote tablet-based hearing assessment in pediatric germ cell tumor survivors (n=100) from GOLD cohort treated with platinum chemotherapy. Found 21% with hearing loss at standard frequencies; strong agreement between self-reported and measured hearing loss. Successfully completed remote assessments in 97% of participants.

title: Exploring the role of SOX 2 and OCT 4 in the pathogenesis of gliomatosis peritonei: the clinicopathological profile of eleven cases.
title_ja: 腹膜神経膠腫症の病因におけるSOX2およびOCT4の役割：11症例の臨床病理学的プロファイル
summary_ja: 腹膜と大網に関連した卵巣奇形腫(8症例が未熟、3症例が成熟)を有する11症例の腹膜神経膠腫症を報告した。幹細胞分化指標SOX2とOCT4を検討し、GP焦点のすべてにおけるSOX2陽性およびOCT4陰性を示し、神経分化におけるSOX2の役割を示唆する。
summary_en: Reports 11 cases of gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition with multiple mature glial implants in peritoneum/omentum associated with ovarian teratomas (8 immature, 3 mature). Examines SOX2 and OCT4 stem cell differentiation markers showing SOX2 positivity in all GP foci and negative OCT4, suggesting SOX2 role in neural differentiation.

title: Defining the cellular origin of seminoma by transcriptional and epigenetic mapping to the normal human germline.
title_ja: 転写的およびエピジェネティックマッピングにより正常ヒト生殖細胞系統にセミノーマの細胞起源を定義する
summary_ja: セミノーマトランスクリプトームおよびエピジェネティック領域を正常男性生殖細胞発達に関連付け。セミノーマが前遊走/遊走原始生殖細胞に類似し、多能性および異なるMAPK/ERK信号を増強していることを発見。Pallister-Killian症候群のi(12p)モザイク多能性幹細胞由来PGCsを用いてセミノーマ形質転換機構をモデル化。
summary_en: Maps seminoma transcriptomes and epigenetic landscape to normal human male germline development. Finds seminoma resembles premigratory/migratory primordial germ cells with enhanced pluripotency and altered MAPK/ERK signaling. Uses pluripotent stem cell-derived PGCs from Pallister-Killian syndrome mosaic for chromosome 12p to model seminoma transformation mechanisms.

title: A rare case of retroperitoneal teratoma with evidence of papillary thyroid carcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌の証拠を有する稀な後腹膜奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌を含む後腹膜奇形腫の41歳女性症例。画像所見と外科的切除、全甲状腺摘除術および放射性ヨウ素療法を実施。性腺外奇形腫の体細胞分化の診断課題と治療を強調。
summary_en: Case report of 41-year-old woman with retroperitoneal teratoma containing papillary thyroid carcinoma. Discusses imaging findings, surgical resection with negative margins, and subsequent total thyroidectomy with radioiodine therapy. Highlights diagnostic challenges and treatment considerations for rare extragonadal teratomas with somatic differentiation.

title: MRI features of ovarian teratomas with somatic-type malignancy and mature cystic teratomas.
title_ja: 体細胞型悪性化を伴う卵巣奇形腫および成熟嚢胞性奇形腫のMRI特徴
summary_ja: 体細胞型悪性性分化を伴う卵巣奇形腫（10例）と良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（193例）のMRI所見を比較。TSMはより大きく、固形成分に脂肪組織と環状強化がない。全例で動的MRIで高/中間リスク曲線を示す。感度100%、特異度97.4%。
summary_en: Compares MRI features of ovarian teratomas with somatic-type malignancy (10 cases) versus benign mature cystic teratomas (193 cases). TSMs larger with absence of fat tissue and ring-like enhancement in solid components; all show high/intermediate-risk time-intensity curves on dynamic MRI versus low-risk in MCTs. ROC analysis shows 100% sensitivity and 97.4% specificity.

title: Omental mature cystic teratoma mimicking a mesenteric cyst: A case report.
title_ja: 腸間膜嚢胞を模倣する大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳女性の大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。画像検査とCA-125上昇に基づき腸間膜嚢胞が疑われたが、試験的開腹により正常卵巣と大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を確認。病理組織学的に診断。稀な性腺外起源を示す。
summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old woman with large omental mature cystic teratoma initially suspected to be mesenteric cyst based on imaging and elevated CA-125. Exploratory laparotomy revealed normal ovaries and large omental MCT. Successful excision with histopathological confirmation demonstrates rare extragonadal teratoma origin.

title: Diagnosis and management of a sacrococcygeal teratoma at a tertiary hospital in northern Tanzania: A case report.
title_ja: タンザニア北部の高度中核病院における仙尾部奇形腫の診断と管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 産後5日に発症した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫（Type II）の症例報告。産前超音波診断、MRI評価、負の辺縁での広範切除、補助化学療法なしの良好な回復。辺縁の重要性と病理学的検査を強調。
summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type II) in neonate presenting 5 days postpartum. Discusses prenatal ultrasound diagnosis, MRI assessment of extent, wide local excision with negative margins, and excellent postoperative recovery without adjuvant chemotherapy. Emphasizes importance of adequate margins and histological examination.

title: Molecular and epigenetic ex vivo profiling of testis cancer-associated fibroblasts and their interaction with germ cell tumor cells and macrophages.
title_ja: 精巣がん関連線維芽細胞のex vivo分子および遺伝子発現解析と胚細胞腫瘍細胞およびマクロファージとの相互作用
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫)由来の癌関連線維芽細胞の分子および遺伝子発現解析。セミノーマおよび胎児性癌は奇形腫より癌関連線維芽細胞をより活性化。IGFBP1、LGALS3BP、LYVE1、PTX3を介して増殖とシスプラチン感受性に影響。
summary_en: Molecular and epigenetic profiling of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAF) from testicular germ cell tumors (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma). Demonstrates CAF activation differs by tumor type; seminoma and EC activate CAF more than teratoma. CAF influence GCT proliferation, cisplatin sensitivity, and macrophage polarization via IGFBP1, LGALS3BP, LYVE1, PTX3.

title: Review of Discordance Between American Urological Association and European Association of Urology Guideline Recommendations for Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに関する米国泌尿器科学会および欧州泌尿器科学会ガイドライン推奨の不一致のレビュー
summary_ja: 精巣がん管理に関する両学会ガイドラインを比較。低容量転移(性)血清腫瘍マーカー陰性第IIA/B期疾患および進行性/再発性疾患戦略における相違。全体的に高い一致率。
summary_en: Compares American Urological Association and European Association of Urology guidelines on testicular cancer management. Identifies high overall concordance with some differences in management of low-volume metastatic serum tumor marker-negative stage IIA/B disease and advanced/relapsed disease strategies.

title: Variations in germ cell tumor histology by age and implications for cancer-specific survival among pediatric and adult males: A population-based study.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の組織型の年齢による変動および小児および成人男性の癌特異的生存への影響：集団ベース研究
summary_ja: SEER基盤の集団研究で0-40歳の男性胚細胞腫瘍の組織型変動を分析。幼少児では卵黄嚢腫瘍および奇形腫優位、思春期では混合型胚細胞腫瘍、成人ではセミノーマ優位。
summary_en: This SEER-based population study analyzes histological variations in male germ cell tumors across age groups (0-40 years), showing yolk sac tumors and teratomas predominate in young children, mixed GCT in adolescents, and seminoma in adults, with significant implications for cancer-specific survival.

title: Growing teratoma syndrome in children and adolescents: Prevalence and surgical outcome.
title_ja: 小児および思春期のgrowing teratoma syndrome：有病率と手術成績
summary_ja: 転移(性)胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児患者におけるgrowing teratoma syndromeを検討し、有病率(28%)、手術成績、および予後因子を分析。転移巣の完全外科的切除により多くの患者で寛解。
summary_en: This study examines growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in pediatric patients with metastatic germ cell tumors, analyzing prevalence (28%), surgical outcomes, and prognostic factors. Complete resection of metastatic sites achieved remission in most patients with GTS.

title: Adult ovarian and sellar region mixed germ cell tumor: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 成人卵巣およびトルコ鞍領域混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告および文献的考察
summary_ja: 同時性卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および卵黄嚢腫瘍）とトルコ鞍領域ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を有する26歳女性。上昇した腫瘍マーカーと画像検査により多学科的管理を施行し化学療法および放射線療法により完全寛解。
summary_en: This case report describes a rare 26-year-old female with simultaneous ovarian mixed germ cell tumors (dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor) and sellar germinoma. Elevated tumor markers and imaging guided multidisciplinary management with chemotherapy and radiotherapy, achieving complete remission.

title: Metastatic malignant struma ovarii to the pituitary presenting as a sellar mass and responding to total thyroidectomy with adjuvant radioactive iodine therapy.
title_ja: 下垂体への転移性悪性卵巣甲状腺腫：トルコ鞍領域腫瘤として呈示し全甲状腺摘除術と放射性ヨウ素療法に奏効した症例
summary_ja: 甲状腺組織から構成される卵巣奇形腫である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が下垂体に転移してトルコ鞍領域腫瘤として呈示した症例。経蝶形骨手術、全甲状腺摘除術、および放射性ヨウ素アブレーション療法により5年間の継続的寛解を達成。
summary_en: This case describes metastatic malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid tissue) to the pituitary presenting as sellar mass. Successfully managed with trans-sphenoidal resection, total thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine ablation with sustained remission over 5 years.

title: Spontaneous pregnancy after fertility-sparing surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy for advanced pure dysgerminoma: A case report.
title_ja: 進行期純粋ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に対する妊孕性温存手術および補助化学療法後の自然妊娠：症例報告
summary_ja: 第IV期純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の23歳女性患者が妊孕性温存手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法により完全寛解を達成し、その後自然妊娠により健康児を出産した症例報告。
summary_en: This case report documents a 23-year-old woman with stage IV pure ovarian dysgerminoma (germ cell tumor) treated with fertility-sparing surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieving complete remission and spontaneous pregnancy with healthy infant birth.

title: A Rare Case of Cervico-Mediastinal Thyroid Teratoma.
title_ja: 頸部-縦隔甲状腺奇形腫の稀な症例
summary_ja: 甲状腺発生の頸部縦隔奇形腫の症例。
summary_en: This case describes a rare cervico-mediastinal thyroid teratoma in a 37-year-old woman presenting with lateral cervical swelling. Surgical management revealed mixed-type teratoma originating from thyroid gland, highlighting diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

title: Primary mediastinal seminoma with azoospermia: case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 無精子症を伴う原発性縦隔セミノーマ: 症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマと無精子症を伴う16歳男性の症例。胸部CTと陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で診断、生検で病理組織学的に確認。腫瘍切除と術後化学療法で治療、フォローアップで再発なし。
summary_en: This case report presents a 16-year-old with primary mediastinal seminoma (germ cell tumor) with azoospermia. Histopathological diagnosis via biopsy guided tumor resection and postoperative chemotherapy with no recurrence.

title: Evaluation of transport mechanisms of methotrexate in human choriocarcinoma cell lines by LC-MS/MS.
title_ja: メトトレキサートのヒト絨毛癌細胞株における輸送機構の評価(LC-MS/MS)
summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株におけるメトトレキサートの輸送機構の検討。
summary_en: This study investigates methotrexate transport mechanisms in human choriocarcinoma cell lines, identifying multiple transporters involved in MTX uptake and efflux. Findings have implications for predicting drug interactions and enhancing MTX sensitivity in choriocarcinoma treatment.

title: Survival outcomes and molecular drivers of testicular cancer in hispanic men.
title_ja: ヒスパニック系男性における精巣がんの生存転帰と分子的要因
summary_ja: SEER登録簿データ(43,709例、ヒスパニック系23.3%)を用いた精巣がん予後研究。ヒスパニック系はNSGCTで悪い生存転帰を示したが、セミノーマでは見られず。体細胞変異は民族間で差がなく、ヒスパニック系の遺伝的祖先は不均質。
summary_en: This SEER-based study examines testicular cancer outcomes in Hispanic men compared to non-Hispanic Whites, finding worse cancer-specific survival for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT) in Hispanics despite presenting at younger ages.

title: A Rare Case of a Non-seminomatous Testicular Cancer Metastasis to the Duodenum: A Case Report.
title_ja: 十二指腸への非セミノーマ性精巣がん転移の稀な症例: 症例報告
summary_ja: 34歳男性の非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者における稀な十二指腸転移症例。18か月前のStage IA精巣腫瘍に対する根治的精巣摘除術後に十二指腸転移を発症。正常腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず、CTおよび内視鏡生検で転移性胎児性癌が確認。
summary_en: This case reports metastatic embryonal carcinoma (non-seminomatous germ cell tumor) to duodenum in a 34-year-old male with prior stage IA testicular cancer. Despite previously normal tumor markers, imaging and endoscopic biopsy confirmed GCT metastasis.

title: Emergent Management of Growing Teratoma Syndrome: A Case Presentation.
title_ja: Growing Teratoma Syndromeの緊急管理:症例提示
summary_ja: 30歳男性のNSGCT患者におけるgrowing teratoma syndrome(GTS)の症例で、精巣摘除術と化学療法後に急性腹痛と肺転移を発症。正常腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず後腹膜腫瘍が診断され、外科的切除で症状改善。
summary_en: This case describes growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in a 30-year-old male with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor presenting with acute abdomen and pulmonary metastasis despite normalized tumor markers. Surgical intervention achieved favorable outcomes.

title: Choriocarcinoma in neonates and infants: A severe but curable disease.
title_ja: 新生児および乳幼児における絨毛癌: 重症だが治療可能な疾患
summary_ja: 新生児および乳幼児における絨毛癌に関する後方視的二国間研究で8例を分析。中央値年齢6週間で、全腫瘍がびまん性。プラチナベース化学療法と遅延手術で4例が完全奏効し、転帰は不良だが治癒の可能性を示唆。
summary_en: This retrospective bi-national study analyzes eight cases of infantile choriocarcinoma (median age 6 weeks) with aggressive presentation. Four of eight patients achieved complete remission with platinum-based chemotherapy and delayed surgery on residual metastases.

title: Adherence Outcomes and Risk Factors Predicting Nonadherence to Active Surveillance in Patients With Stage 1 Testicular Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: Stage 1精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における積極的監視への遵守とそれを予測するリスク因子
summary_ja: 125例のStage 1精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における積極的監視への遵守に関する後方視的研究。遵守状況は最適(51%)、適切(11%)またはフォローアップ喪失(38%)に分類。文化的多様性、非喫煙、失業、パートナー存在が遵守予測因子。
summary_en: This retrospective study examines adherence to active surveillance in 125 stage 1 testicular germ cell tumor patients, categorizing outcomes as optimal (51%), adequate (11%), or loss-to-follow-up (38%). Predictors of adherence include cultural/linguistic diversity and non-smoking status.

title: Higher expression of SALL4-A isoform is correlated with worse outcomes and progression of the disease in subtype of testicular germ cell tumours.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の亜型における高いSALL4-Aアイソフォーム発現は悪い転帰と疾患進行と相関している
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍中のSALL4-Aアイソフォーム発現に関する研究(124例)で、正常および良性組織と比較。セミノーマおよび胎児性癌における高いSALL4-A発現は腫瘍病期、再発および精巣上体浸潤の増加と関連し、予後指標としての有用性を示唆している。
summary_en: Study of SALL4-A isoform expression in testicular germ cell tumors (124 cases), comparing with normal and benign tissues. Higher SALL4-A expression in seminomas and embryonal carcinomas was associated with increased tumor stage, recurrence, and epididymal invasion, suggesting utility as prognostic indicator.

title: Synchronous small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the cervix and immature ovarian teratoma: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 子宮頸部小細胞神経内分泌癌と未熟卵巣奇形腫の同時性：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 子宮頸部小細胞神経内分泌癌と卵巣未熟奇形腫の同時性原発腫瘍の症例報告。臨床的特徴、組織病理学的および免疫表現型特性を記述。頸部と卵巣の同時性原発腫瘍に関する文献レビューも含む。
summary_en: Case report of synchronous primary malignancies: cervical small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and ovarian immature teratoma in a woman. Describes clinical manifestations, histopathological and immunophenotypic features, with literature review of concurrent cervical and ovarian primary tumors.

title: Diagnostic and therapeutic challenges with germ cell tumours associated with transverse testicular ectopia and persistent Müllerian duct syndrome.
title_ja: transverse testicular ectopiaおよび遺残ミュラー管症候群に伴う胚細胞腫瘍の診断的および治療的課題
summary_ja: 30歳代前半の男性におけるII型transverse testicular ectopiaと精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。診断的および治療的課題を強調し、臨床的提示、画像所見および病理学的特徴を記述し、13例の類似症例を文献からレビューした。
summary_en: Case report of type II transverse testicular ectopia (TTE) with testicular mixed germ cell tumor in a man in his early 30s. Highlights diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, presents clinical presentation, imaging findings, and pathological features, with review of 13 similar literature cases.

title: Primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma requiring differentiation from non-small cell lung cancer: An autopsy case report.
title_ja: 非小細胞肺癌との鑑別を要する原発性縦隔絨毛癌：剖検症例報告
summary_ja: 肺がん疑いで入院した縦隔原発絨毛癌の剖検例。診断困難性を示し、肺と縦隔にかかる腫瘍診断時にβ-hCG測定と稀な絨毛癌を考慮することの重要性を強調。
summary_en: Autopsy case of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in 65-year-old man initially suspected of lung cancer. Emphasizes diagnostic difficulty and importance of evaluating serum β-hCG levels when encountering poorly differentiated carcinoma in mediastinal and pulmonary regions.

title: Expression of CD44 is associated with aggressiveness in seminomas.
title_ja: CD44の発現はセミノーマの攻撃性と関連している
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるCD44発現研究。セミノーマで腫瘍細胞および間質細胞のCD44発現増加が腫瘍サイズ、転移、血管侵襲、疾患ステージと関連。攻撃的表現型形成に寄与することを示唆。
summary_en: Study of CD44 expression in testicular germ cell tumors (71 tissue specimens) in seminomas and non-seminomatous tumors. Found increased CD44 expression in tumor and stromal cells associated with larger tumor size, metastasis, vascular invasion, and advanced stage in seminomas, indicating role in aggressive phenotype.

title: Assessment of quantitative microflow Vascular Index in testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける定量的マイクロフロー血管指数の評価
summary_ja: 精巣がんにおけるSMI由来血管指数(VI)の研究(腫瘍患者31例を含む62例)。VIは正常精巣と腫瘍の間で統計的に有意に異なり、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、リンパ腫の区別を支援できることが示された。
summary_en: Study of Superb Microvascular Imaging (SMI)-derived Vascular Index (VI) in testicular cancer (62 patients including 31 with tumors). VI significantly differed between normal testis and tumors, helping distinguish seminomas, non-seminomas, and lymphomas. Proposed as quantitative imaging parameter for tumor differentiation.

title: Epithelial Cell Adhesion Molecule (EpCAM) Expression in Human Tumors: A Comparison with Pan-Cytokeratin and TROP2 in 14,832 Tumors.
title_ja: ヒト腫瘍におけるEpCAM(上皮細胞接着分子)の発現：14,832例の腫瘍におけるPan-CytokeratinおよびTROP2との比較
summary_ja: 14,832検体を対象にしたEpCAM発現の大規模組織マイクロアレイ研究。精巣セミノーマではEpCAMが他の上皮マーカーと比べ高発現を示した。上皮バイオマーカーとしての有用性と診断的意義を支持。
summary_en: Large tissue microarray study of EpCAM expression in 14,832 tumor samples across 120 tumor categories. Germ cell tumors included with EpCAM positivity ≥90%. EpCAM particularly elevated in testicular seminomas compared to other epithelial markers (pan-cytokeratin, TROP2), supporting its diagnostic utility for epithelial tumors.

title: Analysis of MicroRNA-371-373 supports that a subset of spermatocytic tumors demonstrates biologic features similar to those of GCNIS-derived germ cell tumors.
title_ja: マイクロRNA-371-373の解析：精子球細胞腫瘍の一部がGCNIS由来胚細胞腫瘍と類似した生物学的特性を有することを支持する
summary_ja: 18例の精子球細胞腫瘍のマイクロRNA-371-373を定量的リアルタイムポリメラーゼ連鎖反応で解析。侵攻的精子球細胞腫瘍は非侵攻的症例より有意に高値。胎児期マイクロRNAが侵攻的表型に関与し、血清マイクロRNA検査の可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: Analysis of microRNA-371-373 in spermatocytic tumors (18 cases) by quantitative RT-PCR. Found microRNA levels significantly higher in aggressive spermatocytic tumors compared to non-aggressive cases. Results suggest embryonic microRNAs contribute to aggressive phenotype and support need for close follow-up and future serum testing.

title: Long-term outcome and fertility results of intraplacental choriocarcinoma: a retrospective study of 14 patients and literature review.
title_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の長期成績と妊孕性成績：14症例の後方視的研究と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌14症例と文献89症例のレビュー研究。化学療法に感受性があり、良好な寛解率と低い再発率。転移の有無にかかわらず治療後の妊娠成績が良好。患者への心理的支援が重要である。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 14 patients with intraplacental choriocarcinoma and review of 89 literature cases. Found IC sensitive to chemotherapy with good remission rates and low recurrence. Discusses fertility outcomes showing patients achieving successful pregnancies post-treatment, while emphasizing psychological support importance.

title: Surgical outcomes of transvaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopy in treating ovarian cysts and risk factors for surgical conversions.
title_ja: 卵巣嚢胞に対する経膣自然口腔内視鏡手術の手術成績と転換のリスク因子
summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞に対する経膣自然口腔内視鏡手術505例の後方視的研究。奇形腫が56.8%を占めた。手術転換の危険因子として重度骨盤癒着、両側嚢胞、子宮内膜症性嚢胞を同定。低い合併症率を示した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 505 patients undergoing transvaginal natural orifice endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) for ovarian cysts. Teratomas comprised 56.8% of cases. Identified risk factors for surgical conversion including severe pelvic adhesions, bilateral cysts, and endometriotic cysts. Demonstrated low complication and conversion rates.

title: High-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation as salvage therapy in primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: The Indiana University experience.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における大量化学療法と末梢血造血幹細胞移植による救援療法：インディアナ大学の経験
summary_ja: 再発原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍32例を対象とした大量化学療法と末梢血造血幹細胞移植の研究。中央年齢30歳、2年無増悪生存率31%、全生存率35%。9例(28%)が長期無病生存を達成。
summary_en: Study of high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation as salvage therapy in 32 relapsed primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients. Median age 30 years. Two-year progression-free survival 31%, overall survival 35%. Nine patients (28%) achieved long-term disease-free survival including platinum-refractory cases.

title: Retrospective evaluation of gestational trophoblastic disease - experience with ultrasounds.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の後方視的検討：超音波検査の経験
summary_ja: 120名の妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者を対象とした後方視的研究(2019～2022年)。不完全流産34例、完全流産82例、侵入奇胎3例、絨毛癌1例が診断された。患者への情報提供と適切な管理、妊娠回避期間の設定が重要である。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 120 gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) patients between 2019-2022. Analyzed clinical presentations, demographics, and pathological diagnoses. Found incomplete abortion (34), complete abortion (82), invasive moles (3), and choriocarcinoma (1). Discusses management timing and patient counseling regarding pregnancy avoidance periods.

title: Beta-Catenin Alterations in Postchemotherapy Yolk Sac Tumor, Postpubertal-Type With Enteroblastic Features.
title_ja: 腸芽細胞様特徴を伴う化学療法後思春期後型卵黄嚢腫瘍におけるベータカテニン異常
summary_ja: 化学療法後胚細胞型卵黄嚢腫瘍34例のベータカテニン発現研究。29%で核ベータカテニン検出、CTNNB1変異を50%で同定。全例でi(12p)陽性。Wnt経路活性化が進行に関与することを示唆。
summary_en: Study of beta-catenin expression in postchemotherapy postpubertal-type yolk sac tumors with enteroblastic phenotype (34 cases). Found nuclear beta-catenin in 29% of cases; DNA sequencing identified CTNNB1 variants in 50%. FISH positive for i(12p) in all analyzed cases, suggesting Wnt pathway activation in tumor progression.

title: Cardiopulmonary bypass for anesthetic management anterior medistinal teratoma: Case report.
title_ja: 前縦隔奇形腫の麻酔管理における体外循環：症例報告
summary_ja: 気道閉塞を伴う前縦隔成熟奇形腫の周術期麻酔管理の症例報告。仰臥位で呼吸困難が増悪。体外循環で肺を安全にデフレート、腫瘍切除を促進し血行動態的・呼吸的リスクを軽減。
summary_en: Case report of anesthetic management of 18-year-old woman with large anterior mediastinal mature teratoma causing severe airway obstruction. Patient presented with progressive dyspnea in supine position. Femoro-femoral cardiopulmonary bypass used during resection to safely deflate lungs and facilitate tumor dissection with reduced hemodynamic and respiratory complications.

title: Choriocarcinoma Syndrome: A Rare Complication's Impact on Metastatic Germ Cell Tumor Outcomes.
title_ja: 絨毛癌症候群：転移性胚細胞腫瘍の転帰に対する稀な合併症の影響
summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後に絨毛癌症候群を発症した症例。β-hCG高値、精巣腫瘍、肺転移。化学療法開始後に急速な呼吸機能低下でARDSで死亡。
summary_en: Case report of 37-year-old male with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (elevated β-hCG, testicular mass, pulmonary metastases) who developed choriocarcinoma syndrome after chemotherapy initiation. Experienced rapid respiratory decline resulting in ARDS and death. Highlights importance of early detection and awareness of this rare but serious complication.

title: Large congenital cervical mass in a neonate: prenatal diagnosis and postnatal management of teratoma: a case report.
title_ja: 新生児の大きな先天性頸部腫瘤：奇形腫の出生前診断と出生後管理：症例報告
summary_ja: 女性新生児の大きな先天性頸部未熟奇形腫(10cm×10cm)症例。出生時に気道閉塞による呼吸窮迫を呈し、気管挿管と機械換気が必要だった。出生後17日に外科的切除を施行し、良好な転帰が得られた。
summary_en: Case report of female Persian neonate with large congenital cervical immature teratoma (10 cm × 10 cm) causing airway obstruction. Presented with respiratory distress at birth requiring intubation and mechanical ventilation. Surgical resection on postnatal day 17 resulted in good recovery, demonstrating importance of airway stabilization before definitive surgery.

title: Fetal cardiac teratoma and pericardiocentesis: A case report.
title_ja: 胎児心臓奇形腫と心膜穿刺：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫が心膜液貯留と胎児水腫で発症した症例報告。妊娠31週での心膜穿刺により静脈圧迫が緩解し、水腫が消失した。妊娠継続が可能になり、出生後の外科的腫瘍摘出が実施された。
summary_en: Case report of fetal pericardial teratoma presenting with pericardial effusion and hydrops fetalis. Pericardiocentesis performed at 31 weeks gestational age relieved venous compression, resolved hydrops, and allowed pregnancy continuation to term for definitive postnatal surgical management of the tumor.

title: Diagnostic utility of Magnetic Resonance Imaging in discriminating immature teratoma: Insights from a case series.
title_ja: 未熟奇形腫の鑑別における磁気共鳴画像の診断的有用性：症例集積からの知見
summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫と確認された5症例のMRI所見を分析。腫瘍サイズ増大と散在性脂肪成分が主要な診断指標。包括的なMRI評価の診断と管理における重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case series study of five patients with adnexal masses histopathologically confirmed as immature teratomas. Analyzed magnetic resonance imaging findings on pelvic MRI. Key diagnostic indicators included larger tumor size and scattered fatty components. Underscores importance of comprehensive MRI evaluation in diagnosis and management.

title: Efficacy and safety of high-dose chemotherapy as the first or subsequent salvage treatment line in patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell cancer: an international multicentric analysis.
title_ja: 再発または治療抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍患者における大量化学療法の初回または後続の救援治療としての有効性と安全性：国際多施設分析
summary_ja: 283名の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした多施設研究。再発・治療抵抗性症例に対して、初回救援治療としての大量化学療法は後続治療より優れた成績を示した。2年全生存率は74%対53%であり、治癒の可能性が示唆される。
summary_en: This multicenter analysis evaluates high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation for relapsed or refractory germ cell cancer, comparing first versus subsequent salvage treatment. Among 283 patients, first-line high-dose therapy showed superior outcomes with 74% two-year overall survival versus 53%, demonstrating curative potential despite challenging disease.

title: A Case of Solid-Appearing Struma Ovarii: Pitfall in the Assessment Using Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System Magnetic Resonance Imaging Score.
title_ja: 固形様卵巣甲状腺腫の一症例：卵巣付属器報告データシステム磁気共鳴画像法スコアによる評価の落とし穴
summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫が磁気共鳴画像法で悪性腫瘍に酷似し、卵巣付属器報告データシステムスコア5と判定された症例。ガドリニウム造影後の高い信号強度が良性奇形腫に見られることを示し、卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断における落とし穴を強調している。
summary_en: Case report of solid-appearing struma ovarii (monodermal teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue) that mimicked malignancy on MRI O-RADS scoring. Demonstrates the diagnostic challenge and importance of including benign teratomas in differential diagnosis of ovarian masses with high signal enhancement.

title: Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors in North-Western India: A Comprehensive 3-Year Retrospective Study of 145 Cases at a Tertiary Cancer Hospital.
title_ja: 北西インドの卵巣胚細胞腫瘍:三次癌センターにおける145症例の包括的3年後方視的研究
summary_ja: 北西インドの三次癌センターにおける145例の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的3年後方視的研究。成熟奇形腫が最も多く、21-30歳女性で最高発症。良性症例85.5%;固形腫瘍と10cm以上の腫瘍は悪性傾向が高い。
summary_en: Comprehensive 3-year retrospective study of 145 ovarian germ cell tumors at a tertiary hospital in North-Western India. Mature teratomas were most prevalent, with highest incidence in 21-30-year-old women. Benign cases comprised 85.5%; solid tumors and masses >10cm showed higher malignancy propensity.

title: Malignant Transformation of an Ovarian Mature Cystic Teratoma to a Malignant Melanoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性黒色腫への悪性転化
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（dermoid cyst）から悪性黒色腫への変化を示した56歳女性の症例。破裂した奇形腫から黒色腫への悪性転化は極めて稀な合併症である。
summary_en: Case report of rare malignant transformation of mature ovarian cystic teratoma to melanoma in a 56-year-old woman presenting with ruptured dermoid cyst. Histopathology showed melanin-positive cells positive for Melan-A and HMB-45, confirming melanoma arising from teratoma.

title: FDG PET/CT Findings of Primary Pulmonary Choriocarcinoma in a Postmenopausal Woman.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における原発性肺絨毛癌のFDG PET/CT所見
summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告で、血清β-hCG上昇を伴っていた。FDG PET/CTで原発巣と転移巣の異なるuptakeパターンを示し、稀な肺原発絨毛癌の画像所見を提示している。
summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with intrapulmonary metastases in a postmenopausal woman with elevated serum β-hCG. FDG PET/CT showed intense uptake in primary tumor and variable uptake in metastases, demonstrating imaging characteristics of this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor.

title: Co-existence of Ovarian Teratomas With Other Gynecological Tumors.
title_ja: 他の婦人科腫瘍との卵巣奇形腫の共存
summary_ja: 288人の成熟卵巣奇形腫と9人の未熟奇形腫の女性を対象とした15年後方視的研究。成熟奇形腫は卵巣甲状腺腫との正の相関を示しました;子宮内膜様癌、嚢胞腺腫、他の婦人科病変を含む良性および悪性の共存が記録されました。
summary_en: 15-year retrospective study of 288 women with mature ovarian teratomas and 9 with immature teratomas. Mature teratomas showed positive correlation with struma ovarii; benign and malignant coexistence was documented including endometrioid cancer, cystadenomas, and other gynecological lesions.

title: Anti-NMDA encephalitis secondary to an ovarian teratoma presenting as altered mental status in a 32-year-old woman: A case report.
title_ja: 32歳女性における意識変容として呈示する卵巣奇形腫に続発する抗NMDA脳炎：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に随伴するNMDA受容体脳炎の32歳女性症例。精神症状から始まり精神病と癲癇に進行。腫瘍関連神経症候群としての奇形腫の重要性を示す。
summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis secondary to mature ovarian cystic teratoma in 32-year-old woman presenting with altered mental status progressing to psychosis and epilepsy. Documents diagnostic pathway including CSF findings, imaging of teratoma, and immunological confirmation.

title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with pulmonary embolism mimicking tuberculosis.
title_ja: 結核をまねた肺塞栓症を伴う妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍
summary_ja: 胎盤絨毛膜疾患（完全奇胎、部分奇胎、侵襲性奇胎、絨毛膜癌）が肺塞栓症を伴った3症例の報告。結核として誤認された画像所見も記述されている。
summary_en: Three case reports of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) including hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma presenting with pulmonary embolism and mimicking tuberculosis on imaging. Documents rare but serious thrombotic complications of GTN.

title: Role of pre-operative endovascular embolization of a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in neonate: a case report.
title_ja: 新生児における巨大仙尾部奇形腫の術前血管内塞栓術の役割：症例報告
summary_ja: 新生児の高血管性巨大仙尾部奇形腫に対する術前塞栓術の症例報告。マイクロコイルなどを用いた塞栓により術中出血量を最小化する技術を示した。
summary_en: Case report of preoperative endovascular embolization of highly vascular giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in neonate prior to surgical resection. Demonstrates technique for minimizing intraoperative blood loss from large vascular teratomas using microcoils and embolic agents.

title: Prognostic factors of 87 ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST) patients and molecular characteristics of persistent and recurrent OYST.
title_ja: 87例の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(OYST)患者の予後因子および遷延・再発OYSTの分子的特性
summary_ja: 87例の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(OYST)患者の後方視的研究で、全エクソムシーケンシングにより遷延・再発疾患の予後因子と分子的特性を分析。不良転帰と関連するがんドライバー遺伝子と経路を同定し、免疫チェックポイント療法の可能性を示唆しました。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 87 ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST) patients analyzing prognostic factors and molecular characteristics of persistent/recurrent disease via whole-exome sequencing. Identified cancer driver genes and pathways associated with poor outcomes, suggesting immune checkpoint therapy potential.

title: Perinatal Outcomes of Intrauterine Interventions for Fetal Sacrococcygeal Teratoma Based on Different Surgical Techniques-A Systematic Review.
title_ja: 異なる手術技法に基づいた胎児仙尾部奇形腫に対する子宮内介入の周産期転帰：システマティックレビュー
summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫157例の系統的レビュー。開放的胎児手術、経皮的介入、無治療の予後を比較。生存率は56%、46%、71%で、出産時妊娠週数が予後予測因子であった。
summary_en: Systematic review of 157 fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases comparing outcomes between open fetal surgery, percutaneous intervention, and no intervention. Survival rates were 56%, 46%, and 71% respectively; gestational age at delivery was key predictor of outcome.

title: Serum Levels of MicroRNA-371a-3p for Predicting the Histology of Postchemotherapy Residual Masses of Germ Cell Tumours.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤の組織学的特性を予測するための血清マイクロRNA-371a-3p値
summary_ja: 180人のGCT患者を対象とした前向き診断研究で、血清マイクロRNA-371a-3p(M371)を化学療法後残存腫瘤における生存癌の同定のためのバイオマーカーとして評価。感度69%、特異度99%;奇形腫と体性型悪性腫瘍ではマイクロRNA(miRNA)は検出不可。
summary_en: Prospective diagnostic study of 180 GCT patients evaluating serum microRNA-371a-3p (M371) as biomarker to identify viable cancer in postchemotherapy residual masses. Sensitivity 69% and specificity 99%; M371 undetectable in teratoma and somatic-type malignancy.

title: The Status of Spermatogenesis in Germ Cell Tumor Bearing Testis and Its Association with Metastatic Disease.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を有する精巣における精子形成の状態とその転移性疾患との関連性
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍454例患者(195セミノーマ、259非セミノーマ)の後方視的研究で、腫瘍軸承精巣における精子形成の状態と転移性疾患との関連を分析。障害された精子形成と胎児性癌>50%が進行期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を予測しました。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 454 testicular GCT patients (195 seminomatous, 259 nonseminomatous) analyzing spermatogenesis status in tumor-bearing testis and association with metastatic disease. Impaired spermatogenesis and embryonal carcinoma >50% predicted advanced NSGCT stage.

title: Survival outcomes of postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors: A retrospective cohort study from a single tertiary center in South India.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の生存転帰:インド南部単一三次医療機関からの後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: インド三次医療施設(2003-2022年)で化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた73例のNSGCT患者の後方視的研究。診断時に75%の病期IIIの疾患にもかかわらず、2年再発無病生存率93%と全生存期間(全生存率)90%を達成しました。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 73 NSGCT patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection at Indian tertiary center (2003-2022). Achieved 2-year recurrence-free survival 93% and overall survival 90% despite 75% Stage III disease at diagnosis.

title: Comprehensive microRNA expression analysis of pediatric gonadal germ cell tumors: unveiling novel biomarkers and signatures.
title_ja: 小児性腺胚細胞腫瘍のマイクロRNA発現の包括的解析:新規バイオマーカーとシグネチャーの解明
summary_ja: 42例の小児性腺胚細胞腫瘍標本のマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現解析により、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫の個別のマイクロRNA(miRNA)プロファイルを同定。6つのマイクロRNA(miRNA)(miR-302a-3p、miR-302b-3p、miR-371a-5pなど)が悪性腫瘍で有意な過剰発現を示しました。
summary_en: Comprehensive miRNA expression analysis of 42 pediatric gonadal GCT samples identifying distinct miRNA profiles for dysgerminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and immature teratomas. Six miRNAs (miR-302a-3p, miR-302b-3p, miR-371a-5p, etc.) showed significant overexpression in malignant tumors.

title: Staging and Restaging Pediatric Abdominal and Pelvic Tumors: A Practical Guide.
title_ja: 小児腹部・骨盤腫瘍の病期分類と再病期分類:実践ガイド
summary_ja: 小児腹部悪性腫瘍の病期分類と再病期分類に関する実践的画像ガイド。胚細胞腫瘍を含む一般的な病態を対象。神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、リンパ腫、胚細胞腫瘍、横紋筋肉腫の特徴的な画像パターン、予後指標、治療反応評価をレビューしました。
summary_en: Practical imaging guide for staging and restaging common pediatric abdominal malignancies including germ cell tumors. Reviews distinctive imaging patterns, prognostic indicators, and response assessment for neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor, hepatoblastoma, lymphoma, GCT, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

title: Successful laparoscopic resection for giant mature cystic teratoma of the pancreas: a case report and surgical refinements.
title_ja: 膵臓の巨大成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡下切除術の成功:症例報告および手術技術改善
summary_ja: 39歳女性の膵尾部の18cm成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)が腹腔鏡下遠位膵切除術により正常に切除された症例報告。大きな奇形腫に対する手術技術を示し、悪性腫瘍を示唆するMRI所見にもかかわらず良性病理を確認しました。
summary_en: Case report of 18-cm mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of pancreatic tail in 39-year-old woman successfully resected via laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy. Demonstrates surgical technique for large teratomas and confirms benign pathology despite MRI findings suggesting malignancy.

title: Clinical Manifestations of Malignant Struma Ovarii: A Retrospective Case Series in a Tertiary Hospital in Korea.
title_ja: 韓国の三次医療機関における悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の臨床的特徴:後方視的症例集積研究
summary_ja: 良性卵巣甲状腺腫170人中15人の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫患者の後方視的症例集積。乳頭状甲状腺癌(47%)と濾胞性甲状腺癌(27%)が最も一般的であり、全例が術後に診断されました。可変的な手術範囲と一貫性を欠く内分泌フォローアップが記録されました。
summary_en: Retrospective case series of 15 malignant struma ovarii patients among 170 with benign struma ovarii. Papillary thyroid carcinoma (47%) and follicular thyroid carcinoma (27%) most common; all diagnosed post-operatively. Variable surgical extent and inconsistent endocrine follow-up documented.

title: A Case of Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor Complicated by Tumor Thrombus in an Active Duty Soldier.
title_ja: 腫瘍栓を合併した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を呈した現役軍人の症例報告
summary_ja: 21歳の現役軍人が病期IIIB精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を診断され、左下肢腫脹を呈した下大静脈と腸骨静脈の広範な腫瘍栓で発症。血管内血栓摘出術と病理診断確認後、標準的な化学療法で治療継続。
summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old active duty soldier with Stage IIIB nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor presenting with extensive inferior vena cava and iliac vein tumor thrombus. Underwent endovascular thrombectomy with pathologic confirmation of malignant cells; continued standard chemotherapy successfully.

title: Fungal metabolite altersolanol a exhibits potent cytotoxicity against human placental trophoblasts in vitro via mitochondria-mediated apoptosis.
title_ja: 真菌代謝産物altersolanol Aはミトコンドリア介在性アポトーシスを介してヒト胎盤栄養膜細胞に対する強い細胞毒性を示す
summary_ja: 真菌由来代謝産物アルテルソラノールAのヒト栄養膜細胞（絨毛がん細胞株JEG-3及び正常栄養膜）への細胞毒性効果を調査。絨毛がん細胞は正常栄養膜より感受性が高く、ミトコンドリア媒介アポトーシスとMAPKシグナル経路阻害を示す。栄養膜悪性腫瘍への治療応用の可能性を示唆。
summary_en: Investigates cytotoxic effects of fungal metabolite altersolanol A on human placental trophoblasts including choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3. Choriocarcinoma cells more sensitive than normal trophoblasts. Demonstrates mitochondrial-mediated apoptosis, MAPK pathway inhibition, and suppression of migration/invasion. Suggests potential reproductive toxicity and therapeutic applications against trophoblastic malignancies.

title: Mediastinal Mature Cystic Teratoma With Intrapulmonary Extension Mimicking a Hydatid Cyst: Advantages of MRI in Diagnostics.
title_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の肺内進展：MRIの診断における利点
summary_ja: 37歳男性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例報告。左側肺葉への進展を伴い、CT/MRI画像検査により包虫嚢胞との鑑別が確立された。生命を脅かす合併症予防のため外科的切除を実施。多面的画像診断による嚢胞性縦隔病変の鑑別に関する有用性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of mediastinal mature cystic teratoma with intrapulmonary extension in 37-year-old male presenting with left chest pain. CT and MRI confirmed teratoma diagnosis rather than hydatid cyst. Surgical removal performed to prevent life-threatening complications. Demonstrates advantages of multimodal imaging in differentiating teratomas from other cystic mediastinal lesions.

title: Primitive Embryonic-Type Neuroectodermal/Glandular Complexes in Testicular Germ Cell Tumors: A Mimic of Embryonic-Type Neuroectodermal Tumor.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における原始胚仔型神経外胚葉/腺複合体：胚仔型神経外胚葉腫瘍の模倣
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における胚仔型神経外胚葉/腺複合体34例を検討し免疫表型を特徴付け。免疫組織化学パネル（シナプトフィジン、GFAP、ビリン、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)）で両要素を区別。胚仔型神経外胚葉腫瘍への誤診を防ぎ、臨床管理を改善。
summary_en: Comprehensive pathological study of 34 testicular germ cell tumors with embryonic-type neuroectodermal/glandular complexes. Distinguishes embryonic neuroectodermal from primitive yolk sac tumor-like glandular elements using immunohistochemistry. Synaptophysin, GFAP, villin, and AFP comprise optimal panel to prevent misdiagnosis of embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor and guide appropriate clinical management.

title: Paraneoplastic Hyperthyroidism in Advanced Testicular Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumors: Prevalence and Clinical Management.
title_ja: 進行性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症：有病率および臨床管理
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症の臨床分析。438人の患者を分析し、全体で0.7%で確認、極めて高いβ-hCGレベルの患者では60%。全患者が進行性転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍。シスプラチン併用化学療法と甲状腺機能抑制薬治療により正常化。
summary_en: Clinical analysis of paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Study of 438 patients identified hyperthyroidism in 0.7% overall, but 60% in those with extremely elevated beta-hCG levels. All affected patients had advanced, metastasized non-seminomatous GCTs. Thyroid function rapidly normalized with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and thyrostatic treatment, emphasizing need for TSH/fT3 monitoring in poor-prognosis GCTs.

title: Metastatic germ cell tumors in serous cavities and cerebrospinal fluid: A single-center experience.
title_ja: 体腔液および脳脊髄液における転移性胚細胞腫瘍：単一施設の経験
summary_ja: 27例の転移性胚細胞腫瘍が体腔液および脳脊髄液に関与。原発部位：精巣（10）、卵巣（7）、縦隔（4）、後腹膜（3）。組織型は混合胚細胞腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌。89%が他の転移部位を有する、48%死亡率、中央生存期間4ヶ月。
summary_en: Case series of 27 metastatic germ cell tumors in serous cavity effusions and cerebrospinal fluid. Primary sites: testis (10), ovary (7), mediastinum (4), retroperitoneum (3), pineal (2), sacrococcyx (1). Histologies included mixed GCTs with seminoma, immature teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and embryonal carcinomas. Subtyping performed using cytomorphology and immunohistochemistry; 89% had additional metastatic sites, 48% mortality with 4-month median survival.

title: Primary Mediastinal Dysgerminoma: A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 原発性縦隔ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 26歳患者における原発性縦隔ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。セミノーマの女性相当体で、稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を代表。前上縦隔腫瘤が縦隔の重要構造を覆っている。
summary_en: Case report of primary mediastinal dysgerminoma in 26-year-old patient. Dysgerminoma is the female equivalent of seminoma and represents a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Large anterosuperior mediastinal mass encasing vital mediastinal structures. Typical presentation of mediastinal seminomatous GCTs with slow growth pattern, often discovered incidentally. Discusses management of this rare extragonadal GCT location.

title: Mature cystic teratoma with co-existent mucinous cystadenocarcinoma: describing a diagnostic challenge-a case report.
title_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と共存する粘液性嚢胞腺癌：診断的課題の記述-症例報告
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が粘液性嚢胞腺癌と共存する卵巣腫瘍の症例。33歳女性における診断の課題で、衝突腫瘍か悪性転化の鑑別が必要。免疫組織化学分析（CK7-/CK20+）から良性奇形腫の腺癌化を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma coexisting with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma in ovary of 33-year-old woman. Diagnostic challenge distinguishing collision tumor from malignant transformation of benign teratoma. Immunohistochemical analysis (CK7-/CK20+) suggested adenocarcinomatous transformation. Emphasizes importance of thorough sampling, histopathological examination, and immunohistochemistry in diagnosing uncommon ovarian tumors.

title: Nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with bilateral teratoma: A rare case report and literature review.
title_ja: 非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌と両側成熟奇形腫:稀な症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 28歳未婚女性の非妊娠関連卵巣絨毛がん(NGCO)と両側成熟奇形腫の極めて稀な症例報告。hCG上昇により初期診断は異所性妊娠。IFIGO I期疾患で温存手術とBEP化学療法で治療。月経回復し36ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。若い女性の異常膣出血では NGCO考慮の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma (NGCO) with bilateral mature teratomas in 28-year-old unmarried woman with regular menstruation. Initially misdiagnosed as ectopic pregnancy due to elevated hCG. IFIGO stage IA disease treated with fertility-preserving surgery and BEP chemotherapy. Demonstrates importance of considering NGCO in young women with abnormal bleeding and adnexal masses, with 36-month disease-free follow-up.

title: Primary Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Clinical Stage II A/B Seminomas: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
title_ja: 臨床病期IIA/Bセミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清：システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bセミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清のシステマティックレビュー・メタ解析。7研究、331人の男性を分析。2年無再発生存率は81%で再発率17.69%。合併症率9.16%、逆行性射精7.01%。従来の化学療法・放射線療法の毒性を考慮すると、実行可能な代替治療選択肢。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for stage IIA/B seminomas. Analysis of 7 studies comprising 331 male patients. 2-year recurrence-free survival rate was 81% with 17.69% recurrence rate. Complication rate 9.16%, retrograde ejaculation 7.01%. Demonstrates RPLND as viable alternative to chemotherapy/radiation with favorable long-term outcomes, particularly relevant given toxicities of conventional treatments in young males.

title: Extragonadal germ cell tumors: A clinicopathologic study with emphasis on molecular features, clinical outcomes and associated secondary malignancies.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：分子的特徴、臨床転帰および関連する二次悪性腫瘍に焦点を当てた臨床病理学的研究
summary_ja: 77例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病理学的研究。分子特徴と染色体異常を分析：12p等腕染色体（26%）、21番染色体獲得（37%）。主部位：前縦隔、中枢神経系、後腹膜、仙骨尾骨、頚部。8%に体細胞型悪性腫瘍。縦隔セミノーマは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍より良好な生存率。
summary_en: Large clinicopathologic study of 77 extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGCTs) analyzing molecular features and chromosomal abnormalities including 12p isochromosome (26%) and chromosome 21 gain (37%). Primary sites: anterior mediastinum, CNS, retroperitoneum, sacrococcygeal, neck. Somatic-type malignancies identified in 8%. Mediastinal seminomas had better survival than non-seminomatous EGCTs, with outcomes varying by anatomic site.

title: Choriocarcinoma metastatic to both kidneys presenting with spontaneous renal hemorrhage: Case report.
title_ja: 両腎への転移性絨毛癌が自発的腎出血で発症した症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の両側腎転移が自発的腎出血で発症した症例。胞状奇胎の既往を有する22歳の女性が急性側腹部痛で来院。初期診断は腎細胞癌でしたが、病理組織学的検査で絨毛癌が確認された。多剤併用化学療法により1年後にβ-hCGが検出不可能に。
summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma with bilateral renal metastasis presenting with spontaneous renal hemorrhage. 22-year-old female with history of molar pregnancy (confirmed by biopsy) presented with acute flank pain. Initially suspected renal cell carcinoma but pathology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Multi-agent chemotherapy achieved undetectable beta-hCG after 1 year. Emphasizes importance of considering choriocarcinoma in young women with recent pregnancy loss.

title: Competing risk nomogram predicting cause-specific mortality in older patients with testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 高齢患者における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原因特異的死亡率を予測する競合リスク・ノモグラム
summary_ja: 高齢患者（≥50歳）における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原因特異的死亡率を予測する競合リスク・ノモグラム。2004～2015年に診断された2,751人の高齢患者のSEER分析。3年、5年、10年の原因特異的死亡発生率はそれぞれ4.4%、5.0%、6.1%。ノモグラムは良好な識別能（C-index>0.8）を示し、AJCC病期分類よりも臨床的意義が高い。
summary_en: Competing risk nomogram predicting cause-specific mortality in older testicular germ cell tumor patients (≥50 years). SEER database analysis of 2,751 older TGCT patients diagnosed 2004-2015. 3-, 5-, and 10-year cause-specific death incidences were 4.4%, 5.0%, 6.1%. Predictors included age, marital status, income, histology, tumor size, stage, and surgery. Nomogram showed good discrimination (C-index >0.8) with superior clinical significance compared to AJCC staging.

title: Clinical characteristics and survival outcomes of elderly patients with de novo metastatic germ cell tumors.
title_ja: デノボ転移性胚細胞腫瘍高齢患者の臨床特性と生存転帰
summary_ja: デノボ転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者150人の後方視的研究：<40、40-49、≥50歳の年齢グループ。年齢グループ間で生存転帰に有意差がなく、高齢患者でも標準化学療法遵守率が同等。50歳以上で発熱好中球減少症が有意に高い。適切な有害事象管理があれば高齢患者も同等の転帰を達成可能。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 150 patients with de novo metastatic germ cell tumors stratified by age: <40, 40-49, and ≥50 years. No significant survival differences between age groups despite elderly patients tending to receive less-intense chemotherapy. Febrile neutropenia significantly higher in patients ≥50 years. Standard first-line chemotherapy adherence rates comparable across ages, suggesting elderly patients can achieve equivalent outcomes with appropriate adverse event management.

title: NANOG controls testicular germ cell tumour stemness through regulation of MIR9-2.
title_ja: NANOGはMIR9-2の調節を通じて精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹性を制御する
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるNANOG調節マイクロRNA(miRNA)を同定する研究で、MIR9-2-5pは腫瘍抑制因子として機能。ゲイン機能実験は胎児性癌およびセミノーマ細胞における増殖、侵襲、および幹性低下を示す。NANOG負フィードバック調節を通じた治療可能性を示唆。
summary_en: Study identifies NANOG-regulated microRNAs in testicular GCTs, focusing on MIR9-2-5p as a tumor suppressor. Gain-of-function experiments show MIR9-2-5p reduces proliferation, invasion, and stemness in embryonal carcinoma and seminoma cells, suggesting therapeutic potential through NANOG feedback regulation.
