title: Complex treatment of residual metastatic germ cell cancer: A single center experience.
title_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍残存腫瘍の複雑な治療：単一施設の経験
summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた127人患者の後方視的研究。標準BEP治療は最適な転帰を示した; 残存病理は生きている疾患（20.5%）、奇形腫（52.7%）、および壊死（26.8%）を含んだ。高容量センターでのケアの重要性と受け入れ可能な合併症率を強調。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 127 patients undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND for testicular and extragonadal GCTs. Standard BEP regimen showed optimal outcomes; residual pathology included viable disease (20.5%), teratoma (52.7%), and necrosis (26.8%). Emphasizes importance of high-volume center care with acceptable complication rates.

title: A case of testicular cancer in a long-term hydranencephaly survivor with undescended testes.
title_ja: 停留精巣を有する水無脳症長期生存者における精巣がんの症例
summary_ja: 停留精巣を有する水無脳症長期生存者における精巣がんの最初の報告症例。混合型胚細胞腫瘍が外科的切除された。重度の脳性麻痺を有する成人のがん管理の決定における課題と臨床倫理相談の価値を強調。
summary_en: First reported case of testicular cancer in a long-term hydranencephaly survivor with cryptorchidism. Mixed-type GCT was surgically resected. Highlights challenges in cancer management decisions for adults with severe cerebral palsy and the potential value of clinical ethics consultation.

title: Navigating an unexpected diagnosis - experience of a tertiary referral centre with two cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: 予期しない診断への対応 - 胎盤内絨毛癌2症例を経験した三次紹介施設
summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の稀な2症例報告。偶発的発見から臨床的疾患まで多様な臨床像を呈示。母体および新生児転移なく、保存的管理でβ-hCG低下。詳細な胎盤検査の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case series of two rare intraplacental choriocarcinoma cases with varied presentations, ranging from incidental lesion to clinical disease. No maternal or neonatal metastasis found; conservative management with declining serum β-hCG levels. Emphasizes importance of detailed placental examination.

title: Potential diagnostic challenges of intracerebral hemorrhage as an index presentation of metastatic choriocarcinoma: A case series.
title_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の初期提示としての脳内出血の潜在的な診断的課題:症例集積
summary_ja: 脳内出血で発症した転移性絨毛癌の若年女性3症例報告。臨床像の多様性が診断を複雑化。特に限られた医療資源下ではβ-hCG測定と高い臨床的疑いが妊娠性栄養膜疾患診断に必須。
summary_en: Case series of three young females with metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage. Varied clinical presentations complicated diagnosis. Emphasizes importance of high clinical suspicion and serum β-hCG testing in resource-limited settings for identifying gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

title: Asymptomatic mature intrapericardial teratoma in an adult: a case report of a rare condition.
title_ja: 成人における無症状成熟心膜内奇形腫：稀な状態の症例報告
summary_ja: 52歳成人における無症状成熟心膜内奇形腫の稀な症例。ほとんどの心膜内奇形腫は乳幼児に発生; 成人症例は全体の1%未満。完全外科的切除後5年でフォローアップで再発なし。悪性転化と心臓合併症の予防における外科的切除の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Rare case of asymptomatic mature intrapericardial teratoma in 52-year-old adult. Most intrapericardial teratomas occur in infancy; adult cases represent <1% of cases. Complete resection performed without recurrence at 5-year follow-up. Highlights importance of excision to prevent malignant transformation and cardiac complications.

title: A Machine Learning Model to Predict the Histology of Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection Specimens.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清検体の組織学を予測するための機械学習モデル
summary_ja: CT画像と臨床変数を用いた機械学習モデルで化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節廓清標本の奇形腫対壊死を予測。ResNet50は診断精度80%、感度67.3%、特異度90.5%を達成。治療方針決定に有用。
summary_en: Machine learning model using CT imaging and clinical variables to predict residual teratoma versus necrosis in post-chemotherapy RPLND specimens. ResNet50 achieved 80% diagnostic accuracy (sensitivity 67.3%, specificity 90.5%, AUC 0.84). Helps identify patients requiring surgery versus observation.

title: Testicular Cancer Treatments and Sexuality: A Narrative Review.
title_ja: 精巣がんの治療と性機能:ナラティブレビュー
summary_ja: テスト性がんの治療と性機能障害に関する総説。手術、化学療法、放射線療法、後腹膜廓清による勃起障害、射精障害、不妊、ホルモン変化を記述。若年患者の生活の質向上の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Narrative review of testicular cancer treatments and sexual outcomes. Addresses erectile dysfunction, ejaculatory disorders, fertility issues, and hormonal changes associated with surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and RPLND. Emphasizes need for balanced approach between oncological control and quality of life in young male patients.

title: Ovarian Causes of Pseudomyxoma Peritonei (PMP)-A Literature Review.
title_ja: 腹膜偽粘液腫（PMP）の卵巣原因：文献レビュー
summary_ja: 腹膜偽粘液腫の卵巣原因の文献レビュー。粘液性嚢胞腺腫、卵巣癌、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を含む7つの主要な状況が同定された。疾患の疫学、画像検査、症状および治療について記述。診断遅延のリスクと管理の必要性を強調している。
summary_en: Literature review of ovarian causes of pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP). Seven main scenarios identified including mucinous cystadenoma, ovarian cancer, and malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma. Addresses epidemiology, imaging, symptoms, and treatment of rare mucus-secreting malignancy.

title: Dermoid cyst management and outcomes: a review of over 1000 cases at a single institution.
title_ja: 類皮嚢腫の管理と転帰：単一施設における1000例以上のレビュー
summary_ja: 1,054例の卵巣奇形腫の後方視的研究。平均年齢38歳、平均嚢腫サイズ6.26 cm。捻転率5.6%、悪性転化1.1%、両側性10.7%。腹腔鏡アプローチが70%以上で使用され、低い合併症率と関連していたが、嚢腫漏出リスク増加。嚢腫漏出は腹膜炎を稀に引き起こした。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 1,054 ovarian teratoma cases. Mean age 38 years, average cyst size 6.26 cm. Torsion rate 5.6%, malignant transformation 1.1%, bilateral involvement 10.7%. Laparoscopic approach used in >70%, associated with lower complications but increased spillage risk. Cyst spillage rarely caused peritonitis.

title: Laparoscopic transabdominal-sacrococcygeal approach for resection of Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma in adult women: A case report.
title_ja: 成人女性のAltman III型仙尾部奇形腫切除術に対する腹腔鏡下経腹-仙尾部アプローチ:症例報告
summary_ja: 成人Altman III型仙骨尾骨奇形腫の腹腔鏡下経腹会陰式切除の症例。31歳女性、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。腟超音波、CT、MRIによる診断有用性と腹腔鏡手術の安全性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of adult Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma treated with laparoscopic transabdominal-sacrococcygeal resection. 31-year-old woman with mature cystic teratoma. Demonstrates diagnostic utility of imaging (ultrasound, CT, MRI) and laparoscopic surgical approach safety for adult SCT management.

title: Stimulus-Induced Activation of the Glycoprotein Hormone α-Subunit Promoter in Human Placental Choriocarcinoma Cells: Major Role of a tandem cAMP Response Element.
title_ja: ヒト胎盤絨毛癌細胞における糖蛋白ホルモンα-サブユニットプロモーターの刺激誘発活性化:タンデムcAMP応答配列の主要な役割
summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞（栄養膜モデル）におけるグリコプロテインホルモンα-サブユニット遺伝子発現制御の研究。cAMP、カルシウム、p38シグナルによる刺激誘導的活性化を検討。複数のシグナル経路の収束点として機能。
summary_en: Study of glycoprotein hormone α-subunit gene expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells (trophoblast model). Examines stimulus-induced activation via cAMP, Ca2+, and p38 signaling pathways. Tandem cAMP response element acts as convergence point for multiple signaling. Relevant to understanding choriocarcinoma biology.

title: Prenatal Diagnosis of Oral Teratoma by Ultrasound.
title_ja: 超音波による口腔奇形腫の出生前診断
summary_ja: 多羊水を伴う出生前超音波診断された口腔奇形腫（未熟）。50×36×42mm、口腔全体に充満し下咽頭圧迫。33週での早産。気管挿管失敗で新生児死亡。病理学的に口腔未熟奇形腫を確認。
summary_en: Prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of fetal oral teratoma (immature) presenting with polyhydramnios. 50×36×42 mm solid mass filling entire oral cavity with hypopharyngeal compression. Preterm delivery at 33 weeks due to increased amniotic fluid. Neonatal death after failed intubation. Pathology confirmed oral immature teratoma.

title: Evaluation and Management of Testicular Cancer After Late Relapse.
title_ja: 精巣がんの遅延再発後の評価と管理
summary_ja: テスト性非セミノーマ性細胞腫瘍（胚細胞癌95%、卵黄嚢腫瘍5%）の11年後の晩期再発症例。非典型的な対側後腹膜再発。細胞診で28個中12個のリンパ節に胚細胞癌。SALL4、CD30陽性。
summary_en: Case report of 41-year-old with late relapse of testicular NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor) after 11 years of remission. Atypical contralateral retroperitoneal recurrence. Fine needle aspiration showed embryonal carcinoma in 12/28 lymph nodes. Immunostaining positive for SALL4 and CD30.

title: Long-term quality of life of testicular cancer survivors differs according to applied adjuvant treatment and tumour type.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者の長期生活の質は適用された補助治療と腫瘍型によって異なる
summary_ja: テスト性がん長期生存者625例の生活の質評価（中央追跡26.2年）。放射線療法と化学療法はRPLND比較で生活の質が低下。非セミノーマ生存者はセミノーマより生活の質が良好（性的関心除く）。治療選択は長期転帰に重要。
summary_en: Long-term quality of life assessment in testicular cancer survivors (n=625, median follow-up 26.2 years). RT and CT showed greater QoL impairment compared to RPLND. NSGCT survivors reported lower QoL impairment than seminoma survivors, except for sexual concerns. Treatment type significantly impacts long-term outcomes.

title: T cells in testicular germ cell tumors: new evidence of fundamental contributions by rare subsets.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるT細胞:希少サブセットによる基本的貢献の新知見
summary_ja: テスト性性細胞腫瘍と上皮内性細胞新生物の免疫細胞組成の研究。正常精巣のマクロファージからTGCTのT細胞、B細胞、樹状細胞への変化。Treg、Tfhはセミノーマで最も豊富。免疫療法の標的候補を示唆。
summary_en: Study of immune cell composition in testicular GCTs and GCNIS using immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, and scRNA-seq. Profound shift from macrophages in normal testes to T cells, B cells, and dendritic cells in TGCT. Treg and Tfh cells most abundant in seminomas. Novel findings suggest role in TGCT pathobiology and immunotherapy targets.

title: Congenital Gastric Teratoma Presenting with Gastrointestinal Bleeding: Case Report and Review of Literature.
title_ja: 消化管出血で発症する先天性胃奇形腫:症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 3ヶ月男児の反復性上部消化管出血症例報告。胃奇形腫は小児奇形腫全体の1%未満という極めて稀な腫瘍で、術前診断が困難である。
summary_en: A 3-month-old boy with recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding was found to have a gastric teratoma. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of this extremely rare pediatric tumor, representing less than 1% of all pediatric teratomas and typically presenting as a palpable abdominal mass.

title: Yolk Sac Tumor of the Ovary in Mosaic 46XX Turner Syndrome.
title_ja: モザイク46XX ターナー症候群における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍
summary_ja: 46XXモザイク型ターナー症候群患者の左卵巣に発生した大きな卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。Y染色体物質を有さないTS患者における胚細胞腫瘍の発生を強調し、GCT発症の理解を拡大する。
summary_en: A 23-year-old with mosaic 46XX Turner syndrome presented with a large left ovarian yolk sac tumor. This rare case highlights the occurrence of germ cell tumors in TS patients without Y chromosome material, expanding understanding of GCT pathogenesis.

title: Testicular seminoma presenting as a large conglomerate mass in abdomen.
title_ja: 腹部の大きな集塊塊として発症する精巣セミノーマ
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの腹部転移症例。術後のサーベイランスの重要性と、進行期精巣がんの管理における化学療法の役割を示した症例報告である。
summary_en: A 45-year-old with prior testicular seminoma presented with abdominal metastasis. This case emphasizes the importance of post-orchiectomy surveillance and demonstrates how advanced seminoma can present with large conglomerate masses requiring combination chemotherapy.

title: Utilization of sperm cryopreservation in patients with testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者における精子凍結保存の利用
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における精子凍結保存の利用率についての研究。年齢や教育水準が利用決定に影響を与え、術後の生殖機能維持と妊孕性に関する重要な知見が得られた。
summary_en: Study examining sperm cryopreservation utilization in 279 testicular cancer survivors over 5.7 years. Younger age and higher education were associated with cryopreservation use; minimal unmet desires for biological children reported post-treatment.

title: Micro-RNA-371a-3p in Germ Cell Testicular Tumors on Diagnosis: A Prospective Case-Control Study in Turkish Population.
title_ja: 診断時の精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるマイクロRNA-371a-3p:トルコ人集団での前向き症例対照研究
summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるmiR-371a-3pの診断精度を検討した前向き研究。感度98.3%、特異度95%で従来のマーカーを上回る診断精度を示し、腫瘍の臨床病期や大きさと相関した。
summary_en: Prospective study evaluated miR-371a-3p as a diagnostic biomarker for testicular GCTs in Turkish population. Marker demonstrated 98.3% sensitivity and 95% specificity (AUC=0.997), outperforming traditional markers AFP and bHCG.

title: Fertility-sparing approach in concurrent gliomatosis peritonei and growing teratoma syndrome in a young woman.
title_ja: 若い女性における腹膜神経膠腫症とgrowing teratoma syndromeの同時発症に対する妊孕性温存アプローチ
summary_ja: 若い女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫に対する化学療法後に、腹膜神経膠腫症とgrowing teratoma syndromeが同時発症した症例報告。早期外科的介入と妊孕性温存が極めて重要であり、双方の同時発症は文献では稀である。
summary_en: Case report of concurrent gliomatosis peritonei and growing teratoma syndrome in a young woman with immature ovarian teratoma post-chemotherapy. Early surgical intervention and fertility preservation were crucial; dual occurrence is scarcely reported in literature.

title: Extensive surgical resections for rare pleural neoplasms: a single-center experience with a yolk sac tumor and synovial sarcoma.
title_ja: 稀な胸膜新生物に対する広範な外科的切除:卵黄嚢腫瘍と滑膜肉腫
summary_ja: 胸膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。化学療法と拡大胸膜切除術、高温胸腔内化学療法の組み合わせ治療で完全切除を達成した稀な臨床例である。
summary_en: Case series describing surgical management of rare primary pleural neoplasms including a yolk sac tumor. The yolk sac tumor case involved neoadjuvant chemotherapy, extended pleurectomy, and hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy with complete resection and no recurrence.

title: Familial syndromes associated with testicular and paratesticular neoplasms: a comprehensive review.
title_ja: 精巣および傍精巣腫瘍に関連する家族性症候群:包括的レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣・精巣傍腫瘍と遺伝性症候群の関連性に関する総説。セミノーマを含む複数の腫瘍型と家族性症候群の確立した関連性と新知見について述べられている。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of syndromic associations with testicular and paratesticular neoplasms including GCTs. Covers established associations (Carney complex, Peutz-Jeghers, VHL) and discusses emerging potential links with seminomas and other testicular tumors.

title: A case report of malignant struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma.
title_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 乳頭がんに変性した卵巣ストルマ（特殊化した卵巣奇形腫）の症例。甲状腺成分から悪性腫瘍への変性と、その管理について述べられている。
summary_en: Case report of struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma primarily composed of thyroid tissue, with malignant transformation to papillary thyroid carcinoma in a 64-year-old woman. Discusses evaluation and management of this rare malignant-potential condition.

title: Extragonadal Germ Cell Tumor with Hepatic Infiltration in a Child: Aberrant Somatostatin Receptors and the Diagnostic Conundrum.
title_ja: 小児の肝浸潤を伴う性腺外胚細胞腫瘍:異常ソマトスタチン受容体と診断の難題
summary_ja: 肝臓浸潤を伴う小児傍精巣外GCTの症例報告。神経芽腫と肝芽腫との鑑別診断が課題であり、細胞診と免疫組織化学で確定診断された。
summary_en: Case report of a suprarenal extragonadal germ cell tumor with hepatic infiltration in a pediatric patient. Differential diagnosis included neuroblastoma and hepatoblastoma; diagnosis confirmed by fine-needle aspiration cytology and immunohistochemistry.

title: Two rare cases of benign struma ovarii with malignant recurrence.
title_ja: 悪性再発を伴う稀な2症例の良性卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 初期診断から数年後に悪性転化を示した良性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化は極めて稀（<5%）。37歳女性は14年後、26歳女性は6年後に診断。複数転移病巣を有する患者は放射性ヨウ素療法で治療。長期監視の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Two cases of benign struma ovarii that underwent malignant transformation to highly differentiated follicular carcinoma years after initial diagnosis. Emphasizes rarity of malignant transformation (<5%) and importance of long-term surveillance and radioactive iodine therapy.

title: Advancing GCT Management: A Review of miR-371a-3p and Other miRNAs in Comparison to Traditional Serum Tumor Markers.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍管理の進歩:従来の血清腫瘍マーカーとの比較によるmiR-371a-3pおよび他のマイクロRNAのレビュー
summary_ja: GCTにおけるマイクロRNAバイオマーカー（特にmiR-371a-3p）の診断・管理上の役割についての総説。従来のマーカーより診断精度が優れており、治療強度調整と再発検出に有用である。
summary_en: Review of circulating microRNAs, particularly miR-371a-3p, as blood-based biomarkers for germ cell tumor diagnosis and management. microRNAs demonstrate superior diagnostic accuracy compared to AFP, bHCG, and LDH, with potential for treatment guidance.

title: A comprehensive analysis of the KLRB1 expression and its clinical implication in testicular germ cell tumors: A review.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるKLRB1発現の包括的解析とその臨床的意義:レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるKLRB1遺伝子発現と免疫浸潤の関連性についての総説。免疫細胞の浸潤と相関し、新しい予測因子および治療標的となる可能性が指摘されている。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of KLRB1 gene expression in testicular germ cell tumors using TCGA and GTEx datasets. KLRB1 is upregulated in malignant tissues and correlates with immune infiltration and inflammatory response, suggesting potential as biomarker and therapeutic target.

title: Occupational exposure to organic solvents and the risk of developing testicular germ cell tumors (TESTIS study): Effect of combined exposure assessment on risk estimation.
title_ja: 職業的有機溶剤曝露と精巣胚細胞腫瘍発症リスク(TESTIS研究):複合曝露評価が危険度推定に及ぼす影響
summary_ja: 職業的有機溶剤曝露と精巣GCTリスクの関連性を検討した症例対照研究。トリクロロエチレンと精巣GCTの関連が確認され、職業曝露がGCT発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
summary_en: French case-control study of 454 testicular GCT cases and 670 controls examining occupational solvent exposure. Results showed consistent associations between trichloroethylene, ketone esters, and petroleum solvents with TGCT, suggesting occupational factors in GCT pathogenesis.

title: Management of ruptured ovarian teratoma mimicking advanced ovarian cancer.
title_ja: 進行卵巣癌を模倣する破裂卵巣奇形腫の管理
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の破裂による化学腹膜炎は婦人科悪性腫瘍を模倣する。早期手術介入で合併症防止可能。婦人科腫瘍医の関与が推奨される。
summary_en: Rupture of mature cystic ovarian teratoma can cause chronic chemical peritonitis mimicking gynecologic malignancy. Case discusses diagnostic challenges, morbidity from delayed intervention, and importance of gynecologic oncology involvement in management of complex benign ovarian pathology.

title: (18)F-DGPET/CT Imaging of Ovarian Yolk Sac Tumor in a Woman after Induction of Labor: A Case Report.
title_ja: 分娩誘発後の女性における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の(18)F-FDG PET/CT画像：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFPおよびCA-125上昇を認め、PET/CTで著明なFDG取り込みを示した。化学療法後に完全な代謝反応を達成。
summary_en: Case report of ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST) in 19-year-old woman with elevated serum AFP and CA-125. PET/CT imaging showed intense FDG uptake in solid component. Patient achieved complete metabolic response after chemotherapy, demonstrating utility of PET/CT in diagnosis and treatment monitoring of OYST.

title: Risk factors for methotrexate resistance in low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients (FIGO score 0-4).
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者（FIGO score 0-4）におけるメトトレキサート耐性の危険因子
summary_ja: 低リスクGTN患者310例のメトトレキサート療法検討。後流産絨毛癌と高い前治療hCG濃度が抵抗性の独立危険因子。意思決定木モデルで予測精度向上。
summary_en: Study of 310 low-risk GTN patients receiving methotrexate chemotherapy. Postmolar choriocarcinoma and elevated pretreatment hCG were independent risk factors for MTX resistance (35.5% resistant). Decision tree model developed to predict MTX resistance risk and guide clinical treatment decisions.

title: Choriocarcinoma That Had Transferred to the Right Inferior Pulmonary Vein and Left Atrium: A Case Report.
title_ja: 右下肺静脈および左心房に転移した絨毛癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 肺転移なく心臓（左房）に転移した絨毛癌の稀な症例。β-hCG上昇、心エコーで診断。左房腫瘍切除後、EP・EMACO化学療法で良好結果。
summary_en: Rare case of choriocarcinoma with metastasis to left atrium and pulmonary vein without lung involvement. Patient presented with cough and hemoptysis. Elevated β-hCG and cardiac imaging aided diagnosis. Surgical resection followed by chemotherapy (EP and EMACO regimens) achieved satisfactory outcomes.

title: Development of immature ovarian teratoma after mature teratoma in a girl with familial ovarian teratoma: A case report.
title_ja: 家族性卵巣奇形腫を有する少女における成熟奇形腫後の未熟卵巣奇形腫の発生：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の家族歴（母親、叔母、祖母）を有する16歳女児が、3年前の両側成熟奇形腫に対する卵巣囊胞切除術後に1級未熟卵巣奇形腫を発症。腹腔鏡下両側輸卵管卵巣摘出術および病期分類手術が実施された。家族性卵巣奇形腫患者の長期管理の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of 16-year-old girl with family history of ovarian teratomas (mother, aunt, grandmother) who developed grade-1 immature teratoma 3 years after bilateral mature teratoma resection. Underwent repeat bilateral oophorectomy with staging. Highlights importance of management guidance for familial ovarian teratomas.

title: Current outstanding challenges in germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における現在の顕著な課題
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍管理における現在の課題のレビュー。不良リスク疾患治療、脳転移患者の多学科的管理、プラチナ耐性疾患への対応が必要。腫瘍マーカー(αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG))に加えて最小残存疾患と奇形腫検出のための新規バイオマーカー開発が重要。
summary_en: Review of current challenges in germ cell tumor (GCT) management including poor-risk disease treatment, brain metastases management, platinum-refractory disease, and novel biomarkers for minimal residual disease and teratoma detection. Emphasizes multidisciplinary approach at tertiary care centers.

title: A poor prognostic male choriocarcinoma with multiple systemic metastases: a case report and the literature review.
title_ja: 転移性疾患を伴う予後不良の男性絨毛癌：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 41歳男性の妊娠性以外の絨毛癌で肺、脳、骨、後腹膜リンパ節転移が認められた。β-hCGの著しい上昇と女性化乳房が見られ、陽電子放射断層撮影/コンピュータ断層撮影で確認。攻撃的な化学療法とペムブロリズマブで治療されたが全生存期間は診断後5か月。
summary_en: Rare case of non-gestational choriocarcinoma in 41-year-old man with lung, brain, bone, and lymph node metastases. Elevated β-hCG and gynecomastia noted. Treated with aggressive chemotherapy and pembrolizumab, but prognosis remained poor with overall survival of 5 months. Emphasizes need for systematic evaluation in men with elevated hCG.

title: Outcomes of pediatric extracranial germ cell tumors: A single center experience in a developing country.
title_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の転帰：発展途上国における単一施設の経験
summary_ja: 141例の小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の9年間の後方視的研究。悪性胚細胞腫瘍群の5年全生存率は81%、無イベント生存率は73%。奇形腫群は90%の全生存率と85%の無イベント生存率を達成。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値、血清AFP動態、切除状態が有意な予後因子。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 141 children with extracranial GCTs over 9 years. Malignant GCT group showed 5-year overall survival 81% and event-free survival 73%. Teratoma group achieved 90% OS and 85% EFS. AFP level, serum AFP kinetics, and resection status identified as significant prognostic factors.

title: Mature Cystic Oral Teratoma in a Neonate- A Case Report.
title_ja: 新生児の成熟嚢胞性口腔奇形腫 - 症例報告
journal: Indian J Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg
summary_ja: 生後1日の新生児口腔硬口蓋の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。呼吸困難で発症。CT検査と外科的切除で確定診断。新生児口腔腫瘤管理の重要性を示す。
summary_en: Case of 1-day-old male neonate with mature cystic teratoma of right hard palate causing respiratory distress. CT confirmed intraoral cystic lesion with cleft palate. Surgical excision performed with histopathological confirmation. Highlights diagnostic and management challenges in neonatal oral cavity masses.

title: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Locally Advanced Sinonasal Teratocarcinosarcoma a Rare Malignancy: An Audit From an Academic Tertiary Care Centre in India.
title_ja: 局所進行副鼻腔奇形腫肉腫における導入化学療法：インドの学術的第三次医療機関からの監査
summary_ja: 副鼻腔奇形腫肉腫27例の後方視的分析。導入化学療法後、70.4%で部分奏効を達成し、77.8%の患者で外科的切除が実現可能となった。シスプラチン-エトポシドが主要レジメン（74.1%）として使用され、無増悪生存期間中央値は19か月、全生存期間中央値は23か月であった。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 27 sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS) patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin-etoposide. Achieved 70.4% partial response, enabling resection in 77.8% of patients. Median progression-free survival 19 months, overall survival 23 months. NACT shown to be effective for downstaging locally advanced disease.

title: Impact of teratoma on survival probabilities of patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell cancer: Results from the IGCCCG Update Consortium.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の生存確率に対する奇形腫の影響：IGCCCG Update Consortiumの結果
summary_ja: 精巣転移性非精上皮腫性GCT 6792例の検討。一次腫瘍の奇形腫成分は良好予後群で5年生存率を低下させる。奇形腫患者は術後化学療法をより高率に要する。
summary_en: Study of 6792 metastatic testicular NSGCT patients comparing survival outcomes with teratoma (TER) versus without teratoma (NTER) in primary tumor. In good prognosis group, teratoma presence negatively impacted 5-year PFS (87.8% vs 92.0%) and OS (94.5% vs 96.5%). Teratoma patients required more frequent post-chemotherapy surgery.

title: Mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube diagnosed preoperatively with computed tomography and ultrasound: A case report.
title_ja: コンピュータ断層撮影と超音波検査で術前に診断された卵管成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 段階的な右下腹部/骨盤痛で提示した40歳女性における卵管の大規模完全卵管内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影と超音波検査で液体、肉眼的脂肪、および石灰化を含む拡張右卵管を認識し、術前診断を可能にした。患者は卵管切除術を受け、病理学的に確認。卵管成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は極めて稀で、英語文献で100例未満。
summary_en: Case report of large mature cystic teratoma of fallopian tube in 40-year-old woman presenting with pelvic pain. CT and ultrasound showed dilated tube with fat and calcifications, enabling preoperative diagnosis. Salpingectomy performed with pathological confirmation. Extremely rare entity with fewer than 100 cases reported worldwide.

title: Metastatic squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature teratoma of the ovary: Description of multi-modality treatment including incorporation of adjuvant immunotherapy and maintenance PARP inhibitor therapy.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来の転移性扁平上皮癌：補助免疫療法及びPARP阻害薬維持療法の組み入れを含む多施設治療の記載
summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。転移を伴う。手術、化学療法、PARP阻害薬、免疫療法による多機関治療を実施。奇形腫悪性転化の管理を提示。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Rare occurrence of malignant transformation without consensus on optimal treatment. Describes multimodality approach including surgery, chemotherapy, maintenance PARP inhibitor, and immunotherapy for metastatic disease.

title: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN) as a Predictor of Decreased Quality of Life in Testicular Germ Cell Tumor Survivors.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における化学療法誘発末梢神経障害(CIPN)と生活の質低下の予測因子
summary_ja: 151人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における化学療法誘発末梢神経障害(CIPN)と生活の質(QOL)の関連を調査した前向き研究。中央フォローアップ10年。高CIPNスコアを報告した生存者は有意に低いグローバルヘルスステータス、身体的・感情的・認知的・社会的機能の低下、疲労・痛み・呼吸困難などの症状負担の増加と経済的問題を示し、CIPNがQOL低下の強い予測因子。
summary_en: Prospective study of 151 testicular GCT survivors (median 10-year follow-up) investigating chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) impact on quality of life using EORTC questionnaires. High CIPN scores strongly correlated with impaired global health status, physical/emotional functioning, and symptom burden.

title: Component Patterns and Survival Outcomes in Patients with Mixed Malignant Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
title_ja: 混合型卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者における成分パターンと生存転帰：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 70人の混合型卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者の後方視的コホート。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も一般的な成分(80%)、その後ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）(50%)、未熟奇形腫(40%)。5年無再発生存期間77.9%、疾患特異的生存期間87.9%。FIGO病期III-IVと遅延腫瘍マーカー正常化が予後因子として識別。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 70 mixed malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (mMOGCT) patients. Yolk sac tumor most common component (80%), followed by dysgerminoma (50%), immature teratoma (40%). 5-year RFS 77.9%, DSS 87.9%. FIGO stage III-IV and delayed tumor marker normalization identified as prognostic factors with risk stratification model.

title: Post molar choriocarcinoma with solitary renal metastasis in the absence of primary uterine tumor: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 原発子宮腫瘍がない妊娠性絨毛性疾患関連絨毛癌による単発腎転移：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 原発子宮腫瘍がない妊娠性絨毛性疾患関連絨毛癌の単発腎転移の稀な症例報告。41歳女性が血尿と重度の側腹部痛で提示。画像検査で左腎下極に活動性出血を伴う病変を認識。部分腎摘除術後、エトポシド・メトトレキサート・アクチノマイシンD・シクロホスファミド・ビンクリスチン(EMA-CO)化学療法で治療。β-hCGレベルは5 mIU/mLに低下し、6ヶ月間の経過観察で正常範囲を維持。
summary_en: Case report of post-molar choriocarcinoma with solitary renal metastasis in absence of primary uterine tumor. Patient presented with hematuria and flank pain. Treated with standard chemotherapy (EMA-CO), achieving complete response with normalized hCG levels.

title: Actively Targeted Nanomedicines: A New Perspective for the Treatment of Pregnancy-Related Diseases.
title_ja: 能動的にターゲット化されたナノ医療：妊娠関連疾患の治療に対する新しい視点
summary_ja: 妊娠関連疾患における標的化ナノ医薬品のレビュー。絨毛癌を含む妊娠性栄養膜疾患を対象にナノキャリアシステムの応用を検討。
summary_en: Review of actively targeted nanomedicines for pregnancy-related diseases including preeclampsia, preterm birth, fetal growth restriction, and choriocarcinoma. Discusses nanocarrier systems, active targeting ligands, and clinical applications in gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Mature solid teratoma of the uterine cervix: A rare case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 子宮頸部の成熟固形奇形腫：稀な症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 子宮頸部成熟奇形種の稀有症例。複数の胚葉由来組織を含む。手術により治癒、再発なし。
summary_en: Rare case report of mature solid teratoma of uterine cervix in 40-year-old. Histology revealed respiratory epithelium, intestinal epithelium, adipose tissue, and mature glial components. Surgical resection (tumorectomy) achieved cure without recurrence.

title: Gastric Teratoma in Children: A Report of Two Cases and Review of Literature.
title_ja: 小児の胃奇形腫：2症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 腹部膨満で発症した小児胃奇形種2例。放射線画像検査と組織病理で診断。外科切除で治癒可能。
summary_en: Two cases of gastric teratomas in pediatric patients presenting with abdominal distension. Diagnosis confirmed by radiological imaging and histopathological analysis. Surgical excision is curative for these rare tumors.

title: Consensus and controversy in the management of paediatric and adult patients with ovarian immature teratoma: the Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium perspective.
title_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の小児及び成人患者の管理における合意と議論：Malignant Germ Cell International Consortiumの視点
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形種の管理に関するMaGICコンセンサスレビュー。小児と成人の治療方針の相違、AFP高値症例の管理を検討。
summary_en: MaGIC consortium consensus review on management of ovarian immature teratoma in pediatric and adult patients. Addresses diagnostic challenges, elevated AFP, and treatment variations between pediatric (surgery-only) and adult (adjuvant chemotherapy) approaches.

title: Expression of Immunotherapy Target PRAME in Cancer Correlates with Histone H3 Acetylation and Is Unrelated to Expression of Methylating (DMNT3A/3B) and Demethylating (TET1) Enzymes.
title_ja: 癌における免疫療法ターゲットPRAMEの発現はヒストンH3アセチル化と相関し、メチル化酵素(DMNT3A/3B)及び脱メチル化酵素(TET1)の発現とは無関係である
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマを含む複数の悪性腫瘍におけるPRAME発現を検討。ヒストン3アセチル化とDNAメチル化が免疫療法標的の制御に関与。
summary_en: Study of PRAME expression in three malignancy types including testicular seminoma. Examined epigenetic mechanisms including histone H3 acetylation and DNA methylation status in regulating immunotherapy targets for cancer.

title: Ruptured Ovarian Cystic Teratoma: A Rare Diagnosis, Easily to Be Confused with Peritoneal Carcinomatosis.
title_ja: 破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫：稀な診断で腹膜癌腫症と容易に混同される
summary_ja: 腹膜癌腫症に類似した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形種破裂症例。軽度外傷後の腹痛で発症。手術により治癒。
summary_en: Case report of ruptured mature cystic ovarian teratoma mimicking peritoneal carcinomatosis. Presented with abdominal pain following minor trauma. CT and MRI showed peritoneal dissemination of teratoma contents; surgical management achieved favorable outcome.

title: Elevated chorionic gonadotropic hormone in transgenic mice induces parthenogenetic activation and ovarian teratomas.
title_ja: トランスジェニックマウスにおける絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの高発現は単為生殖活性化と卵巣奇形腫を誘導する
summary_ja: hCG過剰分泌による卵巣奇形種発生機序を検討。単為発生を介した腫瘍形成、卵胞発育障害とERK1/2シグナルの抑制。
summary_en: Transgenic mouse study investigating hCG's role in ovarian teratoma development. Chronic hCG hypersecretion induced parthenogenetic oocyte activation and teratoma formation with 100% penetrance. Identifies mechanism linking gonadotropin dysfunction to teratoma pathogenesis.

title: Prognostic factors for relapse in patients with clinical stage I testicular non-seminoma: A nationwide, population-based cohort study.
title_ja: 臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ患者における再発の予後因子：全国人口ベースコホート研究
summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ453人の全国人口ベースコホート研究。中央フォローアップ6.3年で139人(30.6%)が再発。精巣精巣部肉芽組織への腫瘍侵襲、腫瘍サイズ、リンパ管侵襲、および胎児性癌が再発の独立した予測因子。これらの因子を用いた新しいモデルは、現在の臨床慣行より正確な危険度層別化を提供。
summary_en: Population-based cohort study of 453 clinical stage I testicular non-seminoma patients identifying independent prognostic factors for relapse. Tumor invasion, size, lymphovascular invasion, and embryonal carcinoma were significant predictors. Model provides improved risk stratification.

title: Evolution of Testicular Germ Cell Tumors in the Molecular Era With Histogenetic Implications.
title_ja: 分子時代における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進化：組織発生的な含意
summary_ja: 分子時代における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進化に関する包括的レビュー。ゲノムイベントによる発症経路、GCNIS前駆病変、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性分化の機構、シスプラチン耐性、有望なマイクロRNAバイオマーカーについて論述。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular germ cell tumor evolution in molecular era. Discusses pathogenesis driven by genomic events, GCNIS precursor lesion, mechanisms of seminoma and non-seminomatous differentiation, cisplatin resistance, and promising miRNA biomarkers.

title: Case report: Metastatic choriocarcinoma in the second trimester of a viable pregnancy with successful delivery and outcome after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 症例報告：生存可能な妊娠の妊娠中期における転移性絨毛癌と化学療法後の成功した分娩と転帰
summary_ja: 妊娠中期に診断された転移性絨毛癌の症例。EMA-CO化学療法で治療、26週で健康児を出産。その後の疾患制御に成功。
summary_en: Case report of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed in second trimester of viable pregnancy. Successfully treated with EMA-CO and TC chemotherapy during pregnancy, achieving healthy live delivery at 26 weeks gestation with subsequent disease control.

title: Ovarian Yolk Sac Tumors: Is Fertility Preservation Possible?
title_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍：生殖能温存は可能か？
summary_ja: 小児・若年成人患者における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の3症例報告。患者はいずれも著しく上昇したAFPレベルを示し、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン(BEP)化学療法で治療。治療反応のモニタリングとフォローアップにおいてAFP測定が重要。若年患者で高いAFPレベルと急速増大する卵巣腫瘤が見られた場合は卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断を念頭に置くべき。
summary_en: Three case reports of ovarian yolk sac tumors in pediatric and young adult patients with elevated AFP levels. Discusses treatment with BEP chemotherapy and monitoring response. Addresses fertility preservation considerations in these highly treatable malignancies.

title: Challenges in the management of Turner syndrome with Y chromosome material: a case report of prophylactic gonadectomy revealing dysgerminoma.
title_ja: Y染色体物質を有するTurner症候群の管理における課題：未分化胚細胞腫を明らかにする予防的性腺摘除術の症例報告
summary_ja: Y染色体を有するターナー症候群でジスジャーミノーマが予防的去勢時に発見。悪性化リスクと妊孕性保存のバランスを検討。
summary_en: Case report of dysgerminoma with gonadoblastoma revealed on prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy in 12-year-old with mosaic Turner syndrome with Y chromosome material. Discusses challenges in timing prophylactic surgery, balancing malignancy risk with fertility preservation.

title: Association of the minimal cyclophosphamide equivalent dose and outcome of microdissection testicular sperm extraction in patients with persistent azoospermia after chemotherapy.
title_ja: 化学療法後の持続的無精子症患者における最小シクロホスファミド相当用量と顕微鏡精巣精子抽出術の成績の関連
summary_ja: 化学療法後無精子症患者の精子採取に関する研究。セミノーマと非セミノーマを含む。シクロホスファミド用量と精子採取率の関連。
summary_en: Retrospective study of sperm retrieval by microdissection TESE in azoospermic cancer survivors post-chemotherapy, including seminoma and non-seminomatous GCT patients. Minimal cyclophosphamide equivalent dose significantly associated with improved sperm retrieval rates.

title: Pseudo-Meigs' Syndrome With Eosinophilic Pleural Effusion.
title_ja: 好酸球性胸水を伴う偽Meigs症候群
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形種による疑似Meigs症候群。好酸球性胸水を伴う非典型的炎症応答を呈した稀有症例。
summary_en: Case report of pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with eosinophilic pleural effusion secondary to mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Rare presentation with atypical inflammatory response; typical pseudo-Meigs syndrome shows mononuclear predominance rather than eosinophilia.

title: Squamous cell carcinoma malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: a case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における扁平上皮癌への悪性転化：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌への悪性転化は稀(約2%)だが、術前診断は困難である。43歳女性が腹痛で提示。完全な外科的切除と化学療法で治療。悪性転化の可能性を考慮して、腹痛を伴う高齢者や腫瘍マーカー上昇者で評価すべき。
summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma malignant transformation arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in 43-year-old woman. Emphasizes rarity of malignant transformation (approximately 2%) and diagnostic challenges, requiring comprehensive staging and adjuvant chemotherapy.

title: Impact of Surgical Timing (Primary, Delayed, or Second Look) on Surgical Morbidity and Outcomes in Malignant Germ Cell Tumor of the Ovary in Children.
title_ja: 小児卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍における外科的タイミング(一次的、遅延、二次検査)が手術的罹患率と転帰に与える影響
summary_ja: 小児卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍118人(中央年齢12歳)における手術タイミング(一次、遅延、二次検査)が手術罹患率と転帰に与える影響を比較。一次手術は高い手術罹患率と関連し、遅延手術は同様の転帰で合併症を最小化。二次検査手術は有意な合併症をもたらした。追跡調査中央値5.2年で、5年無イベント生存期間86%、全生存期間89%。
summary_en: Study comparing surgical timing in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors in children (118 patients, median age 12 years). Primary surgery associated with higher morbidity; delayed surgery minimizes complications with similar outcomes. Five-year event-free survival 86%, overall survival 89%.

title: Self-perceptions of masculinities and testicular cancer: Qualitative explorations.
title_ja: 精巣がんと男性性の自己認識：質的探索
summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者21人(年齢31-47歳)を対象とした質的研究。伝統的男性規範が治療後の自己認識に与える影響を探索。男性は感情統制と身体的強さを重視する一方、能力低下により男性性の脅威を経験。男性性の柔軟な適応を促すことで、精巣がん患者の対処と心理的転帰の改善を推奨。
summary_en: Qualitative study of 21 men (ages 31-47) who survived testicular cancer (TC), exploring how traditional masculine norms affect post-treatment self-perception. Men valued emotional control and physical strength, but experienced threats to masculine identity from reduced competencies. The study recommends encouraging flexible adaptation of masculinity to improve coping and psychological outcomes in TC survivors.

title: Unveiled: A Case of N-Methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor Antibody Encephalitis With Delayed Diagnosis of Ovarian Teratoma.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎と卵巣奇形腫の遅延診断：症例報告
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を呈した25歳女性で、行動変化、けいれん、カタトニアで発症。初期画像検査陰性だが血清・脳脊髄液は抗NMDA受容体抗体陽性。免疫療法に良好反応したが、2年後の監視で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が発見。
summary_en: Case report of 25-year-old female with anti-NMDAR encephalitis presenting with behavioral changes, seizures, and catatonia. Initial imaging was negative, but serum and CSF tested positive for anti-NMDAR antibodies. Patient responded well to immunotherapy (steroids, IVIg, rituximab). Ovarian mature cystic teratoma was discovered two years later during surveillance, highlighting importance of continued imaging screening.

title: Clinicopathological features and surgical procedures of adnexal masses with abdominal pain in pediatric and adolescent patients.
title_ja: 小児および思春期患者における腹痛を伴う付属器腫瘤の臨床病理学的特性と手術手技
summary_ja: 小児・思春期患者212名の付属器腫瘤と腹痛に関する研究。成熟奇形腫（29.4%）と単純嚢胞（25.6%）が最も一般的。腫瘤サイズ>5cm、急性発症痛が茎捻転のリスク因子。卵巣温存手術が推奨される。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 212 pediatric and adolescent patients with adnexal masses and abdominal pain. Mature teratoma (29.4%) and simple cysts (25.6%) were most common pathologic findings. Multivariate analysis identified mass size >5 cm, acute onset pain, and persistent/recurrent pain as risk factors for adnexal torsion. Early laparoscopy with ovary-preserving surgery is recommended for better outcomes.

title: Large Malignant Testicular/Paratesticular Tumors in Adolescence: Assessment of Gross Tumor Size in a Vulnerable Age Group.
title_ja: 思春期における大型悪性精巣/精巣周囲腫瘍：脆弱年齢層における肉眼腫瘍サイズの評価
summary_ja: 思春期患者85名の精巣および精巣傍悪性腫瘍を分析。腫瘍サイズ0.8-18cm（平均4.4cm）。11.8%が≥10cm。11-13歳グループでは100%が大腫瘍。思春期患者は診断遅延に脆弱であり、早期スクリーニングの必要性を強調。
summary_en: Analysis of 85 malignant testicular and paratesticular tumors in adolescents (ages 11-20). Tumor size ranged 0.8-18 cm (mean 4.4 cm). Notably, 11.8% were ≥10 cm, with 100% of the youngest group (11-13 years) having large tumors. This suggests adolescents, particularly 11-13 year-olds, are vulnerable to delayed diagnosis, highlighting need for increased awareness and early screening.

title: Germ Cell Tumor Presenting as a Mesenteric Cyst: a Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 腸間膜嚢胞として発症した胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 腸間膜に発生した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。22歳男性が腸間膜嚢胞として初期診断されたが、病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学（SALL-4、グリピカン-3、PLAP、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性）で確認。正確な病理診断の重要性と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の発生起源について論述。
summary_en: Case report of rare extragonadal yolk sac tumor (YST) in the mesentery of a 22-year-old male, initially presenting as a mesenteric cyst. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry (positive for SALL-4, glypican-3, PLAP, AFP) confirmed diagnosis. The case emphasizes the importance of accurate histopathology in distinguishing mesenteric YST from benign cysts and recognition of extragonadal GCT pathogenesis.

title: Cytodiagnostic Dilemma in a Lung Mass as the First Presentation of Testicular Mixed Germ Cell Tumor Metastasis.
title_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍転移の初発症状である肺腫瘤における細胞診上のジレンマ
summary_ja: 精巣混合胚細胞腫瘍が肺転移として初発した症例。CT誘導下FNACで角質物質と軟骨粘液質間質が検出された。奇形腫成分の識別が診断的課題。肺偶発所見のある患者での転移性胚細胞腫瘍検討の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT) with lung metastasis as initial presentation in a young male without prior testicular symptoms. CT-guided FNAC revealed keratinous debris and chondromyxoid stroma consistent with teratoma components. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of identifying teratoma elements in FNA specimens and importance of considering metastatic MGCT in patients with unexpected lung findings.

title: Primary Right Adrenal Teratoma in a Postmenopausal Female: a Case Report and Review of Literature.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における一次性右副腎奇形腫：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 閉経後女性の右副腎に発生した一次性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の稀な症例報告。腫瘤18×13×10cmで壊死物質と固体領域を含む。組織学的検査で多組織系統への分化を確認。成熟奇形腫は良好予後を示し、外科的切除とフォローアップが標準治療。
summary_en: Rare case report of primary mature cystic teratoma in right adrenal gland of postmenopausal female presenting with abdominal pain. Large mass (18×13×10 cm) showed cystic contents with necrotic material and solid gelatinous areas. Histology confirmed teratoma with differentiation along multiple tissue lineages. Surgical resection remains standard treatment with good prognosis for mature teratomas.

title: New insights on testicular cancer prevalence with novel diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic approaches.
title_ja: 新規診断バイオマーカーと治療的アプローチによる精巣がん有病率に関する新知見
summary_ja: 精巣がん（TC）は男性悪性腫瘍の1%であるが、若年男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍。胚細胞腫瘍が95%、性索間質腫瘍が5%を占める。シスプラチン併用化学療法の導入により5年生存率は95%を超えて改善。本レビューは多因子的病因、出生前後の原因、新規診断バイオマーカー、治療戦略について述べる。
summary_en: Review of testicular cancer (TC), comprising 95% germ cell tumors and 5% sex cord-stromal tumors. Despite being only 1% of male neoplasms, TC is the most common malignancy in young males with rising global prevalence. Discussion includes multifactorial etiology, prenatal and postnatal causes, novel diagnostic biomarkers, and therapeutic approaches, highlighting improved 5-year survival exceeding 95% with cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

title: P53 Overexpression May Represent an Early Marker of Clinicopathologic Progression in Vasculogenic Mesenchymal Lesions of Germ Cell Tumor Origin.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来血管新生間葉系病変におけるP53過剰発現は臨床病理学的進行の早期マーカーである可能性がある。
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の血管新生間葉系病変39例（低悪性度19例、高悪性度16例）を検討。P53過剰発現（核陽性>80%）は全体13%、高悪性度腫瘍で25%の頻度で認められ、疾患進行と肉腫への形質転換に関連。定期的な臨床フォローアップが必要。
summary_en: Study of 39 vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions (VMLs) of germ cell tumor origin, including teratoma with vasculogenic stroma (TVS), low-grade and high-grade vasculogenic mesenchymal tumors (VMTs). P53 overexpression (>80% cells) was observed in 13% of cases, with higher frequency in high-grade tumors (25%). P53 overexpression associated with disease progression and potential sarcoma transformation, suggesting it warrants routine surveillance.

title: DNA damage levels in peripheral blood mononuclear cells before and after first cycle of chemotherapy have comparable prognostic values in germ cell tumor patients.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法初回サイクル前後の末梢血単核細胞のDNA損傷レベルは同等の予後値を有する
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の末梢血単核球のDNA損傷が予後予測因子となる研究。化学療法前後で同等の予後価値。コメットアッセイでDNA損傷評価。無増悪生存率と全生存期間と相関。治療戦略への応用推奨。
summary_en: Study demonstrating that DNA damage levels in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) serve as independent prognostic markers in germ cell tumor (GCT) patients both before and after first cycle of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. DNA damage assessed by alkaline and styrene oxide-modified comet assay correlated with progression-free and overall survival. Clinical use is recommended to stratify poor-prognosis patients for tailored therapeutic interventions.

title: Primary testicular teratoid Wilms tumor in a 40-year-old male with retroperitoneal lymph node involvement: A case report.
title_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移を有する40歳男性における原発性精巣奇形腫様Wilms腫瘍:症例報告
summary_ja: 40歳男性の精巣における稀な奇形腫様Wilms腫瘍（腎芽腫）の症例。奇形腫（60%）と腎芽腫（40%）の混合腫瘍。後腹膜リンパ節転移。成人精巣奇形腫様腎芽腫の稀性と包括的診断の必要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of rare testicular teratoid Wilms tumor (nephroblastoma) in 40-year-old male with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Initial orchiectomy showed 60% teratoma with 40% nephroblastoma and extensive necrosis. Re-review of pathology after metastasis detection revealed the nephroblastoma component. Case illustrates rarity of adult testicular teratoid Wilms tumors and emphasizes need for comprehensive diagnostic approaches and further research into extrarenal teratoid Wilms tumor pathophysiology.

title: Paraneoplastic neurologic syndrome and autoantibody accompaniments of germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の傍腫瘍性神経症候群と自己抗体
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍性神経症候群に関するハンドブック章。神経特異的自己抗体（抗NMDAR、抗LG1など）と様々な神経症候群表型を討議。臨床的・放射線学的特徴と治療を概説。早期診断がGCT発見と神経合併症予防に重要。
summary_en: Handbook chapter on paraneoplastic neurologic syndromes (PNSs) associated with germ cell tumors (GCTs), covering pathophysiology and epidemiology. Discusses neural-specific autoantibodies (anti-NMDAR, anti-LG1, and others) and various PNS phenotypes. Reviews clinical and radiologic accompaniments, treatment, and prognosis. Early PNS diagnosis is vital for uncovering underlying GCTs and preventing permanent neurologic complications.

title: Paraneoplastic encephalitis.
title_ja: 傍腫瘍性脳炎
summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性脳炎と悪性腫瘍関連神経障害に関するハンドブック章。若年女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎と卵巣奇形腫の関連、および他の抗体関連脳炎症候群を論述。歴史的辺縁系脳炎概念から新規神経膜蛋白抗体を伴う広い表現型への転換を示す。
summary_en: Handbook chapter on paraneoplastic encephalitis and malignancy-associated neurologic disorders. Discusses well-characterized association of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis with ovarian teratoma in young women, along with other antibody-associated encephalitis syndromes. Reviews shift from historical limbic encephalitis concept to broader phenotypes involving novel neuronal membrane protein antibodies. Covers pathogenic mechanisms and importance of malignancy screening in seronegative cases.

title: N-linked α2,6-sialylation of integrin β1 by the sialyltransferase ST6Gal1 promotes cell proliferation and stemness in gestational trophoblastic disease.
title_ja: 絨毛性疾患におけるシアリルトランスフェラーゼST6Gal1によるインテグリンβ1のN結合α2,6-シアリル化が細胞増殖と幹性を促進
summary_ja: 妊娠滋養膜疾患における ST6Gal1 が integrin β1 のシアリル化を介して細胞増殖と幹性を促進することを示唆。miR-199a-5p による制御と FAK シグナル経路の関与を解明。
summary_en: Research demonstrating ST6Gal1 sialyltransferase promotes proliferation and stemness in gestational trophoblastic disease through α2,6-sialylation of integrin β1, with miR-199a-5p regulating ST6Gal1 expression and integrin β1/FAK pathway involvement.

title: Natural products and derivatives in renal, urothelial and testicular cancers: Targeting signaling pathways and therapeutic potential.
title_ja: 腎臓、尿路上皮および精巣がんにおける天然物と誘導体：シグナル伝達経路の標的化と治療の可能性
summary_ja: 腎がん、尿路上皮がん、精巣がんに対する天然物の効果についてのシステマティックレビュー。抗増殖作用、アポトーシス誘導機構、既存化学療法および免疫療法の効果増強の可能性、並びにPI3K/AKT、NF-κB、STAT、MAPKパスウェイの調節による作用機序を示す。
summary_en: Systematic review examining natural products' effects on renal cancer, urothelial carcinoma, and testicular cancer, highlighting anti-proliferative, pro-apoptotic mechanisms and potential to enhance existing chemotherapy and immunotherapy through modulation of PI3K/AKT, NF-κB, STAT, and MAPK pathways.

title: Postpartum choriocarcinoma - a rare cause of delayed postpartum hemorrhage: Four case reports and literature review.
title_ja: 産後絨毛癌 - 遅延産後出血の稀な原因:4症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 分娩後遅延性出血で発症する絨毛がん 4 症例。β-hCG 監視と標準化学療法で 3 例が完全奏効。妊娠遺残物との鑑別の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Four case reports of postpartum choriocarcinoma presenting as delayed hemorrhage with respiratory and neurological symptoms, emphasizing importance of β-hCG monitoring, standardized chemotherapy protocols (EMA-CO with modifications), and awareness of this rare malignancy mimicking gestational remnants.

title: Effectiveness of Prophylactic Laparoscopic Surgery for Benign Adnexal Mass during Pregnancy: A Single-center Retrospective Study.
title_ja: 妊娠中の良性付属器腫瘤に対する予防的腹腔鏡手術の有効性：単一施設後方視的研究
summary_ja: 妊娠中の良性付属器腫瘤に対する腹腔鏡嚢胞摘除術126症例の分析。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が76.2%で最多病理診断であった。開腹術への移行例なく、正期産率は97.4%と高く、卵巣機能を温存しながら付属器捻転などの合併症リスクを軽減する有効性が示された。
summary_en: Analysis of 126 laparoscopic cystectomies for benign adnexal masses during pregnancy, primarily mature cystic teratomas (76.2%), demonstrating safety, high full-term delivery rates (97.4%), and ovarian function preservation while reducing torsion risk.

title: Outcomes of upfront plerixafor use for mobilization in germ cell tumor patients.
title_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における造血幹細胞採集のための初期プレリキサフォール使用の成績
summary_ja: 難治性精巣がん患者における plerixafor 先制的投与で、94% で CD34+ 細胞採取成功、中央値 1 回のアフェレーシスで達成。幹細胞動員効率の著明な向上。
summary_en: Study of upfront plerixafor use in relapsed/refractory germ cell tumor patients demonstrating 94% successful CD34+ cell collection in median one apheresis day, improving mobilization efficiency and facilitating autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

title: A Report of a Rare Case of Rapidly Progressing Immature Teratoma With Associated Splenic Metastasis and Gliomatosis Peritonei.
title_ja: 関連する脾転移と腹膜神経膠腫症を伴う急速進行性未熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 21歳女性の急速進行性未熟奇形腫で脾転移と腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた症例報告。生殖機能温存的減量手術と化学療法後、二次手術で最終的に成熟奇形腫と関連GPであることが判明。
summary_en: Case report of rapidly progressive immature teratoma with splenic metastasis and gliomatosis peritonei in 21-year-old female treated with fertility-sparing debulking surgery and chemotherapy, followed by secondary surgery revealing mature teratoma and associated peritoneal nodules.

title: Neutropenic Enterocolitis in a Metastatic Seminoma Patient With Streptococcus gallolyticus Bacteremia.
title_ja: 好中球減少性腸結腸炎を伴う転移性セミノーマ患者におけるガロリティクス連鎖球菌菌血症
summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者における化学療法中の好中球減少性腸炎と Streptococcus gallolyticus 菌血症の症例。本菌とこの合併症の新規関連を報告。
summary_en: Case report of neutropenic enterocolitis with Streptococcus gallolyticus bacteremia in metastatic seminoma patient during chemotherapy, successfully treated with broad-spectrum antibiotics and filgrastim, representing unique association with this organism.

title: Pediatric orbital lesions: neoplastic extraocular soft-tissue lesions.
title_ja: 小児眼窩病変：腫瘍性眼外軟部組織病変
summary_ja: 小児眼窩非眼球外軟部腫瘍に関する多モダリティ画像レビュー。奇形腫を含む複数の腫瘍型の画像的特徴を解説し診断に貢献。
summary_en: Multimodality imaging review of pediatric neoplastic extraocular soft-tissue orbital lesions including teratomas, emphasizing key imaging features for differential diagnosis among vascular neoplasms, optic nerve lesions, and other soft-tissue masses.

title: A Case of Metastatic Choriocarcinoma-Related Paraneoplastic Thyroid Storm.
title_ja: 転移性絨毛癌に関連する傍腫瘍性甲状腺ストームの症例
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と転移性絨毛癌（脳・肺転移）を伴う甲状腺ストームを呈した女性の症例報告。集中治療支援、EMA-CO化学療法、子宮摘出術、追加化学療法を含む多職種アプローチで成功裏に管理。
summary_en: Case of metastatic gestational trophoblastic choriocarcinoma with brain and lung metastases presenting with thyroid storm, successfully managed with multidisciplinary approach including intensive care support, EMA-CO chemotherapy, hysterectomy, and additional cycles.

title: Potential Exploration of Biocompatible Carbon-Coated MoSe(2) Nanoparticles for Exploration of the Photothermal Potential in the Treatment of Human Choriocarcinoma.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛癌の治療における光熱ポテンシャルの探索のための生体適合性カーボンコーティングMoSe(2)ナノ粒子の可能性の探索
summary_ja: 炭素被覆 MoSe2 ナノ粒子による絨毛がん光熱治療研究。高い光熱変換効率（50.97%）と良好な生体適合性。ROS 産生と DNA 複製抑制によるアポトーシス誘導を確認。
summary_en: Study of carbon-coated molybdenum diselenide nanoparticles for photothermal therapy in choriocarcinoma, demonstrating high photothermal conversion efficiency (50.97%), biocompatibility with normal cells, significant ROS induction, and transcriptomic evidence of apoptosis induction.

title: Spontaneous rupture‑induced life‑threatening mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor: A case report and therapeutic considerations.
title_ja: 自然破裂に起因する生命を脅かす縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告と治療上の考察
summary_ja: 自然破裂と出血を起こした縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫）を認めた20歳男性の症例報告。血管豊富な腫瘍の管理の困難性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor with spontaneous rupture and life-threatening hemorrhage containing four pathological types (embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma), highlighting challenges of managing highly vascular tumors.

title: The CDK Inhibitor Dinaciclib Improves Cisplatin Response in Nonseminomatous Testicular Cancer: A Preclinical Study.
title_ja: CDK阻害薬ジナシクリブは非セミノーマ性精巣がんのシスプラチン反応を改善する：前臨床研究
summary_ja: CDK 阻害剤 dinaciclib が非セミノーマ精巣がんモデルで CDK5 を標的としてシスプラチン感受性を回復。細胞株および動物モデルで効果を実証。
summary_en: Preclinical study demonstrating CDK inhibitor dinaciclib enhances cisplatin response in nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor models by targeting CDK5 upregulation, improving cell viability reduction and in vivo efficacy in zebrafish xenograft model.

title: Malignant ovarian and testicular germ cell tumors: Common characteristics but different prognoses.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣および精巣胚細胞腫瘍：共通の特性と異なる予後
summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的比較レビュー。共通の病因および腫瘍生物学的特徴を有する一方で、顕著な予後格差（5年全生存期間98.2% vs 85.2%）を認識。精巣がんから適応した特定の治療戦略を採用することにより、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の成果改善を提案。
summary_en: Comprehensive review comparing testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, highlighting common etiologic and biological features but significant prognostic disparity (98.2% vs 85.2% 5-year survival), proposing treatment strategies adapted from testicular cancer to improve ovarian GCT outcomes.

title: A rare case of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from thymic carcinoma to an ovarian mature teratoma.
title_ja: 胸腺癌から卵巣成熟奇形腫への腫瘍間転移の稀な症例
summary_ja: 胸腺癌から卵巣成熟奇形腫への腫瘍間転移を認めた25歳女性の症例報告。病理学的確認により正確な腫瘍分類と病期分類が可能となり、この稀な現象の認識の重要性を示した。
summary_en: Case report of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from thymic carcinoma to ovarian mature teratoma in 25-year-old woman, demonstrating importance of pathological confirmation for accurate tumor staging and recognition of this rare phenomenon.

title: Erratum to "Intra-abdominal mass with empty scrotum in adult male revealed as testicular seminoma: A case report" [Radiology Case Reports 17 (2022) 3308-3311].
title_ja: 「空の陰囊を伴う腹腔内腫瘤で明らかになった精巣セミノーマ：症例報告」への正誤表
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ症例報告の訂正。空陰嚢と腹部腫瘤を伴う発症パターンの重要性。
summary_en: Erratum to case report of testicular seminoma presenting as intra-abdominal mass with empty scrotum, correcting prior publication and highlighting diagnostic considerations in germ cell tumor presentation.

title: Rare Metastatic Embryonal Carcinoma Resembling Lymphoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: リンパ腫に類似した稀な転移性胎児性癌：症例報告
summary_ja: 46歳男性の転移性胚胎癌（腹部リンパ節）がリンパ腫と類似した臨床像・画像所見を呈したが、腫瘍マーカーと生検で確定診断された症例報告。診断には臨床所見、画像、腫瘍マーカーおよび病理組織診が必要とされた。
summary_en: Case report of 46-year-old male with metastatic embryonal carcinoma of abdominal lymph nodes mimicking lymphoma clinically and radiologically. Diagnosis required correlation of clinical presentation, tumor markers, imaging findings, and pathological biopsy confirmation.

title: Unusual imaging findings associated with abdominal pediatric germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 小児腹部胚細胞腫瘍に関連する異常な画像所見
summary_ja: 小児腹部胚細胞腫瘍の非定型的な画像・臨床症状の包括的レビュー。多焦点原発腫瘍、卵巣捻転、破裂類皮嚢腫、燃え尽きた原発腫瘍、growing teratoma syndrome、腹膜神経膠腫症、内分泌症状、傍腫瘍症候群などを含む。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of atypical imaging and clinical manifestations of pediatric abdominal germ cell tumors, including multifocal primaries, torsion, ruptured dermoids, burned-out primary, growing teratoma syndrome, gliomatosis peritonei, endocrine manifestations, and paraneoplastic syndromes.

title: Differentiation of testicular seminomas from nonseminomas based on multiphase CT radiomics combined with machine learning: A multicenter study.
title_ja: 多相CT放射線学と機械学習の組み合わせに基づく精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の鑑別：多施設研究
summary_ja: CT放射線学的特徴と機械学習を組み合わせた多施設共同研究により、精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別診断モデルを開発。統合モデルは高精度（AUC 0.918-0.839）を示し、臨床的治療方針決定に有用。
summary_en: Multicenter study developing clinical-radiomics machine learning model to differentiate testicular seminomas from nonseminomas on CT. Combined model achieved high accuracy (AUC 0.918-0.839) across training, validation, and test cohorts, providing noninvasive diagnostic tool.

title: Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for ovarian mixed germ cell tumor in a patient with situs inversus totalis; reporting the first case worldwide with literature review and in silico analysis.
title_ja: 完全内臓逆位を伴う卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清：世界初例報告と文献レビュー及びin silico解析
summary_ja: 大全臓器逆位を伴う32歳女性の悪性混合型卵巣GCT初報告例。腹腔鏡下全子宮摘出、両側卵巣摘出、後腹膜リンパ節廓清術が施行された。
summary_en: First worldwide case report of malignant ovarian mixed germ cell tumor in patient with situs inversus totalis (mirror-image organ transposition). Patient underwent successful laparoscopic total abdominal hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy, and bilateral retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.

title: [Paraneoplastic Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate Receptor Encephalitis Associated with Anterior Mediastinal Mature Teratoma].
title_ja: 前縦隔成熟奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性抗NMDA受容体脳炎
summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の27歳男性の症例報告。精神症状と神経学的悪化で発症。腫瘍切除術と血液交換療法・ステロイド療法により回復し、人工呼吸器から離脱した。
summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old male with anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor encephalitis associated with anterior mediastinal mature teratoma. Tumor resection combined with plasmapheresis and steroid therapy led to recovery with successful mechanical ventilation weaning.

title: Histologic transformation of rectal adenocarcinoma to choriocarcinoma after surgery and chemotherapy: A rare case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 手術および化学療法後の直腸腺癌から絨毛癌への組織学的転化: 稀な症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 直腸腺癌が化学療法後に絨毛癌へ組織学的に転化した稀な非妊娠性絨毛癌症例。β-hCG上昇と病理組織学的転化を認め、再生検と遺伝子検査の重要性を示す。
summary_en: Rare case report of non-pregnant choriocarcinoma transformed from primary rectal adenocarcinoma. Post-chemotherapy histologic transformation showed elevated β-hCG and choriocarcinoma component without adenocarcinoma. Demonstrates importance of repeat biopsies and genetic testing in unusual disease progression.

title: Primary mature teratoma of the left adrenal gland: a case report.
title_ja: 左副腎の原発性成熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 52歳無症状男性で偶発的に発見された左副腎成熟奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍の大きさが大きいため腹腔鏡下副腎摘出術を施行。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫が確認され、術後経過は良好で再発を認めなかった。
summary_en: Case report of 52-year-old asymptomatic male with incidental left adrenal mature teratoma discovered on CT imaging. Laparoscopic adrenalectomy performed due to large tumor size; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with excellent post-operative recovery.

title: Unraveling the Enigma: A Case Report on Unilateral Ovarian Dermoid Cyst.
title_ja: 謎を解き明かす：一側性卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告
summary_ja: 42歳女性の左卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告。過去5ヶ月間に漸進的に増大する腹部腫瘤と直近5日間の左下腹痛を主訴に来院。試験的開腹手術を施行し、全腹式子宮摘出術および両側卵管卵巣切除術を実施。病理組織学検査により成熟奇形腫を確認し、1年間3ヶ月間隔でフォローアップ。
summary_en: Case report of 42-year-old female with left ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) presenting with progressive abdominal mass and lower abdominal pain. Exploratory laparotomy with total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy performed; histology confirmed mature teratoma.

title: Pediatric Intraabdominal Cysts-A Case Series from a Single Tertiary Center Experience.
title_ja: 小児腹腔内嚢腫-単一3次医療機関経験からの症例集積
summary_ja: 1～16歳の小児腹腔内嚢腫36例の単一3次医療機関後方視的症例集積。診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、リンパ管腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、重複嚢腫など。嚢腫の種類と位置に応じた外科的管理が必要。
summary_en: Retrospective single-center case series of 36 pediatric intraabdominal cysts (ages 1-16 years). Diagnoses included mature cystic teratoma, lymphangioma, mucinous cystadenoma, duplication cyst, and others. Surgical management varied by cyst type and location; timely diagnosis and resection emphasized.

title: Low-Grade Glioma within Mature Cystic Teratoma in a Patient with Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate Receptor Encephalitis: A Case Report.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の低悪性度グリオーマ：症例報告
summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内低悪性度グリオーマの初の記録例。45歳女性、けいれんと意識変容で腹腔鏡下卵巣摘除；病理で稀な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を確認。
summary_en: First documented case of anti-NMDAR encephalitis patient with low-grade glioma within mature cystic teratoma (MCT). 45-year-old woman with seizures and altered consciousness underwent laparoscopic ovarian resection; pathology revealed rare malignant transformation of MCT showing astrocytic proliferation with cellular atypia.

title: Dysgerminoma Probably Due to a Novel SOHLH1-pathogenic Variant Causing Familial Ovarian Dysgenesis.
title_ja: 家族性卵巣形成不全を引き起こす新規SOHLH1病原性変異によっておそらく引き起こされた未分化胚細胞腫
summary_ja: SOHLH1遺伝子新規ホモ接合ミスセンス変異を有する卵巣ジスゲネシスとジスゲルミノーマ症例。両側ジスゲルミノーマを発症；定期的な画像検査による腫瘍監視が推奨される。
summary_en: Case report of two sisters and paternal great-aunt with ovarian dysgenesis and bilateral dysgerminoma. Whole-exome sequencing identified novel homozygous SOHLH1 missense variant (c.275C>T). Histopathology showed dysgerminoma and ovarian fibrosis with follicle absence, supporting tumor surveillance in affected women.

title: Primary Yolk Sac Tumor of the Liver: A Rare Cause of Bile Duct Obstruction.
title_ja: 肝臓の原発性卵黄嚢腫瘍: 胆管閉塞の稀な原因
summary_ja: 32歳男性の肝臓原発卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。周囲リンパ節転移による胆管閉塞で黄疸を呈現。初期生検は腺癌を疑ったが、免疫染色で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確診され、BEP化学療法開始。
summary_en: Case report of 32-year-old male with primary yolk sac tumor (YST) of the liver presenting with painless jaundice from periductal lymph node metastases causing bile duct obstruction. Initial biopsy suggested adenocarcinoma; diagnosis of primary YST confirmed with appropriate immunostaining, enabling BEP chemotherapy.

title: Presentation and treatment of two cases of malignant struma ovarii.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例の臨床経過と治療
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(MSO)の2症例の臨床経過と治療。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に分化した甲状腺癌で診断された稀な胚細胞腫瘍。症例1：乳頭状甲状腺癌の濾胞型変異体を伴い、腹膜細胞診は悪性；症例2：乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。両症例とも腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣切除術、全甲状腺切除術、放射性ヨウ素療法が施行された。
summary_en: Two cases of malignant struma ovarii (MSO)—rare germ cell tumor showing differentiated thyroid cancer within mature cystic teratoma. Case 1: follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma with peritoneal involvement; Case 2: papillary thyroid cancer within teratoma. Both underwent surgery, thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine therapy.

title: Cellular senescence in testicular cancer. Is there a correlation with the preoperative markers and the extent of the tumor? An experimental study.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける細胞老化：腫瘍マーカーおよび腫瘍範囲との相関。実験的研究
summary_ja: 精巣がん31検体の実験的研究。細胞老化は腫瘍サイズと正相関（Pearson r=0.40, p=0.027）、術前LDH値と負相関（r=-0.53, p=0.002）を示した。
summary_en: Experimental study investigating correlation between cellular senescence and testicular cancer characteristics (size, stage, tumor markers). Analyzed 31 testicular cancer specimens; senescence rate correlated positively with tumor size (Pearson r=0.40, p=0.027) and negatively with preoperative LDH level (r=-0.53, p=0.002).

title: Uterine transposition for fertility preservation in pelvic cancers.
title_ja: 骨盤癌における妊孕性温存のための子宮転位
summary_ja: 骨盤がんの生殖能温存における子宮転位術のレビュー。18症例で直腸がん50%、子宮頸がん33%、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例を含む。3例で自然妊娠成功。
summary_en: Literature review of uterine transposition for fertility preservation in pelvic cancers. Eighteen published cases reviewed; indications included rectal cancers (50%), cervical squamous cell carcinomas (33%), and one sacral yolk sac tumor (GCT). Mean operative time ~150 min; three spontaneous pregnancies achieved with successful gestations.

title: An Unusual Presentation of Choriocarcinoma in a Postmenopausal Woman: A case report.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における絨毛癌の異常な発症: 症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠後8年経過した閉経後女性における転移性絨毛癌の稀な症例報告。脳、脾臓、肺、腎臓への転移を認め、脳放射線療法、脾動脈塞栓術、EMA/CO化学療法により完全寛解を達成した。
summary_en: Case report of a postmenopausal woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma of presumed gestational origin 8 years after last pregnancy, presenting with brain, spleen, lung, and kidney metastases. Treatment included whole-brain radiotherapy, splenic artery embolization, and EMA/CO chemotherapy achieving complete remission.

title: Protracted Chemical Peritonitis Following Laparoscopy for Dermoid Cyst: A management dilemma.
title_ja: 類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡検査後の持続する化学性腹膜炎：管理上のジレンマ
summary_ja: 卵巣ダーモイド嚢胞の捻転後に生じた化学性腹膜炎の稀な合併症の症例報告。複数回のドレナージ、抗生物質、抗炎症療法、および再開腹術を含む治療管理について述べている。
summary_en: Case report of chemical peritonitis and prolonged fever following laparoscopic surgery for ovarian dermoid cyst with torsion. Management included repeated drainage, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory therapy, and re-laparotomy for this rare postoperative complication.

title: Diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of a rare large ovarian strumal carcinoid in pregnancy, about a case report.
title_ja: 妊娠中に診断された稀な卵巣ストルマルカルチノイドの診断的および治療的課題：症例報告
summary_ja: 妊娠17週で急性卵巣茎捻転で診断された稀な卵巣ストルマルカルチノイドの症例報告。腹腔鏡下嚢胞切除術を施行；病理診断で確認。この胚細胞腫瘍亜型は稀性にもかかわらず優れた予後を示す。
summary_en: Case report of rare ovarian strumal carcinoid diagnosed at 17 weeks gestation presenting with acute ovarian torsion. Laparoscopic cystectomy was performed; pathology confirmed strumal carcinoid. Despite rarity, excellent prognosis is typical for this germ cell tumor subtype.

title: Lymph Node Dissection in Testicular Cancer: The State of the Art and Future Perspectives.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおけるリンパ節郭清：現状と将来の展望
summary_ja: 精巣がん管理における後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の進化する役割の総説。患者選択、神経温存技術、現代的画像診断、および改善された腫瘍学的転帰を強調している。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in testicular cancer management, highlighting its dual role in staging and therapy. Emphasizes patient selection, nerve-sparing techniques, modern imaging approaches, and improved oncological outcomes.

title: Successful diagnosis of asymptomatic choriocarcinoma by ultrasonography during a viable pregnancy: A rare case report.
title_ja: 生活継続妊娠中の超音波検査による無症候性絨毛癌の成功した診断：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 生存妊娠中に超音波で診断された無症状の妊娠性絨毛癌の稀な症例。超音波による早期診断と治療監視により、タイムリーな治療介入と新生児の安全な退院が達成された。
summary_en: Rare case of asymptomatic gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed by ultrasonography during viable pregnancy. Early diagnosis and treatment monitoring via ultrasound enabled timely therapeutic intervention and successful newborn discharge.

title: A rare germline BMP15 missense mutation causes hereditary ovarian immature teratoma in human.
title_ja: 稀なBMP15遺伝子変異は人間の遺伝性卵巣未熟奇形腫を引き起こす
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形種の易罹患性に関連するBMP15の稀な生殖細胞変異を同定。成熟BMP15分泌の減少とH-Ras/MAPK経路の異常活性化がOIT発症に関与することを示した。
summary_en: Study identifying a rare BMP15 germline missense mutation associated with hereditary ovarian immature teratomas (OITs). Findings showed reduced mature BMP15 secretion and abnormal H-Ras/MAPK pathway activation in OIT development, providing insights into genetic susceptibility.

title: Iodine‑125 seeds combined with carboplatin in the treatment of retroperitoneal metastatic seminoma: A case report and literature review.
title_ja: 後腹膜転移性セミノーマの治療におけるヨウ素-125シードとカルボプラチンの併用：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの後腹膜転移に対するヨウ素125シード組織内放射線療法とカルボプラチン併用の治療成績報告。従来の放射線療法・化学療法と比較して長期毒性を低減した治療法を示した。
summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal metastatic seminoma treated with iodine-125 seed brachytherapy combined with carboplatin. Novel approach demonstrated tumor control with reduced long-term toxicity compared to standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy over 3-year follow-up.

title: Hybrid Lymphovenous Anastomosis Surgery Guided by Intraoperative Mesenteric Intranodal Lymphangiography for Refractory Nontraumatic Chylous Ascites: A Case Report.
title_ja: 難治性非外傷性乳び腹水に対する術中腸間膜節内リンパ管造影をガイドとしたハイブリッドリンパ静脈吻合術：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形種の腹腔鏡除去術後に生じた難治性乳糜腹水に対する淋巴静脈吻合術の症例報告。術中腸間膜リンパ管造影を用いた新規ハイブリッド淋巴静脈吻合術により、再発なく乳糜腹水を完全に解決した。
summary_en: Case report of lymphovenous anastomosis surgery for refractory chylous ascites following laparoscopic adnexectomy for ovarian teratoma. Hybrid lymphovenous anastomosis with intraoperative mesenteric lymphangiography guidance successfully resolved ascites without recurrence.

title: Role of immune checkpoint inhibitors combined with chemotherapy in recurrent drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: Four case reports and literature review.
title_ja: 再発薬剤耐性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における免疫チェックポイント阻害薬と化学療法の併用の役割：4つの症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 薬剤耐性妊娠絨毛性疾患に対するPD-1/PD-L1免疫チェックポイント阻害剤と化学療法併用の4症例。3/4例が完全奏効または部分奏効を達成し、軽度の免疫関連有害事象のみで有効性を示唆した。
summary_en: Four case reports of immune checkpoint inhibitor (PD-1/PD-L1) therapy combined with chemotherapy for recurrent drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Three of four patients achieved complete or partial response with mild immune-related adverse events.

title: Cumulative incidences of hypogonadism, hypertension, and dyslipidaemia in patients with stage I seminoma treated with a risk-adapted strategy: a Spanish single-centre retrospective analysis.
title_ja: リスク適応戦略で治療された病期Iセミノーマ患者におけるヒポゴナディズム、高血圧、および脂質異常症の累積発生率：スペインの単一施設後方視的分析
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者145例の危険度適応化治療後の長期合併症を検討。10年累積発生率は男性ホルモン低下症5.3%、高血圧8.6%、脂質異常症25.1%で、治療群間に有意差なし。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 145 stage I seminoma patients treated with risk-adapted strategy (surveillance, single-dose or two-dose carboplatin). Cumulative 10-year incidences were 5.3% for hypogonadism, 8.6% for hypertension, and 25.1% for dyslipidemia.

title: Genetic and histological analysis intraplacental choriocarcinoma: a case report.
title_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の遺伝学的および組織学的分析：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の症例を遺伝子解析とメチル化解析で検討。145個の癌関連遺伝子に変異なくMDM2増幅を観察。異常メチル化パターンから、発がんの機序はエピジェネティック機序が関与する可能性を示唆した。
summary_en: Single case of intraplacental choriocarcinoma with feto-maternal hemorrhage analyzed by cancer gene panel and methylation analysis. No mutations detected in 145 cancer-related genes; MDM2 amplification observed. Aberrant methylation patterns suggested epigenetic mechanisms in carcinogenesis.

title: Rare Presentation and Diagnostic Challenge of a Germ Cell Tumor of the Yolk Sac Type.
title_ja: 卵黄嚢型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な臨床像と診断上の課題
summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍がオプソクロヌス失調症パネオプラスティック症候群で呈示した稀な症例報告。神経学者と腫瘍医による多学際的管理が診断と治療に不可欠であった。
summary_en: Case report of mediastinal yolk sac germ cell tumor presenting with opsoclonus-ataxia paraneoplastic syndrome, an unusual neurological association. Multidisciplinary management involving neurologists and oncologists was essential for diagnosis and treatment.

title: The Diagnostic Accuracy of Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein Levels in Follow-up for Recurrence of Sacrococcygeal Teratoma; a Nationwide Review of SCT Cases in the Netherlands.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の再発フォローアップにおける血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値の診断精度：オランダにおけるSCT症例の全国的レビュー
summary_ja: 57例の小児仙骨尾骨部奇形種におけるAFP測定値の再発予測精度を検討した全国的研究。AFP値の変化は再発の予測因子ではなかったが、55μg/L以上は悪性再発を予測する可能性を示した。
summary_en: Nationwide Dutch study of 57 pediatric sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients examining AFP's diagnostic accuracy for recurrence surveillance. AFP dynamics were not predictive of recurrence; however, serum AFP >55 μg/L predicted malignant recurrence with 100% specificity.

title: Enhancing Testicular Cancer Prevention Among University Students: A Health Belief Model and Social Support Intervention.
title_ja: 大学生における精巣がん予防の強化：ヘルス・ビリーフ・モデルと社会的支援介入
summary_ja: 18-25歳男子大学生350例を対象とした精巣がんの保健信念モデルに基づく教育介入研究。介入後、知識、知覚便益、自己効力感、精巣自己検診実践に有意な改善が認められた。
summary_en: Quasi-experimental study of 350 male university students (ages 18-25) implementing a Health Belief Model-based educational intervention on testicular cancer. Post-intervention improvements observed in knowledge, perceived benefits, self-efficacy, and testicular self-examination performance.

title: Anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis and concurrent neuroborreliosis misdiagnosed for post-COVID-19-syndrome: a case report.
title_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎およびポストCOVID-19症候群と誤診された併存神経ボレリア症：症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形種に起因する抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。当初はCOVID後症候群と誤診されたが、骨盤CT検査で奇形種を同定し、形質交換療法と腫瘍切除で改善。パネオプラスティック神経症候群における奇形種スクリーニングの重要性を強調した。
summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis caused by ovarian teratoma, initially misdiagnosed as post-COVID syndrome. Pelvic CT identified the teratoma; patient improved with plasmapheresis and teratoma resection, emphasizing teratoma screening in paraneoplastic neurological syndromes.

title: Immature ovarian teratoma in a 20-year-old woman: A case report.
title_ja: 20歳女性における未熟卵巣奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳女性における腹部腫瘤として提示したグレードII未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例報告。若い女性に罹患することが多い稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍亜型である未熟卵巣奇形腫の臨床表現、画像診断所見、および管理上の課題について詳しくレビューしました。
summary_en: Case report of grade II immature ovarian teratoma in a 20-year-old woman presenting with abdominal mass. Reviews clinical presentation, imaging features, and management challenges of immature teratomas, a rare malignant germ cell tumor subtype in young women.

title: Twist-1 Stimulates the Malignant Behaviors of Hydatidiform Mole via the PI3K/AKT Pathway.
title_ja: Twist-1はPI3K/AKT経路を介して胞状奇胎の悪性振る舞いを促進する
summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の悪性化におけるTwist-1の役割を検討した研究。Twist-1抑制は上皮間葉転換とPI3K/AKT経路を抑制し、絨毛癌細胞の増殖、浸潤、転移を阻害した。
summary_en: Study investigating Twist-1's role in hydatidiform mole (HM) malignancy. Twist-1 silencing inhibited choriocarcinoma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion through suppressing epithelial-mesenchymal transition and PI3K/AKT pathway signaling.

title: Ex-vivo microscopic oncotesticular sperm extraction: step-by-step surgical technique at time of radical orchiectomy.
title_ja: 生体外顕微鏡下腫瘍精巣精子抽出：根治的精巣摘除術時のステップバイステップ手術手技
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における根治的精巣摘出術と同時実施の顕微鏡下精巣精子採取（m-OncoTESE）の外科技術を詳細に説明。精液が無精子症の患者から生殖能温存のため精子を採取・凍結保存した。
summary_en: Video presentation and technique guide for microscopic oncotesticular sperm extraction (m-OncoTESE) performed simultaneously with radical orchiectomy in testicular cancer patients. Successfully extracted and cryopreserved motile sperm for fertility preservation in an azoospermic seminoma patient.

title: Multifocality in Testicular Cancer: Clinicopathological Correlations and Prognostic Implications.
title_ja: 精巣がんの多病巣性：臨床病理学的相関と予後上の意義
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者280例における多発性と臨床病理学的特性の関連性検討。多発性は15.7%に認められ、より小さい一次腫瘍と関連していたが、進行期疾患の予後因子ではなかった。
summary_en: Study of 280 testicular cancer patients examining multifocality (distinct tumor foci >1mm). Multifocality occurred in 15.7%, associated with smaller primary tumors but not a significant prognostic factor for advanced disease.

title: Radiation Therapy for Stage IIA/B Seminoma: Modeling Secondary Cancer Risk for Protons and VMAT versus 3D Photons.
title_ja: 臨床病期IIA/B セミノーマに対する放射線療法：陽子ペンシルビーム走査とVMAT対3D光子線の二次がんリスクのモデリング
summary_ja: 臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する陽子ペンシルビーム走査、光子線VMAT、3D放射線療法の二次がん発症リスクを比較検討。PBSはリスク臓器への平均線量を60%削減し、他の方法より優れた用量削減と低い二次がん発症リスク予測を示し、晩期副作用を軽減する可能性がある。
summary_en: Compared secondary cancer risk from proton PBS, photon VMAT, and 3D radiotherapy for stage II seminoma. PBS achieved 60% dose reduction to organs-at-risk and lower secondary cancer risk.

title: Perspectives and Concerns on Late Effects Regarding Sexuality among Adolescents and Young Adults Treated for Testicular Germ Cell Tumor: The PRICELESS-Study-A Qualitative Study.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で治療された思春期・若年成人における晩期有害事象に関する性に関する展望と懸念：PRICELESS研究 - 質的研究
summary_ja: 精巣GCT治療後の思春期・若年成人13例の性的問題に関する定性研究。子供を望むこと、性的再発見、不安など7つのテーマが抽出され、性に関する支援方策の構築が推奨された。
summary_en: Qualitative study of 13 adolescents/young adults with testicular GCT examining sexuality-related late effects. Seven themes identified: desire for children, sexual rediscovery, performance anxiety, physical acceptance, masculinity loss, relationship burden, communication about sexuality.

title: MicroRNAs in Testicular Germ Cell Tumors: The Teratoma Challenge.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるマイクロRNA：奇形腫の課題
summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるマイクロRNAバイオマーカーのレビュー。miR-371a-3pは未分化GCTで発現されるが奇形腫では発現されない。miR-371とmiR-375の組み合わせは腫瘍の鑑別に有用。
summary_en: Review of microRNA biomarkers in testicular GCTs, focusing on challenges distinguishing teratomas. miR-371a-3p expressed in undifferentiated GCTs but not teratomas; combined miR-371/miR-375 panels differentiate viable tumors, teratomas, necrosis/fibrosis.

title: Identification of Germline FOXE1 and Somatic MAPK Pathway Gene Alterations in Patients with Malignant Struma Ovarii, Cleft Palate and Thyroid Cancer.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫、口蓋裂、甲状腺癌患者におけるFOXE1生殖系列変異と体細胞MAPK経路遺伝子変異の同定
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(異所性甲状腺を伴う卵巣奇形腫)、口蓋裂、甲状腺癌を伴う家族を対象とした研究。FOXE1およびAXIN1の生殖系列変異、ならびに腫瘍における体細胞BRAF/HRAS変異を同定した。FOXE1変異は遺伝子発現に影響を与え、MAPK経路活性化とともに悪性転化に寄与する可能性がある。
summary_en: Study of families with malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma with ectopic thyroid), cleft palate, thyroid cancer. Identified germline FOXE1 and AXIN1 variants; somatic BRAF/HRAS mutations in tumors. FOXE1 variants affect expression and contribute to malignant transformation.

title: The origins of human pluripotent stem cells: the road from a cancer to regenerative medicine.
title_ja: ヒト多能性幹細胞の起源：癌から再生医学への道
journal: In Vitro Cell Dev Biol Anim
summary_ja: 129系統マウスの胚細胞腫瘍感受性から始まり、胎児性癌細胞をテラトカルシノーマの幹細胞として同定し、初期胚の多能性細胞との関係を認識し、マウスおよびヒト由来の胚性幹細胞の導出へと至るまでの、癌遺伝学から再生医学への学問的発展の過程を辿った歴史的レビュー。
summary_en: Historical review tracing development from strain 129 mice susceptibility to germ cell tumors through embryonal carcinoma cells as teratocarcinoma stem cells, their relationship to embryonic pluripotent cells, to embryonic stem cell derivation and regenerative medicine.

title: Case report: remedial microdissection testicular sperm extraction after onco-microdissection testicular sperm extraction failure.
title_ja: 症例報告：腫瘍精巣からの精子抽出失敗後の補救的微小切開精巣精子抽出
summary_ja: 精巣がんと無精子症の若い男性2例。最初の採取に失敗したが、その後の補正的微小採取で精子採取に成功。がん治療中の生殖機能温存の機会を示唆。
summary_en: Case reports of two men with testicular cancer and azoospermia. Failed onco-microdissection TESE initially; remedial mTESE successfully recovered sperm in both. Demonstrates opportunities for fertility preservation in GCT despite treatment complications.

title: Therapeutic efficacy of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation in 44 relapsed or refractory germ-cell tumor patients: A retrospective cohort study.
title_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍患者44例に対する大量化学療法および自家造血幹細胞移植の治療効果：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性GCT患者44例に対する大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植の治療成績。化学療法後の最良奏効が生存の独立した予測因子であった。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 44 relapsed/refractory GCT patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation. Median PFS 7 months, OS 14.9 months. Best response to HDCT was strongest predictor of survival.

title: MR diagnosis of SCC arising within ovarian cystic teratomas: analysis of mural nodule characteristics.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した扁平上皮癌のMR診断：壁在結節の特性分析
summary_ja: 135例患者（卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内扁平上皮癌12例、良性MCT 123例）の後方視的MRI研究。壁在結節所見は感度83.3%、特異度97.6%で扁平上皮癌診断に有用。
summary_en: Retrospective MRI study of 135 patients (12 with squamous cell carcinoma in ovarian mature cystic teratoma, 123 benign). Mural nodule findings showed 83.3% sensitivity, 97.6% specificity for SCC-MCT diagnosis.

title: Burnt out testicular tumor - A case report.
title_ja: 消退精巣腫瘍 - 症例報告
summary_ja: 消退精巣腫瘍（治療なしで自発的に完全または部分的に退行する精巣胚細胞腫瘍）の症例報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体の約5%に発生。2016年WHO分類に含まれる。適切な管理のため臨床医の認識の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of burnt-out testicular tumor, spontaneous complete or partial regression of testicular GCT without treatment. Occurs in ~5% of testicular GCTs. Included in 2016 WHO classification. Emphasizes clinician awareness for proper management.

title: The Histopathological Spectrum of Scrotal Lesions in a Tertiary Care Hospital: A Cross-Sectional Study.
title_ja: 3次医療機関における陰嚢病変の病理組織学的スペクトラム：横断面研究
summary_ja: 70例の陰嚢腫瘤の横断面病理組織学的研究。非腫瘍性病変80%で精巣萎縮が最も一般的。腫瘍性病変20%でセミノーマが最頻（7例）。定期的な病理組織学的検査の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Cross-sectional histopathological study of 70 scrotal masses. 80% non-neoplastic lesions; testicular atrophy most common. 20% neoplastic; seminoma most frequent (7 cases). Emphasizes importance of routine histopathology.

title: Semen parameters in testicular tumor patients before orchiectomy: What is the impact of testicular tumor stage and histology?
title_ja: 精巣摘除術前の精巣腫瘍患者における精液パラメータ：精巣腫瘍病期と組織学的所見の影響は何か？
summary_ja: 精巣摘除術前精液凍結保存を受けた64例の精巣がん患者における精液パラメータを検討した後方視的研究。病期II/III患者は病期I患者と比較して前向き運動性および奇形精子症が低い。全ての精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者への精液凍結保存を推奨、特に転移性疾患で重要。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of semen parameters in 64 testicular cancer patients undergoing pre-orchiectomy cryopreservation. Stage II/III showed worse progressive motility and teratozoospermia than stage I. Recommends cryopreservation for all GCT patients.

title: Struma Ovarii With Extensive Peritoneal Implants Metastasis Revealed by 99m TcO 4 SPECT/CT.
title_ja: 99m TcO 4 SPECT/CTで明らかにされた腹膜播種転移を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫
summary_ja: 甲状腺組織を主とする卵巣奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）が広範な腹膜播種転移を呈した55歳女性の症例。初回摘出手術4年後の再発。腹部骨盤腔の複数結節が画像検査で確認され、病理組織学的検査で甲状腺様濾胞上皮を認定。全甲状腺摘除術および放射性ヨウ素療法で治療。
summary_en: Case report of struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma with thyroid tissue) with extensive peritoneal implants metastasis. 55-year-old with 4-year history of initial resection. Multiple abdominopelvic nodules confirmed as thyroid tissue. Treated with total thyroidectomy and 131I therapy.

title: Robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection as primary treatment for stage II seminoma germ cell tumor.
title_ja: 病期IIセミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍の一次治療としてのロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清
summary_ja: 病期IIAセミノーマ患者（24歳）に対するロボット支援二側後腹膜リンパ節郭清による治療の症例報告。手術時間4時間13分、出血量400ml、神経温存手術を施行。24時間以内に退院し、射精機能が保持。解剖病理学的結果に基づきEP 2サイクルの補助療法を追加。
summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old with stage IIA seminoma treated with robot-assisted bilateral RPLND. Surgery 4h13min, 400ml blood loss, nerve-sparing; patient discharged 24 hours with preserved ejaculation.

title: MicroRNA-320a enhances LRWD1 expression through the AGO2/FXR1-dependent pathway to affect cell behaviors and the oxidative stress response in human testicular embryonic carcinoma cells.
title_ja: マイクロRNA-320aはAGO2/FXR1依存経路を通じてLRWD1発現を増強し、ヒト精巣胚細胞がん細胞の細胞動態と酸化ストレス応答に影響を与える
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がん細胞においてマイクロRNA-320aがLRWD1（精子マーカー）を調節する機構を検討した研究。miR-320aはAGO2/FXR1依存経路を通じてLRWD1を正に調節し、細胞増殖を促進するとともに遊走・侵襲能を抑制し、酸化ストレス応答に影響する。
