summary_en: Study of miR-320a regulation of LRWD1 (sperm-specific marker) in testicular embryonic carcinoma cells. miR-320a positively regulated LRWD1 through AGO2/FXR1-dependent pathway, affecting cell proliferation, migration/invasion, and oxidative stress response.

title: Intratumoral Heterogeneity, Chemoresistance and Lymph Node Landing Zone Prognosis in Testicular Tumors Based on Histopathological Characteristics.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍における病理組織学的特性に基づく腫瘍内不均質性、化学療法耐性、リンパ節到達領域予後
summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の病理組織学的特性とリンパ節浸潤および化学療法耐性との相関を検討した研究。EYST/EYSグループで高リンパ節浸潤に関連。救援化学療法VIP反応率41%。NSGCTの管理プロトコル用の病理組織学的ノモグラムを提案。
summary_en: Study examining non-seminomatous GCT histopathological properties correlation with lymph node involvement and chemoresistance. EYST/EYS groups associated with high lymph node involvement. Salvage VIP response 41%. Proposed histopathological nomogram for NSGCT management.

title: Deep Learning for Subtypes Identification of Pure Seminoma of the Testis.
title_ja: 精巣純粋セミノーマの亜型同定のための深層学習
summary_ja: 精巣純セミノーマのサブタイプ識別のための深層学習ツール開発。ROC-AUC 0.896を達成。従来は識別不可能な形態学的相違を検出。
summary_en: Deep learning tool development for identifying two distinct pure seminoma subtypes from histopathological slides using TCGA samples. Achieved ROC-AUC 0.896. Discovered morphological differences between subtypes imperceptible to human eye.

title: A Comprehensive Review of Current Trends in the Diagnosis and Treatment of Ovarian Germ Cell Tumors.
title_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療における現在のトレンドの包括的レビュー
summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的レビュー。分類（ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍）、超音波検査およびMRIなどの画像検査と腫瘍マーカー（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCG）を用いた診断、FIGO病期分類、および手術、化学療法、標的療法、免疫療法を含む治療法をカバー。予後因子と管理上の課題に対応。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian germ cell tumors covering classification (dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, mixed GCT), diagnosis using imaging and tumor markers (AFP, hCG), FIGO staging, and treatment modalities including surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapies, and immunotherapy. Addresses prognosis factors and management challenges.

title: Retroperitoneal Sarcomatoid Yolk Sac Tumor in a Chemotherapy-Naive Patient With Testicular Postpubertal Type Teratoma: A Rare Case Report With Emphasis on Molecular Features.
title_ja: 精巣思春期後型奇形腫を有する化学療法未治療患者における後腹膜肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍:分子的特徴を強調した稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 精巣後思春期型奇形腫を伴う後腹膜肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例報告。ポリソミー12、MYC増幅、ARAF増幅、ATR変異を含む分子所見を記載。診断上の困難性と正確な分類のための免疫組織化学と分子研究の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of rare sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor in retroperitoneum occurring with testicular postpubertal teratoma. Describes molecular findings including polysomy 12, MYC amplification, ARAF amplification, and ATR mutation. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and importance of immunohistochemistry and molecular studies for accurate classification.

title: Survival differences in non-seminoma testis cancer patients according to race/ethnicity.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣がん患者の人種/民族による生存率の違い
summary_ja: SEER研究による13,515例の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者における人種/民族別がん特異的死亡率検討（2004-2019）。非白人で全病期にわたり死亡率が上昇。ヒスパニック系では全病期で上昇、アフリカ系米国人では病期IおよびIIIで上昇、アジア系は病期IIIのみで上昇。個別患者管理の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Population-based SEER study examining cancer-specific mortality in 13,515 non-seminoma testicular cancer patients by race/ethnicity (2004-2019). Non-Caucasians showed higher mortality across stages. Hispanics had higher hazard ratios at all stages; African-Americans at stages I and III; Asians only at stage III. Emphasizes importance of individualized patient management.

title: Macroscopy of specimens from the genitourinary system.
title_ja: 泌尿生殖器系標本の肉眼所見
summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器病理学における肉眼標本検査に関するレビュー。精巣摘除術標本における焦点非セミノーマ性成分の同定が患者管理に重要であることを強調。精巣胚細胞腫瘍および他の泌尿器科標本における臨床的に重要な所見を検出するための適切なサンプリング方法について述べる。
summary_en: Review of macroscopic specimen examination in genitourinary pathology. Emphasizes critical importance of identifying focal non-seminomatous components in orchidectomy specimens for patient management. Discusses adequate sampling protocols for testicular germ cell tumors and other urological specimens to detect clinically important findings.

title: Pulsatile giant sacrococcygeal teratoma appearing like 2nd head.
title_ja: 脈動性の巨大仙尾部奇形腫：第2の頭部のように出現
summary_ja: 5日齢男児に見られた脈動性の巨大仙尾部奇形腫症例。多様な硬さ、耳様付属器、毛髪、骨、壊死組織を伴う。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で不均一に増強される腫瘤が確認。全摘出術施行後、病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判定。術後経過良好でフォローアップ中。
summary_en: Case report of large sacrococcygeal teratoma in 5-day-old male presenting as pulsatile mass with variegated consistency, ear-like appendage, hair, bone, and necrotic tissue. MRI confirmed heterogeneously enhancing mass. Gross total excision performed with histopathology showing mature cystic teratoma. Uncomplicated postoperative course with good follow-up.

title: Outcome of patients with stage I immature teratoma after surveillance or adjuvant chemotherapy.
title_ja: 病期I未熟奇形腫患者におけるサーベイランスまたは補助化学療法後の転帰
summary_ja: 妊孕性温存手術を受けた74例の病期I卵巣未熟奇形腫患者の後方視的研究。中央値188ヶ月のフォローアップでサーベイランス(88%)と補助化学療法(12%)を比較。再発率に有意差なし(13.9% vs 11.1%)。5年無病生存率87-90%、全生存率100%。サーベイランスアプローチの実現可能性を支持。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 74 stage I ovarian immature teratoma patients treated with fertility-sparing surgery. Compared surveillance (88%) versus adjuvant chemotherapy (12%) with median 188-month follow-up. No significant difference in recurrence rates between groups (13.9% vs 11.1%). 5-year DFS 87-90%, OS 100% in both cohorts. Supports feasibility of surveillance approach.

title: Cross-individual cancer transmission to children during the gestational and perinatal periods.
title_ja: 妊娠および周生期における小児への個人間がん伝播
summary_ja: 妊娠・周産期間の個体間がん伝播に関するレビュー。母体がん細胞の胎児への伝播、ヒト絨毛膜癌の胎児伝播、一卵性双生児間の伝播の3つの病因を論述。小児体内でのがん細胞生存・定着の免疫学的機序と機序ベース免疫療法を考察。
summary_en: Review of cross-individual cancer transmission during gestation and perinatal periods. Discusses three etiologies: maternofetal transmission of maternal cancer, gestational choriocarcinoma transmission to fetus, and transfer between monozygotic twins. Summarizes immunological mechanisms enabling cancer cell survival in child and discusses mechanism-based immunotherapy approaches.

title: A population-based validation of the IGCCCG Update Consortium for survival in metastatic non-seminoma testis cancer.
title_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ精巣がんの生存に対するIGCCCG更新コンソーシアムの人口ベース検証
summary_ja: 1,672名の転移性非セミノーマ精巣がん患者(2010-2018年)におけるIGCCCG予後グループのSEER人口ベース検証研究。改善された5年全生存期間(全生存率)率を確認:94%(良好予後)、87%(中間予後)、65%(不良予後)。IGCCCG更新コンソーシアムの生存改善が優秀なセンターを超えて広い機関に適用されることを検証。
summary_en: Population-based SEER validation study of IGCCCG prognosis groups in 1,672 metastatic non-seminoma testicular cancer patients (2010-2018). Confirmed improved 5-year OS rates: 94% (good prognosis), 87% (intermediate), 65% (poor). Validated that IGCCCG Update Consortium survival improvements apply beyond centers of excellence to broader institutions.

title: New analysis of atypical spermatocytic tumours reveals extensive heterogeneity and plasticity of germ cell tumours(†).
title_ja: 非定型精子細胞腫瘍の新しい解析は胚細胞腫瘍の広範な異質性と可塑性を明らかにする
summary_ja: 非定型精子細胞腫瘍の分子解析。異なる2つの進展経路が明らかに：RAS/MAPK経路変異またはTP53変異/12p領域増加を伴う倍数性シフト。可塑性概念が全GCT型に適用され、内在的異質性と進展中の重大な形質転換能を示唆。
summary_en: Analysis of atypical spermatocytic tumors (type III GCT) revealing molecular heterogeneity with two distinct progression pathways: RAS/MAPK pathway mutations or ploidy shifts with TP53 mutations and/or chromosome 12p gain. Demonstrates plasticity concept applies to all GCT types, illustrating inherent heterogeneity and capability for significant transformation during progression.

title: Fetal Pericardial Teratoma: Perinatal Management and Example of Preterm Cesarean Birth to Resection.
title_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫：周産期管理と早産帝王切開から外科的切除までの例
summary_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠28週で非常に大きな奇形腫が診断され、出生前の侵襲的処置と早産分娩のリスク・ベネフィットについて学際的専門家によるコンサルテーションが実施された。計画的な早産帝王切開により乳児を出生させた後、直後に心肺バイパス下での外科的切除を施行し、良好な転帰を得た。
summary_en: Case report of very large fetal pericardial teratoma diagnosed at 28 weeks gestation. Multidisciplinary consultation led to planned preterm cesarean delivery for immediate postnatal surgical management. Infant underwent cardiopulmonary bypass and surgical resection with successful outcome.

title: Primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage II seminoma: A systematic review and meta-analysis of safety and oncological effectiveness.
title_ja: 臨床病期II精巣セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清:安全性および腫瘍学的有効性のシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析
summary_ja: 355名の病期IIセミノーマ患者における一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を実施した8つの研究のシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析。全体的再発率14%(領内4%)、4%≥病期III合併症。順行性射精が98%のケースで保存。臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する一次RLPNDは安全で有効な治療選択肢、優れた治癒率。
summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies with 355 stage II seminoma patients undergoing primary RPLND. Overall recurrence rate 14% (infield 4%) with 4% ≥grade III complications. Antegrade ejaculation preserved in 98% of cases. Concluded primary RPLND is safe and effective treatment option for CS II seminomatous GCT with excellent cure rates.

title: Survival difference among adult and pediatric mediastinal yolk sac tumors cases: A meta-analysis of case reports.
title_ja: 成人および小児縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍症例のメタ解析による生存差の検討
summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍130患者（成人90例、小児40例）を含む87試験のメタ分析。年齢別全生存率差なし（23vs25ヶ月）。3・5年全生存率は成人34.4%・22.9%、小児41.5%・41.5%。腹側位置、化学療法、手術と良好な転帰の関連。早期診断と治療の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Meta-analysis of 87 studies including 130 mediastinal yolk sac tumor patients (90 adults, 40 pediatrics). No significant age-related OS difference (23 vs 25 months). 3- and 5-year OS 34.4% and 22.9% (adults) vs 41.5% and 41.5% (pediatrics). Anterior tumor location, chemotherapy receipt, and surgery associated with better outcomes. Emphasizes importance of early diagnosis and treatment.

title: Prolonged survival after thoracic metastasectomy in patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者における胸部転移摘出術後の延長生存
summary_ja: 化学療法後の胸部転移を有する非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者37名の後方視的研究。化学療法と根治的手術を組み合わせた多面的治療で10年全生存期間(全生存率)94.3%を達成。一次腫瘍型として奇形腫(40.5%)および胎児性癌(40.5%)が優位、転移で奇形腫が主流(70.3%)。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 37 non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients with intrathoracic metastasis after chemotherapy. Multimodality treatment combining chemotherapy with radical surgery achieved 10-year OS of 94.3% with no surgical mortality. Teratoma (40.5%) and embryonal carcinoma (40.5%) were prevalent primary histologies; 70.3% teratoma in metastases.

title: Invasive micropapillary carcinoma of the breast and bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratoma with benign Brenner tumor in a postmenopausal woman - An uncommon occurrence.
title_ja: 閉経後女性における乳房侵襲的微乳頭癌と両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫および良性ブレンナー腫瘍:稀な同時性発症
summary_ja: 58歳閉経後女性における乳房侵襲的微乳頭癌および偶然発見された良性ブレンナー腫瘍を伴う両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。稀な同時性発症として非ヘレディタリー同時性腫瘍として文書化。正確な診断における免疫組織化学の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report of 58-year-old postmenopausal woman with invasive micropapillary carcinoma of breast and incidentally discovered bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas with benign Brenner tumor. Unusual synchronous presentation documented as non-hereditary synchronous tumors. Emphasizes importance of immunohistochemistry in accurate diagnosis.

title: A Complete Hydatidiform Mole Complicated by Theca Lutein Cysts in a Teenager: A Rare Case.
title_ja: 思春期少女に見られた胞状奇胎を複雑にするテカ黄体嚢腫の稀な症例
summary_ja: テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞を伴う完全子宮胎盤奇胎の少女症例。異常出血、上昇したhCG、過度嘔吐、子癇前症で呈示。テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞は子宮胎盤奇胎に関連する良性ホルモン応答性嚢胞。保存的管理と妊娠後の自然消退を論述。
summary_en: Case report of complete hydatidiform mole complicated by theca lutein cysts in teenager. Presented with abnormal bleeding, elevated hCG, hyperemesis, and pregnancy-induced hypertension. Theca lutein cysts are benign, hormonally responsive cysts associated with molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic disease. Discusses conservative management and spontaneous resolution after pregnancy.

title: Ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis with severe features.
title_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎の重篤例
summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を有する若い女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。脳脊髄液IgG抗体検査によりNMDARのGluNR1およびGluNR2サブユニットに対する陽性を確認。奇形腫の外科的切除と複数の免疫調整療法で治療。
summary_en: Case report of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis in young woman with ovarian teratoma. Diagnosis confirmed by cerebrospinal fluid IgG antibodies against GluNR1 and GluNR2 subunits of NMDAR. Treated with surgical resection of teratoma and multiple immunomodulatory therapies for management of paraneoplastic encephalitis.

title: Chemotherapy is not needed when complete evacuation of gestational choriocarcinoma leads to hCG normalization.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の完全摘出によるhCG正常化時には化学療法は不要である
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌患者80名が化学療法なしで腫瘍除去後のhCG正常化を達成した多施設国際後方視的研究。中央値50ヶ月のフォローアップ中に再発なし。FIGO/WHOリスクスコア≤6が93.7%のケースに該当。基準センターの厳選された患者における補助化学療法なしの期待的管理が安全なアプローチである可能性が示唆。
summary_en: Multicenter international retrospective study of 80 gestational choriocarcinoma patients achieving hCG normalization after tumor removal without chemotherapy. Zero recurrence during median 50-month follow-up. FIGO/WHO risk score ≤6 in 93.7% of cases. Suggests expectant management without adjuvant chemotherapy may be safe approach for highly selected gestational choriocarcinoma patients in reference centers.

title: Risk for testicular germ cell tumors and spermatogenesis failure in post-pubertal undescended testes.
title_ja: 思春期後停留精巣における精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクと精子形成障害
summary_ja: 治療されていない停留精巣を有する思春期後患者23名(2010-2019年)の後方視的研究。1名(4%)がセミノーマを有していた。停留精巣における正常な精子形成は観察されず、19名が精細管の欠損、3名が成熟停止を示した。片側停留精巣を有する思春期後男性における精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスク低下を目的とした精巣摘除術を支持。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 23 post-pubertal patients with untreated cryptorchidism undergoing orchiectomy (2010-2019). One patient (4%) had seminoma. No normal spermatogenesis observed in any undescended testis; 19 patients lacked seminiferous tubules, 3 showed maturation arrest. Results support orchiectomy in post-pubertal males with unilateral cryptorchidism to reduce GCT risk.

title: Two tumor types in a unilateral testis in a patient with severe oligozoospermia and a history of cryptorchidism surgery: A case report.
title_ja: 重度乏精子症と停留精巣手術既往を有する患者の片側精巣における2つの腫瘍:症例報告
summary_ja: 停留精巣手術既往と重度乏精子症を有する38歳男性の左精巣における2つの異なる腫瘍(頭側セミノーマ、尾側に胚細胞新生物)の症例報告。精巣摘除術後、腫瘍マーカーとホルモンレベルは正常化し、精液パラメータが改善。片側精巣における2つの腫瘍タイプの報告は初例。
summary_en: Case report of 38-year-old male with two distinct tumors in left testis: cranial seminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic cells and caudal mass showing germ cell neoplasia in situ. Patient had severe oligozoospermia with cryptorchidism surgery history. Underwent orchiectomy with tumor marker normalization and improved semen parameters postoperatively. First reported case of two tumor types in unilateral testis.

title: 46, XX disorder of sexual development associated with mixed germ cell tumor of the prostate: a rare case report.
title_ja: 前立腺の混合型胚細胞腫瘍を伴う46,XX性分化疾患：稀な症例報告
summary_ja: 40歳の46,XX性分化疾患患者の前立腺における卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。全ゲノムシーケンシングにより高い体細胞変異負荷と46,XX（SRY+）核型が確認された。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇、ゴナドトロピン上昇、テストステロン低値を呈示。
summary_en: Rare case of mixed germ cell tumor (with yolk sac tumor and teratoma components) in the prostate of a 40-year-old with 46,XX disorder of sexual development. Whole-genome sequencing revealed high somatic mutational load and confirmed karyotype as 46,XX (SRY+). Patient presented with elevated AFP, elevated gonadotropins, and low testosterone levels. Case advances understanding of genetic and phenotypic profiles.

title: Paraneoplastic Hyperthyroidism Secondary to a Chemotherapy-Induced Surge in β-hCG in a Patient with Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法誘発性β-hCG上昇に続発する傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症
summary_ja: ステージIIIc非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の初回化学療法から4日以内に化学療法誘発性β-hCG上昇により傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症が生じた21歳男性の初の報告症例。
summary_en: First documented case of paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism triggered by chemotherapy-induced surge in β-hCG in a 21-year-old with stage IIIc non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Thyrotoxicosis developed within 4 days of initial chemotherapy. This first peer-reviewed report expands understanding of hCG-mediated endocrine complications in GCT patients during cancer treatment.

title: Cytoreductive Surgery and Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy to Treat Pseudomyxoma Peritonei of Ovarian Origin: A Retrospective French RENAPE Group Study.
title_ja: 卵巣由来腹膜偽粘液腫治療のための減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法：フランスRENAPEグループ後方視的研究
summary_ja: 卵巣由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者に対する減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法のフランス後方視的研究。15例中60%が卵巣奇形腫内またはその由来の粘液性新生物。卵巣奇形腫由来の腹膜偽粘液腫は5年・10年で100%の無病生存率。
summary_en: Retrospective French study of cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for ovarian pseudomyxoma peritonei (OPMP). Among 15 patients, 60% involved mucinous neoplasms arising within or from ovarian teratomas. OPMP of teratomatous origin showed superior disease-free survival (100% at 5 and 10 years).

title: Prenatally Diagnosed Congenital Oral Teratoma Successfully Treated in a Neonate.
title_ja: 出生前に診断された先天性口腔奇形腫の新生児における成功した治療
summary_ja: 出生前診断された新生児先天性口腔奇形腫症例。妊娠30週の胎児MRI所見により多職種チーム管理を決定し、予定帝王切開後に速やかに腫瘍摘出術を実施。気道開存を確保し良好な予後を得た。
summary_en: Case report of prenatally diagnosed congenital oral teratoma in a neonate. Fetal MRI at 30 weeks guided multidisciplinary management, leading to planned cesarean delivery at 38 weeks. Immediate postnatal surgery ensured airway patency and successful tumor resection with no postoperative complications at three-month follow-up.

title: Immature Sacrococcygeal Teratoma: A Case Report and Extensive Review of the Literature.
title_ja: 未熟仙尾部奇形腫：症例報告と文献の広範なレビュー
summary_ja: 未熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。成熟型と比較して急速な増殖、高い再発リスク、高い死亡率を特徴とし、出生前診断と適切な治療管理の重要性を強調。
summary_en: Case report and extensive literature review of immature sacrococcygeal teratoma. This histological form exhibits rapid growth, higher recurrence risk, and increased mortality compared to mature types. Paper emphasizes importance of prenatal diagnosis and optimal therapeutic management for improving prognosis in immature teratoma cases.

title: A Risk of Gonadoblastoma in Familial Swyer Syndrome-A Case Report and Literature Review.
title_ja: 家族性スウィア症候群におけるゴナドブラストーマのリスク：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 家族性Swyer症候群患者における性腺芽腫症例報告。家族性症例での悪性腫瘍リスクが散発例より高い（66.6% vs 15-45%）ことを示唆。予防的性腺摘出術と長期ホルモン補充療法が推奨される。
summary_en: Case report of gonadoblastoma in two siblings with familial Swyer syndrome (46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis). Literature review suggests familial cases have significantly higher gonadal tumor risk (66.6%) compared to sporadic cases (15-45%). Preventive gonadectomy and long-term hormonal replacement therapy are recommended management.

title: A Case Report of Carcinoid With Teratoma Arising From the Renal Hilum.
title_ja: 腎門に発生した奇形腫を伴うカルチノイドの症例報告
summary_ja: 49歳女性の腎門に発生した稀な混合型胚細胞腫瘍（カルチノイドを伴う奇形腫）。組織学的に単純嚢胞内の奇形腫様組織から発生するカルチノイドを確認。この部位での性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の稀有性を強調。
summary_en: Rare case report of mixed germ cell tumor (carcinoid with teratoma) arising from renal hilum in 49-year-old woman. Histological examination revealed carcinoid tumor arising from teratomatous tissue within simple cyst. Tumor appeared independent of kidney parenchyma, highlighting rarity of extragonadal GCTs at this site.

title: Atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation following surgical treatment of a cervical teratoma in a child: a case report.
title_ja: 小児の頸部奇形腫の外科的治療後に生じた環軸椎回転性亜脱臼：症例報告
summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫の外科治療後に発生した後頭環椎回旋脱臼症例。4歳女児が頸部手術後に軸椎亜脱臼を発症。段階的治療により症状改善。小児頭頸部外科における稀有な術後合併症。
summary_en: Case report of atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation (AARS) as complication following neck surgery in 4-year-old girl with cervical teratoma. Patient received one month of conservative management with serial treatment, resulting in symptom improvement and resolution of neck tilt. Raises awareness of rare postoperative complication.

title: Split-bolus single-phase versus single-bolus split-phase CT acquisition protocols for staging in patients with testicular cancer: A retrospective study.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者の病期分類における分割ボーラス単一相型と単一ボーラス分割相型コンピュータ断層撮影撮影プロトコルの比較：後方視的研究
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者45例の監視コンピュータ断層撮影における撮影プロトコル比較。分割ボーラス単一相プロトコルは放射線量を21.5%削減しながら診断許容性を維持。精巣がんフォローアップにおける放射線安全性を改善。
summary_en: Retrospective comparison of CT imaging protocols (split-bolus single-phase vs. single-bolus split-phase) in 45 testicular cancer patients undergoing surveillance imaging. Split-bolus protocol achieved 21.5% radiation dose reduction while maintaining diagnostic acceptability. Demonstrates improved radiation safety in testicular cancer follow-up.

title: Adenocarcinoma of sigmoid colon with metastasis to an ovarian mature teratoma: A case report.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫への転移を伴うS状結腸腺がん：症例報告
summary_ja: 結腸腺癌が卵巣成熟奇形腫に転移した腫瘍間転移症例。41歳女性患者に大腸がんの多臓器転移と左卵巣奇形腫を認定。手術で奇形腫内の転移腺癌を確認。大腸がん患者における奇形腫切除の重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from sigmoid colon adenocarcinoma to mature ovarian teratoma in 41-year-old woman. Patient presented with metastatic colorectal cancer involving liver, lungs, bone, and ovarian teratoma. Exploratory surgery revealed metastatic adenocarcinoma in mature ovarian teratoma. Highlights importance of teratoma resection to prevent secondary metastasis.

title: Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumour Mimicking Placenta Previa.
title_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が胎盤前置を模倣する症例
summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患を示唆する胎盤前置として初期管理された3回の帝王切開既往を有する42歳ナイジェリア人女性。帝王切開子宮全摘術で病理組織学的に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断。
summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in 42-year-old Nigerian woman with three prior cesarean sections, initially managed conservatively for suspected placenta previa. Cesarean hysterectomy revealed PSTT on histopathology. Case highlights diagnostic challenges of gestational trophoblastic disease mimicking placental abnormalities.

title: Analysis of clinical characteristics, treatment patterns, and outcome of patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の臨床的特性、治療パターン、および転帰の分析
summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（異時性24例、同時性16例）40例の多施設後方視的分析。両側疾患は若い年齢で発症し、より進行した疾患を呈し、β-hCG上昇とリンパ節転移がより頻繁。同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍は異時性例より疾患特異的死亡率が18%高かった。
summary_en: Multicenter retrospective analysis of 40 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors (24 metachronous, 16 synchronous) compared to unilateral cases. Bilateral disease presented at younger age with more advanced disease, elevated β-hCG levels, and higher nodal involvement. Synchronous bilateral GCT showed 18% higher disease-specific mortality.

title: Controlled ovarian stimulation in cancer patients under 18 years old; a case series.
title_ja: 18歳未満のがん患者における卵巣刺激：症例集積
summary_ja: 18歳未満のがん患者9例における卵巣刺激と卵母細胞凍結保存の症例集積。うち2例は胚細胞腫瘍患者（ディスジャーミノーマ1例、胚細胞腫瘍1例）で、化学療法前の思春期胚細胞腫瘍患者における生殖能温存の実行可能性を示した。
summary_en: Case series of controlled ovarian stimulation with oocyte cryopreservation in 9 adolescent cancer patients (<18 years) prior to cancer treatment. Two patients had germ cell tumors (one dysgerminoma, one GCT). Study demonstrates feasibility of fertility preservation in adolescents with GCT before chemotherapy and provides outcome data on oocyte recovery and cryopreservation.

title: Aneuploid embryonic stem cells drive teratoma metastasis.
title_ja: 異倍体胚性幹細胞が奇形腫の転移を駆動する
summary_ja: 異数性胚盤葉幹細胞由来の奇形腫は、追加変異なしに高いステムネスと不全なプロテアソーム活性を示し転移能を有する。プロテアソーム活性化剤とER応力阻害薬が転移抑制に有効。
summary_en: Teratomas derived from aneuploid murine embryonic stem cells demonstrate metastatic capacity through high stemness populations with deficient proteasome activity and ER stress, independent of additional genetic mutations. Proteasome activators and ER stress inhibitors effectively suppress aneuploid teratoma metastasis.

title: Beta-HCG Secretion by a Pulmonary Choriocarcinoma in a Male Patient.
title_ja: 男性患者における肺絨毛癌によるBeta-hCG分泌
summary_ja: 65歳男性の肺原発絨毛癌でβ-hCG産生があり、両側乳房女性化を呈した稀な症例。両側肺病変と脳転移を認め、化学免疫療法で部分奏効を得た。
summary_en: Rare case of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with β-hCG secretion in a 65-year-old male presenting with bilateral gynecomastia. Bilateral pulmonary lesions and brain metastasis identified; treated with carboplatin-etoposide-pembrolizumab achieving partial response.

title: Mediastinal teratoma in children: A case series of misdiagnoses in a high-endemic tuberculosis setting.
title_ja: 小児における縦隔奇形腫：結核高流行地域における誤診の症例集積
summary_ja: 結核高流行地域で初期に結核と誤診された小児の縦隔奇形腫2症例。開胸手術により成熟奇形腫が確認され、良好な長期転帰が得られ再発はなかった。
summary_en: Case series of two children with mediastinal teratoma initially misdiagnosed as tuberculosis in a TB-endemic setting. Both underwent thoracotomy; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with satisfactory long-term outcomes and no recurrence.

title: Primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma in a young female: Case report.
title_ja: 若年女性における原発性後腹膜成熟奇形腫：症例報告
summary_ja: 20歳女性の後腹膜成熟奇形腫例。腹痛で発症、画像診断とCA19.9高値で診断。完全切除で治癒、再発なし。
summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old female with primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma presenting with abdominal pain. Imaging and elevated CA19.9 were diagnostic; complete surgical resection was curative with excellent postoperative outcome.

title: Testicular cancer with small metastatic burden: optimal approach in 2024.
title_ja: 転移病巣が小さい精巣がん：2024年の最適アプローチ
summary_ja: 臨床病期II精巣がん管理における最近の進歩。選択的セミノーマ患者への一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清と補助化学療法の減量。新規バイオマーカーマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリスク層別化。
summary_en: Review of clinical stage II testicular cancer management advances, including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for seminoma and adjuvant chemotherapy de-escalation. Discusses novel biomarkers like microRNA-371a-3p for risk stratification and personalized approaches.

title: Rare pediatric synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors of different pathological types: a case report.
title_ja: 異なる病理組織型の稀な小児同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍：症例報告
summary_ja: 小児の両側精巣腫瘍（左卵黄嚢腫、右成熟奇形腫）同時性例。左精巣摘除と右精巣温存手術。後腹膜再発に化学療法実施。
summary_en: Pediatric case of synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histologies: left yolk sac tumor and right mature teratoma. Left orchiectomy with right testis-sparing surgery performed; retroperitoneal recurrence treated successfully with chemotherapy.

title: Molecular profiling of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia: Identifying therapeutic targets.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の分子プロフィリング：治療標的の同定
summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜疾患の分子プロファイリング。高PD-L1陽性率を確認。治療標的としてWee1、PARP、MEK阻害薬を特定。
summary_en: Molecular profiling of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia including choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumors (ETT), and placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT). Identifies high PD-L1 positivity and potential therapeutic targets including Wee1, PARP, and MEK inhibitors.

title: MAEL in human cancers and implications in prognostication and predicting benefit from immunotherapy over VEGFR/mTOR inhibitors in clear cell renal cell carcinoma: a bioinformatic analysis.
title_ja: ヒトのがんにおけるMAELと明細胞腎細胞がんにおける免疫療法対VEGFR/mTOR阻害薬の予測的価値：バイオインフォマティクス解析
summary_ja: バイオインフォマティクス解析でMAELが精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む複数のがんで高発現。ccRCCではMAEL発現が予後と関連。低MAEL発現は免疫療法の治療効果利益を示唆。患者選別の有用性。
summary_en: Bioinformatic analysis of MAEL expression across human cancers including testicular germ cell tumors. MAEL expression correlates with treatment response and prognosis in various malignancies.

title: Paradigm Shifting Research: Key Studies in Urologic Oncology.
title_ja: パラダイム転換研究：泌尿器腫瘍学における重要研究
summary_ja: 泌尿器悪性腫瘍の総説。精巣セミノーマのリンパ節郭清に関するSEMS試験を含む。
summary_en: Review of paradigm-shifting studies in urologic oncology including SEMS trial on retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular seminoma with limited nodal metastases.

title: Valproic acid elevates HIF-1α-mediated CGB expression and suppresses glucose uptake in BeWo cells.
title_ja: バルプロ酸はHIF-1α仲介性CGB発現を上昇させ、BeWo細胞のグルコース取り込みを抑制する
summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞株を用いた研究。バルプロ酸がHIF-1α経由でCGB発現を上昇させ、glucose摂取を抑制。妊娠性栄養膜疾患関連。
summary_en: Study using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells investigating valproic acid effects on placental function. VPA elevated chorionic gonadotropin β (CGB) expression and suppressed glucose uptake through HIF-1α-mediated mechanisms relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease.

title: Assessing the risk to develop a growing teratoma syndrome based on molecular and epigenetic subtyping as well as novel secreted biomarkers.
title_ja: 分子およびエピジェネティック亜型分類ならびに新規分泌バイオマーカーに基づくgrowing teratoma syndromeの発症リスク評価
summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるgrowing teratoma syndromの分子およびエピジェネティック特性評価。循環バイオマーカーの特定、成長率による分層、化学療法後に持続する潜在的な非セミノーマ性成分の示唆。
summary_en: Molecular and epigenetic characterization of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in germ cell tumors. Identifies circulating biomarkers, stratifies GTS by growth rate, and suggests occult non-seminomatous components may persist after chemotherapy in teratomas.

title: Initial surveillance in men with marker negative clinical stage IIA non-seminomatous germ cell tumours.
title_ja: マーカー陰性病期IIA非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における初期監視
summary_ja: CS IIA marker陰性NSGCT患者の監視療法研究。RPLND病理：70%生存癌、26%良性リンパ節、6%奇形腫。
summary_en: Prospective study of clinical stage IIA marker-negative NSGCTs managed with surveillance and CT imaging. RPLND histopathology showed 70% viable cancer, 26% benign nodes, and 6% teratoma, identifying patients with occult disease.

title: Infantile fetiform abdominal mass: Teratoma or fetus in fetu? A case report with insights into radiological diagnosis and surgical management.
title_ja: 幼児の胎児様腹部腫瘤：奇形腫か胎児在胎児か？放射線学的診断および外科的管理に関する知見を伴う症例報告
summary_ja: 腹部腫瘤の奇形腫対胎児内胎児の鑑別診断。画像診断で胎児内胎児と確認。腫瘍マーカー正常。
summary_en: Pediatric case of abdominal mass initially suspected to be teratoma or fetus-in-fetu. Imaging confirmed fetus-in-fetu diagnosis; normal serum tumor markers. Illustrates diagnostic differentiation between these entities.

title: Imaging features of mucinous carcinoma arising from mature teratoma showing cytokeratin 7+ and cytokeratin 20+ expression profile: A case report.
title_ja: 成熟奇形腫から発生した粘液性癌の画像特性：シトケラチン7+およびシトケラチン20+発現プロフィール示す症例報告
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫からの粘液性腺癌例。多房性嚢胞性腫瘍で異常なFDG-PET集積。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化を議論。
summary_en: Case report of mucinous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma showing atypical cytokeratin expression profile. Imaging demonstrates multilocular cystic mass with abnormal FDG-PET uptake. Discusses malignant transformation risk in mature teratomas.

title: Predictive tissue markers in testicular germ cell tumors: Immunohistochemical expression of MLH1 and REV-7 proteins.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における予測的組織マーカー：MLH1およびREV-7タンパク質の免疫組織化学的発現
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者64例を対象とした後方視的研究で、MLH1およびREV-7の免疫組織化学的発現を予測的マーカーとして検討。REV-7陽性は化学療法耐性と不良予後と強く関連していた。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 64 testicular germ cell tumor patients examining immunohistochemical expression of MLH1 and REV-7 as predictive markers. REV-7 positivity strongly associated with chemoresistance and poor prognosis.

title: Mature cystic ovarian teratoma with squamous cell carcinoma transformation: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の扁平上皮癌への悪性転化：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が扁平上皮癌に悪性化した症例。66歳閉経後女性。免疫組織化学によりCK5/6およびP63陽性を確認。高齢および腫瘍の大きさが危険因子。ステージIA患者の予後は良好で化学療法不要。
summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratoma in a 66-year-old woman. Discusses risk factors including advanced age and large tumor size, histopathology findings, and favorable prognosis in stage IA disease without requiring chemotherapy.

title: Surgical management of mediastinal mature cystic teratoma of the elderly remaining asymptomatic.
title_ja: 無症状のままの高齢者の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の外科的管理
summary_ja: 70歳女性の縦隔に発見された大型腫瘤が70年以上無症状で経過。右後側方開胸術により完全切除。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認。血清hCGおよびAFP値は正常。予後は良好。
summary_en: Case report of a 70-year-old woman with a voluminous mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest X-ray, remaining asymptomatic for over 70 years. Surgical resection via posterolateral thoracotomy confirmed histologically as mature cystic teratoma with excellent prognosis.

title: Ovarian tumors in the pediatric population: An update.
title_ja: 小児集団における卵巣腫瘍:更新
summary_ja: 17歳以下女児の卵巣腫瘍の包括的レビュー。疫学、危険因子、臨床症状、診断、鑑別診断、治療選択肢を網羅。妊孕性温存手術と小児・思春期患者への心理的影響に注目。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian tumors in females under 17 years, covering epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentations, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and treatment options. Emphasizes fertility-sparing surgery and psychological impacts on children and adolescents.

title: The Rare of the Rarest: Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumor, Epithelioid Trophoblastic Tumor, Atypical Placental Site Nodule.
title_ja: 最も稀なもの:胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、上皮様トロホブラスト腫瘍、非定型胎盤部結節
summary_ja: 絨毛膜疾患の稀な亜型3つ（ETT、PSTT、APSN）の診断的特徴、臨床特性、標準治療、妊孕性温存療法を網羅。中間トロホブラストから発生する稀な腫瘍の新しい知見を提供。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and atypical placental site nodule (APSN). Covers diagnostic features, clinical characteristics, standard treatment, and fertility-sparing management strategies.

title: Patients and general practitioner knowledge and perception of testicular self-examination for cancer.
title_ja: 癌に対する精巣自己検査に関する患者および一般開業医の知識および知覚
summary_ja: 睾丸がん自己検診に関する一般男性と医師の知識・認識を調査。医師の8.9%しかスクリーニング検査を実施せず、男性の77.5%は自己検診方法を認識しておらず、知識ギャップが明白。
summary_en: Survey assessing knowledge and perceptions of testicular self-examination for cancer detection among general practitioners and males aged 15-45. Found significant gaps: only 8.9% of GPs perform screening, and 77.5% of males don't know how to perform self-examination.

title: Propensity-matched Analysis of Open Versus Robotic Primary Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection for Clinical Stage II Testicular Cancer.
title_ja: 病期II精巣がんに対する開腹的およびロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の傾向スコアマッチング分析
summary_ja: 病期II精巣がんに対する開腹的対ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の傾向スコアマッチング分析。ロボット支援アプローチは短い入院期間と低い出血量を示しながら、腫瘍学的有効性を維持していた。神経温存を含む標準的管理アルゴリズムへの組み入れが推奨される。
summary_en: Propensity-matched analysis comparing open versus robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage II testicular cancer. Robotic approach showed shorter hospital stay and lower blood loss without compromising oncologic efficacy.

title: The prognostic impact of treatment centralization in patients with testicular germ cell tumors: analysis of hospital-based cancer registry data in Japan.
title_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における治療集約化の予後的影響：日本のがん登録データ分析
summary_ja: 日本の病院ベースがん登録における1,767人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。病期II-III患者は低容量施設での5年生存率が著明に低く、治療集約化により転帰が改善することを示す。
summary_en: Hospital-based cancer registry analysis of 1,767 testicular GCT patients in Japan (seminoma and non-seminoma). Shows stage II-III patients at low-volume institutions had significantly worse 5-year survival, indicating treatment centralization improves outcomes.

title: Neonatal Sacrococcygeal Fetiform Teratoma Containing Bowel: A Case Report.
title_ja: 腸を含有する新生児仙尾部胎児様奇形腫:症例報告
summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫（fetiform type）の症例。腸など完全に形成された構造を含む。組織学的に成熟型であり悪性所見なし。術後14ヶ月で良好に経過。AFP値3.5 μg/L。
summary_en: Case report of a 5-day-old neonate with type II sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma (homunculus). Surgical excision revealed fully formed bowel, bones, and well-defined structures. Histopathology confirmed mature features without malignancy.

title: Sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adult female patient-case report and review of literature.
title_ja: 成人女性患者の仙尾部奇形腫-症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 小児期から診断された20歳女性患者の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。緩徐成長する骨盤外腫瘤として、圧迫症状で発症。外科的切除により成熟奇形腫が確認された。悪性転化の危険性は1-2%である。
summary_en: Case report of a 20-year-old female with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed since childhood, presenting as a slowly growing extraperitoneal mass causing compression. Surgical resection confirmed mature teratoma; 1-2% malignant transformation risk noted.

title: The increasing burden of testicular seminomas and non-seminomas in adolescents and young adults (AYAs): incidence, treatment, disease-specific survival and mortality trends in the Netherlands between 1989 and 2019.
title_ja: 青年・若年成人における精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの増加傾向：1989-2019年オランダデータ
summary_ja: オランダ(1989-2019)で診断された12,528人の精巣がん(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。青年・若年成人における発生率は著明に増加。放射線療法使用は78%から5%に低下。積極的監視を受けた患者が大半で、20年生存率は90%を超える。
summary_en: Analysis of 12,528 testicular cancers (seminoma and non-seminoma) diagnosed in Netherlands (1989-2019) among adolescents and young adults. Incidence increased significantly; radiotherapy declined from 78% to 5%; most received active surveillance with >90% 20-year survival.

title: SMARCB1-Deficient Skull Base Chondrosarcoma with 12p Duplication Presenting as Somatic-Type Malignancy Arising from Metastatic Seminoma.
title_ja: 転移性セミノーマ由来の体細胞型悪性腫瘍：SMARCB1欠損頭蓋底軟骨肉腫(12p重複)
summary_ja: 39歳男性の転移性精巣セミノーマから生じた頭蓋底軟骨肉腫(体細胞型悪性腫瘍)の症例報告。上横隔膜リンパ節腫大を伴う。胚細胞腫瘍の稀だが重大な合併症で、分子特性が異なり予後不良である。
summary_en: Case report of skull base chondrosarcoma arising as somatic-type malignancy from metastatic testicular seminoma in a 39-year-old man with supradiaphragmatic lymphadenopathy. Demonstrates rare but serious complication of GCT with divergent molecular features and poor prognosis.

title: First case of synchronous Leydig cell tumor and spermatocytic tumor in the unilateral testis.
title_ja: 片側精巣における同時性Leydig細胞腫瘍と精子細胞腫瘍の初報告症例
summary_ja: 84歳男性における片側精巣に発生した同時性Leydig細胞腫瘍（性索間質腫瘍）と精子細胞腫瘍（胚細胞腫瘍）の初報告症例。異なる起源を有する両腫瘍が同一精巣で同時に発生することは極めて稀であり、臨床的に重要な症例である。
summary_en: First reported case of synchronous Leydig cell tumor (sex cord-stromal tumor) and spermatocytic tumor (germ cell tumor) in a single testis of an 84-year-old male. These tumors rarely coexist due to their different origins.

title: Impact of a one-year supervised physical activity program on long-term cancer-related fatigue and mediating effects of the gut microbiota in metastatic testicular cancer patients: protocol of the prospective multicentre, randomized controlled phase-III STARTER trial.
title_ja: 転移性精巣がん患者における1年間の監視下身体活動プログラムの長期癌関連疲労への影響と腸内微生物叢の仲介効果：STARTER試験の前向き多施設ランダム化対照第III相プロトコル
summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者においてシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けている際の1年間の監視下身体活動プログラムが癌関連疲労に及ぼす影響を評価する第III相試験プロトコル。腸内微生物叢とその代謝産物の潜在的仲介効果を調査する。
summary_en: Phase-III trial protocol evaluating one-year supervised physical activity program's impact on cancer-related fatigue in metastatic testicular germ cell tumor patients receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy, investigating gut microbiota as potential mediator.

title: Pure testicular choriocarcinoma, a rare and highly malignant subtype with challenging treatment: A case report and review of the literature.
title_ja: 純粋精巣絨毛癌、治療が困難な稀で極めて悪性の亜型：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: 精巣純粋絨毛膜癌は生殖細胞腫瘍の中で最も稀で高い悪性度を有し、早期血行性転移を特徴とする。65歳患者の化学療法への部分奏効例を報告し、免疫療法の可能性について検討している。
summary_en: Rare case of pure testicular choriocarcinoma in 65-year-old with partial chemotherapy response. Reviews characteristics and therapeutic principles; discusses emerging targeted and immune-based therapies showing potential for maintenance therapy in advanced GCTs.

title: A 12 Week Fetus with Anophthalmia, Limb Anomalies and Infratemporal Teratoma.
title_ja: 眼球欠損、肢体異常、および耳下腺部奇形腫を伴う妊娠12週の胎児
summary_ja: 眼球欠損、四肢奇形を伴う12週齢胎児の前額部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。病理学的診断により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認され、胎児眼球欠損と四肢奇形症候群と診断された。
summary_en: Case report of 12-week fetus with anophthalmia, left upper limb absence, and infratemporal teratoma measuring 4mm. Pathological investigation confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Diagnosed with fetal microphthalmia with limb anomalies.

title: Hamartomas, choristomas, and teratomas of the oral cavity: A 49-years cross-sectional study in an oral diagnostic service.
title_ja: 口腔の過誤腫、異所性組織症、奇形腫：口腔診断サービスにおける49年間の横断研究
summary_ja: 16,412件の医療記録を49年間調査した結果、300の過誤腫、2つの異所性腫瘍、1つの奇形腫類似病変が口腔領域から確認された。オドントーマが最も一般的で、異所性腫瘍と奇形腫類似病変は稀である。
summary_en: 49-year cross-sectional study of 16,412 records found 300 hamartomas (1.83%), 2 choristomas (0.01%), and 1 teratoid lesion (0.01%) in oral cavity. Odontoma most frequent hamartoma. Low occurrence of choristomatous and teratoid lesions.

title: Short tandem repeats genotyping of gestational choriocarcinoma - our experiences.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の短タンデムリピート遺伝子型判定-我々の経験
summary_ja: 短い反復配列遺伝子型検査により3例の妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の起源を同定した研究。症例1では10年前の臨床的に診断されなかった完全胞状奇胎が根拠と判明。起源の特定はFIGOスコアシステム決定に重要。
summary_en: Short tandem repeat genotyping identified origins of gestational choriocarcinoma in three cases. Case 1: choriocarcinoma originated from previously undiagnosed complete hydatidiform mole 10 years prior. Cases 2-3 confirmed clinically presumed origins.

title: Engineering human pluripotent stem cell lines to evade xenogeneic transplantation barriers.
title_ja: 異種移植の障壁を回避するためのヒト多能性幹細胞株の遺伝子改変
summary_ja: HLA遺伝子欠損と免疫回避因子発現により改変された多能性幹細胞は、T細胞、NK細胞、補体によるバリアを回避できる。これらの改変細胞は免疫能マウスにおいて永続性奇形腫を形成し、細胞治療研究に有用である。
summary_en: Genetic ablation of HLA and immune evasion factor expression in pluripotent stem cells led to persistent teratoma formation in wild-type mice despite immune barriers. Demonstrates T cell, NK cell, and complement evasion necessary for preventing immunological rejection.

title: Insights into cAMP-dependent molecular mechanisms regulating expression and function of LGALS16 gene in choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells.
title_ja: 絨毛癌JEG-3細胞におけるLGALS16遺伝子の発現と機能を調節するcAMP依存的分子メカニズムの知見
summary_ja: 絨毛膜癌JEG-3細胞におけるLGALS16遺伝子発現はcAMP依存的にp38 MAPKおよびEPAC経路を介して制御される。LGALS16は栄養膜分化と合胞体栄養膜マーカー発現に必要であり、胎盤細胞生物学に重要。
summary_en: LGALS16 gene expression in choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells is regulated by cAMP-dependent signaling through p38 MAPK and EPAC pathways. LGALS16 required for trophoblast differentiation and syncytiotrophoblast marker expression.

title: Primary embryonal carcinoma of the prostate.
title_ja: 前立腺の原発性胎児性癌
summary_ja: 24歳男性に認められた前立腺原発性胎児性癌の初報告症例。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の極めてまれな形態。患者はシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けたが、外科的切除を拒否したため、疾患再発および短期間での死亡に至った。タイムリーな外科的切除の重要性が示唆される。
summary_en: First reported case of primary embryonal carcinoma of prostate in 24-year-old male. Represents extragonadal germ cell tumor. Patient received cisplatin-based chemotherapy but refused surgical treatment, resulting in disease relapse and death.

title: Postchemotherapy Retroperitoneal Lumpectomy in Patients with Nonseminoma Testicular Cancer: A Nationwide Study.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣がん患者における化学療法後後腹膜限定切除術：全国研究
summary_ja: デンマークでの化学療法後後腹膜限定切除術を受けた219人の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者の後方視的集団ベース研究（1990-2015年）。主要罹患率は低く（5%）、10年再発率は5.9%、10年全生存期間は96%。
summary_en: Retrospective population-based study of 219 nonseminoma testicular cancer patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lumpectomy in Denmark (1990-2015). Low major morbidity (5%), 10-year recurrence rate 5.9%, 10-year overall survival 96%.

title: Carbon-coated selenium nanoparticles for photothermal therapy in choriocarcinoma cells.
title_ja: 絨毛癌細胞における光熱療法のための炭素被覆セレニウムナノ粒子
summary_ja: 炭素コーティングセレン二水化物粒子と近赤外線レーザーの組み合わせは絨毛膜癌細胞の増殖を阻害し、活性酸素産生を通じてアポトーシスを誘導する。低侵襲的光熱療法の新規治療選択肢として有望である。
summary_en: Carbon-coated selenium nanoparticles combined with near-infrared laser inhibit choriocarcinoma cell proliferation, induce apoptosis through ROS production. Shows potential for minimally invasive photothermal therapy as alternative to conventional chemotherapy.

title: Ovarian non-gestational placental site trophoblastic tumor with lung metastasis: further evidence for a distinct category of trophoblastic neoplasm.
title_ja: 肺転移を伴う卵巣非妊娠性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍：栄養膜性腫瘍の別個のカテゴリーに対する追加的証拠
summary_ja: 13歳患者の卵巣非妊娠性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)で肺への遠隔転移と軽微な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫成分を伴う症例。遠隔転移を伴う初めての症例であり、非妊娠性PSTTが胚細胞由来の別個の腫瘍として認識されるべきことを支持する。
summary_en: Case of 13-year-old with non-gestational ovarian placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with lung metastasis and minor mature cystic teratoma component. First case with distant metastasis; supports recognition of non-gestational PSTT as distinct germ cell-derived neoplasm.

title: Frequent expression of CD45RO memory T cell marker as well as low to high expression of PD-1 and PD-L1 inhibitory molecules in seminoma and dysgerminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマおよびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）におけるCD45RO記憶T細胞マーカーおよびPD-1/PD-L1阻害分子の頻繁な発現
summary_ja: セミノーマ33例およびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）31例における免疫組織化学研究。高いCD45RO浸潤；変動するPD-1/PD-L1発現は抗腫瘍反応有効性と免疫療法の可能性に影響。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of CD45RO memory T cell marker and PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitory molecules in 33 seminoma and 31 dysgerminoma patients. High CD45RO infiltration; variable PD-1/PD-L1 expression impacts anti-tumor response effectiveness and immunotherapy potential.

title: Apparent diffusion coefficient histogram in the differentiation of benign and malignant testicular tumors.
title_ja: 見かけの拡散係数ヒストグラムによる良性および悪性精巣腫瘍の鑑別
summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のMRI見かけ拡散係数ヒストグラムパラメータを用いた良性と悪性の鑑別研究。最大ADCが最も良好な鑑別能を示し、悪性腫瘍の診断における有用な画像バイオマーカーである。
summary_en: Retrospective study of apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) histogram parameters for MRI-based differentiation of 45 testicular tumors (7 benign, 39 malignant including seminoma). Maximum ADC performed best in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions.

title: Intracardiac metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の心内転移：症例報告と文献レビュー
summary_ja: 高レベルβ-hCGを伴う妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の心腔内転移症例。右房、三尖弁、右室に転移巣が位置した。多くの化学療法サイクル後も限定的な奏効で、心腔内腫瘤切除後も急速に再発し、姑息的治療に至った。
summary_en: Case of gestational choriocarcinoma with intracardiac metastasis in right atrium, tricuspid valve, and right ventricle (high β-hCG 199,060 mIU/mL). Limited response to eight chemotherapy cycles; intracardiac masses resected but rapidly recurred.

title: Giant bilateral prepubertal-type teratomas in a postpubertal patient: An illustrative case and review of the literature.
title_ja: 思春期後患者における巨大双側思春期前型奇形腫：症例報告と文献のレビュー
summary_ja: 28歳男性の両側精巣前思春期型奇形腫の症例報告。3層由来の成熟組織からなる大型の固液性腫瘤。FISH検査でi(12p)欠失がなく、長期経過にもかかわらず転移なしで良性と確認。
summary_en: Case report of bilateral testicular prepubertal-type teratomas in a 28-year-old man. Large solid-cystic masses comprised mature tissues from all three germ layers. FISH confirmed absence of i(12p), establishing benign prepubertal-type teratoma diagnosis despite lifelong tumor burden.

title: En bloc resection of an extremely giant mediastinal immature teratoma with somatic-type malignancy: A case report with a brief review of the literature.
title_ja: 体部型悪性転化を伴う極めて巨大な縦隔未熟奇形腫の一塊切除：症例報告と文献概説
summary_ja: 体部型悪性転化を伴う極めて巨大な縦隔未熟奇形腫の一塊切除症例。未熟奇形腫の悪性転化は化学療法感受性に乏しく、完全外科的切除がより良い生存をもたらす可能性がある。
summary_en: Case report of en bloc resection of a giant mediastinal immature teratoma with somatic-type malignant transformation. Demonstrates importance of complete surgical resection given poor chemotherapy sensitivity in immature teratomas with malignant somatic components.

title: Long-Term Outcomes of Infantile Sacrococcygeal Teratoma: Results from a Multi-Institutional Retrospective Observational Study in Japan.
title_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部奇形腫の長期成績：日本における多施設後方視的観察研究の結果
summary_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部奇形腫355例の多施設研究。再発は11.8%、機能障害後遺症23.4%（肛門直腸、尿路、下肢運動機能障害）。リスク因子は未熟組織学、不完全切除、手術合併症。
summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 355 infantile sacrococcygeal teratomas. Recurrence occurred in 11.8%, with 23.4% experiencing functional sequelae (anorectal, urinary, motor dysfunction). Risk factors included immature histology, incomplete resection, and surgical complications.

title: MRI findings of malignant transformation arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary: comparison with benign mature cystic teratoma.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の悪性転化のMRI所見：良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫との比較
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化と良性例のMRI所見比較。悪性転化は固形成分が大きく脂肪成分が低く、有茎性結節、不規則な辺縁、腹膜播種を認めた。
summary_en: MRI study comparing imaging features of malignant transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratomas versus benign cases. Malignant transformation showed larger solid components, lower fat occupancy, sessile solid nodules, irregular margins, and peritoneal dissemination.

title: Analysis of GATA3 and FOXA2 expression suggests that downregulation of genes involved in the maintenance of a mature yolk sac tumor phenotype may underlie sarcomatoid transformation.
title_ja: GATA3およびFOXA2発現の分析は、成熟卵黄嚢腫瘍表現型の維持に関与する遺伝子の下方制御が肉腫様転化の基礎にある可能性があることを示唆している
summary_ja: 肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍のGATA3およびFOXA2発現の免疫組織化学研究。FOXA2欠失とGATA3焦点発現が認められ、成熟表現型維持遺伝子の下制御が肉腫様化に関与することを示唆。
summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of GATA3 and FOXA2 expression in sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor postpubertal-type from testicular germ cell tumors. Sarcomatoid YSTpt showed absence of FOXA2 and focal GATA3, suggesting downregulation underlying sarcomatoid transformation.

title: Endocrine tumors of the female reproductive tract.
title_ja: 女性生殖器官の内分泌腫瘍
summary_ja: 女性生殖器官の内分泌腫瘍のレビュー。ステロイド産生腫瘍、神経内分泌新生物、ならびに卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および奇形腫に生じる甲状腺濾胞細胞増殖を含む。遺伝的易罹患症候群と転移性悪性腫瘍との鑑別を述べた。
summary_en: Review of endocrine tumors in female reproductive tract. Includes steroidogenic tumors, neuroendocrine neoplasms, and thyroid follicular proliferations arising in ovarian germ cell tumors and teratomas. Discusses genetic predisposition syndromes and distinction from metastatic disease.

title: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma: unraveling the similarities and distinctions from its gestational counterpart.
title_ja: 非妊娠性絨毛癌：その妊娠性相当物との類似点と相違点の解明
summary_ja: 妊娠性と非妊娠性絨毛癌の包括的なレビュー。非妊娠性絨毛癌は胚細胞由来または体細胞悪性腫瘍に関連。疫学、病因、臨床呈示、管理の相違を検討し、正確な診断と予後のための鑑別を強調。
summary_en: Comprehensive review distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma can be germ cell-derived or associated with somatic malignancy. Discusses epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical presentation, and management differences for accurate diagnosis and prognosis.

title: Transvaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery-assisted versus transumbilical laparoendoscopic single-site ovarian cystectomy for ovarian mature cystic teratoma. A randomized controlled trial.
title_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対する経膣自然口腔経管内視鏡手術補助と臍部腹腔鏡内視鏡単一部位卵巣嚢胞切除術の比較：無作為化対照試験
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫手術における経膣NOTES対経臍LESS術の前向きランダム化試験。経膣NOTESは手術時間が短く、術後疼痛が少なく、穿孔率が低かった。
summary_en: Randomized controlled trial comparing transvaginal NOTES versus transumbilical LESS for ovarian mature cystic teratoma cystectomy in 81 women. Transvaginal NOTES achieved shorter operative time (68 vs 85 minutes), lower postoperative pain, and lower intraoperative rupture rate.

title: Molecular and histopathological characterization of seminoma patients with highly elevated human chorionic gonadotropin levels in the serum.
title_ja: 血清で高度に上昇したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンレベルを有するセミノーマ患者の分子および病理組織学的特性
summary_ja: 極度に上昇したhCG(>1000 U/L)を示す精原細胞腫患者7人の分子および病理学的特性化。高hCGにもかかわらず純粋精原細胞腫と診断、絨毛膜絨毛下層が認められた。
summary_en: Molecular and histopathological characterization of seven seminoma patients with extraordinarily elevated serum hCG levels (>1000 U/L). Despite high hCG, tumors were diagnosed as pure seminoma with syncytiotrophoblast subpopulations by immunohistochemistry and gene expression analysis.

title: Activation of estrogen receptor induces differential proteomic responses mainly involving migration, invasion, and tumor development pathways in human testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells.
title_ja: エストロゲン受容体の活性化はヒト精巣胎児性癌NT2/D1細胞における遊走、浸潤、および腫瘍発生経路を主に含む異なるプロテオーム応答を誘導する
summary_ja: 精巣胚胎がん細胞のエストロゲン受容体効果のプロテオミクス解析。17β-エストラジオール処理により遊走、浸潤、アンカリッジ非依存的増殖が増加。
summary_en: Proteomic analysis of estrogen receptor effects on human testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. Treatment with 17β-estradiol and ERβ-selective agonist increased migration, invasion, and anchorage-independent growth, identifying potential therapeutic targets for non-seminomatous management.

title: Adjunctive Surgery Is Often Without Oncological Benefit at Time of Postchemotherapy Retroperitoneal Lymph Node Dissection.
title_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清時における補助手術はしばしば腫瘍学的利益を伴わない
summary_ja: 2施設研究：非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に補助臓器切除を受けた242例。切除臓器の22%のみが実行可能な腫瘍を含有し、39%は奇形腫、39%は壊死のみであった。補助手術の腫瘍学的利益は限定的。
summary_en: Two-center study of 242 patients undergoing adjunctive organ resection during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Only 22% of resected organs contained viable tumor; 39% had teratoma and 39% had only necrosis.

title: Unusual presentation of a seminomatous tumor of the testis by acute pyelonephritis: An exceptional case report.
title_ja: 急性腎盂腎炎による精巣セミノーマの異常な提示：例外的症例報告
summary_ja: 急性腎盂腎炎の精査中に偶然発見された精巣精原細胞腫の症例報告。精巣がんの非典型的な発症と包括的臨床検査の重要性を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma discovered incidentally during evaluation for acute pyelonephritis in a young man. Demonstrates unusual clinical presentation of testicular cancer and importance of thorough physical examination.

title: Higher prevalence of benign tumors in men with testicular tumors and history of treated cryptorchidism.
title_ja: 精巣腫瘍を有する男性と停留精巣の治療歴を有する男性における良性腫瘍の有病率の上昇
summary_ja: 435例の精巣がん患者を対象とした機関内研究で、停留精巣治療の有無による腫瘍病理を比較した。停留精巣治療経験のある患者では良性病理がより一般的（15.2% vs 4.7%）であり、混合型胚細胞腫瘍はより低率（18.2% vs 37.3%）であった。
summary_en: Institutional study of 435 testicular cancer patients comparing tumor pathology in those with versus without prior cryptorchidism treatment. Benign pathology was significantly more common in previously treated patients (15.2% vs 4.7%); mixed GCT less common (18.2% vs 37.3%).

title: Variability in Surveillance Strategies Following Resection of Sacrococcygeal Teratoma.
title_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除後の監視戦略の変動
summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除を受けた36例小児の研究：27例成熟奇形腫、8例未熟奇形腫、1例悪性胚細胞腫瘍。病理組織学的亜型別の監視戦略と再発率を検討し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)監視慣行の変動を評価した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 36 children undergoing sacrococcygeal teratoma resection: 27 mature, 8 immature, and 1 malignant GCT. Examines surveillance strategies, recurrence rates, and varying AFP monitoring practices across histopathologic subtypes.

title: Sperm mitochondria dysfunction in response to testicular cancer.
title_ja: 精巣がんに対応する精子ミトコンドリア機能障害
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の精子ミトコンドリア機能障害を検討。ATP産生、酸化的リン酸化、酸化ストレスが精巣がん関連の精子異常の基礎となるメカニズムであることを探索した。胚細胞腫瘍患者における精子品質低下の可能性を検討。
summary_en: Review examining mitochondrial dysfunction in sperm of testicular cancer patients. Explores ATP production, oxidative phosphorylation, and oxidative stress as mechanisms underlying cancer-associated sperm abnormalities in GCT patients.

title: Change in telomere length and cardiovascular risk factors in testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 精巣がん生存者におけるテロメア長と心血管危険因子の変化
summary_ja: 55例の精巣がん生存者の前向きコホート研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法後のテロメア長変化と心血管危険因子（代謝症候群、男性ホルモン低下）を治療後5年間のフォローアップで検討した。
summary_en: Prospective cohort of 55 testicular cancer survivors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Examines telomere length changes and cardiovascular risk factors including metabolic syndrome and hypogonadism over 5-year follow-up.

title: Impact of molecular genotyping on the diagnosis and treatment of human chorionic gonadotropin-producing tumors.
title_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン産生腫瘍の診断と治療に対する分子遺伝子型決定の影響
summary_ja: hCG産生腫瘍55例のモレキュラージェノタイピング有用性を検討。81.2%が妊娠関連（絨毛疾患）。分子検査は診断・治療決定・生存予測を導いた。
summary_en: Retrospective study from French Reference Center analyzing molecular genotyping of 55 hCG-producing tumors: 81.2% gestational origin, 12.7% non-gestational. Molecular testing guided diagnosis, treatment decisions, and predicted overall survival in GTD.

title: 'Testicular masquerade': a case report of testicular malignancy with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia.
title_ja: 「精巣の仮面」：持続ミュラー管症候群とtransverse testicular ectopiaを伴う精巣悪性腫瘍の症例報告
summary_ja: 48歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(主にセミノーマ)で後腹膜リンパ節転移を有する症例。持続ミュラー管症候群とtransverse testicular ectopiaに関連し、化学療法および手術で治療された。成人のPMDSとTTEは通常、術中に発見され、ectopic精巣の悪性腫瘍に関連している。
summary_en: Case report of a 48-year-old with mixed germ cell tumor (predominantly seminoma) of testis with retroperitoneal nodal metastases. Associated with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia, treated with chemotherapy and surgery.

title: In Vivo Quantitative Assessment of Gestational Choriocarcinoma Development and Progression Using Luminescent Trophoblast Cells.
title_ja: 蛍光トロホブラスト細胞を用いた妊娠性絨毛癌の発生と進行の生体内定量評価
summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌の初の原位置マウスモデル開発。JEG-3細胞を妊娠中マウス胎盤に注射。腫瘍進行と肝脾肺への転移を観察し臨床像を再現。
summary_en: First orthotopic animal model of gestational choriocarcinoma using JEG-3 luciferase cells injected into gravid mouse placenta. Studies tumor development and rapid metastasis to liver, spleen, lung, and peritoneum mimicking clinical disease progression.

title: High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation for relapsed metastatic germ cell tumors The Alberta experience.
title_ja: 再発転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する大量化学療法と自己幹細胞移植：アルバータの経験
summary_ja: 再発転移性GCT患者43例へのHDC-ASCT実施の回顧的研究。単回および二重移植の治療成績を検討。無病生存率と全生存率を評価。
summary_en: Retrospective review of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation for 43 relapsed metastatic GCT patients in Alberta. Examines disease-free and overall survival outcomes comparing second/third-line therapy and single vs. tandem transplants.

title: Increased serum creatinine associated with testicular microlithiasis in adult Japanese men: A retrospective cohort study.
title_ja: 成人日本人男性における精巣微小石灰化に関連する血清クレアチニン上昇：後方視的コホート研究
summary_ja: 828人の日本人男性における精巣微小石灰化と関連する因子を調査した後方視的コホート研究。胚細胞腫瘍の既往が有意に関連(16.7% vs 1.3%)し、血清クレアチニン値の上昇(1.04 vs 0.91 mg/dL)も関連していた。
summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 828 Japanese men examining testicular microlithiasis and associated factors. History of germ cell tumor was significantly associated (16.7% vs 1.3% controls), along with elevated serum creatinine levels.

title: Morphological Diversity of the Endometrium in Choriocarcinoma Specimens and its Role in Differential Diagnosis.
title_ja: 絨毛癌標本における子宮内膜の形態的多様性とその鑑別診断における役割
summary_ja: 絨毛癌46例の内膜形態を検討。分泌期・非分泌期パターンと臨床病理学的特性を分析。化学療法の影響とhCG受容体発現を評価。
summary_en: Histopathologic study of endometrial morphology in 46 choriocarcinoma specimens. Describes diverse secretory and proliferative changes, analyzes relationship to treatment and hCG effects, distinguishing choriocarcinoma from hydatidiform mole endometrium.

title: Overexpression of SerpinB9 in non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるSerpinB9の過剰発現
summary_ja: 28の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例におけるSerpinB9発現の免疫組織学的研究。非セミノーマにおけるSerpinB9アップレギュレーション、CD8陽性腫瘍浸潤細胞との逆相関を示し、精巣腫瘍における免疫逃避メカニズムを示唆している。
summary_en: Immunohistologic study of SerpinB9 expression in 28 testicular GCT cases. Demonstrates SerpinB9 upregulation in non-seminomas with inverse correlation to CD8-positive tumor-infiltrating cells, suggesting immune escape mechanism in testicular tumors.

title: The effect of diagnosis delay in testis cancer on tumor size, tumor stage and tumor markers.
title_ja: 精巣がんにおける診断遅延が腫瘍サイズ、腫瘍病期、および腫瘍マーカーに及ぼす影響
summary_ja: 診断遅延が腫瘍サイズ、病期、および腫瘍マーカーに及ぼす影響を検討した71名の精巣がん患者(セミノーマ39名、非セミノーマ32名)の後方視的研究。遅延は病理学的サイズ増加、αフェトプロテイン/LDH上昇、およびN病期上昇と正の相関を示した。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 71 testicular cancer patients (39 seminoma, 32 non-seminoma) examining effect of diagnostic delay on tumor size, stage, and markers. Delay positively correlated with increased pathological size, elevated AFP/LDH, and higher N stage.

title: Hepatic Metastasectomy in Pediatric Patients: An Observational Study.
title_ja: 小児患者における肝転移切除術：観察研究
summary_ja: 小児16例の肝臓転移切除を検討、GCT6例を含む。成熟奇形腫のみが検出された例も認めた。転移GCTの治療成績と安全性を評価。
summary_en: Observational study of 16 pediatric patients undergoing hepatic metastasectomy, including 6 with germ cell tumors. Some GCT metastases revealed only mature teratoma, guiding adjuvant therapy. Examines safety and utility of hepatectomy for metastatic pediatric malignancies.

title: Intraplacental Gestational Neoplasms: A Review of Clinically Relevant Diagnostically Challenging Lesions.
title_ja: 胎盤内妊娠性腫瘍：臨床的に関連のある診断的に困難な病変のレビュー
summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜上皮腫瘍スペクトラムの子宮内病変についてのレビュー。診断特性、分子生物学的ツール、予後因子を論述。子宮内絨毛膜癌は無症状から広範転移まで多様な臨床像を示す。
summary_en: Reviews intraplacental gestational choriocarcinoma and chorangiocarcinoma, rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasms affecting mothers and fetuses. Discusses diagnostic features, molecular tools, and prognostic factors. IPCs range from asymptomatic to widely metastatic with potential for metastasis even with microscopic disease.

title: Detection of Recurrence through microRNA-371a-3p Serum Levels in a Follow-up of Stage I Testicular Germ Cell Tumors in the DRKS-00019223 Study.
title_ja: DRKS-00019223研究における病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップにおけるマイクロRNA-371a-3p血清レベルを通じた再発の検出
summary_ja: 258名の病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において中央値18ヶ月フォローアップされた再発検出のための血清マイクロRNA-371a-3pを評価。M371テストは100%感度および96.3%特異度を達成し、従来診断法を著しく上回る。しかし、術後M371レベルは将来の再発を予測しなかった。
summary_en: Evaluates serum microRNA-371a-3p for detecting relapses in 258 stage I testicular GCT patients followed for median 18 months. M371 test achieved 100% sensitivity and 96.3% specificity, significantly outperforming conventional diagnostics. However, postoperative M371 levels did not predict future relapse.

title: Impact of pain and adverse health outcomes on long-term US testicular cancer survivors.
title_ja: 長期米国精巣がん生存者における疼痛および悪性健康転帰の影響
summary_ja: シスプラチン化学療法後の精巣がん生存者358名における長期健康害を調査。神経障害性疼痛、糖尿病、肥満、疲労が生活の質に有意な悪影響を与えることを明らかにした。
summary_en: Examines long-term health impacts in 358 testicular cancer survivors receiving cisplatin (median 10.7 years post-treatment). Identifies chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain, diabetes, obesity, and fatigue as significant factors reducing global mental and physical health outcomes.

title: Low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia - 20 years experience of a state registry.
title_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍 - 州レジストリの20年間の経験
journal: Aust N Z J Obstet Gynaecol
summary_ja: 低リスクGTN 115名の20年間レジストリ研究。メトトレキサート単剤療法で77%が完全奏効。WHO危険度スコア5-6と高いhCGは治療抵抗性と関連。再発率4.3%。
summary_en: 20-year registry study of 115 low-risk GTN patients with 100% survival. 77% achieved complete response to methotrexate monotherapy. WHO risk scores 5-6 and elevated pretreatment hCG associated with higher treatment resistance. Relapse rate 4.3% with successful salvage therapy.

title: Peripubertal Presentation of Metastatic Testicular Mixed, Nonseminomatous Germ Cell Tumor.
title_ja: 転移性精巣混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の思春期周辺期プレゼンテーション
summary_ja: 思春期周辺における稀な転移性精巣混合型非精上皮胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。通常と異なる低年齢での広範転移を示す。
summary_en: Case report of rare peripubertal mixed nonseminomatous testicular GCT with widespread metastases at presentation, classified as poor-risk disease. Highlights unusual presentation in younger patients compared to typical postpubertal presentation.

title: Prognostic Factor Risk Groups for Clinical Stage I Seminoma: An Individual Patient Data Analysis by the European Association of Urology Testicular Cancer Guidelines Panel and Guidelines Office.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマの予後因子リスク群：患者個別データ分析
summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者1016例の患者個別データ分析における新しいリスク層別化の提案。腫瘍サイズ、精巣網浸潤、リンパ管侵襲に基づく3段階リスク群で、5年累積再発確率は低リスク8%、中間リスク20%、高リスク44%を報告。
summary_en: Individual patient data analysis of 1016 stage I seminoma patients identifying prognostic factors. Proposes new risk stratification based on tumor size, rete testis invasion, and lymphovascular invasion with 5-year relapse probabilities: low-risk 8%, intermediate 20%, high-risk 44%.

title: Testicular cancer in 2023: Current status and recent progress.
title_ja: 2023年の精巣がん：現在の状況と最近の進歩
summary_ja: 思春期・若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍管理に関する総説。治療成績の50年間での劇的改善（25%から80%）と化学療法耐性疾患への対応を論述。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular GCT management in adolescents and young adults. Discusses treatment advances improving cure rates from 25% in 1970s to nearly 80%. Addresses toxicity, relapsed disease, and platinum-refractory disease management.

title: Testicular Mixed Teratoma and Yolk Sac Tumor, Prepubertal Type: A Case Report with Summary of Prior Published Cases.
title_ja: 精巣混合型奇形腫および卵黄嚢腫瘍、思春期前型：症例報告および過去に公開されたケースの要約
summary_ja: 思春期前精巣の成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な混合型の18ヶ月男児症例。AFP上昇。思春期前での成熟奇形腫との組み合わせは報告例が極めて少ない。
summary_en: Case of 18-month-old with prepubertal testicular mixed teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Elevated serum AFP (2200 ng/ml). Rare combination of mature teratoma with yolk sac tumor in prepubertal testis with only one prior published case.

title: Robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection: Initial experience in Japan.
title_ja: ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清：日本での初期経験
summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫と後腹膜リンパ節転移に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の日本初報告。小侵襲手術の安全性と有効性を示す。
summary_en: First reported robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) in Japan for 32-year-old with testicular teratoma and para-aortic lymph node metastases. Demonstrates R-RPLND as safe and effective minimally invasive alternative to open RPLND.

title: Evaluation of a miRNA-371a-3p Assay for Predicting Final Histopathology in Patients Undergoing Primary Nerve-sparing Retroperitoneal Lymphadenectomy for Stage IIA/B Seminoma or Nonseminoma.
title_ja: セミノーマまたは非セミノーマの病期IIA/Bで神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受ける患者における最終病理組織学を予測するためのmiRNA-371a-3pアッセイの評価
summary_ja: マーカー陰性ステージIIA/Bの精巣胚細胞腫瘍24名でマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリンパ節転移予測を検証。感度90.9%、陽性適中率100%。不必要な治療回避に有用。
summary_en: Evaluates miR-371a-3p predictive accuracy in 24 marker-negative stage IIA/B TGCT patients for identifying lymph node metastases. miR371 showed 90.9% sensitivity and 100% positive predictive value, useful for avoiding unnecessary treatment and associated toxicity.

title: Study of neoadjuvant chemotherapy in advanced malignant ovarian germ cell tumors at a tertiary center in western India.
title_ja: インド西部の三次医療センターにおける進行性悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する新補助化学療法の研究
summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍30名の導入化学療法に関する研究。内胚葉腺腫瘍と顆粒層膜細胞腫が大多数。42ヶ月で67%が無病生存。18名で生殖温存手術施行。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 30 malignant ovarian GCT patients receiving neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Majority had endodermal sinus tumor or dysgerminoma. 67% disease-free survivors at median 42-month follow-up with successful fertility-sparing surgery in 18 patients.

title: MicroRNAs for detecting occult genitourinary cancer.
title_ja: 潜在性泌尿器がん検出のためのマイクロRNA
summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の液体生検バイオマーカーとしてのマイクロRNAのレビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではmiR-371a-3pが臨床応用の最終段階に。
summary_en: Reviews microRNAs as liquid biopsy biomarkers for genitourinary malignancies. Testicular GCTs have specific target miR-371a-3p with high sensitivity and specificity, approaching clinical implementation. Other GU cancers remain in earlier biomarker development stages.

title: Predictors of the development of febrile neutropenia in chemotherapy for advanced germ cell tumors.
title_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法における発熱性好中球減少症の発症予測因子
summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍80名の化学療法267サイクル分析。高年齢、腎機能低下、第1サイクルが発熱性好中球減少症の独立予測因子として同定。
summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 80 advanced GCT patients (267 chemotherapy cycles). Identified older age (≥36 years), renal dysfunction (CCr <70), and first chemotherapy cycle as independent predictive factors for febrile neutropenia (15% incidence).

title: Application of microRNAs in the diagnosis and monitoring of pediatric germ cell tumors: Kazakh experience.
title_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍の診断と監視におけるマイクロRNAの応用：カザフスタンの経験
summary_ja: 小児頭外胚細胞腫瘍20名でマイクロRNA9種を検討。miR367、371、372、373、302dの臨床的有用性を確認。miR375-3pは悪性GCTと奇形腫で発現なし。
summary_en: Study of 20 pediatric extracranial GCT cases examining 9 microRNAs (clusters 302/367, 371-373, 375). miR 367, 371, 372, 373, 302d showed high clinical utility for malignant GCT diagnosis and monitoring. miR 375-3p not expressed in malignant GCT or teratomas.

title: Strong apoptotic response of testis tumor cells following cisplatin treatment.
title_ja: シスプラチン処置後の精巣腫瘍細胞における強いアポトーシス応答
summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞のシスプラチン高感受性の分子メカニズムを検証。p53誘導、プロアポトーティックタンパク上昇、ミトコンドリア・Fas/FasL経路の二重活性化を確認。
summary_en: Investigates cisplatin-induced apoptotic pathways in testicular GCT cells versus cisplatin-resistant bladder cancer cells. Shows p53 induction, elevated pro-apoptotic Bax/Noxa, and dual mitochondrial and Fas/FasL-mediated apoptotic activation explaining unique cisplatin sensitivity of testicular GCT.

title: A Phase II Basket Trial of Dual Anti-CTLA-4 and Anti-PD-1 Blockade in Rare Tumors (DART SWOG 1609 Cohort 47) in Patients with Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia.
title_ja: 稀な腫瘍における二重抗CTLA-4および抗PD-1阻害（DART SWOG 1609コホート47）の第II相バスケット試験：妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者におけるDARTトライアル
summary_ja: 化学療法耐性GTN患者4名に対するイピリムマブとニボルマブ併用試験。奏効率75%。6ヶ月無増悪生存率75%。毒性は忍容範囲内。
summary_en: Phase II trial of dual checkpoint blockade (ipilimumab plus nivolumab) in 4 patients with chemotherapy-refractory GTN. Overall response rate 75% (1 CR, 2 PRs) in gestational choriocarcinoma and malignant GTN. 6-month PFS 75% with manageable toxicity profile.

title: KLHL11 antibody-associated autoimmune encephalomyelitis in a middle-aged female patient: a case report and literature review.
title_ja: 中年女性患者におけるKLHL11抗体関連自己免疫性脳脊髄炎：症例報告および文献レビュー
summary_ja: KLHL11抗体関連腫瘍随伴神経症候群の症例報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する新規バイオマーカー。小脳・脳幹病変と早期治療の重要性を論述。
summary_en: Case report of KLHL11 antibody-associated paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis. KLHL11 recently identified as biomarker for paraneoplastic neurological syndromes in GCT patients, particularly seminoma. Reviews cerebellar and brainstem involvement with emphasis on early diagnosis and treatment.

title: Extracranial germ cell tumours: Mature and immature (1990-2015). First report by the South African Association of Paediatric Haematology Oncology (SAAPHO).
title_ja: 頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍：成熟および未熟（1990-2015年）。南アフリカ小児血液腫瘍学会（SAAPHO）による最初の報告
summary_ja: 南アフリカの小児成熟奇形腫60名と未熟奇形腫40名の転帰研究（1990-2015）。5年生存率85.4%、ステージに大きく依存。完全切除率高し。標準化ガイドラインの必要性提唱。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 60 mature and 40 immature extracranial teratoma cases in South African children (1990-2015). 5-year overall survival 85.4%, highly stage-dependent (Stage I 96.9%, Stage III 38.9%). High complete resection rates. Highlights need for standardized treatment guidelines.

title: Effect of Aprepitant on Etoposide Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Testicular Cancer: A Pharmacokinetic Study to Determine the Absence of a Clinically Relevant Interaction.
title_ja: 精巣がん患者におけるエトポシド薬物動態に対するアプレピタントの効果:臨床的に関連性のある相互作用の欠如を決定するための薬物動態研究
summary_ja: 精巣がん患者12例の一次化学療法におけるエトポシド-アプレピタント相互作用の薬物動態研究。臨床的に関連性のある相互作用なく、両薬剤とも安全に併用でき、AUCおよび最大血漿濃度に影響なし。
summary_en: Pharmacokinetic study evaluating etoposide-aprepitant interaction in 12 testicular cancer patients receiving first-line chemotherapy. No clinically relevant interaction was found; AUC and Cmax values were similar with and without aprepitant, confirming safe co-administration of both drugs.

title: Prognostic Differences Between Surveillance and Active Treatment After Initial Orchiectomy in Patients With Stage I Mixed Germ Cell Tumors of the Testis: A Propensity Score Matching Analysis.
title_ja: 初期精巣摘除術後の精巣病期I混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者における監視と積極的治療の予後の違い:傾向スコアマッチング分析
summary_ja: 病期I精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者5,743例の大規模後方視的研究。監視および化学療法率は時間とともに増加、RPLND使用は低下。RPLND群は化学療法群と比較してがん特異的死亡率が有意に低い。
summary_en: Large retrospective study of 5,743 stage I testicular mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing surveillance versus active treatment (chemotherapy/RPLND). Surveillance and chemotherapy rates increased over time while RPLND use declined. RPLND showed significantly lower cancer-specific mortality than chemotherapy in active treatment cohorts.

title: Extragonadal Germ Cell Tumors: A Single Institution Experience with Clinicopathological Correlation.
title_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍：単一施設の臨床病理学的相関を伴う経験
summary_ja: 56例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者（男性60%、女性40%）の臨床病理学的分析。一般的な部位：縦隔（45%）、仙骨尾骨部（18%）、後腹膜（14%）。組織型は成熟奇形腫（34%）、混合型胚細胞腫瘍（27%）、セミノーマ/ジャーミノーマ（12%）を含む。白金製剤併用化学療法は有意に予後を改善した。
summary_en: Clinical-pathological analysis of 56 extragonadal germ cell tumor cases (60% male, 40% female). Common sites: mediastinum (45%), sacrococcyx (18%), retroperitoneum (14%). Histologies included mature teratoma (34%), mixed germ cell tumor (27%), seminoma/germinoma (12%), yolk sac tumor (11%). Platinum-based chemotherapy significantly improved outcomes.

title: Extragonadal recurrence of benign mature teratoma in the pouch of Douglas.
title_ja: ダグラス窩における性腺外良性成熟奇形腫の再発
summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の腹腔内播種後、26年後にダグラス窩に再発した症例。腹腔内溢出物の完全な除去の重要性を強調し、再発予防の手術技法を提唱。
summary_en: Case report of benign mature teratoma recurrence in pouch of Douglas 26 years after bilateral ovarian cystectomy. Recurrent lesion was firmly adherent to peritoneal tissues despite normal ovaries. Emphasizes importance of intraoperative irrigation to remove spilled tumor contents and prevent extragonadal recurrence.

title: From National to International Collaboration in Gestational Trophoblastic Disease: Hurdles and Possibilities.
title_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患における国内から国際的協働へ：障害と可能性
summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜疾患の国家・国際的管理における連携のレビュー。専門センター設置と組織的管理体制が良好な予後に直結。国際的協力が治療プロトコル最適化と生存率向上に不可欠。
summary_en: Review of national and international collaboration in gestational trophoblastic disease management. Established expert GTD centers and organized national systems achieve superior disease outcomes. Emphasizes importance of international collaboration for optimizing management protocols and improving survival rates across income levels.

title: Adolescent and Young Adult Germ Cell Tumors: Epidemiology, Genomics, Treatment, and Survivorship.
title_ja: 思春期および若年成人胚細胞腫瘍：疫学、ゲノム学、治療、および生存者
summary_ja: 思春期および若年成人における胚細胞腫瘍（精巣および卵巣）は最も一般的な悪性腫瘍。シスプラチン併用化学療法で優れた転帰を達成するが、晩期有害事象軽減のため新治療法開発が急務。悪性胚細胞腫瘍国際コンソーシアムが16か国115名以上専門家参加、分子的リスク層別化と精密腫瘍学試験を展開中。
summary_en: Comprehensive review of adolescent and young adult germ cell tumors (testicular and ovarian), the most common malignancies in this age group. Discusses innovations including collaborative clinical trials across pediatric/gynecologic/genitourinary specialties, molecular risk stratification, and precision oncology. The Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium coordinates efforts across 16 countries and 115+ experts.

title: Comparative cost-effectiveness of contemporary treatment strategies for stage IIA seminoma.
title_ja: 病期IIAセミノーマに対する現代的治療戦略の費用効果比較
summary_ja: セミノーマ stage IIA の治療戦略（RPLND、化学療法、放射線療法）の費用対効果分析。RPLND が最も費用対効果的。放射線療法と化学療法は高コストと慢性毒性による利益喪失が大きい。
summary_en: Cost-effectiveness analysis comparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), radiotherapy, and chemotherapy for stage IIA seminoma. RPLND was most cost-effective at lifetime horizon ($58,469/patient, 40.61 QALYs) versus radiotherapy ($98,783, 40.70 QALYs) and chemotherapy ($104,096, 39.15 QALYs). RPLND advantage driven by lower toxicity-related costs.

title: Orbital and paranasal sinuses changes after neonatal orbital exenteration for massive teratoma management.
title_ja: 巨大奇形腫管理のための新生児眼窩摘除後の眼窩および副鼻腔の変化
summary_ja: 新生児眼窩奇形腫に対する眼窩摘出術の長期管理症例。眼窩尖端での骨硬化症と副鼻腔の過度な気化を4年にわたり観察。発育過程での複雑な骨変化を示唆。
summary_en: Case report of neonatal orbital teratoma management via lid and conjunctiva-sparing orbital exenteration with temporalis muscle rotation and dermis-fat graft. Sequential postoperative imaging over 4 years showed progressive hyperostosis in orbital apex and over-pneumatization of paranasal sinuses, demonstrating complex developmental bony changes.

title: The Irish Experience with Sacrococcygeal Teratomas: Are Type IV Lesions More Common than We Think?
title_ja: アイルランドにおける仙尾部奇形腫の経験：第IV型病変はわれわれが考えるより一般的か？
summary_ja: アイルランドの仙骨尾骨奇形腫29例の研究。成熟奇形腫76%、未熟奇形腫7%、悪性腫瘍17%。Type IV が28% と Altman 分類より頻度が高く、再評価の必要性を提案。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 29 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients in Ireland (2004-2020), predominantly female (79%). Histology: 22 mature (76%), 2 immature (7%), 5 malignant (17%). Type IV (completely presacral) lesions present in 28% versus 10% in Altman's original series, suggesting Type IV prevalence may be underestimated.

title: Genomic analysis of spermatocytic tumors demonstrates recurrent molecular alterations in cases with malignant clinical behavior.
title_ja: 精子細胞腫瘍の遺伝子解析：悪性臨床転帰を示す症例における反復的な分子異常の実証
summary_ja: 精巣精子細胞腫瘍27例のゲノム解析。2つのサブグループ（diploid RAS/RAF変異型と核分裂相変化型）を同定。悪性転帰は TP53 変異と 12p 領域のゲイン関連で、肉腫様転化と関連。
summary_en: Genomic analysis of 27 spermatocytic tumor samples identifying molecular features predicting aggressive behavior. Found two genomic subgroups: diploid with RAS/RAF hotspot mutations and ploidy-shifted without recurrent mutations. Aggressive behavior associated with TP53 mutations and 12p gains; sarcomatoid transformation linked to TP53 mutations.

title: Fertility-sparing approach to malignant ovarian germ cell tumors - Oncologic and obstetric outocome: A retrospective study.
title_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存アプローチ - 腫瘍学的および産科的転帰：後方視的研究
summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者70人（中央値22.5歳）の妊孕性温存手術後方視的研究（フォローアップ92ヶ月）。未熟奇形腫が最多（32.9%）、両側侵襲稀（1.4%）。5年無病生存/全生存期間(全生存率)：未熟奇形腫91.1%/95.7%、ディスジャーミノーマ94.1%/100%、卵黄嚢82.4%/88.2%。妊娠試行者34人中23人（67.6%）が妊娠成功。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 70 fertility-sparing surgery patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, median age 22.5 years (92-month follow-up). Immature teratoma most common (32.9%), bilateral involvement rare (1.4%). 5-year DFS/OS rates: immature teratoma (91.1%/95.7%), dysgerminoma (94.1%/100%), yolk sac (82.4%/88.2%). 67.6% (23/34) attempting conception achieved pregnancy.

title: New Findings in the Multidisciplinary Management of a Fetal Intrapericardial Teratoma: A Case Report.
title_ja: 胎児心膜内奇形腫の多学科的管理における新知見：症例報告
summary_ja: 胎児心嚢内奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠31週で腫瘍著明増大、胎児腹水・心嚢液貯留。母体ベタメタゾン投与で改善し、妊娠33週で帝王切開・胎児心臓手術施行。良好な転帰。
summary_en: Case report of fetal intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally in second trimester. At 31 weeks, tumor enlargement with fetal ascites and pericardial effusion prompted delivery planning. Maternal low-dose betamethasone therapy reduced fetal ascites and extended gestation to 33 weeks. Neonate underwent ex utero intrapartum treatment and cardiac surgery with good outcome.

title: Clinical Outcomes of De Novo Versus Relapsed Early Metastatic Testicular Seminoma Treated With Contemporary Radiation Therapy.
title_ja: 現代放射線療法で治療された初発および再発早期転移性精巣セミノーマの臨床転帰
journal: Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys
summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ stage II に対する放射線療法73例の検討。de novo CS-II 38例、再発 CS-II 35例。5年無再発生存率は再発例92%、de novo 例73%。全再発が照射野外で、疾患特異的生存率100%。
summary_en: Retrospective review of 73 testicular seminoma patients (CS-II stage) treated with modern radiation therapy (2001-2022). De novo CS-II: 38 patients; relapsed CS-II: 35 patients. 5-year RFS: 92% relapsed versus 73% de novo. All recurrences out-of-field; no in-field failures. Disease-specific survival 100%. Two secondary malignancies noted.

title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Early-Stage Testicular Cancer: AUA Guideline Amendment 2023.
title_ja: 早期精巣がんの診断および治療：AUAガイドライン修正版2023
summary_ja: 2023年修正版AUAガイドラインで早期精巣がんの診断および治療をまとめた。1980年1月から2023年3月の文献を体系的にレビュー。画像検査、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ管理、臨床病期Iサーベイランス、サバイバーシップをカバー。強度評価（A/B/C）で臨床意思決定をガイド。
summary_en: Updated AUA guideline for early-stage testicular cancer diagnosis and treatment (2023 amendment). Systematic literature review (January 1980-March 2023) with evidence-based recommendations. Covers imaging, seminoma and non-seminoma management, stage I surveillance strategies, and survivorship. Strength ratings (A/B/C) guide clinical decision-making.

title: Laparoscopic management of ovarian cysts during pregnancy under urgent situations.
title_ja: 緊急状況下での妊娠中の卵巣嚢胞の腹腔鏡的管理
summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣嚢胞に対する緊急腹腔鏡下手術48例。成熟奇形腫が最多病理診断。平均手術時間45分、全例成功で胎児母体合併症なし。全例37週以上で妊娠継続。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 48 urgent laparoscopic surgeries for ovarian cysts during pregnancy (first/second trimesters). Ovarian torsion most common indication; mature teratoma most frequently identified pathology. Mean operative time 45 minutes with successful completion in all cases, no fetal-maternal complications. All pregnancies continued beyond 37 weeks.

title: Advanced ovarian yolk sac tumor: upfront surgery or neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by interval debulking?
title_ja: 進行卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍：初期手術か術前化学療法に続く間隔減量手術か？
summary_ja: III～IV病期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍および混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者40人の後方視的研究。術前化学療法+間隔減量（n=19）対初期減量手術（n=21）。3年DFS/OSに差なし。術前群は出血少ない（328対1286 mL）、輸血量少ない（1044対3067 mL）、周術期合併症少ない。
summary_en: Retrospective study of 40 stage III-IV ovarian yolk sac and mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing neoadjuvant chemotherapy + interval debulking (n=19) versus primary debulking surgery (n=21). No difference in 3-year DFS/OS. Neoadjuvant group had less blood loss (328 vs. 1286 mL), lower transfusion needs (1044 vs. 3067 mL), and fewer perioperative complications.

title: Prognostic Factors for Relapse in Patients With Clinical Stage I Testicular Seminoma: A Nationwide, Population-Based Cohort Study.
title_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマにおける再発の予後因子：全国人口ベースコホート研究
summary_ja: デンマーク臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者924人の研究。精巣網侵襲、リンパ管侵襲、上昇β-hCG、LDHが独立的再発予測因子。5年再発リスクはリスク因子なしで6%、全因子合併時で62%。予後モデルは臨床意思決定を改善する可能性。
summary_en: Study of 924 Danish patients with clinical stage I seminoma identifies prognostic factors for relapse including rete testis invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and elevated β-hCG and LDH. A prognostic model showed 5-year relapse risk ranging from 6% to 62% based on risk factor combinations, potentially improving clinical decision-making for risk-adapted treatment strategies.

title: Insulin-like Factor 3, Basal and Human Chorionic Gonadotropin-Stimulated Testosterone as Biomarkers to Predict the Effect of Testosterone Replacement in Testicular Cancer Survivors With Mild Leydig Cell Insufficiency.
title_ja: インスリン様因子3およびhCG刺激テストステロンによる精巣がん生存者のテストステロン補充療法の効果予測
summary_ja: 軽度ライディヒ細胞不全を有する精巣がん生存者69人のランダム化研究。低INSL3およびhCG刺激テストステロン患者はテストステロン補充療法後に脂肪量が減少。これらのバイオマーカーはテストステロン置換の恩恵患者を特定するのに役立つ可能性がある。
